title.zh: 人类定居萨胡尔大陆

summary.zh: 约五万年前，人类已经抵达当时连为一体的澳大利亚与新几内亚大陆。即使在海平面较低的冰期，这段旅程也需要跨越海峡。抵达后的群体逐渐适应海岸、森林和内陆环境，形成延续至今的原住民文化传统，为理解人类早期航海与环境适应提供了重要线索。
summary.en: By roughly 50,000 years ago, people had reached Sahul, the landmass joining Australia and New Guinea. Crossing the intervening seas required maritime skills even during periods of low sea level. Communities subsequently adapted to coastal, forest and inland environments, beginning a long history of Indigenous life that illuminates early seafaring and human environmental adaptation.

significance.zh: 将澳大利亚原住民历史置于深远的人类迁徙与文化发展之中。
significance.en: Connects Aboriginal Australian history with the deep history of human migration and cultural development.

sources.title: aws-digital-classroom.nma.gov.au — Human settlement of Sahul

editorialNotes.zh: 早期定居年代仍有分歧；这里用约五万年前作为保守的时间锚点，更早的考古年代亦有研究支持。
editorialNotes.en: The timing of early settlement remains debated. Roughly 50,000 years ago is used as a conservative chronological anchor; research also supports earlier dates.

title.zh: 梅多克罗夫特岩棚与美洲早期居住证据
title.en: Meadowcroft Rockshelter and evidence for early habitation in the Americas

summary.zh: 梅多克罗夫特岩棚位于宾夕法尼亚州西部，俯瞰俄亥俄河支流。放射性碳测年显示人类居住可能始于约1.6万年前（约前14000年），甚至可能早至1.9万年前（约前17000年）；遗址保存了北美东部最丰富的动植物遗存之一，并延续有古印第安、古代与林地时期文化层。
summary.en: Meadowcroft Rockshelter in western Pennsylvania overlooks a tributary of the Ohio River. Radiocarbon dating indicates occupation beginning about 16,000 years ago (roughly 14,000 BCE) and possibly as early as 19,000 years ago (roughly 17,000 BCE); the site preserves one of the richest plant and animal assemblages in eastern North America, with Paleoindian, Archaic and Woodland layers above.

significance.zh: 若早期年代成立，梅多克罗夫特支持人类在克洛维斯之前已进入美洲的论点。
significance.en: If the early dates hold, Meadowcroft supports human entry into the Americas before Clovis.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Meadowcroft Rockshelter（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 早期年代仍有争议：2013年一项调查显示38%的考古学家支持、20%反对，质疑集中在煤系地层古碳污染的可能；本条并列保留1.6万年与1.9万年两种估计，不把争议年代写成确定事实。
editorialNotes.en: The early dates remain controversial: a 2013 survey found 38% of archaeologists supportive and 20% opposed, with criticism focusing on possible ancient-carbon contamination from coal-bearing strata; both the 16,000-year and 19,000-year estimates are retained without presenting a disputed date as settled.

title.zh: 绳文社会与陶器传统

summary.zh: 冰期结束前后，日本列岛出现早期绳文陶器，居民以狩猎、采集和渔捞获取食物，并逐渐形成较稳定的聚落。陶器用于储存与加工食物，贝冢、墓葬和仪式遗物则留下了日常生活与精神世界的痕迹。绳文社会在漫长岁月中不断变化，展现了农业国家之外丰富的社会发展路径。
summary.en: Early Jōmon pottery appeared in the Japanese archipelago around the end of the last ice age. Hunting, gathering and fishing supported communities that increasingly lived in settled villages. Pottery, shell middens, burials and ritual objects preserve evidence of both everyday life and shared beliefs, revealing varied forms of social complexity beyond the development of agricultural states.

significance.zh: 丰富了对定居生活、技术与社会复杂性之间关系的认识。
significance.en: Broadens understanding of how settled life, technology and social complexity developed.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Jōmon societies and pottery

editorialNotes.zh: 前14000年是绳文文化早期分期的约略起点，各地陶器和聚落的发展时间有所不同。
editorialNotes.en: 14000 BCE is an approximate opening date for early Jōmon chronology; pottery and settlement developed at different times across the archipelago.

title.zh: 蒙特韦尔德的人类居住证据

summary.zh: 智利南部的蒙特韦尔德遗址保存了约一万四千八百年前的木构、植物食物、工具和动物遗存。潮湿环境让许多容易腐烂的材料得以留存，使研究者能够重建居民利用森林、河流和海岸资源的生活。这些发现拓宽了美洲早期定居的时间框架，也推动了对人类迁徙方式的重新讨论。
summary.en: Monte Verde in southern Chile preserves wooden structures, plant foods, tools and animal remains from human occupation roughly 14,800 years ago. Wet conditions protected materials that usually decay, offering an unusually detailed view of how people used forest, river and coastal resources. The discoveries expanded the chronology of early American settlement and renewed debate about migration into the continent.

significance.zh: 为研究美洲早期居民的生活和迁徙提供了关键考古证据。
significance.en: Provides crucial archaeological evidence for the lives and movements of early American populations.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Human occupation at Monte Verde

editorialNotes.zh: 年代依据所引遗产提名材料，换算为约前12800年；不同研究对具体层位的年代估计略有差异。
editorialNotes.en: The date follows the cited heritage nomination and is rounded to about 12800 BCE; estimates vary somewhat between studies and archaeological layers.

title.zh: 和平文化：东南亚大陆的狩猎采集传统
title.en: The Hoabinhian: hunter-gatherer traditions in mainland Southeast Asia

summary.zh: 和平文化是东南亚大陆从更新世晚期到全新世的石器技术传统，年代约为公元前10000年至前2000年，通常与当地的狩猎采集社会相联系。遗存以砾石打制工具为特征，越南北部的北山文化被看作其中较晚的变体，年代约在公元前8000年至前4000年。2016年在中国云南发现的同类石器组合，把这一技术传统的分布进一步向北延伸。
summary.en: The Hoabinhian is a lithic techno-complex of mainland Southeast Asia from the late Pleistocene to the Holocene, dated to about 10,000–2000 BCE and associated with hunter-gatherer societies. Its assemblages are characterised by flaked cobble tools, and the Bacsonian of northern Vietnam is regarded as a later variant dated to about 8000–4000 BCE. A comparable assemblage recognised in Yunnan in 2016 extended the tradition's known range further north.

significance.zh: 和平文化记录了东南亚大陆在农业出现之前的长期狩猎采集适应。
significance.en: The Hoabinhian records long-term hunter-gatherer adaptation in mainland Southeast Asia before farming.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Hoabinhian（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 该术语最初指特定人群与时期，后来的研究把它扩展为技术复合体；云南遗址的年代（距今约41500年）远早于东南亚主体年代，本条只用后者作为概括时段。
editorialNotes.en: The term once denoted a specific people and period and is now used for a techno-complex; the Yunnan shelter dates to about 41,500 BCE, far earlier than the Southeast Asian mainstream, so only the latter frames this entry's range.

title.zh: 农业的多中心起源与定居社会
title.en: The multiple origins of farming and sedentary societies

summary.zh: 全新世开始后，即约1.17万年前起，植物与动物的驯化在西亚、东亚、非洲、美洲等若干地区分别出现，而不是从一个中心向外扩散。各地狩猎采集社群在长期观察和试验中发展出作物栽培、家畜饲养、陶器、磨制石器与定居村落。到约公元前4500年，两河流域南部出现已知最早的城市文明，并随之进入青铜时代。
summary.en: After the beginning of the Holocene, about 11,700 years ago, the domestication of plants and animals appeared separately in western Asia, East Asia, Africa and the Americas rather than spreading from one centre. Hunting and gathering communities developed crop cultivation, animal husbandry, pottery, polished stone tools and settled villages through long observation and experiment. By about 4500 BCE the earliest known urban civilisation emerged in southern Mesopotamia.

significance.zh: 多中心起源说明农业社会并非单一路径，而是不同环境下的多次选择。
significance.en: Multiple origins show that farming societies followed several paths rather than a single route.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Neolithic Revolution（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 各地区的驯化时间差异很大，本条以全新世开始（约1.17万年前）到两河流域最早城市文明（约公元前4500年）为概括范围，不表示全球同步，也不把某一遗址当作唯一发源地。
editorialNotes.en: Regional dates differ widely; the range runs from the start of the Holocene (about 11,700 years ago) to the earliest urban civilisation in Mesopotamia (about 4500 BCE) and neither implies global synchrony nor treats one site as the sole origin.

title.zh: 哥贝克力石阵的纪念性建造

summary.zh: 安纳托利亚东南部的哥贝克力石阵建于前陶新石器时代，巨大的石柱围成建筑空间，柱面刻有动物和抽象符号。连续的建造与改造需要组织劳动力，也凝聚了群体共享的仪式观念。遗址形成于定居与农业转型的年代，使宗教活动、社会协作和食物生产之间的关系成为新的研究焦点。
summary.en: At Göbekli Tepe in southeastern Anatolia, communities of the Pre-Pottery Neolithic built monumental enclosures with stone pillars carved with animals and abstract imagery. Successive construction phases required organised labour and expressed shared ritual practices. Emerging during the transition toward more settled life and farming, the site has reshaped discussion of the connections among belief, cooperation and food production.

significance.zh: 揭示早期群体通过大型仪式建筑组织合作的能力。
significance.en: Reveals the capacity of early communities to organise cooperation through monumental ritual construction.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Monumental construction at Göbekli Tepe

title.zh: 恰塔霍裕克：安纳托利亚的新石器聚落
title.en: Çatalhöyük: a Neolithic settlement in Anatolia

summary.zh: 恰塔霍裕克位于安纳托利亚南部科尼亚平原，是一处大型新石器时代与铜石并用时代土丘聚落，约公元前7500年至前5600年有人居住，约公元前7000年达到繁盛。房屋密集相连，聚落内部少见街道，居民以农业、畜牧与手工制作为生，其规模与社会组织是研究早期永久定居的重要材料。
summary.en: Çatalhöyük is a large Neolithic and Chalcolithic tell settlement on the Konya plain in southern Anatolia, occupied from about 7500 to 5600 BCE and flourishing around 7000 BCE. Houses were packed closely together with few streets inside the settlement, and residents lived from farming, herding and craft production; its scale and social organisation are key evidence for early permanent settlement.

significance.zh: 恰塔霍裕克是理解早期永久定居与社会组织的关键遗址。
significance.en: Çatalhöyük is a key site for understanding early permanent settlement and social organisation.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Çatalhöyük（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 经团队转述读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 约前7500—前5600年为概括时段，约前7000年为繁盛期；不主张逐年连续占居，也不指定单一建城或废弃年份。2012年7月列入世界遗产。“出入多经屋顶”一说本轮未获第二个来源复核，未写入正文。
editorialNotes.en: The c. 7500–5600 BCE range is an overview with a peak around 7000 BCE; no continuous annual occupation or single foundation and abandonment year is asserted. Inscribed in July 2012. The roof-access detail was not confirmed by a second source this round and is left out of the summary.

title.zh: 纳布塔普拉亚与努比亚沙漠的新石器社群
title.en: Nabta Playa and Neolithic communities in the Nubian desert

summary.zh: 纳布塔普拉亚位于埃及南部努比亚沙漠，是努比亚新石器时代最早的遗址之一，年代约在公元前7500年。湿润期降雨形成临时湖泊，第九至第八千纪出现季节性营地；到第七千纪出现成排小屋与深井支撑的较大聚落，约公元前6800年开始本地制作陶器，晚期还出现来自西亚的绵羊与山羊。
summary.en: Nabta Playa in the Nubian desert of southern Egypt is among the earliest Nubian Neolithic sites, dated to about 7500 BCE. Rain during a humid phase formed a temporary lake; seasonal camps appear in the ninth to eighth millennia, larger settlements with rows of huts and deep wells by the seventh, local pottery from about 6800 BCE, and sheep and goats arriving from western Asia later in that millennium.

significance.zh: 纳布塔普拉亚说明撒哈拉湿润期如何支持早期的定居、陶器与畜牧实验。
significance.en: Nabta Playa shows how the Saharan humid phase supported early settlement, pottery and experiments with herding.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Nabta Playa（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 当地早期牛骨是否属于驯化家畜存在争议：多项研究显示其形态偏野生，驯化牛约在公元前7千纪晚期由幼发拉底河谷传入东北非；本条不把纳布塔当作最早的畜牧中心。
editorialNotes.en: Whether the early cattle remains were domesticated is disputed: several studies find them morphologically wild, and domesticated cattle reached northeast Africa in the late seventh millennium BCE from the Euphrates valley; Nabta Playa is therefore not presented as an earliest herding centre.

title.zh: 梅赫尔格尔的早期农牧聚落

summary.zh: 俾路支地区的梅赫尔格尔在约前六千五百年已有早期农牧聚落。居民栽培谷物、饲养家畜，使用泥砖建筑，并逐步发展陶器与其他手工业。长期积累的聚落层展示了生产方式、储藏设施和社会组织的变化，为理解印度河城市兴起以前数千年的南亚历史提供了连续线索。
summary.en: Early farming communities lived at Mehrgarh in Balochistan by approximately 6500 BCE. Residents cultivated cereals, kept livestock, used mud-brick buildings and gradually developed pottery and other crafts. Successive settlement layers document changes in production, storage and social organisation, providing a long archaeological sequence for South Asian life thousands of years before the Indus cities emerged.

significance.zh: 连接了南亚早期农牧生活与后来的城市化进程。
significance.en: Connects early South Asian farming communities with the later development of urban life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Early farming at Mehrgarh

editorialNotes.zh: 采用所引UNESCO提名材料的约前6500年分期；其他研究也使用约前7000年的起始年代。
editorialNotes.en: The approximate date of 6500 BCE follows the cited UNESCO nomination; other studies place the beginning around 7000 BCE.

title.zh: 贡迪杰马拉人发展水产管理系统
title.en: Gunditjmara aquaculture develops at Budj Bim

summary.zh: 澳大利亚东南部的贡迪杰马拉人利用布吉比姆火山熔岩塑造的地形，逐步修筑沟渠、堰坝与水池，管理湿地水流，捕捞和储养短鳍鳗鱼。延续数千年的工程与知识体系为社区提供稳定食物，并把劳动、季节变化和土地关系结合起来，留下复杂的原住民资源管理传统。
summary.en: Gunditjmara communities in southeastern Australia used terrain shaped by Budj Bim's lava flows to develop channels, weirs and pools. By managing wetland water, they could trap, hold and harvest short-finned eels. Engineering and ecological knowledge sustained food resources and community life over millennia, connecting labour, seasonal change and relationships with Country through an enduring Indigenous management tradition.

significance.zh: 布吉比姆展示了澳大利亚原住民长期改造水环境与组织食物生产的能力。
significance.en: Budj Bim demonstrates long-established Aboriginal expertise in managing water and food resources.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：布吉比姆文化景观

editorialNotes.zh: 约前4600年用于概括至少约6600年的水产管理历史；不同工程分别在长期使用中修建和调整。
editorialNotes.en: Around 4600 BCE summarizes an aquaculture history of at least about 6,600 years; individual works were built and modified over time.

title.zh: 库克湿地的农业发展

summary.zh: 新几内亚高地的库克湿地保存着堆垄、沟渠和土地改造的遗迹。约六千五百年前，当地居民已经持续管理湿地并发展栽培活动，后来又通过排水设施调整种植环境。这里漫长的土地利用历史显示，大洋洲居民根据高地生态条件发展出自己的农业经验，并将环境管理知识传递给后代。
summary.en: Mounds, ditches and modified soils at Kuk in the New Guinea highlands preserve a long history of wetland cultivation. By roughly 6,500 years ago, people were actively managing this landscape, with later drainage works further changing growing conditions. The sequence documents agricultural knowledge developed within Oceania and sustained adaptation to the distinctive environment of the highlands.

significance.zh: 展示大洋洲农业的发展及长期管理湿地的技术经验。
significance.en: Documents agricultural development in Oceania and enduring expertise in wetland management.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Agricultural development at Kuk

editorialNotes.zh: 约前4500年对应约6500年前的重要农业发展阶段，遗址还保存着更早的植物利用与后续排水活动。
editorialNotes.en: About 4500 BCE marks an important agricultural phase roughly 6,500 years ago; the site also preserves earlier plant use and later drainage activity.

title.zh: 卡纳克巨石列与布列塔尼仪式景观
title.en: The Carnac stones and the Breton ritual landscape

summary.zh: 法国布列塔尼南部卡纳克一带集中分布着石列、石棚墓、坟丘与独立立石，超过三千块立石取材于本地花岗岩。多数遗迹位于卡纳克市镇内，东侧一部分延伸到邻镇，周边地区与莫尔比昂湾岛屿也有同期巨石建筑。这些遗存由新石器时代社群营建，主要阶段很可能在公元前3300年前后，部分可能早至公元前4500年。
summary.en: Around Carnac in southern Brittany, rows of standing stones, dolmens, tumuli and isolated menhirs form a dense prehistoric complex of more than three thousand stones, mostly local granite. Most monuments lie within the commune of Carnac with some extending into the neighbouring town, and related megaliths stand nearby and on islands in the Gulf of Morbihan. Neolithic communities raised them, most probably around 3300 BCE and some perhaps as early as 4500 BCE.

significance.zh: 卡纳克显示新石器时代西欧如何以巨石建筑组织仪式景观。
significance.en: Carnac shows how Neolithic western Europe organised ritual landscapes through megalithic building.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Carnac stones（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 经团队转述读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 巨石建筑由新石器时代社群竖立，后世“德鲁伊所建”的说法属于流传传说，本条不采用。年代范围取约前4500—前3300年，不把任一单块立石的测年当作整体年代。
editorialNotes.en: The stones were raised by Neolithic communities; the later claim that druids built them is legend and is not used here. The range c. 4500–3300 BCE is retained without treating any single stone's date as the date of the whole complex.

title.zh: 乌鲁克的早期书写

summary.zh: 前四千纪末，美索不达米亚的乌鲁克发展为大型城市。管理物资、分配口粮和记录劳动力的需要，促使人们在泥板上刻画数量与物品符号。这些记录逐渐发展成复杂的书写体系，并扩展到更多社会活动。可以长期保存和核对的信息，改变了城市机构组织经济与传承知识的方式。
summary.en: As Uruk grew into a major city in the late fourth millennium BCE, institutions needed to record goods, rations and labour. Signs inscribed on clay tablets developed from administrative records into increasingly complex writing. Durable information could be stored and checked across time, transforming the organisation of urban economic activity and eventually opening new possibilities for transmitting knowledge.

significance.zh: 书写使行政记录和知识保存进入新的阶段。
significance.en: Writing opened a new stage in administrative record keeping and the preservation of knowledge.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Early writing at Uruk

title.zh: 良渚城市与水利体系

summary.zh: 长江下游的良渚居民依靠水稻农业，营建城址、土台和规模可观的水利设施。精细玉器、墓葬差异与礼仪活动反映了社会分层和共同的信仰秩序。历经数百年的建设，良渚将农业生产、工程组织和政治权力联系起来，展示了中国早期复杂社会的一条重要发展道路。
summary.en: Rice-growing communities at Liangzhu in the lower Yangtze region built a city, substantial earthworks and extensive water-management facilities. Fine jade objects and differences among burials reveal social hierarchy and shared ritual practices. Centuries of construction linked agricultural production, coordinated engineering and political authority, making Liangzhu an important example of the development of complex societies in early China.

significance.zh: 为理解长江流域早期城市、工程与权力组织提供实物证据。
significance.en: Provides material evidence for early urbanism, engineering and political organisation in the Yangtze region.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Liangzhu city and water management

title.zh: 纽格莱奇与博因河谷的巨石墓葬
title.en: Newgrange and the Boyne valley passage tombs

summary.zh: 爱尔兰博因河畔的纽格莱奇通道墓约建于公元前3100年，早于巨石阵与吉萨金字塔。圆形土丘内部有石砌通道与十字形墓室，外圈为刻纹缘石与白石英墙面，冬至日出光线经入口上方的屋顶箱照入墓室。它与诺斯、道斯等墓葬同属博因河谷遗址群，构成欧洲规模最大的巨石艺术组合之一。
summary.en: The Newgrange passage tomb beside the River Boyne in Ireland was built around 3100 BCE, earlier than Stonehenge and the Egyptian pyramids. A circular mound contains a stone passage and cruciform chamber, ringed by engraved kerbstones and a white quartz façade, and the rising sun at the winter solstice shines through a roof-box into the chamber. With Knowth and Dowth it belongs to the Brú na Bóinne complex, home to Europe's largest assemblage of megalithic art.

significance.zh: 博因河谷墓葬群显示了新石器时代西欧的纪念性建筑、天文知识与仪式景观。
significance.en: The Boyne valley tombs show monumental building, astronomical knowledge and ritual landscape in Neolithic western Europe.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Newgrange（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
Wikipedia — Brú na Bóinne（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 纽格莱奇约建于前3100年，诺斯与道斯等主要墓葬建于前32世纪；博因河谷遗址群至少包含90处遗迹，本条只描述其墓葬与仪式特征，不把遗址群当作单一年份的事件。
editorialNotes.en: Newgrange is dated to about 3100 BCE and the main tombs of Knowth and Dowth to the 32nd century BCE; the complex includes at least ninety monuments, and no single year stands for the whole landscape.

title.zh: 斯卡拉布雷：奥克尼的新石器村落
title.en: Skara Brae: a Neolithic village in Orkney

summary.zh: 约五千年前，奥克尼群岛的斯卡拉布雷形成由石砌房屋、通道和储藏设施组成的村落。房屋以石板建造，内有壁炉、石床与柜架，村落被贝壳堆和沙土覆盖后得以保存。它与布罗德盖石环、梅肖石室等遗址同属“新石器时代奥克尼”世界遗产。
summary.en: About five thousand years ago a village of stone-built houses, passages and storage fittings took shape at Skara Brae in Orkney. The dwellings used flagstone walls with hearths, stone beds and shelving, and the settlement survived because it was covered by midden and sand. It forms part of the Heart of Neolithic Orkney World Heritage Site.

significance.zh: 斯卡拉布雷保存了新石器时代北大西洋村落的日常生活空间。
significance.en: Skara Brae preserves the everyday spaces of a Neolithic North Atlantic village.

sources.title: Historic Environment Scotland — Skara Brae

editorialNotes.zh: 来源页面以“约5000年前”表述村落年代；本条采用考古学常用的前3200—前2500占居范围，并保留该概括，不把它当作某一年的事件。
editorialNotes.en: The source describes the village as about 5,000 years old; this entry uses the conventional 3200–2500 BCE occupation range while retaining that summary, and does not treat it as a single-year event.

title.zh: 埃及早期国家统一

summary.zh: 约前3100年，尼罗河流域的地方政权逐渐整合，形成统治上、下埃及的早期王朝国家。王权借助宗教仪式、书写和资源调配加强统治，孟菲斯与阿拜多斯成为重要政治及宗教中心。此后延续的官僚制度、纪念建筑和王室丧葬传统，奠定了古埃及文明的许多基本特征。
summary.en: Around 3100 BCE, local powers in the Nile valley consolidated into an early dynastic state ruling Upper and Lower Egypt. Kingship drew strength from religious ritual, writing and resource mobilisation, while Memphis and Abydos became major political and religious centres. The resulting administrative institutions, monumental building and royal funerary traditions shaped many lasting features of ancient Egyptian civilisation.

significance.zh: 推动尼罗河流域形成延续数千年的王朝国家传统。
significance.en: Established foundations for the Nile valley’s enduring traditions of dynastic government.

sources.title: egymonuments.gov.eg — Early unification of Egypt

editorialNotes.zh: 统一是逐步推进的过程，纳尔迈与早期王朝的具体年代因年表和考古解释而异。
editorialNotes.en: Unification developed gradually, and the dating of Narmer and the earliest dynasties varies between chronologies and archaeological interpretations.

title.zh: 米诺斯文明与克里特宫殿社会
title.en: The Minoan civilization and Cretan palace society

summary.zh: 米诺斯文明是青铜时代以克里特岛为中心的文化，常被视为欧洲最早的文明。它由当地新石器文化发展而来，约公元前2000年出现复杂的城市聚落与宫殿建筑。克里特缺少金属矿藏，米诺斯人通过出口农产品与奢侈品换取原料金属，商人与工匠把影响扩展到爱琴海和东地中海。
summary.en: The Minoan civilization was a Bronze Age culture centred on Crete and is often regarded as the first civilisation in Europe. It developed from the local Neolithic culture, with complex urban settlements and palaces appearing around 2000 BCE. Crete lacked metal ores, so Minoans exported agricultural produce and luxury crafts in exchange for raw metals, and their traders and artisans extended influence across the Aegean and eastern Mediterranean.

significance.zh: 米诺斯文明展示了欧洲最早的宫殿经济、远洋贸易与文字使用。
significance.en: Minoan Crete shows Europe's earliest palace economies, maritime trade and script use.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Minoan civilization（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 约前3100年为文化形成期，约前2000年出现宫殿与城市；本条不使用某个宫殿毁于火山或地震的单一年份作为文明终点。
editorialNotes.en: About 3100 BCE marks the formative phase and about 2000 BCE the appearance of palaces and towns; no single destruction year is used as the end of the civilisation.

title.zh: 卡拉尔—苏佩的城市发展

summary.zh: 秘鲁苏佩河谷的卡拉尔在前第三千纪形成大型公共建筑与聚落体系。居民通过农业、海岸资源和区域交换维持生活，并投入大量劳动修筑土台、广场和仪式空间。遗址展示了安第斯地区早期城市社会如何在不同生态区的联系中发展，也保存了公共活动与社会组织日趋复杂的证据。
summary.en: In the third millennium BCE, Caral in Peru’s Supe valley developed monumental public buildings and an extensive settlement landscape. Agriculture, coastal resources and regional exchange supported residents who invested substantial labour in platforms, plazas and ceremonial spaces. The site documents early Andean urban society and the connections among different ecological zones that sustained increasingly complex forms of organisation.

significance.zh: 展现美洲早期城市社会独立发展的深厚历史。
significance.en: Demonstrates the deep history of independently developing urban societies in the Americas.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban development at Caral-Supe

title.zh: 多拉维拉：印度河城市的水利与规划
title.en: Dholavira: water management and planning in an Indus city

summary.zh: 约公元前3000年至前1500年，多拉维拉在卡奇荒漠的岛上发展出分区明确的城市：城堡、中城与下城由城墙和通道分隔，石砌蓄水池、水井与引水沟把季风降水保存下来。居民制作印章、珠饰与陶器，并依靠畜牧、种植和远距离交换维持生计。区域水系变化与贸易重组后，城市逐渐衰落。
summary.en: Between about 3000 and 1500 BCE, Dholavira grew on an island in the Rann of Kutch as a planned city whose citadel, middle and lower towns were separated by walls and passages. Stone reservoirs, wells and channels stored monsoon water, while seals, beads and pottery linked the city to wider exchange. Changing water systems and trade contributed to its later decline.

significance.zh: 多拉维拉以水利设施展示了印度河文明对干旱环境的适应能力。
significance.en: Dholavira's waterworks show how an Indus civilisation city adapted to a semi-arid environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Dholavira: a Harappan City

editorialNotes.zh: 约前3000—前1500是占居期概括，城内各阶段的兴衰并不同步，也未把某座蓄水池的年代扩展为全城年代。
editorialNotes.en: The 3000–1500 BCE range summarises the occupation period; phases within the city were not synchronous, and no single reservoir date is extended to the whole site.

title.zh: 青铜时代的生产与跨区域网络
title.en: Bronze Age production and transregional networks

summary.zh: 青铜时代以冶炼铜并与锡、砷等合金，或通过交换获得青铜制品为标志，在欧亚大陆与北非大部分地区约公元前3000年已经开始。不同地区的时间表并不一致：两河流域与埃及在公元前第四千纪末出现文字，形成最早的实际书写系统；青铜生产依赖远距离的矿料与工匠流动，把政体、商路与作坊连接起来。约公元前1200年，东地中海体系在崩溃中转向铁器时代。
summary.en: The Bronze Age is defined by smelting copper and alloying it with tin or arsenic, or by trading for bronze, and had begun in much of the Old World by 3000 BCE. Regional chronologies differ: writing appeared in Mesopotamia and Egypt by the late fourth millennium as the earliest practical scripts, while bronze production depended on long-distance flows of ores and craftsmen that linked polities, routes and workshops. Around 1200 BCE the eastern Mediterranean system collapsed and gave way to the Iron Age.

significance.zh: 青铜时代显示技术、文字与贸易网络如何在欧亚大陆相互支撑。
significance.en: The Bronze Age shows how technology, writing and trade networks sustained one another across Eurasia.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Bronze Age（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 青铜时代是各地区分别界定的考古分期，美洲原住民社会采用不同的分期体系且在前哥伦布时期未发展铁器经济；本条不把“青铜时代”当作全球统一时段。
editorialNotes.en: The Bronze Age is defined separately in each region; Indigenous American societies use a different periodisation and did not develop an iron economy before Columbus, so the term is not treated as one global period.

title.zh: 埃兰：伊朗西南的古代国家
title.en: Elam: an ancient state in south-western Iran

summary.zh: 埃兰是古代伊朗西部与西南部的文明，范围包括今伊拉姆、胡齐斯坦及伊拉克南部一角，首都苏萨。它参与近东早期的城市化，约公元前3000年起出现文字记录，埃兰语文献延续两千余年。埃兰诸国长期与美索不达米亚政权竞争与结盟，公元前六世纪被波斯阿契美尼德帝国取代。
summary.en: Elam was an ancient civilisation in western and south-western Iran, covering parts of modern Ilam and Khuzestan and a corner of southern Iraq, with its capital at Susa. It took part in the early urbanisation of the Near East, written records appear from about 3000 BCE, and Elamite texts continued for more than two millennia. Elamite states long competed and allied with Mesopotamian powers until the Achaemenid Persians replaced them in the sixth century BCE.

significance.zh: 埃兰把伊朗西南纳入近东早期国家与文字传统，并深刻影响后来的波斯统治。
significance.en: Elam brought south-western Iran into the early state and writing traditions of the Near East and shaped later Persian rule.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Elam（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: “埃兰”是长期存在的多政权与文化集合，本条用约前2700—前539年概括其有文字记录的国家阶段，不表示政治统一。
editorialNotes.en: 'Elam' is a long-lived set of polities and cultures; the c. 2700–539 BCE range summarises its documented state phase and does not imply political unity.

title.zh: 印度河城市文明成熟
title.en: Mature urbanism in the Indus civilisation

summary.zh: 前第三千纪中后期，哈拉帕、摩亨佐达罗等印度河城市形成规划街道、排水设施和专业手工业区。标准化砖块、度量衡与印章显示了广泛联系，农业腹地和远距离贸易则支撑城市生活。城市之间共享许多物质文化特征，留下了研究南亚早期生产、交换与社会组织的重要材料。
summary.en: During the later third millennium BCE, Indus cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro developed planned streets, drainage systems and specialised craft production. Standardised bricks, weights and seals indicate extensive connections, while agricultural hinterlands and long-distance trade supported urban life. Shared material practices across these settlements provide important evidence for early South Asian production, exchange and social organisation.

significance.zh: 呈现早期城市规划与跨区域经济联系的高度发展。
significance.en: Shows the advanced development of early urban planning and interregional economic connections.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Mature urbanism in the Indus civilisation

editorialNotes.zh: 印度河文字尚未得到公认解读，政治制度和城市间权力关系仍是研究中的问题。
editorialNotes.en: The Indus script has no generally accepted decipherment, leaving political institutions and relations among cities open to investigation.

title.zh: 吉萨金字塔群的建造

summary.zh: 埃及第四王朝时期，胡夫、哈夫拉和孟卡拉的王室工程在吉萨高地形成宏大的金字塔群。石材开采与运输、人员供给和建筑测量需要持续协调，周边墓地与附属设施也体现了王室和精英的关系。金字塔将王权、来世信仰和尼罗河流域的资源组织能力凝聚在同一景观中。
summary.en: Royal building projects under Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure created the Giza pyramid complex during Egypt’s Fourth Dynasty. Quarrying and transporting stone, supplying workers and surveying the structures required sustained coordination. Associated cemeteries and buildings reveal connections between the royal court and elites, while the monuments brought together kingship, beliefs about the afterlife and the resources of the Nile valley.

significance.zh: 成为研究古埃及工程、劳动组织与王权的重要窗口。
significance.en: Offers a major window into ancient Egyptian engineering, labour organisation and royal authority.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of the Giza pyramids

editorialNotes.zh: 建造阶段采用圆整年代，具体国王在位年数与工程起止仍存在年表差异。
editorialNotes.en: The construction period uses rounded dates; chronologies differ over individual reigns and the beginnings and ends of particular projects.

title.zh: 巨石阵主要石构阶段

summary.zh: 约前2500年，英国南部的巨石阵进入重要的石构建造阶段。人们运输和竖立大型石块，使建筑与至日方向相联系，周围还有墓葬、道路和其他仪式遗址。多代人的修建与使用将这一地区塑造成共同参与的礼仪景观，反映了新石器时代社会组织劳动、纪念祖先和观察天象的方式。
summary.en: Around 2500 BCE, Stonehenge in southern Britain entered a major phase of construction with large standing stones. Its alignment relates to the solstices, while surrounding burials, routes and ceremonial sites formed a wider landscape of shared activity. Generations of building and use reveal how Neolithic communities coordinated labour, commemorated the dead and related their practices to celestial cycles.

significance.zh: 保存了新石器时代工程、仪式与季节观念相互交织的证据。
significance.en: Preserves evidence of the interaction between Neolithic engineering, ritual and seasonal knowledge.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Major stone-building phase at Stonehenge

editorialNotes.zh: 巨石阵经历多个建造阶段，约前2500年标记主要石构阶段，早期土筑和后续改造另有年代。
editorialNotes.en: Stonehenge developed through several phases; about 2500 BCE marks major stone construction, with earlier earthworks and later modifications dated separately.

title.zh: 克尔玛王国的发展
title.en: Development of the kingdom of Kerma

summary.zh: 尼罗河中游的克尔玛在前第三千纪至第二千纪发展为强大的政治中心。城市中的大型土砖建筑、手工业与富有差异的墓葬，显示了王权和社会分层。克尔玛连接非洲内陆与埃及的交换网络，在贸易、竞争和战争中扩大影响，形成具有自身文化传统的努比亚国家。
summary.en: Kerma in the middle Nile valley developed into a powerful political centre during the third and second millennia BCE. Monumental mud-brick buildings, craft production and differentiated burials reveal kingship and social hierarchy. Through trade, competition and warfare, Kerma connected Egypt with regions farther into Africa while maintaining distinctive Nubian cultural traditions and political institutions.

significance.zh: 突出努比亚在古代非洲国家形成与区域交流中的作用。
significance.en: Highlights Nubia’s role in ancient African state formation and regional exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Development of the kingdom of Kerma

title.zh: 阿卡德王朝的扩张

summary.zh: 萨尔贡及其继承者将美索不达米亚多个城市置于阿卡德王朝统治之下，并向周边地区扩张。统治者依靠军事力量、地方官员和资源征收维系跨区域权力，也面临反抗与继承危机。阿卡德语和王室铭文留下了帝国治理的记录，其统治经验长期影响后来的近东政治想象。
summary.en: Sargon and his successors brought numerous Mesopotamian cities under the Akkadian dynasty and expanded into neighbouring regions. Military force, provincial officials and the collection of resources supported this wider authority, while rebellions and succession struggles tested it. Akkadian-language records and royal inscriptions preserve evidence of imperial government that continued to shape later Near Eastern ideas of kingship.

significance.zh: 为近东跨区域帝国统治留下了具有长久影响的先例。
significance.en: Established an influential precedent for interregional imperial rule in the Near East.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Expansion of the Akkadian dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 这里采用传统中年表约前2334—前2154年；绝对年代存在分歧，阿卡德城的确切位置也尚未确定。
editorialNotes.en: The dates follow the conventional Middle Chronology, approximately 2334–2154 BCE. Absolute chronology remains disputed, and the city of Akkad has not been securely located.

title.zh: 达尔蒂希特与西非早期农牧聚落
title.en: Dhar Tichitt and early farming settlements in West Africa

summary.zh: 达尔蒂希特是毛里塔尼亚西南撒哈拉沙漠中的砂岩崖地带，分布着提希特文化的一系列新石器时代遗址。约公元前2000年至前300年，牧民与农民在此居住，遗址群包括达尔蒂希特、达尔瓦拉塔、达尔内马与达尔塔甘特；达尔蒂希特可能是该传统中等级化社会结构的区域中心，也是西非已知最早的定居遗址之一。
summary.en: Dhar Tichitt is a line of sandstone cliffs in the south-western Sahara in Mauritania with a series of Neolithic sites of the Tichitt tradition. Pastoralists and farmers lived there between about 2000 and 300 BCE across the Dhar Tichitt, Dhar Walata, Dhar Néma and Dhar Tagant groups; Dhar Tichitt may have been the regional centre of a hierarchical social structure and is among the oldest known occupation sites in West Africa.

significance.zh: 达尔蒂希特记录了撒哈拉湿润期西非农牧社会与聚落组织的早期形态。
significance.en: Dhar Tichitt records early farming and herding society and settlement organisation in West Africa during the Saharan humid phase.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Dhar Tichitt（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代约为公元前2000—前300年；遗址群是否构成单一政体仍待研究，本条按聚落传统表述。
editorialNotes.en: The range is about 2000–300 BCE; whether the sites formed a single polity remains unresolved, so the entry describes a settlement tradition.

title.zh: 班清：东南亚早期的农业与金属工艺
title.en: Ban Chiang: early farming and metalworking in Southeast Asia

summary.zh: 泰国乌隆他尼府的班清遗址因红彩陶器与早期金属制品受到关注。1974至1975年发掘后，热释光测年曾给出很早的年代，但该技术当时属于实验性且样本出处不确定；后续放射性碳再分析认为最早冶金约在公元前2000至前1700年，最下层墓葬的稻米植硅体约为公元前2100年，最晚墓葬约在公元200年。
summary.en: The Ban Chiang site in Udon Thani province, Thailand, drew attention for its painted pottery and early metalwork. After excavations in 1974–75 thermoluminescence produced very early dates, but the technique was then experimental and sample contexts uncertain; later radiocarbon work places the earliest metallurgy at about 2000–1700 BCE, with rice phytoliths around 2100 BCE in the lowest grave and the latest burials around 200 CE.

significance.zh: 班清展示了东南亚早期农业与青铜工艺的本土发展，也提醒读者区分已被修正的早期测年。
significance.en: Ban Chiang shows indigenous early farming and bronze working in Southeast Asia while warning readers against superseded early dating.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Ban Chiang（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 经团队转述读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1966年发现，1992年列入世界遗产。早期热释光年代（约前4420—前3400年）已被放射性碳再分析修正；本条采用后者，并明确墓葬与金属活动约在前2000年至公元200年之间，遗址本身更早，具体起点仍有争议。
editorialNotes.en: Discovered in 1966 and inscribed in 1992. The early thermoluminescence dates (about 4420–3400 BCE) were revised by radiocarbon reanalysis; this entry follows the latter and states that burial and metal activity runs from about 2000 BCE to 200 CE, with the site itself earlier and its exact beginning still debated.

title.zh: 二里头文化与中国早期国家
title.en: The Erlitou culture and early state formation in China

summary.zh: 二里头文化是黄河中游的早期青铜时代社会，早期估计为约公元前1900至前1500年，2007年以来的放射性碳研究给出约前1750—前1500年的较窄范围。遗址位于河南偃师，分布遍及河南、山西，后扩展到陕西与湖北；多数考古学者认为它是中国最早的国家级社会，中国学者一般把二里头与夏代后期相联系。
summary.en: The Erlitou culture was an early Bronze Age society in the middle Yellow River valley. Early estimates dated it to about 1900–1500 BCE, while radiocarbon studies since 2007 narrowed it to about 1750–1500 BCE. The type site lies at Yanshi in Henan, with distribution across Henan and Shanxi and later Shaanxi and Hubei; most archaeologists regard it as China's first state-level society, and Chinese scholars generally associate it with the later Xia dynasty.

significance.zh: 二里头是理解中国早期国家、青铜铸造与都邑规划的关键遗址。
significance.en: Erlitou is key to understanding early Chinese statehood, bronze casting and urban planning.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Erlitou culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代存在约前1900—前1500与约前1750—前1500两种表述，本条并列保留；二里头与夏代的对应仍是学术讨论，不作为已证实的王朝编年。
editorialNotes.en: Two date ranges circulate, c. 1900–1500 and c. 1750–1500 BCE, and both are retained; the identification with the Xia dynasty remains debated and is not presented as a proven dynastic chronology.

title.zh: cemetery H 文化与印度河晚期的区域转型
title.en: The Cemetery H culture and the late Indus regional transformation

summary.zh: cemetery H 文化是青铜时代印度次大陆北部的区域文化，分布于今旁遮普、哈里亚纳与北方邦西部，约公元前1900年至前1300年。它被视为哈拉帕（印度河）文明晚期的地方形态之一，同时也与印度—雅利安人迁徙的某些阶段相关；名称来自哈拉帕遗址“H区”发现的墓地，葬俗与陶器显示区域变化。
summary.en: The Cemetery H culture was a Bronze Age culture of the northern Indian subcontinent in present-day Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh, dated to about 1900–1300 BCE. It is regarded as a regional form of the late Harappan (Indus) civilisation and is also linked to phases of Indo-Aryan migration; the name comes from a cemetery in 'area H' at Harappa, and its burial customs and pottery show regional change.

significance.zh: cemetery H 展示了印度河城市体系衰退后北印度社会的重组过程。
significance.en: Cemetery H shows how northern Indian society reorganised after the Indus urban system declined.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Cemetery H culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 该文化的年代约前1900—前1300年；把它与特定族群迁徙直接对应属于解释性观点，本条分开表述考古文化与迁徙假说。
editorialNotes.en: The culture is dated to about 1900–1300 BCE; equating it directly with a specific migration is an interpretive claim, so the archaeological culture and migration hypotheses are kept separate.

title.zh: 汉谟拉比法碑

summary.zh: 约前1750年，巴比伦王汉谟拉比的法碑将王权宣言与大量判例条文刻在石上，涉及财产、贸易、家庭和劳动关系。条文对不同身份者规定不同处罚，展示了当时社会的等级秩序。石碑同时塑造国王维护正义的形象，让法律实践与王室权威以可见、可传承的形式结合起来。
summary.en: Around 1750 BCE, Hammurabi’s Babylonian stele combined statements of royal authority with legal cases concerning property, trade, family and labour. Different penalties for people of different status reveal the hierarchy of contemporary society. The monument also presented the king as a guardian of justice, joining legal practice with a durable public expression of royal power.

significance.zh: 为研究古代法律、社会等级与王权的关系提供重要文献。
significance.en: Provides an important source for relations among ancient law, social hierarchy and kingship.

sources.title: www.louvre.fr — The stele of Hammurabi

editorialNotes.zh: 学者通常将碑文理解为判例与王权思想的汇编，其与日常司法实践的对应关系仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: Scholars generally treat the inscription as a collection of legal cases and royal ideology; its relationship to everyday judicial practice remains debated.

title.zh: 波弗蒂角土方工程与交换网络
title.en: Poverty Point earthworks and exchange networks

summary.zh: 公元前二千纪，密西西比河下游的狩猎、捕鱼和采集社群在波弗蒂角修筑大型土丘、弧形土垄与广场。工程利用高于洪泛平原的地势，兼顾聚居与仪式活动。当地缺少制作工具所需的石材，居民因此维持远达数百公里的交换网络，把分散的人群、原料与公共劳动连接起来。
summary.en: In the second millennium BCE, hunting, fishing and gathering communities built large mounds, curved ridges and plazas at Poverty Point in the lower Mississippi valley. The raised setting above the floodplain supported settlement and ceremonial activities. Because local stone was scarce, inhabitants maintained exchange networks extending hundreds of kilometres, linking dispersed communities, materials and collective construction.

significance.zh: 波弗蒂角展示了采集渔猎社会的大型工程与远距离交换能力。
significance.en: Poverty Point demonstrates monumental construction and long-distance exchange among hunter-fisher-gatherer communities.

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：Poverty Point World Heritage Site
UNESCO世界遗产中心：波弗蒂角

title.zh: 拉皮塔航海与远大洋洲定居

summary.zh: 拉皮塔文化群体凭借航海与岛屿生活经验，逐步扩展到西南太平洋的多个岛群。他们带来带有戳印纹饰的陶器、栽培植物和家畜，并通过跨海交换维持联系。各地聚落在新的环境中形成不同传统，这一连串航行与定居成为理解远大洋洲人口历史和后续波利尼西亚社会发展的关键。
summary.en: Lapita communities used maritime skills and island knowledge to settle island groups across the southwestern Pacific. They carried distinctive dentate-stamped pottery, cultivated plants and domestic animals, maintaining connections through seaborne exchange. Settlements developed local traditions in new environments, making this extended history of voyaging and settlement central to understanding Remote Oceania and the later growth of Polynesian societies.

significance.zh: 连接西南太平洋航海网络与远大洋洲聚落的发展。
significance.en: Connects southwestern Pacific voyaging networks with the growth of settlements in Remote Oceania.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Lapita voyaging into Remote Oceania

editorialNotes.zh: 前1500—前500年是涵盖不同岛群的宽泛阶段，各地首次定居和拉皮塔陶器延续时间并不一致。
editorialNotes.en: 1500–500 BCE is a broad interval spanning different island groups; first settlement and the duration of Lapita pottery traditions vary by location.

title.zh: 查文成为安第斯宗教中心
title.en: Chavin becomes an Andean religious centre

summary.zh: 在安第斯高山谷地，查文逐渐发展成吸引不同地区人群的仪式与朝圣中心。工匠围绕广场修筑石砌平台、神庙和复杂的内部廊道，并以人兽结合的形象装饰石柱、门梁与雕像。共同的宗教图像和仪式联系沿海、高地及森林边缘，推动了安第斯早期文化的交流。
summary.en: In a high Andean valley, Chavin developed into a ceremonial and pilgrimage centre drawing people from different regions. Builders arranged stone platforms, temples and intricate interior galleries around plazas, decorating columns and monuments with human and animal imagery. Shared religious forms linked coastlands, highlands and forest margins, helping sustain an early network of cultural exchange across the Andes.

significance.zh: 查文显示宗教与朝圣活动在早期安第斯跨区域交流中的作用。
significance.en: Chavin demonstrates the role of religion and pilgrimage in early interregional Andean exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：查文考古遗址

editorialNotes.zh: UNESCO概要使用前1500—前300年，价值说明又使用前十五至前五世纪；本条采用较宽时段，建筑各阶段仍应分别理解。
editorialNotes.en: UNESCO's summary uses 1500–300 BCE, while its value statement uses the fifteenth to fifth centuries BCE; this entry adopts the broader range.

title.zh: 殷墟：晚商都城与甲骨档案
title.en: Yin Xu: the late Shang capital and its oracle-bone archive

summary.zh: 约公元前1300年起，商王把都邑设在洹河两岸的殷墟，宫殿宗庙区、王陵区与手工业作坊沿河分布。这里出土的甲骨卜辞记录祭祀、战争、农事与王令，是重建商代晚期政治与文字的第一手材料。前1046年商亡后都邑废弃，遗址在二十世纪的系统发掘中重新进入历史叙述。
summary.en: From about 1300 BCE the Shang kings ruled from Yin Xu on the Huan River, where palace-temple compounds, royal tombs and craft workshops were laid out along the banks. Oracle-bone inscriptions found there record sacrifice, warfare, harvests and royal commands, making the site a primary source for late Shang politics and writing. The capital was abandoned after the Shang fell in 1046 BCE.

significance.zh: 甲骨与都城遗存共同支撑了商代晚期历史的重建。
significance.en: Oracle bones and urban remains together underpin the reconstruction of late Shang history.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Yin Xu

editorialNotes.zh: 年代采用世界遗产条目所记约前1300—前1046；甲骨占卜不记录全部政务，不能当作完整的王室档案。
editorialNotes.en: The 1300–1046 BCE range follows the World Heritage listing. Divination bones do not record all government business and are not a complete royal archive.

title.zh: 商代甲骨记录

summary.zh: 晚商王室在安阳一带利用龟甲和兽骨占卜，并刻下问题、日期及部分结果。甲骨内容涉及祭祀、战争、农业、气象与王室活动，保留了可以与考古材料相互参照的早期汉字记录。占卜与书写共同服务于王权决策，也让研究者得以窥见商代制度、信仰和日常事务。
summary.en: The late Shang court at Anyang used turtle shells and animal bones for divination, inscribing questions, dates and sometimes outcomes. These records concern ritual, warfare, farming, weather and royal activity, preserving early Chinese writing that can be studied alongside archaeological evidence. Divination and record keeping supported royal decisions and now illuminate Shang institutions, beliefs and everyday concerns.

significance.zh: 为早期中国提供可与考古发现相互印证的文字史料。
significance.en: Provides written evidence that can be compared directly with archaeological findings from early China.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Shang oracle-bone records

title.zh: 东地中海青铜时代体系转变
title.en: Transformation of the Late Bronze Age eastern Mediterranean

summary.zh: 前十二世纪前后，东地中海多个宫殿中心遭到破坏，赫梯帝国瓦解，迈锡尼地区的行政体系也发生深刻变化。战争、迁徙、气候压力和贸易中断相互作用，不同地区经历了程度各异的危机与重组。旧有权力网络衰退后，新城镇、政治集团和交换方式逐渐出现，开启了地区历史的新阶段。
summary.en: Around the twelfth century BCE, numerous palace centres in the eastern Mediterranean suffered destruction, the Hittite Empire fragmented and Mycenaean administrative systems changed profoundly. Warfare, migration, climatic pressures and disrupted trade interacted differently across regions. As older networks weakened, new settlements, political groups and patterns of exchange emerged, reshaping the region over subsequent generations.

significance.zh: 揭示高度联系的区域体系如何在多重压力下发生转变。
significance.en: Shows how interconnected regional systems can transform under multiple interacting pressures.

sources.title: gwtoday.gwu.edu — Transformation of the Late Bronze Age eastern Mediterranean

editorialNotes.zh: 各地区的变化时间和原因存在争论，研究更强调一系列相互关联但并不同步的转型。
editorialNotes.en: The timing and causes remain debated; scholarship increasingly emphasises related transformations that did not occur simultaneously in every region.

title.zh: 彩绘灰陶文化：恒河平原的铁器时代聚落
title.en: The Painted Grey Ware culture: Iron Age settlement in the Gangetic plain

summary.zh: 彩绘灰陶文化分布于印度次大陆恒河平原西部与加加尔—哈克拉河谷，通常断代为约公元前1200年至前600或前500年。陶器以细灰胎上黑彩几何纹样为特征；聚落多为农耕村落，也有数十处发展为设防的较大城镇，居民驯养马匹、加工象牙并使用铁器。该文化一般与吠陀中晚期及俱卢—般遮罗王国相联系。
summary.en: The Painted Grey Ware culture spread across the western Gangetic plain and the Ghaggar–Hakra valley, conventionally dated to about 1200–600/500 BCE. Its fine grey pottery is painted with black geometric patterns; most sites were farming villages while several dozen grew into larger, fortified settlements, and their people kept horses, worked ivory and used iron. The culture is generally linked to the middle and late Vedic period and the Kuru–Panchala kingdom.

significance.zh: 彩绘灰陶文化记录了印度河文明衰落之后恒河平原的 iron 时代城市化起步。
significance.en: The Painted Grey Ware culture records the beginnings of Iron Age urbanism in the Gangetic plain after the Indus cities declined.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Painted Grey Ware culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 断代存在 c.1200—600/500 BCE 与 1300—500/300 BCE 两种表述，本条采用前者；截至2018年已发现1576处该文化遗址，坐标取代表点，不代表某一具体遗址。
editorialNotes.en: Two conventional ranges circulate, c. 1200–600/500 BCE and 1300–500/300 BCE; this entry uses the former. By 2018 some 1,576 sites were known, and the coordinate is a representative point rather than a specific excavation.

title.zh: 冶铁技术的传播与铁器时代的展开
title.en: The spread of iron smelting and the beginning of the Iron Age

summary.zh: 铁器时代并非全球同步开始，而是以各地冶炼铁取代青铜成为常用工具与武器的时点分别界定。在安纳托利亚、高加索与东南欧，这一转变约始于公元前1300年；在古代近东，它与青铜时代晚期的崩溃同期发生在公元前12世纪，随后在公元前12至前11世纪传到地中海盆地与南亚，并继续向中亚、东欧和中欧扩散。
summary.en: The Iron Age did not begin everywhere at once but is defined locally by the point when smelted iron replaced bronze for common tools and weapons. In Anatolia, the Caucasus and southeast Europe the transition began around 1300 BCE; in the ancient Near East it occurred during the twelfth century BCE alongside the Late Bronze Age collapse, spreading to the Mediterranean and South Asia in the twelfth to eleventh centuries BCE and onwards to Central Asia and Europe.

significance.zh: 冶铁传播说明技术变革如何在不同地区以不同节奏重塑经济与军事。
significance.en: The spread of ironworking shows how a technological change reshaped economies and warfare at different rhythms.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Iron Age（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 铁器时代是考古学的地方性分期，不是单一全球事件；美洲原住民社会在前哥伦布时期未发展冶铁经济，澳大利亚的金属加工随欧洲接触而来。本条只描述旧大陆的传播过程。
editorialNotes.en: The Iron Age is a local archaeological period rather than one global event; Indigenous American societies did not develop an iron economy before Columbus, and metalworking reached Australia with European contact. This entry covers only the Old World diffusion.

title.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化：中欧的盐、铁与墓葬
title.en: The Hallstatt culture: salt, iron and burials in Central Europe

summary.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化是公元前12至前6世纪中欧与西欧的主要考古文化，先属青铜时代晚期，后进入早期铁器时代，通常与原始凯尔特语人群相联系。其命名遗址是奥地利萨尔茨卡默古特的湖畔村落哈尔施塔特，当地盐矿带来财富，已发现约1300座墓葬，随葬品显示远距离交换与等级分化。
summary.en: The Hallstatt culture dominated Central and Western Europe from the twelfth to the sixth century BCE, first in the Late Bronze Age and then in the Early Iron Age, and is commonly associated with Proto-Celtic speakers. Its type site is the lakeside village of Hallstatt in Austria's Salzkammergut, where salt mining brought wealth; some 1,300 burials are known, their grave goods showing long-distance exchange and social ranking.

significance.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化把中欧的盐矿财富、铁器技术与跨区域交换联系起来。
significance.en: The Hallstatt culture links Central European salt wealth, iron technology and transregional exchange.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Hallstatt culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 该文化跨越青铜时代晚期与早期铁器时代，本条以约前1200—前450年为概括范围，不把某一墓葬或矿层的年代当作整体起点。
editorialNotes.en: The culture spans the Late Bronze Age and Early Iron Age; the c. 1200–450 BCE range is an overview and no single grave or mine layer dates the whole.

title.zh: 奥尔梅克中心与纪念性艺术

summary.zh: 墨西哥湾沿岸的圣洛伦索、拉文塔等奥尔梅克中心修筑土台与广场，制作巨大的石雕头像和精细玉器。石材与绿石的远距离运输体现了交换网络，雕塑和礼仪器物则展示了统治者与超自然世界的联系。各中心先后兴盛，其艺术语言对后来的中美洲社会产生了深远影响。
summary.en: Olmec centres including San Lorenzo and La Venta on Mexico’s Gulf coast built platforms and plazas and produced colossal stone heads and finely worked jade. The movement of stone and greenstone reflects long-distance exchange, while sculpture and ritual objects expressed connections between rulers and supernatural powers. Successive centres developed artistic forms that strongly influenced later Mesoamerican societies.

significance.zh: 奠定了中美洲多种纪念艺术与王权表达的重要传统。
significance.en: Established influential traditions of monumental art and royal expression in Mesoamerica.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Olmec centres and monumental art

editorialNotes.zh: 奥尔梅克中心的政治联系仍有争论；本条选取所引博物馆文章的主要繁荣阶段。
editorialNotes.en: Political relationships among Olmec centres remain debated; the selected interval follows the main period of flourishing discussed by the cited museum source.

title.zh: 腓尼基字母书写的传播

summary.zh: 腓尼基城市的商人和工匠沿地中海活动，使以少量辅音符号记录语言的字母书写逐步传播。港口、殖民聚落和贸易交往为不同语言使用者提供了接触这种文字的机会。希腊人等群体在借用中加以调整，形成各自的书写传统，使字母系统成为地中海文化交流中影响深远的工具。
summary.en: Merchants and craftspeople from Phoenician cities helped spread alphabetic writing around the Mediterranean through ports, settlements and trade. A relatively small set of consonantal signs could be adapted by speakers of other languages. Communities including the Greeks modified the system for their own needs, creating new writing traditions with lasting consequences for communication and cultural exchange.

significance.zh: 推动了后来多种字母书写体系的发展与传播。
significance.en: Contributed to the development and spread of many later alphabetic writing systems.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Spread of Phoenician alphabetic writing

editorialNotes.zh: 字母书写有更早的前身，腓尼基体系的形成和传播延续多个世纪。
editorialNotes.en: Alphabetic writing had earlier predecessors, and the formation and dissemination of the Phoenician system extended over several centuries.

title.zh: 周取代商与天命观念
title.en: Zhou conquest of Shang and the Mandate of Heaven

summary.zh: 约前1046年，周人击败商王朝，建立新的王室统治。周王通过亲族、封国和礼仪关系组织广阔地区，并以天命解释王朝更替与统治责任。青铜器铭文和传世文献保留了分封、祭祀及政治承诺的记录。随着地方力量发展，周代制度与思想又成为后世政治讨论的重要资源。
summary.en: Around 1046 BCE, Zhou forces defeated the Shang and established a new royal order. Kinship, regional grants and ritual relationships helped organise rule, while the concept of the Mandate of Heaven explained dynastic change and the responsibilities of rulers. Bronze inscriptions and transmitted texts preserve political commitments and ceremonial practices that remained influential in later Chinese thought.

significance.zh: 天命与周代礼制成为中国政治和伦理思想的重要基础。
significance.en: The Mandate of Heaven and Zhou ritual institutions became major foundations of Chinese political and ethical thought.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Zhou conquest of Shang and the Mandate of Heaven

editorialNotes.zh: 前1046年是常用的克商年代，具体年份及早期周代年表仍有学术讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 1046 BCE is a widely used date for the Zhou conquest, although the exact year and early Zhou chronology remain subjects of scholarly discussion.

title.zh: 东山文化：红河三角洲的青铜社会
title.en: The Đông Sơn culture: a bronze-age society in the Red River delta

summary.zh: 以越南北部红河三角洲为中心的东山文化属于青铜时代，相关遗存自约公元前1000年延续至公元1世纪。居民种植水稻、饲养水牛与猪，并以长独木舟航行；青铜铸造技术发达，东山铜鼓在越南北部以及中国云南、广西等地均有发现，鼓面纹饰描绘战船、羽饰武士与太阳。
summary.en: The Đông Sơn culture centred on the Red River delta of northern Vietnam belongs to the Bronze Age, with related material running from about 1000 BCE into the first century CE. Its people cultivated rice, kept water buffalo and pigs and sailed long dugout canoes; bronze casting was highly developed, and Đông Sơn drums found in northern Vietnam and in Yunnan and Guangxi depict warships, feathered warriors and a central sun.

significance.zh: 东山文化展示了东南亚大陆本土的青铜技术、航海与稻作社会。
significance.en: The Đông Sơn culture shows indigenous bronze technology, seafaring and rice-based society in mainland Southeast Asia.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Dong Son culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 越南史学传统把该文化与文郎、瓯貉等早期国家相联系，这属于历史解释；本条按考古材料的年代范围表述，不将文献传统当作测年证据。
editorialNotes.en: Vietnamese historiography links the culture to early states such as Văn Lang and Âu Lạc; that is a historical interpretation, and this entry follows the archaeological date range rather than treating textual tradition as dating evidence.

title.zh: 波利尼西亚人的远洋航海与岛屿定居
title.en: Polynesian voyaging and the settlement of the Pacific

summary.zh: 约公元前2000年至前1000年，南岛语族人群从台湾方向扩散到西密克罗尼西亚与美拉尼西亚；其后波利尼西亚人的祖先使用双体与舷外支架独木舟，依靠星辰、鸟群、洋流与风向等知识在太平洋远航，逐步定居从萨摩亚、汤加到夏威夷、新西兰与复活节岛的广大海域。波利尼西亚文化的探索与定居阶段常被概括为约公元前1800年至公元700年。
summary.en: Between about 2000 and 1000 BCE Austronesian speakers spread from the direction of Taiwan into western Micronesia and Melanesia; their Polynesian descendants then used double-hulled and outrigger canoes, navigating by stars, birds, swells and winds to settle the Pacific from Samoa and Tonga to Hawai'i, New Zealand and Rapa Nui. The exploration and settlement era of Polynesian culture is commonly summarised as c. 1800 BCE to c. 700 CE.

significance.zh: 波利尼西亚航海展示了口传知识体系支撑的远洋定居能力。
significance.en: Polynesian voyaging demonstrates ocean-scale settlement sustained by orally transmitted knowledge.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Polynesian navigation（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
Wikipedia — Polynesian culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条以约前1000—公元700年为概括时段，岛屿定居的具体年代各处不同；航海知识通过口述传统传承，不应简化为单一“发现”事件。
editorialNotes.en: The entry uses a broad c. 1000 BCE–700 CE range; individual islands were settled at different times, and navigational knowledge passed through oral tradition rather than a single 'discovery' event.

title.zh: 达马特：埃塞俄比亚高原的早期王国
title.en: Dʿmt: an early kingdom in the Ethiopian highlands

summary.zh: 达马特是位于今厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的埃塞俄比亚—萨巴王国。其确切年代不明，学界提出约公元前8世纪末至前6世纪的时段假设。由于留存铭文很少、考古工作有限，达马特是否在阿克苏姆早期之前结束、是否演变为阿克苏姆国家，或只是后被阿克苏姆统一的地方政权之一，仍无定论。
summary.en: Dʿmt was an Ethio-Sabean kingdom in present-day Eritrea and the northern Tigray region of Ethiopia. Its exact dates are unknown, with a hypothesised span from the late eighth to the sixth century BCE. Because few inscriptions survive and archaeological work is limited, it remains unclear whether Dʿmt ended before the early Aksumite state, evolved into it, or was one of the smaller states later united by Aksum.

significance.zh: 达马特是理解埃塞俄比亚高原早期国家与阿克苏姆起源的关键但证据有限的环节。
significance.en: Dʿmt is a crucial but poorly evidenced link in understanding early statehood in the Ethiopian highlands and the origins of Aksum.

sources.title: Wikipedia — D'mt（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代仅为假设（约前8世纪末—前6世纪），证据有限；本条明确保留不确定性，不把达马特写成阿克苏姆的直接前身。
editorialNotes.en: The dating is hypothetical (late eighth to sixth century BCE) and evidence is limited; the entry keeps the uncertainty explicit and does not present Dʿmt as the direct predecessor of Aksum.

title.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化与安第斯纺织传统
title.en: The Paracas culture and Andean textile traditions

summary.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化是约公元前800年至前100年存在于今秘鲁伊卡地区的安第斯社会。居民掌握灌溉与水资源管理，在纺织艺术上成就突出，墓葬出土的精美织物与彩绘陶器显示复杂的社会分工与信仰。关于该社会的大部分信息来自帕拉卡斯半岛海滨遗址的发掘，20世纪20年代由秘鲁考古学家胡利奥·特略首次系统调查。
summary.en: The Paracas culture was an Andean society of the Ica region of Peru between about 800 and 100 BCE. Its people practised irrigation and water management and were especially accomplished in textile arts, and the fine fabrics and painted ceramics from their tombs indicate complex labour organisation and belief. Most knowledge of the society comes from excavations at the seaside Paracas site, first systematically investigated in the 1920s by the Peruvian archaeologist Julio Tello.

significance.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化以纺织与墓葬证据展示了安第斯早期复杂社会。
significance.en: Paracas shows early Andean social complexity through its textiles and funerary evidence.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Paracas culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代约前800—前100年；帕拉卡斯与后续纳斯卡文化的关系仍有讨论，本条不把两者合并为一个连续政权。
editorialNotes.en: The range is about 800–100 BCE; the relationship with the later Nazca culture remains debated and the two are not merged into one continuous polity.

title.zh: 杜鲁拉早期冶铁

summary.zh: 公元前八世纪左右，今布基纳法索的杜鲁拉已留下冶铁活动的证据。冶炼者把矿石转化为可加工的铁料，需要掌握炉体、燃料和气流之间的配合。这样的技术扩展了制作工具和其他器物的可能性，也为研究西非铁器生产的早期发展提供了关键的考古材料。
summary.en: Around the eighth century BCE, iron production was already taking place at Douroula in present-day Burkina Faso. Smelters transformed ore into workable iron by coordinating furnaces, fuel and airflow. This technical knowledge broadened the possibilities of tool and object production. The archaeological remains provide an important reference point for studying the early development of ironworking in West Africa.

significance.zh: 杜鲁拉为西非早期冶铁技术史提供了直接的遗址证据。
significance.en: Douroula provides direct archaeological evidence for early ironworking in West Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：布基纳法索古代冶铁遗址

editorialNotes.zh: 公元前750年用于表达遗址的公元前八世纪断代；冶铁技术在非洲的起源与传播仍有学术讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 750 BCE summarizes the site's eighth-century BCE dating; the origins and transmission of African ironworking remain debated.

title.zh: 库施王朝统治埃及

summary.zh: 来自尼罗河中游库施地区的统治者向北扩张，建立埃及第二十五王朝。他们整合努比亚与埃及的王权传统，修复神庙、资助宗教建筑，并在政治竞争中强调自己维护传统秩序的角色。随后亚述的军事压力改变了局势，库施王权退回南方，继续在努比亚发展。
summary.en: Rulers from Kush in the middle Nile valley expanded northward and established Egypt’s Twenty-fifth Dynasty. They joined Nubian and Egyptian traditions of kingship, restored temples and sponsored religious building while presenting themselves as protectors of established order. Assyrian military pressure later altered this balance, and Kushite royal power withdrew southward and continued to develop in Nubia.

significance.zh: 展现努比亚与埃及相互交织的政治和宗教历史。
significance.en: Reveals the intertwined political and religious histories of Nubia and Egypt.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kushite rule in Egypt

editorialNotes.zh: 起止年取常见王朝分期；库施王对埃及不同地区的控制是逐步建立和失去的。
editorialNotes.en: The dates follow a common dynastic periodisation; Kushite control over different parts of Egypt was gained and lost gradually.

title.zh: 新亚述帝国的尼尼微

summary.zh: 新亚述君主辛那赫里布及其继承者将尼尼微扩建为宏大的帝国首都，修筑宫殿、城防和供水工程。王室浮雕呈现征战与狩猎，泥板收藏保存宗教、文学和学术知识。城市的繁荣依赖帝国资源与强制性劳动，前612年的陷落则成为新亚述权力崩溃的重要转折。
summary.en: Sennacherib and his successors enlarged Nineveh into a monumental Assyrian imperial capital with palaces, defences and waterworks. Royal reliefs celebrated warfare and hunting, while collections of clay tablets preserved religious, literary and scholarly knowledge. The city drew on imperial resources and coerced labour; its fall in 612 BCE became a major turning point in the collapse of Neo-Assyrian power.

significance.zh: 将帝国治理、工程建设与古代知识保存集中呈现出来。
significance.en: Brings together evidence of imperial government, engineering and the preservation of ancient knowledge.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Nineveh under the Neo-Assyrian Empire

title.zh: 迦太基海上贸易网络扩展
title.en: Carthage expands its maritime trade networks

summary.zh: 公元前六世纪起，北非的迦太基成长为地中海西部的重要商业与政治力量。港口连接北非海岸、岛屿和欧洲沿岸，商贸活动支持城市财富与势力扩张。这个源于腓尼基人定居的城市逐渐发展出自身的政治社会，并与其他地中海强权竞争，深刻影响西部海域的历史。
summary.en: From the sixth century BCE, Carthage developed into a major commercial and political power in the western Mediterranean. Its harbour linked North African shores, islands and European coastlands, supporting the city's wealth and expanding influence. Originating as a Phoenician settlement, Carthage developed its own political society and competed with other Mediterranean powers, profoundly shaping the history of the western basin.

significance.zh: 迦太基说明古代北非在地中海海上经济中处于核心位置。
significance.en: Carthage highlights North Africa's central role in the ancient Mediterranean maritime economy.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：迦太基考古遗址

title.zh: 孔子及儒家思想的早期发展
title.en: Confucius and the early Confucian tradition

summary.zh: 孔子生活在春秋后期礼制与政治秩序不断变化的时代。他通过教学和与诸侯、弟子的讨论，思考仁、礼、学习与为政的关系，强调个人修养及社会责任。弟子及后学整理、解释这些思想，使儒家传统逐步形成，并在后来的教育、伦理和国家治理中获得持久影响。
summary.en: Confucius lived during the later Spring and Autumn period, when political and ritual relationships were changing. Through teaching and discussion with rulers and disciples, he explored humaneness, ritual, learning and government, stressing personal cultivation and social responsibility. His followers collected and interpreted these teachings, helping form a tradition that deeply influenced education, ethics and political life in later centuries.

significance.zh: 奠定了儒家教育、伦理与政治思考的早期基础。
significance.en: Laid early foundations for Confucian approaches to education, ethics and government.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Confucius and the early Confucian tradition

editorialNotes.zh: 前551—前479年为传统生卒年；传世文本的形成与编订跨越后续多个时期。
editorialNotes.en: 551–479 BCE are the traditional life dates; the surviving texts were formed and edited across subsequent periods.

title.zh: 居鲁士攻占巴比伦

summary.zh: 前539年，波斯王居鲁士占领巴比伦，将这座城市及其广阔腹地纳入阿契美尼德帝国。新统治者利用地方行政与宗教传统巩固权力，并通过王室铭文塑造恢复秩序的形象。巴比伦的经济、学术和宗教生活继续发展，帝国则借助多地区制度扩大统治规模。
summary.en: In 539 BCE, Cyrus of Persia captured Babylon and incorporated the city and its extensive hinterland into the Achaemenid Empire. The new rulers drew on local administrative and religious traditions to consolidate authority, while royal inscriptions presented the conquest as a restoration of order. Babylon’s economic, scholarly and religious life continued within a growing imperial system.

significance.zh: 使巴比伦进入波斯帝国，也展示了征服与地方制度延续的联系。
significance.en: Brought Babylon into the Persian Empire and illustrates how conquest could coexist with institutional continuity.

sources.title: www.britishmuseum.org — Cyrus takes Babylon

editorialNotes.zh: 居鲁士圆柱是具有政治目的的王室铭文，其现代“人权宣言”式解读需与古代语境区分。
editorialNotes.en: The Cyrus Cylinder is a royal inscription with political purposes; modern interpretations as a human-rights declaration require distinction from its ancient context.

title.zh: 雅典的民主制度改革

summary.zh: 前508至前507年，克里斯提尼推动雅典政治改革，以新的部落和地方组织重新安排公民参与，削弱部分旧有贵族关系的影响。公民大会和议事制度在此基础上继续发展，扩大了男性公民处理公共事务的作用。妇女、奴隶和外邦移民仍被排除在主要政治权利之外，民主与社会不平等同时存在。
summary.en: In 508–507 BCE, Cleisthenes reorganised Athenian civic participation through new tribes and local units, weakening some older aristocratic networks. Assemblies and councils subsequently developed around these arrangements, increasing the role of male citizens in public affairs. Women, enslaved people and resident foreigners remained excluded from principal political rights, so democracy grew alongside substantial social inequality.

significance.zh: 成为理解公民政治的发展及其历史边界的重要案例。
significance.en: Provides a major example of the development of citizen government and its historical limits.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Democratic reforms at Athens

title.zh: 佛陀的教导与早期佛教
title.en: The Buddha and early Buddhist communities

summary.zh: 约前五世纪，释迦牟尼在恒河流域活动，围绕苦、欲望、修行与解脱展开教导，并吸引弟子建立修行团体。这些团体通过口传保存教义，在不同地区逐渐形成寺院与教育网络。佛教后来跨越南亚、中亚和东亚传播，也在与当地社会的接触中发展出多种思想和实践传统。
summary.en: Around the fifth century BCE, Siddhartha Gautama taught in the Ganges region about suffering, desire, disciplined practice and liberation, attracting followers who formed communities of practice. Oral transmission preserved the teachings as monastic and educational networks developed. Buddhism later spread through South, Central and East Asia, taking varied intellectual and ritual forms through interaction with local societies.

significance.zh: 开启了影响广泛的宗教、哲学与跨区域文化传统。
significance.en: Began a far-reaching tradition of religion, philosophy and cross-regional cultural exchange.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Buddha and early Buddhist communities

editorialNotes.zh: 佛陀的生卒年存在明显分歧，本条以约前500年作为早期教导活动的宽泛时间锚点。
editorialNotes.en: The Buddha’s life dates are substantially disputed; about 500 BCE serves as a broad chronological anchor for his early teaching activity.

title.zh: 诺克陶塑传统

summary.zh: 今尼日利亚中部的诺克文化留下了富有表现力的陶塑人物与动物形象。精细的造型、装饰和烧制技术反映了专业技能，也为探索当时的社会身份与仪式活动提供线索。诺克遗存与铁器时代的发展联系在一起，显示西非古代社会在艺术生产和技术实践方面积累了深厚经验。
summary.en: Nok communities in what is now central Nigeria produced expressive terracotta figures of people and animals. Their modelling, decoration and firing techniques reveal specialised skills and provide clues to social identities and ritual activity. Associated with developments of the Iron Age, Nok remains document a substantial history of artistic production and technical practice in ancient West Africa.

significance.zh: 凸显西非古代艺术传统与社会技术发展的历史深度。
significance.en: Highlights the depth of West African artistic traditions and social and technical development.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Nok terracotta traditions

editorialNotes.zh: 前500年至公元200年采用所引博物馆专题的阶段范围；诺克文化的整体年代比这一展示范围更长。
editorialNotes.en: 500 BCE–200 CE follows the phase discussed by the cited museum essay; the broader chronology of Nok culture extends beyond this interval.

title.zh: 萨波特克都城蒙特阿尔班发展
title.en: Development of the Zapotec capital Monte Alban

summary.zh: 公元前五世纪起，萨波特克人在瓦哈卡谷地上方的山丘营建蒙特阿尔班。整平山顶、修筑梯地和水利设施，使宫殿、神庙、球场与墓葬组成宏大的城市中心。带铭文的浮雕记录了政治和仪式活动，城市长期影响周围谷地，并留下跨越一千多年的社会与艺术变迁。
summary.en: From the fifth century BCE, Zapotec communities developed Monte Alban on hills above the Oaxaca valleys. Levelling, terraces and waterworks supported a monumental centre of palaces, temples, ball courts and tombs. Carved inscriptions recorded political and ceremonial activities. The city exerted influence over its surrounding valleys and preserves more than a millennium of changes in social organization and artistic practice.

significance.zh: 蒙特阿尔班体现了中美洲早期城市规划、文字与区域政治的发展。
significance.en: Monte Alban illuminates early Mesoamerican urban planning, writing and regional political organization.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：瓦哈卡与蒙特阿尔班

title.zh: 波希战争

summary.zh: 前490至前479年，阿契美尼德波斯与若干希腊城邦发生一系列战争，马拉松、萨拉米斯和普拉提亚成为其中著名战役。城邦之间合作、竞争与立场分化并存，海军和补给能力对战局十分关键。战争结束后，雅典的海上势力增长，爱琴海地区的政治联盟也随之重组。
summary.en: Between 490 and 479 BCE, Achaemenid Persia and several Greek city-states fought a series of wars, including the battles of Marathon, Salamis and Plataea. Cooperation among Greek communities coexisted with rivalry and divided loyalties, while naval power and supplies shaped the campaigns. In their aftermath, Athens expanded its maritime influence and political alliances across the Aegean were reorganised.

significance.zh: 改变了爱琴海地区的权力关系，并推动雅典海上势力扩张。
significance.en: Changed the Aegean balance of power and encouraged the expansion of Athenian maritime influence.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Greco-Persian Wars

title.zh: 战国时代的国家竞争
title.en: State competition in the Warring States period

summary.zh: 战国时期，各国通过军事改革、税制调整和官僚组织增强力量，战争规模与动员能力不断扩大。铁器、农业生产和城市交换的发展改变了社会生活，游说者与思想家则围绕秩序、法度和君主责任提出不同主张。持续竞争最终以秦的统一告一段落，也为帝国治理准备了制度与思想资源。
summary.en: During the Warring States period, competing states strengthened their armies, taxation and bureaucratic administration. Changes in ironworking, agriculture and urban exchange transformed social life, while thinkers and advisers debated order, law and the responsibilities of rulers. Prolonged competition culminated in Qin unification and left a rich inheritance of institutions and ideas for imperial government.

significance.zh: 国家竞争推动了制度重组与诸子思想的发展。
significance.en: Competition among states drove institutional change and the development of major philosophical traditions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — State competition in the Warring States period

editorialNotes.zh: 战国起点有前475年、前403年等不同划法；这里沿用原数据的前403年。
editorialNotes.en: The period is variously dated from 475 or 403 BCE; this entry retains the original dataset’s 403 BCE boundary.

title.zh: 亚历山大的东征

summary.zh: 亚历山大率马其顿军队渡入亚洲，击败阿契美尼德帝国，随后远征至印度河流域。征服造成战争破坏，也建立了新的驻军、城市和统治网络。其死后，继承者分割帝国，各地希腊语文化与既有传统持续交融，形成通常称为希腊化时代的政治与文化格局。
summary.en: Alexander led Macedonian forces into Asia, defeated the Achaemenid Empire and campaigned as far as the Indus region. Conquest caused destruction while creating new garrisons, cities and networks of rule. After his death, successor rulers divided the empire, and interactions between Greek-speaking institutions and established local traditions shaped the political and cultural worlds of the Hellenistic period.

significance.zh: 重组了东地中海与西亚的政治联系和文化交流网络。
significance.en: Reorganised political connections and cultural exchange across the eastern Mediterranean and western Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Alexander’s campaigns into Asia

title.zh: 孔雀王朝兴起

summary.zh: 约前322年，旃陀罗笈多在北印度建立孔雀王朝，并逐渐扩展统治。以华氏城为中心的王权组织军队、官员和资源征收，连接恒河流域及更广阔的地区。继任统治者继续扩张，也面对如何治理不同地方社会的问题，使孔雀王朝成为南亚早期大型帝国的重要阶段。
summary.en: Around 322 BCE, Chandragupta established the Mauryan dynasty in northern India and began expanding its authority. From Pataliputra, rulers organised armies, officials and the collection of resources, linking the Ganges region with a much wider territory. Successors extended these connections while confronting the challenges of governing diverse local societies, creating a major early imperial formation in South Asia.

significance.zh: 推动南亚大范围政治整合与行政组织的发展。
significance.en: Advanced large-scale political integration and administrative organisation in South Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Rise of the Mauryan dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 王朝建立年采用常用约数，不同历史重建对旃陀罗笈多的早期经历和年代有细节差异。
editorialNotes.en: The founding date is a common approximation; reconstructions differ in some details of Chandragupta’s early career and chronology.

title.zh: 欧几里得编纂《几何原本》

summary.zh: 约公元前300年，亚历山大里亚的欧几里得把前人积累的几何、比例和数论知识整理成《几何原本》。书中从定义、基本假设与共同概念出发，依次建立命题之间的证明关系。清晰的组织方式让它成为长期使用的教学经典，其严密论证的理想影响了后来多个语言世界中的数学研究。
summary.en: Around 300 BCE, Euclid in Alexandria organized inherited knowledge of geometry, proportion and number into the Elements. Beginning with definitions, postulates and common notions, the work arranged propositions into connected chains of proof. Its systematic exposition made it a durable teaching text, while its ideal of rigorous demonstration influenced mathematical study across later linguistic and intellectual traditions.

significance.zh: 《几何原本》使系统化证明成为数学教学与研究的重要范式。
significance.en: The Elements made systematic proof a lasting model for mathematical teaching and research.

sources.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学MacTutor数学史：Euclid

editorialNotes.zh: 欧几里得生平材料很少，约前300年是活动及编纂年代的常见估计。
editorialNotes.en: Evidence for Euclid's life is sparse; around 300 BCE is a conventional estimate for his activity and compilation.

title.zh: 麦罗埃的库施王国

summary.zh: 库施王国的政治重心逐渐转向麦罗埃，城市与周围地区发展出宫殿、神庙、金字塔墓地和手工业。铁器生产、农业及区域贸易支撑王权，麦罗埃文字也留下了自身的书写传统。位于尼罗河与非洲内陆联系地带的这一中心，持续吸收外来因素并形成独特的政治和艺术面貌。
summary.en: Kushite political activity increasingly centred on Meroe, where palaces, temples, pyramid cemeteries and craft production developed. Ironworking, agriculture and regional trade supported royal power, while the Meroitic script expressed a distinctive written tradition. Situated between Nile networks and inland African connections, the centre incorporated outside influences while developing its own political and artistic character.

significance.zh: 显示尼罗河上游国家在技术、贸易与文化创造中的持续活力。
significance.en: Shows the continuing vitality of upper Nile states in technology, trade and cultural production.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The Kushite kingdom at Meroe

editorialNotes.zh: 所列区间选取麦罗埃作为重要王权中心的阶段；文字仍有大量内容无法充分解读。
editorialNotes.en: The interval selects Meroe’s importance as a royal centre; much of its written language remains incompletely understood.

title.zh: 阿努拉德普勒：佛教圣城的兴衰
title.en: Anuradhapura: rise and fall of a Buddhist sacred city

summary.zh: 约公元前3世纪起，阿努拉德普勒成为僧伽罗王国的都城与上座部佛教中心。佛塔、寺院与供水系统在城市周围扩展，僧团与王权互相支持，来自南亚与东南亚的朝圣者和商人往来其间。十世纪末，南印度朱罗军队攻占并破坏城市，政治中心随后东移，但寺院与朝圣传统延续下来。
summary.en: From about the third century BCE Anuradhapura served as the capital of Sinhalese kings and a centre of Theravada Buddhism. Stupas, monasteries and waterworks spread around the city as monastic institutions and royal power supported one another, while pilgrims and traders arrived from South and Southeast Asia. At the end of the tenth century a Chola army sacked the city and the political centre moved east.

significance.zh: 阿努拉德普勒体现了王权、僧团与水利社会在南亚的长期结合。
significance.en: Anuradhapura embodies the long alliance of royal power, monastic institutions and irrigation society in South Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Sacred City of Anuradhapura

editorialNotes.zh: 前3世纪为圣城传统的起点；993年是政治中心转移的事件年份，不代表佛教传统的终结。
editorialNotes.en: The third century BCE marks the beginning of the sacred-city tradition; 993 is a political event year, not the end of Buddhist practice.

title.zh: 阿育王的羯陵伽战争与法敕

summary.zh: 孔雀王朝的阿育王在羯陵伽战争后，通过岩石和石柱铭文宣示自己对统治责任的理解。敕令讨论减少伤害、善待臣民、尊重不同宗教群体等问题，也记录帝国官员和传播命令的方式。王室对佛教的支持扩大了其影响，战争经历与道德治理之间的张力成为阿育王历史形象的重要部分。
summary.en: After the Kalinga war, the Mauryan ruler Ashoka used inscriptions on rocks and pillars to explain his understanding of royal responsibility. The edicts discuss reducing harm, caring for subjects and respecting different religious communities, while revealing how imperial officials communicated authority. Royal support strengthened Buddhism, and the tension between conquest and ethical government became central to Ashoka’s historical legacy.

significance.zh: 留下了古代统治者公开阐述道德治理的珍贵铭文。
significance.en: Preserves exceptional inscriptions in which an ancient ruler publicly articulated ethical government.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Ashoka’s Kalinga war and edicts

editorialNotes.zh: 羯陵伽战争及早期法敕使用约年代；敕令中的统治者自我描述需要与其他史料共同阅读。
editorialNotes.en: The Kalinga war and early edicts use approximate dates; the ruler’s self-presentation should be read alongside other historical evidence.

title.zh: 秦统一与帝国制度

summary.zh: 前221年，秦完成对六国的征服，秦王政采用皇帝称号，并将大片地区纳入郡县行政。统一后的度量衡、文字规范和交通建设加强了治理与资源调动，沉重徭役和强制政策也加剧社会压力。秦朝虽很快覆亡，其制度实践却深刻影响了后来的汉代及中国帝国政治。
summary.en: In 221 BCE, Qin completed its conquest of the rival states, and King Zheng adopted the title of emperor. Commandery and county administration, standardisation and transport projects strengthened government and resource mobilisation across a large territory. Heavy labour demands and coercive policies also generated pressure. Although the dynasty fell quickly, its institutions profoundly influenced Han and later imperial government.

significance.zh: 确立了此后帝国治理反复继承与调整的一套制度框架。
significance.en: Established an institutional framework repeatedly inherited and modified by later imperial governments.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Qin unification and imperial institutions

title.zh: 第二次布匿战争

summary.zh: 第二次布匿战争中，汉尼拔率军进入意大利，在多场战役中重创罗马。罗马则依靠联盟、兵员和持续作战能力稳住局势，并将攻势扩展到伊比利亚与北非。前202年扎马战役后，迦太基接受严厉条件，罗马在西地中海的优势得到巩固，战争也给沿途社会带来长期损失。
summary.en: During the Second Punic War, Hannibal invaded Italy and inflicted major defeats on Roman armies. Rome sustained its position through alliances, manpower and continued mobilisation, while extending operations into Iberia and North Africa. Following Zama in 202 BCE, Carthage accepted severe terms, consolidating Roman predominance in the western Mediterranean after years of disruption and loss across affected societies.

significance.zh: 改变了西地中海的力量对比，并加速罗马的海外扩张。
significance.en: Changed the western Mediterranean balance of power and accelerated Roman overseas expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Second Punic War

title.zh: 汉王朝建立

summary.zh: 刘邦在秦末战争和楚汉竞争中胜出，于前202年建立汉朝。新政权在继承秦代行政经验的同时调整统治方式，逐渐处理诸侯王、地方官员与中央之间的关系。农业恢复、财政组织和后续边疆经营支撑了长期统治，汉代的政治制度与文化传统由此展开。
summary.en: After warfare following Qin’s collapse and the struggle with Xiang Yu, Liu Bang established the Han dynasty in 202 BCE. The new regime adapted Qin administrative practices while renegotiating relations among the court, regional kings and local officials. Agricultural recovery, fiscal organisation and later frontier policies supported a long period of rule and the development of influential political and cultural traditions.

significance.zh: 开启了对中国制度、文化与欧亚联系影响深远的王朝时代。
significance.en: Opened a dynastic era with lasting effects on Chinese institutions, culture and Eurasian connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of the Han dynasty

title.zh: 纳斯卡地画与沙漠社会

summary.zh: 秘鲁南部干旱地区的纳斯卡人移开深色地表石块，形成动物、植物和几何形状的巨大地画。沙漠环境让这些痕迹长期保存，相关道路、聚落和礼仪遗存则显示地画与社会活动的联系。居民还发展出适应缺水环境的生产方式，使艺术、信仰和环境管理共同塑造了这片景观。
summary.en: People in the Nazca region of southern Peru removed dark surface stones to create enormous animal, plant and geometric designs. Arid conditions preserved these traces, while associated paths, settlements and ritual remains connect the geoglyphs with social activity. Communities also developed ways of living with limited water, bringing artistic expression, belief and environmental management together in a distinctive landscape.

significance.zh: 保存了安第斯社会将仪式活动融入自然环境的独特证据。
significance.en: Preserves distinctive evidence of how Andean communities incorporated ritual into their environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Nazca geoglyphs and desert societies

editorialNotes.zh: 地画的具体功能、建造阶段和使用者关系仍有多种解释，所列年代涵盖一个宽泛发展阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The functions, construction phases and users of the geoglyphs remain subjects of differing interpretations; the dates span a broad development phase.

title.zh: 骠国城市与灌溉社会发展
title.en: Pyu cities and irrigated urban society

summary.zh: 公元前后，伊洛瓦底江流域的骠人逐渐建起带城墙和护城河的城市。室利差呾罗等中心通过蓄水与灌溉支持农业，城内出现宫殿、佛塔和手工业作坊。居民吸收南亚的宗教与文字传统，又在本地社会中重新塑造它们，城市之间及其与印度、中国的贸易联系随之扩大。
summary.en: Around the beginning of the Common Era, Pyu communities in the Ayeyarwady basin developed cities enclosed by walls and moats. Centres such as Sri Ksetra supported agriculture through water storage and irrigation, alongside palaces, Buddhist monuments and workshops. Residents adapted South Asian religious and written traditions while maintaining exchanges with other Southeast Asian communities, India and China.

significance.zh: 农业水利、城市组织和跨区域交流共同推动了缅甸早期城市社会的发展。
significance.en: Irrigation, urban organization and long-distance exchange together sustained early cities in Myanmar.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：骠国古城

title.zh: 丝绸之路廊道上的跨洲交换
title.en: Transcontinental exchange along the Silk Roads corridor

summary.zh: 公元前二世纪以后，连接长安与中亚绿洲的交通线持续扩展，商队、使者与僧侣沿塔里木盆地南北两道往来。丝绸、马匹、玻璃、香料与纸张在绿洲城市间转手，佛教、摩尼教与伊斯兰教也随商路传播。十四世纪前后海上贸易与政治变动改变了陆路格局，但廊道上的城市与知识网络并未立即消失。
summary.en: After the second century BCE the routes linking Chang'an with Central Asian oases expanded, carrying caravans, envoys and monks along the northern and southern edges of the Tarim basin. Silk, horses, glass, aromatics and paper changed hands in oasis cities, while Buddhism, Manichaeism and Islam spread along the same roads. Maritime trade and political change later reshaped these networks without ending them at once.

significance.zh: 这条廊道说明欧亚大陆的贸易、宗教与知识交流长期依赖同一套绿洲城市网络。
significance.en: The corridor shows how trade, religion and knowledge in Eurasia depended on one network of oasis cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an–Tianshan Corridor

editorialNotes.zh: 本条描述廊道网络的长期运行，不主张某条路线的精确走向，也不把商路视为由单一政权全程管理。
editorialNotes.en: This entry describes the long-running network rather than an exact route alignment, and does not treat the routes as administered by a single power throughout.

title.zh: 张骞出使与欧亚交流
title.en: Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

summary.zh: 汉武帝派张骞出使西域，寻求与月氏等势力的联系。他在长期滞留与行旅后返回汉廷，带回关于中亚地区政治、物产和道路的信息。此后汉朝的军事、外交和贸易活动进一步向西展开，使原有的欧亚交换网络获得新的联系，也让不同地区的知识与商品更加频繁地流动。
summary.en: Emperor Wu sent Zhang Qian westward to seek contacts with the Yuezhi and other powers. After prolonged captivity and travel, he returned with information about Central Asian politics, products and routes. Subsequent Han diplomacy, military activity and trade extended these connections, adding to existing Eurasian networks through which knowledge, people and goods circulated with growing frequency.

significance.zh: 扩展了汉朝对中亚的认识及其参与欧亚交流的范围。
significance.en: Expanded Han knowledge of Central Asia and its participation in Eurasian exchange.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

title.zh: 佛教沿丝绸之路的传播
title.en: Buddhism travels along the Silk Roads

summary.zh: 公元前后的数百年间，佛教从印度经中亚绿洲传入塔里木盆地与中国内地，僧侣、商队与使团沿同一路线往返。译经活动把梵文与中亚语言文本转写为汉文，寺院在绿洲城市和交通节点建立，犍陀罗与敦煌等地形成融合多种艺术传统的造像与壁画。八世纪以后陆路佛教社群在部分地区衰落，但网络遗产延续至今。
summary.en: In the centuries around the beginning of the common era, Buddhism travelled from India through Central Asian oases into the Tarim basin and China, carried by monks, merchants and envoys. Translation projects rendered Sanskrit and Central Asian texts into Chinese, monasteries grew at oasis towns, and Gandhara and Dunhuang developed hybrid sculptural and mural traditions.

significance.zh: 佛教的陆路传播说明宗教、贸易与翻译网络在欧亚大陆相互交织。
