significance.en: The overland spread of Buddhism shows how religious, commercial and translation networks intertwined across Eurasia.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Buddhism along the Silk Road

editorialNotes.zh: 传播并非单向或均质，各地接受的时间与形式差异很大，本条只用世纪尺度表述。
editorialNotes.en: Transmission was neither one-way nor uniform; the entry therefore uses century-scale phrasing.

title.zh: 奥古斯都与罗马元首制

summary.zh: 前27年，屋大维获得奥古斯都称号，在内战之后建立以个人权威为核心的新政治秩序。他保留共和国的许多官职与形式，同时控制关键军队、省份和资源。元首制使罗马统治获得较长时期的稳定，也将政治权力与皇室继承问题紧密结合，改变了地中海世界的治理方式。
summary.en: In 27 BCE, Octavian received the title Augustus and consolidated a new political order after civil war. Republican offices and procedures continued, while decisive control over armies, provinces and resources centred on one ruler. The principate brought greater stability to Roman rule but also tied political authority to questions of imperial succession, transforming government across the Mediterranean world.

significance.zh: 奠定了罗马帝国元首制的政治基础。
significance.en: Established the political foundations of the Roman imperial principate.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Augustus and the Roman Principate

title.zh: 印度洋季风贸易网络

summary.zh: 公元初的印度洋航海者利用季风往返红海、阿拉伯半岛、东非和南亚港口。香料、织物、象牙及贵金属通过多种商人和地方市场流通，港口社会也在语言、信仰和生活方式上相互影响。海上航行与陆地运输相接，使广阔海域逐渐成为联系多个经济中心的交换空间。
summary.en: In the early centuries CE, Indian Ocean sailors used the monsoons to travel among ports in the Red Sea, Arabia, eastern Africa and South Asia. Spices, textiles, ivory and precious metals passed through diverse merchants and local markets. Maritime voyages joined overland transport, while port communities exchanged languages, beliefs and practices across an increasingly connected commercial world.

significance.zh: 展示季风知识与港口网络如何支撑跨区域贸易。
significance.en: Shows how knowledge of the monsoons and networks of ports sustained interregional trade.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Indian Ocean monsoon trading networks

title.zh: 霍普韦尔仪式土方工程兴盛

summary.zh: 公元最初四个世纪，俄亥俄河支流流域的社群定期聚集，修筑规模宏大的圆形、方形和八角形土垒。精确的几何布局与日月运行周期相联系，显示长期观察和工程知识的积累。来自远方的原料被制成精美仪式器物，说明这些以耕种、采集和捕鱼维生的社群参与了广泛交流。
summary.en: During the first four centuries CE, communities along tributaries of the Ohio River gathered to build enormous circular, square and octagonal earthworks. Precise layouts related to solar and lunar cycles reflect sustained observation and engineering knowledge. Fine ceremonial objects used materials obtained from distant places, showing extensive connections among communities supported by cultivation, gathering and fishing.

significance.zh: 霍普韦尔遗址把天文观察、几何规划与跨区域社会交往结合在一起。
significance.en: Hopewell earthworks unite astronomical observation, geometric design and interregional social connections.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：霍普韦尔仪式土方工程

title.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎的都市繁荣

summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎在墨西哥高原成长为大型都市，居民沿规划道路生活，修筑金字塔、广场和多家庭住宅区。专业工匠制作黑曜石制品、陶器等物品，城市与周围地区保持广泛交换。来自不同背景的人群共同塑造了都市生活，其建筑和文化影响远及中美洲其他地区。
summary.en: Teotihuacan grew into a major city in the Mexican highlands, with planned streets, pyramids, plazas and multifamily residential compounds. Specialised craftspeople produced obsidian objects, pottery and other goods exchanged through extensive regional connections. Residents of different backgrounds shaped its urban life, while the city’s architecture and cultural influence reached many other parts of Mesoamerica.

significance.zh: 成为研究美洲古代都市规模、多样性与区域联系的重要案例。
significance.en: Provides a major case for studying the scale, diversity and regional connections of ancient American cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban flourishing at Teotihuacan

editorialNotes.zh: 统治者身份、政治组织和衰落过程仍存在讨论，主要发展阶段的边界为约数。
editorialNotes.en: The identities of rulers, political organisation and processes of decline remain debated; the boundaries of the principal development phase are approximate.

title.zh: 耶稣活动与基督教起源
title.en: Jesus and the origins of Christianity

summary.zh: 耶稣在罗马统治下的犹太地区开展教导，吸引追随者，并最终在耶路撒冷被处死。门徒围绕他的生活、死亡与复活信仰形成社群，通过传教、书信和聚会扩展联系。早期基督教在犹太传统与罗马地中海社会中发展，逐渐形成自己的经文、礼仪和组织方式。
summary.en: Jesus taught in Judaea under Roman rule, gathered followers and was eventually executed in Jerusalem. His disciples formed communities around accounts of his life and death and their belief in his resurrection, spreading connections through preaching, letters and gatherings. Early Christianity developed within Jewish traditions and the Roman Mediterranean, gradually establishing its scriptures, rituals and forms of organisation.

significance.zh: 开启了后来广泛传播的基督教社群与思想传统。
significance.en: Began the communities and intellectual traditions from which Christianity spread widely.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Jesus and the origins of Christianity

editorialNotes.zh: 处刑年代通常估计在公元30年前后，也有公元33年等方案；宗教信仰内容与可考历史叙述的证据性质不同。
editorialNotes.en: The execution is commonly dated around 30 CE, with 33 CE among other proposals. Religious beliefs and historical reconstructions rest on different kinds of evidence.

title.zh: 征氏姐妹起义

summary.zh: 公元40年，征侧与征贰领导反抗东汉统治的起义，获得今越南北部多地支持，并建立短暂的独立政权。汉军随后南下，至43年镇压起义并加强地方控制。征氏姐妹的故事在后世被持续纪念，成为越南历史记忆中地方自主、反抗统治与女性领导力的重要象征。
summary.en: In 40 CE, Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị led an uprising against Eastern Han rule, gaining support across parts of present-day northern Vietnam and establishing a short-lived independent government. Han forces suppressed the revolt by 43 and strengthened their control. Later commemoration made the sisters enduring figures of autonomy, resistance and women’s leadership in Vietnamese historical memory.

significance.zh: 留下了越南早期政治反抗与女性领导的重要历史记忆。
significance.en: Created an enduring historical memory of early Vietnamese resistance and women’s leadership.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Trưng sisters’ uprising

title.zh: 维苏威火山喷发

summary.zh: 公元79年，维苏威火山猛烈喷发，火山灰、碎屑与高温流动掩埋庞贝、赫库兰尼姆及周边聚落。灾难夺去众多生命，也封存了房屋、商铺、壁画和日常用品。后来发掘的遗迹让研究者能够细察罗马城市中的居住、劳动、消费与社会差异，使一次灾难留下了罕见的生活记录。
summary.en: In 79 CE, Vesuvius erupted violently, burying Pompeii, Herculaneum and nearby settlements beneath ash, debris and hot flows. Many people died, while houses, shops, paintings and everyday objects were sealed beneath the deposits. Later excavations created an unusually detailed record of housing, work, consumption and social differences within Roman urban life.

significance.zh: 让古代自然灾害与罗马城市日常生活获得了罕见的实物记录。
significance.en: Preserved exceptional material evidence of an ancient disaster and everyday Roman urban life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Eruption of Mount Vesuvius

editorialNotes.zh: 喷发发生在79年，但具体月份和日期仍因文献抄本与考古材料而有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: The eruption occurred in 79 CE, but its precise month and date remain debated in light of manuscript and archaeological evidence.

title.zh: 罗马斗兽场落成与公共娱乐
title.en: Inauguration of the Colosseum and Roman public entertainment

summary.zh: 公元80年，提图斯为罗马斗兽场举行落成活动。这座由弗拉维王朝修建的圆形竞技场可容纳数万观众，用于角斗、狩猎表演与公开处决。竞技活动与皇帝、元老和民众之间的政治关系相连，也依赖帝国各地提供的物资与人力。斗兽场在后世被反复使用和拆解，其外壳仍是最具辨识度的罗马建筑之一。
summary.en: In 80 CE Titus inaugurated the Colosseum, the Flavian amphitheatre built for tens of thousands of spectators, where gladiatorial contests, hunts and executions took place. The shows were bound up with political relations among emperor, senate and people and depended on supplies and manpower drawn from across the empire. Later reuse and stone robbing left the arena's shell.

significance.zh: 斗兽场把罗马的公共娱乐、皇权展示与帝国资源动员集中在一座建筑之中。
significance.en: The Colosseum concentrated Roman public entertainment, imperial display and resource mobilisation in one building.

sources.title: Parco archeologico del Colosseo — Blood and the Arena

editorialNotes.zh: 80年为落成活动之年，建筑在弗拉维王朝期间分期完成；后世使用与拆解持续到中世纪以后。
editorialNotes.en: 80 CE is the inauguration year; the building was completed in stages under the Flavians, and later reuse and stone removal continued for centuries.

title.zh: 贵霜时代的跨区域交流

summary.zh: 贵霜王朝控制了中亚与南亚之间的重要地区，城市、商路和钱币流通将不同人群联系起来。佛教寺院与艺术活动在王室及商人支持下发展，犍陀罗等地的雕塑吸收多种文化传统。跨区域贸易、宗教赞助和多语言环境共同塑造了这一时期富有交流特色的社会。
summary.en: The Kushan dynasty ruled important areas between Central and South Asia, connecting diverse populations through cities, trade routes and circulating coinage. Royal and mercantile patronage supported Buddhist institutions and artistic production, while sculpture in regions such as Gandhara drew on several cultural traditions. Commerce, religious sponsorship and multilingual life shaped a society marked by extensive cross-regional interaction.

significance.zh: 加强了中亚、南亚与更远地区之间的贸易和佛教文化联系。
significance.en: Strengthened commercial and Buddhist cultural connections between Central Asia, South Asia and regions beyond.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Cross-regional exchange under the Kushans

editorialNotes.zh: 贵霜早期及迦腻色迦的年代仍有不同年表，本条选取公元100—250年的宽泛交流繁荣阶段。
editorialNotes.en: Chronologies differ for the early Kushans and Kanishka; this entry selects a broad period of flourishing exchange between 100 and 250 CE.

title.zh: 莫切社会的灌溉与艺术

summary.zh: 秘鲁北部沿海的莫切社会利用河流建设灌溉系统，在干旱环境中支撑农业和聚落。大型土砖建筑、精细陶器与金属制品体现了劳动组织和专业技艺，墓葬及图像也记录了社会等级与仪式暴力。各河谷中心通过竞争和交流形成不断变化的关系，留下丰富的安第斯社会史材料。
summary.en: Moche communities on Peru’s northern coast used river-fed irrigation to support farming and settlements in an arid environment. Monumental adobe buildings, elaborate ceramics and metalwork reveal organised labour and specialised skills, while burials and imagery document hierarchy and ritual violence. Relations among valley centres changed through competition and exchange, leaving a rich record of Andean social life.

significance.zh: 展现干旱海岸的农业管理、权力关系与艺术生产。
significance.en: Illuminates agricultural management, relations of power and artistic production on an arid coast.

sources.title: peabody.harvard.edu — Moche irrigation and artistic traditions
The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Moche Decorated Ceramics

editorialNotes.zh: 莫切各河谷的政治统一程度及变化过程仍有争论，研究通常强调区域差异。
editorialNotes.en: The extent and changing nature of political integration among Moche valleys remain debated; research commonly emphasises regional differences.

title.zh: 蔡伦与造纸技术的改进
title.en: Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

summary.zh: 传统史料记载，蔡伦于105年向汉廷报告改进的造纸方法，使用树皮、麻和破旧织物等纤维材料。更方便制作和使用的纸逐渐扩大了书写材料的选择，并在行政、教育和宗教活动中发挥作用。此后技术经过长期改进与传播，成为不同地区保存和交流文字的重要基础。
summary.en: Traditional accounts associate 105 CE with Cai Lun’s report to the Han court on improved papermaking from fibres including bark, hemp and old textiles. Paper gradually widened the available materials for writing and became important in administration, education and religion. Centuries of technical refinement and transmission later made it fundamental to storing and exchanging written information across many regions.

significance.zh: 推动纸成为日益普及的书写与知识传播材料。
significance.en: Helped paper become an increasingly widespread medium for writing and transmitting knowledge.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

editorialNotes.zh: 考古发现的纸早于蔡伦的记录；105年对应史料中的改进与报告，造纸技术本身经历长期发展。
editorialNotes.en: Archaeological paper predates Cai Lun’s report; 105 CE marks the improvement recorded in historical accounts, within a much longer technological development.

title.zh: 安东尼瘟疫

summary.zh: 二世纪后期，一场严重疫病在罗马帝国传播，影响军队、城市居民和帝国资源调度。医师盖伦等人的记述保存了症状及流行情况，也反映了当时应对疾病的知识条件。战争、人口流动和交通网络扩大了人群接触，使这场危机成为研究帝国社会与传染病相互作用的重要案例。
summary.en: A severe epidemic spread through the Roman Empire in the later second century, affecting armies, urban populations and the mobilisation of resources. Accounts associated with Galen and other writers preserve descriptions of illness and contemporary medical understanding. Warfare, population movement and transport networks increased contact among communities, making the crisis important for studying the relationship between imperial society and infectious disease.

significance.zh: 揭示帝国交通、战争和公共健康之间的紧密联系。
significance.en: Reveals close connections among imperial transport, warfare and public health.

sources.title: www.getty.edu — The Antonine epidemic

editorialNotes.zh: 天花是常见的回溯诊断，但病原尚未确定；死亡总数与长期经济影响也难以精确估算。
editorialNotes.en: Smallpox is a common retrospective diagnosis, but the pathogen is not established; total mortality and long-term economic effects are also difficult to estimate precisely.

title.zh: 玛雅古典时期的城市网络

summary.zh: 玛雅古典时期，低地和高地的众多城市发展出宫殿、神庙、广场与文字记录。统治者通过仪式、战争、婚姻和联盟竞争地位，工匠与书吏创造了精细艺术和历法知识。城市社会依靠复杂的农业与水资源管理维持，区域之间的差异和互动共同塑造了这一繁盛时代。
summary.en: During the Classic period, numerous Maya cities developed palaces, temples, plazas and written records. Rulers competed through ritual, warfare, marriage and alliances, while artists and scribes produced sophisticated imagery and calendrical knowledge. Urban populations depended on varied agricultural and water-management practices, and interactions among distinct regional societies shaped this period of extensive political and cultural activity.

significance.zh: 留下了研究美洲文字、王权、历法与城市生活的丰富材料。
significance.en: Left rich evidence for American writing, kingship, calendars and urban life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Classic Maya urban networks

title.zh: 占婆美山圣地持续营建
title.en: Building the Cham sanctuary of My Son

summary.zh: 从公元四世纪起，占婆统治者和宗教团体在越南中部山谷中的美山持续营建塔庙。湿婆崇拜在这里占有重要地位，工匠以砖墙、砂岩构件和精细雕刻表达神灵与王权的联系。历代修建把南亚宗教观念与占人的地方艺术相结合，留下占婆政治和信仰变化的长时段记录。
summary.en: From the fourth century, Cham rulers and religious communities repeatedly developed My Son in a valley of central Vietnam. Worship of Shiva held an important place, expressed through brick towers, sandstone elements and elaborate carving. Successive building phases connected royal authority with sacred practice, adapting South Asian religious ideas to Cham artistic traditions and preserving a long record of political and religious change.

significance.zh: 美山记录了占婆社会对跨海宗教文化的主动吸收与创造。
significance.en: My Son records the creative adaptation of religious traditions through Cham maritime connections.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：美山圣地

title.zh: 罗马帝国的宗教宽容安排
title.en: Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

summary.zh: 313年，君士坦丁与李锡尼达成宗教宽容安排，基督徒及其他群体获得更有保障的信仰空间，被没收的教会财产也获准归还。这些措施改变了此前迫害所造成的处境，促使基督教社群更公开地组织活动。皇权与教会的联系随之加深，罗马帝国的宗教政治进入新的阶段。
summary.en: In 313, Constantine and Licinius agreed on measures of religious toleration, providing greater security for Christians and other worshippers and allowing confiscated church property to be restored. These arrangements changed conditions created by earlier persecution and enabled Christian communities to operate more openly. Relations between imperial power and the church deepened, opening a new phase in Roman religious politics.

significance.zh: 改善了基督教社群的法律处境，并改变皇权与宗教的关系。
significance.en: Improved the legal position of Christian communities and altered relations between imperial power and religion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

editorialNotes.zh: 常称《米兰敕令》的安排由不同文本传世；帝国后来确立基督教正统地位是另一阶段的发展。
editorialNotes.en: The arrangement conventionally called the Edict of Milan survives through different texts; the later establishment of Christian orthodoxy was a subsequent development.

title.zh: 笈多王朝与古典文化发展
title.en: The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

summary.zh: 四至六世纪，笈多王朝在北印度扩展影响，王室、地方精英和宗教机构共同参与政治与文化生活。梵语文学、数学、天文学及寺庙艺术获得发展，各地区也延续自己的语言和社会传统。政权的赞助与广泛交流为学术和艺术创造提供条件，使这一时期在南亚文化史中占有重要位置。
summary.en: From the fourth to sixth centuries, Gupta rulers expanded their influence in northern India, alongside local elites and religious institutions. Sanskrit literature, mathematics, astronomy and temple arts developed within a society that retained substantial regional diversity. Patronage and wider networks of exchange supported scholarly and artistic work, giving the period an important place in South Asian cultural history.

significance.zh: 促进了对后世影响深远的南亚学术和艺术传统。
significance.en: Supported South Asian scholarly and artistic traditions with a long-lasting influence.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

title.zh: 阿克苏姆王权采用基督教
title.en: Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

summary.zh: 四世纪，阿克苏姆王权在埃扎纳统治时期采用基督教，王室符号、钱币与铭文逐渐反映新的宗教认同。位于红海与非洲内陆交往网络中的王国，通过宗教人物和商业联系参与更广泛的基督教世界。新的信仰在地方社会中持续发展，成为埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚历史的重要组成部分。
summary.en: In the fourth century, Aksumite kingship adopted Christianity under Ezana, with royal symbols, coins and inscriptions increasingly reflecting the new affiliation. Situated within networks linking the Red Sea and inland Africa, the kingdom participated in wider Christian connections through religious figures and commerce. The faith continued to develop locally and became central to Ethiopian and Eritrean history.

significance.zh: 奠定了非洲之角长期基督教传统的重要基础。
significance.en: Helped establish the enduring Christian traditions of the Horn of Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

editorialNotes.zh: 王权改宗的具体年份不确定，公元340年用作四世纪中期前后的约略锚点。
editorialNotes.en: The precise year of royal conversion is uncertain; 340 CE is an approximate anchor within the fourth-century transition.

title.zh: 那烂陀的学术寺院发展
title.en: Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

summary.zh: 那烂陀在印度东北部发展为大型佛教寺院和学术中心，吸引来自亚洲不同地区的僧人与学生。教学涉及佛教经典、逻辑、语言及其他知识，寺院建筑和赞助网络支撑了长期学习生活。求学者携带文本与解释传统往返，使那烂陀成为南亚与更广泛佛教世界交流的重要节点。
summary.en: Nalanda in northeastern India developed into a major Buddhist monastic and scholarly centre, attracting monks and students from across Asia. Instruction included Buddhist texts, logic, language and other fields, supported by substantial buildings and networks of patronage. Travelling scholars carried texts and interpretations between regions, making Nalanda an important connection between South Asia and the wider Buddhist world.

significance.zh: 推动了亚洲学术旅行、文本传播与佛教知识交流。
significance.en: Advanced scholarly travel, textual transmission and Buddhist learning across Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

editorialNotes.zh: 建置与衰落均为分阶段过程，所列450—1200年为其重要发展期的圆整范围。
editorialNotes.en: Its establishment and decline unfolded in stages; 450–1200 is a rounded interval for its major period of development.

title.zh: 梅萨维德聚落与悬崖村落发展
title.en: Settlements and cliff dwellings develop at Mesa Verde

summary.zh: 从公元五世纪中叶起，普韦布洛先民在梅萨维德高原长期聚居，住宅逐渐从地穴式建筑发展为砌石村落和悬崖下的多层居所。梯地、蓄水设施与沟渠支持耕作，公共仪式空间连接家庭与社区。保存下来的建筑与农田遗迹，呈现了居民适应高原环境及共同生活方式的持续变化。
summary.en: From the mid-fifth century, Ancestral Pueblo communities occupied the Mesa Verde plateau, developing pit houses, masonry villages and eventually multistorey cliff dwellings. Agricultural terraces, reservoirs and ditches supported cultivation, while ceremonial spaces linked households and communities. Surviving buildings and field systems document changing forms of cooperation and adaptation to the plateau environment across many generations.

significance.zh: 梅萨维德把古代聚落史与今天普韦布洛族群的文化传承联系起来。
significance.en: Mesa Verde connects the history of ancestral settlements with the continuing heritage of Pueblo peoples.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：梅萨维德国家公园

title.zh: 西罗马皇帝被废黜
title.en: Deposition of the western Roman emperor

summary.zh: 476年，奥多亚塞在意大利废黜西部皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，结束了当时意大利的西罗马皇帝统治。地方精英、城市制度和罗马法律传统继续存在，东部帝国也延续政治与文化生活。这一事件处于西方权力长期重组的过程之中，后来成为欧洲历史分期中广为使用的转折年份。
summary.en: In 476, Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in Italy, ending the reigning western imperial court there. Local elites, urban institutions and Roman legal traditions continued, as did the political and cultural life of the eastern empire. The event formed part of a prolonged redistribution of western power and later became a widely used turning point in European historical periodisation.

significance.zh: 象征西部帝国统治的变化，同时揭示罗马传统的延续。
significance.en: Symbolises the transformation of western imperial rule while revealing the survival of Roman traditions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Deposition of the western Roman emperor

editorialNotes.zh: 476年属于后世常用的分期节点；西部皇位的合法性、地方政权和制度延续具有更复杂的时间线。
editorialNotes.en: 476 is a conventional later period boundary; imperial legitimacy, regional governments and institutional continuity followed more complex chronologies.

title.zh: 阿耶波多的数学天文学著作

summary.zh: 499年，阿耶波多撰成以简练诗句组织的数学天文学著作，讨论计算方法、三角函数、行星运动及地球自转等问题。他把数学技巧与天体观察联系起来，为历法和位置计算提供工具。后来的学者通过注释、批评和修订延续这一传统，使著作在南亚及跨区域知识交流中产生持续影响。
summary.en: In 499, Aryabhata composed a concise mathematical and astronomical work addressing calculation, trigonometric relationships, planetary motion and the rotation of the Earth. He linked mathematical techniques with the study of celestial phenomena, offering tools for calendars and positional calculation. Later scholars sustained this tradition through commentary, criticism and revision, giving the work a lasting role in South Asian and wider knowledge exchange.

significance.zh: 将数学计算与天文模型结合，影响了后续历法和学术传统。
significance.en: Joined mathematical calculation with astronomical modelling and influenced later calendrical and scholarly traditions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Aryabhata’s mathematical astronomy

title.zh: 杰内—杰诺的城市网络

summary.zh: 尼日尔河内三角洲的杰内—杰诺及周边聚落依靠农业、渔业和区域交换逐步扩展。居民从事铁器等手工业，与不同生态区的社群联系，形成相互依赖的城市网络。考古材料展示了西非城市生活的发展，也让研究者关注商贸、专业分工和地方合作如何共同组织大型聚居地。
summary.en: Jenne-jeno and neighbouring settlements in the inland Niger delta expanded through farming, fishing and regional exchange. Craftspeople worked iron and other materials, while connections with different ecological zones supported an interdependent urban network. Archaeology documents the development of West African city life and the roles of commerce, specialised production and local cooperation in organising large settlements.

significance.zh: 丰富了对西非城市化及其多种组织方式的理解。
significance.en: Broadens understanding of West African urbanisation and its varied forms of organisation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Urban networks at Jenne-jeno

editorialNotes.zh: 本条选取500—850年的扩展阶段；杰内—杰诺的居住历史更早，政治组织方式仍在研究中。
editorialNotes.en: This entry selects an expansion phase from 500 to 850; occupation began earlier, and the nature of political organisation remains under study.

title.zh: 蒂瓦纳库的高原政治中心
title.en: Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

summary.zh: 蒂瓦纳库在的的喀喀湖附近成长为安第斯高原的重要政治与仪式中心。石构建筑、雕塑和公共空间汇集权威与信仰，周围农业及跨生态区联系支持人口和手工业。其文化影响向外扩展，人群与物资的流动将高原、山谷和沿海地区相接，形成复杂的区域关系。
summary.en: Tiwanaku near Lake Titicaca grew into a major political and ceremonial centre of the Andean highlands. Stone architecture, sculpture and public spaces expressed authority and belief, supported by agriculture and connections across ecological zones. Its cultural influence spread as people and goods moved among highlands, valleys and coastal regions, creating a complex set of regional relationships.

significance.zh: 展现高原环境中农业、仪式与跨区域政治联系的结合。
significance.en: Shows how agriculture, ritual and interregional political connections developed in a highland environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

editorialNotes.zh: 所列500—900年为主要繁荣阶段；蒂瓦纳库对外围地区的控制形式和衰落原因仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 500–900 marks a principal phase of flourishing; the forms of authority in peripheral regions and the causes of decline remain debated.

title.zh: 迪基斯首领聚落与石球艺术发展
title.en: Diquis chiefly settlements and stone spheres

summary.zh: 公元六至十五世纪，哥斯达黎加南部迪基斯三角洲的社群营建具有不同等级中心的聚落。人工土台、铺石空间、墓地与大型石球共同组织居住和公共活动。工匠把巨石加工为规整的球体，并将其置于聚落之中；这些工程显示了专业技艺、劳动协作和地方权力结构的发展。
summary.en: From the sixth through fifteenth centuries, communities in southern Costa Rica's Diquis delta developed settlements with centres of differing rank. Raised platforms, paved areas, burial grounds and large stone spheres organized residential and communal space. Artisans shaped massive stones into regular spheres and placed them within settlements, demonstrating specialized craft knowledge, collective labour and developing local political structures.

significance.zh: 迪基斯石球是中美洲南部社会组织与工艺传统的重要物质记录。
significance.en: Diquis spheres are important material evidence of social organization and craft traditions in southern Central America.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：迪基斯石球首领聚落

editorialNotes.zh: 石球的具体用途、象征含义和部分制造步骤仍未完全厘清。
editorialNotes.en: The spheres' specific uses, symbolic meanings and some manufacturing procedures remain incompletely understood.

title.zh: 查士丁尼时期的鼠疫

summary.zh: 541年起，鼠疫在东地中海及周边地区传播，随后袭击君士坦丁堡。文献描写了疾病带来的死亡、劳动力损失和日常秩序受扰，古代病原DNA研究则帮助确认了鼠疫杆菌的存在。此后数代人的反复流行，使疾病成为理解晚期古代人口、交通与社会变化的重要因素。
summary.en: From 541, plague spread through the eastern Mediterranean and surrounding regions, reaching Constantinople soon afterward. Written accounts describe deaths, disrupted work and disturbances to everyday life, while ancient pathogen DNA has helped identify Yersinia pestis. Recurrent outbreaks over subsequent generations make the disease an important part of research into late antique populations, transport and social change.

significance.zh: 将文献和古代DNA证据结合，用于研究早期鼠疫流行。
significance.en: Brings written and ancient DNA evidence together in the study of early plague outbreaks.

sources.title: www.mpg.de — Plague during Justinian’s reign
Mordechai et al., PNAS — The Justinianic Plague: An inconsequential pandemic? (2019)

editorialNotes.zh: 本条541—549年侧重早期流行波次。死亡规模及其对帝国经济、人口的长期影响仍存在较大争论。
editorialNotes.en: 541–549 focuses on early outbreaks. Mortality levels and the long-term effects on imperial population and economy remain substantially debated.

title.zh: 伊奢那补罗与三波坡雷古寺群
title.en: Ishanapura and the temples of Sambor Prei Kuk

summary.zh: 六世纪末至七世纪初，伊奢那补罗成为真腊的重要都城。城市把居住区、道路、水利设施与砖石寺庙结合起来，工匠在塔庙和门楣上发展出鲜明的地方风格。梵文与古高棉文铭文记录了供奉和统治活动，这一时期的建筑与雕刻为后来吴哥艺术的发展积累了经验。
summary.en: In the late sixth and early seventh centuries, Ishanapura became an important capital of Chenla. Residential areas, roads and waterworks connected with brick and sandstone temples, whose towers and lintels developed a distinctive local style. Sanskrit and Old Khmer inscriptions recorded religious endowments and political life. The complex helped establish architectural and sculptural practices that later flourished at Angkor.

significance.zh: 展现了吴哥兴起以前高棉城市、文字与宗教艺术的发展。
significance.en: Documents Khmer urban life, writing and sacred art before the rise of Angkor.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：三波坡雷古考古遗址

editorialNotes.zh: 550—650年为六世纪后半叶至七世纪前半叶的概括时段，各寺庙的营建年代有所不同。
editorialNotes.en: The 550–650 range summarizes the later sixth and earlier seventh centuries; individual temples have different construction dates.

title.zh: 隋朝重新统一

summary.zh: 589年，隋军灭陈，结束了长期南北分立的主要政治格局。统一政权整合官僚制度、税收与军事组织，进一步连接南北经济和交通。此后大规模工程及战争加重了社会负担，隋朝迅速灭亡，但它完成的政治整合和行政建设成为唐朝发展的重要基础。
summary.en: In 589, Sui forces defeated the Chen dynasty, bringing an end to the principal political division between northern and southern China. The unified government integrated administration, taxation and military organisation while strengthening economic and transport connections. Large projects and warfare later imposed heavy burdens and contributed to rapid collapse, but Sui integration and institutions provided important foundations for the Tang.

significance.zh: 为唐代的政治整合和经济联系奠定基础。
significance.en: Laid foundations for Tang political integration and economic connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Reunification under the Sui

title.zh: 奇琴伊察的建筑与区域交流
title.en: Architecture and regional exchange at Chichen Itza

summary.zh: 七至十二世纪，奇琴伊察围绕尤卡坦半岛的天然水井逐渐扩展。工匠营建神庙、柱廊、大球场和圆形建筑，把玛雅传统与墨西哥中部流行的形式结合起来。宏大的公共空间承载宗教仪式与政治活动，城市的建筑和雕刻也把尤卡坦与更广泛的中美洲文化网络联系起来。
summary.en: Between the seventh and twelfth centuries, Chichen Itza expanded around natural cenotes in the Yucatan Peninsula. Artisans built temples, colonnades, a great ball court and circular structures that combined Maya traditions with forms shared in central Mexico. Monumental public spaces supported religious and political activities, while architecture and sculpture connected Yucatan with wider Mesoamerican cultural networks.

significance.zh: 奇琴伊察体现了古典期之后玛雅城市的延续与跨区域艺术交流。
significance.en: Chichen Itza illustrates the continuation of Maya urban life and interregional artistic exchange after the Classic period.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：奇琴伊察古城
墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所：奇琴伊察与托尔特克问题

editorialNotes.zh: 建筑联系有多种解释；把全部变化归于一次托尔特克入侵的旧式叙述并无充分共识。
editorialNotes.en: Architectural connections have several interpretations; a single Toltec invasion is not a settled explanation for all changes.

title.zh: 隋代大运河的扩建
title.en: Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

summary.zh: 隋朝在既有水道基础上扩建运河，将黄河、淮河与长江流域的交通进一步贯通。运河便于粮食、军队和物资向政治中心集中，也加强了南北地区的经济联系。工程征发消耗了大量人力，成为当时社会压力的重要来源；长期使用和后续改造又使大运河成为中国交通与供给体系的骨干。
summary.en: The Sui expanded existing waterways into a canal system linking the Yellow, Huai and Yangtze river regions. It moved grain, troops and supplies toward political centres and strengthened north–south economic connections. Construction demanded extensive labour and created severe social pressures, while continued use and later improvements made the Grand Canal a backbone of transport and provisioning in China.

significance.zh: 大规模水运加强了国家供给体系与南北经济联系。
significance.en: Large-scale water transport strengthened state provisioning and economic links between northern and southern China.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

title.zh: 唐朝建立与长安的交流网络
title.en: Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

summary.zh: 618年建立的唐朝继承并调整隋代制度，在此后数代统治者治下扩大影响。都城长安汇集商人、使节、宗教人士和学生，来自亚洲不同地区的人群参与城市生活。外交、贸易和文化赞助推动文学、艺术与知识发展，唐代也在边疆战争和内部权力竞争中不断改变。
summary.en: Founded in 618, the Tang dynasty adapted Sui institutions and expanded its influence under successive rulers. Chang’an brought together merchants, envoys, religious figures and students from across Asia. Diplomacy, commerce and cultural patronage supported literature, art and learning, while frontier warfare and internal struggles continually reshaped the dynasty’s political and social life.

significance.zh: 长安成为中世纪亚洲政治往来和文化交流的重要中心。
significance.en: Chang’an became an important centre of political contact and cultural exchange in medieval Asia.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

title.zh: 希吉拉：穆罕默德迁徙麦地那

summary.zh: 622年，穆罕默德及其追随者从麦加迁往麦地那，在当地建立新的共同体关系。宗教实践与政治协商日益交织，追随者通过相互支持、盟约和集体行动应对外部冲突。此次迁徙成为伊斯兰教早期历史的重要转折，后来被选为伊斯兰历纪元，持续影响穆斯林社会的时间记忆。
summary.en: In 622, Muhammad and his followers moved from Mecca to Medina, where they established new communal relationships. Religious practice became closely connected with political negotiation as followers used mutual support, agreements and collective action to meet external challenges. The migration became a decisive episode in early Islamic history and was later chosen as the starting point of the Islamic calendar.

significance.zh: 推动了早期穆斯林共同体的形成，并成为伊斯兰历的纪元。
significance.en: Advanced the formation of the early Muslim community and became the epoch of the Islamic calendar.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Hijra to Medina

title.zh: 婆罗摩笈多论零与负数
title.en: Brahmagupta on zero and negative numbers

summary.zh: 628年，婆罗摩笈多在数学天文学著作中讨论零、正负数及相关运算，并处理方程、几何和天体计算问题。他将计算规则纳入天文学知识体系，使抽象数的性质与历法、观测任务相联系。后来的注释与跨语言传播让这些成果进入更广阔的学术网络，成为数学发展史中的重要环节。
summary.en: In 628, Brahmagupta discussed zero, positive and negative numbers and their operations in a mathematical and astronomical work, alongside equations, geometry and celestial calculations. He placed computational rules within a framework connecting numerical ideas to calendars and observation. Later commentary and transmission across languages carried these results into wider scholarly networks and made them important in mathematical history.

significance.zh: 系统讨论了零和负数运算，丰富了后续数学传统。
significance.en: Systematically discussed operations involving zero and negative numbers and enriched later mathematical traditions.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Brahmagupta

editorialNotes.zh: 古代关于除以零的处理与现代定义不同，应在当时数学体系中理解。
editorialNotes.en: Ancient treatments of division by zero differ from modern definitions and should be understood within their historical mathematical setting.

title.zh: 早期哈里发国家的扩张

summary.zh: 穆罕默德去世后，早期哈里发统治者率军向阿拉伯半岛之外扩张，将叙利亚、埃及、伊朗等地区纳入新的权力结构。倭马亚王朝以大马士革为中心继续扩大统治，整合地方行政、税收与货币制度。阿拉伯语和伊斯兰制度逐步发展，各地社会也在延续既有传统的同时参与新的政治与文化网络。
summary.en: After Muhammad’s death, early caliphs expanded beyond Arabia, bringing Syria, Egypt, Iran and other regions into a new political order. The Umayyads ruled from Damascus and extended their authority while integrating local administration, taxation and coinage. Arabic and Islamic institutions grew in importance as regional societies maintained established practices and participated in new political and cultural networks.

significance.zh: 重塑西亚、北非及更广泛地区的政治联系与文化交流。
significance.en: Reshaped political connections and cultural exchange across western Asia, North Africa and beyond.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Expansion of the early caliphates

title.zh: 大明宫与唐长安宫城
title.en: The Daming Palace and the palace city of Tang Chang'an

summary.zh: 634年，唐朝廷在长安城东北的龙首原营建大明宫，此后成为皇帝听政与居住的主要宫城。宫城沿南北中轴排列含元殿、宣政殿与紫宸殿，朝会、政务与内廷活动分区展开。大明宫与郭城、里坊和东西市共同构成唐长安的都城秩序，其宫室布局也影响了东亚其他都城的建设。
summary.en: In 634 the Tang court began building the Daming Palace on high ground northeast of Chang'an, and it became the main palace where emperors held audience and governed. Halls arranged along a north–south axis separated ceremonial, administrative and residential functions. Together with the outer city, wards and markets, the palace expressed the spatial order of the Tang capital.

significance.zh: 大明宫体现了唐代宫城制度与都城规划的结合。
significance.en: The Daming Palace exemplifies how Tang palace institutions and capital planning were combined.

sources.title: Xi'an Municipal Government — Ancient city celebrates new national 5A-level scenic spot

editorialNotes.zh: 634年为始建之年，此后多次增修；本条不把某一殿的落成年份当作整座宫城的完成时间。
editorialNotes.en: 634 is the year construction began; halls were added later, so no single hall date is treated as completion of the whole palace city.

title.zh: 新罗扩展在朝鲜半岛的统治
title.en: Silla’s expansion on the Korean peninsula

summary.zh: 七世纪后期，新罗先与唐朝合作击败百济和高句丽，随后与唐争夺朝鲜半岛的控制权。至676年前后，新罗巩固了半岛大部分南部地区的统治，庆州的王权与佛教文化继续发展。战争改变了地区政治版图，也促使人口、工艺和宗教知识在周边国家之间流动。
summary.en: In the later seventh century, Silla allied with Tang forces against Baekje and Goguryeo, then fought Tang over control of the Korean peninsula. By around 676, Silla had consolidated rule over much of the south, while royal and Buddhist culture flourished at Gyeongju. The wars reshaped regional politics and contributed to movements of people, skills and religious learning among neighbouring societies.

significance.zh: 改变朝鲜半岛政治格局，并促进区域文化与人口流动。
significance.en: Changed the peninsula’s political landscape and encouraged regional movements of culture and people.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Silla’s expansion on the Korean peninsula

title.zh: 室利佛逝的海上与佛教网络

summary.zh: 七世纪起，室利佛逝以苏门答腊及海峡地带的港口联系为基础扩大影响。统治者通过贸易、外交和宗教赞助参与连接南海与印度洋的海上网络，佛教学习也吸引远方僧人停留。义净的记述留下了重要见闻，显示商贸航行与求法旅行如何在这一地区相互交织。
summary.en: From the seventh century, Srivijaya expanded its influence through ports in Sumatra and the straits. Rulers used trade, diplomacy and religious patronage to participate in maritime networks linking the South China Sea with the Indian Ocean. Buddhist learning attracted visiting monks, and Yijing’s account provides important evidence of how commerce and journeys for religious study intersected in the region.

significance.zh: 使海峡贸易与佛教学习网络紧密相连。
significance.en: Joined trade through the straits with influential networks of Buddhist learning.

sources.title: University of Missouri Museum of Art and Archaeology — Muse 22

editorialNotes.zh: 671年是义净到访的重要记录，室利佛逝的早期形成时间与控制范围仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 671 marks Yijing’s documented visit; the timing of Srivijaya’s formation and the extent of its authority remain debated.

title.zh: 跨撒哈拉黄金贸易网络

summary.zh: 八至十四世纪，西非的黄金经撒哈拉商路运往马格里布与地中海，换取食盐、铜、纺织品和马匹。商队以绿洲城镇为节点，加纳、马里等政权通过控制贸易与征税积累财富，伊斯兰商人、学者与工匠随之往来。黄金流通把西非、北非与欧洲市场连接起来，也塑造了萨赫勒城市的文化面貌。
summary.en: Between the eighth and fourteenth centuries West African gold travelled the Saharan routes to the Maghrib and the Mediterranean in exchange for salt, copper, textiles and horses. Caravan towns served as nodes, while polities such as Ghana and Mali taxed and protected commerce. Muslim merchants, scholars and craftsmen moved along the same routes, linking West Africa with North Africa and Europe.

significance.zh: 跨撒哈拉贸易把西非纳入中世纪世界经济与宗教网络。
significance.en: The trans-Saharan trade connected West Africa with medieval economic and religious networks.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Trans-Saharan Gold Trade (7th–14th Century)

editorialNotes.zh: 七至十四世纪为来源概述范围；黄金产量与流向的具体规模仍有争论，本条不作数量估计。
editorialNotes.en: The seventh-to-fourteenth-century range follows the source overview; output and direction of gold flows remain debated, so no quantities are given.

title.zh: 印度洋贸易网络的长期运行
title.en: The long-run Indian Ocean trading network

summary.zh: 印度洋贸易把东南亚、南亚、中东与东非连接为一个长期的交换体系，商船依靠季风往返，港口城市同时面向海洋与内陆。七至十五世纪，阿拉伯、波斯、印度、马来与斯瓦希里商人运输香料、纺织品、陶瓷、金属与象牙，宗教、语言与技术随航线传播。国家通过港口税与护航获取收入，贸易网络在政治变动中保持韧性。
summary.en: Indian Ocean trade linked Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East and East Africa into a long-lived exchange system in which ships followed the monsoons and port cities faced both sea and hinterland. Between the seventh and fifteenth centuries Arab, Persian, Indian, Malay and Swahili merchants moved spices, textiles, ceramics, metals and ivory, while religions, languages and technologies travelled the same routes. States drew revenue from port duties and protection, and the networks proved resilient to political change.

significance.zh: 印度洋网络说明前现代全球化依赖季风航线与多语港口社会。
significance.en: The Indian Ocean network shows how premodern globalisation depended on monsoon routes and multilingual port societies.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Indian Ocean trade（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条描述长期网络，不主张单一航线或统一管理机构；不同商品的流向与规模随时间变化。
editorialNotes.en: This entry describes a long-run network rather than a single route or unified administration; commodity flows and volumes changed over time.

title.zh: 平城京与奈良时代都城

summary.zh: 710年，日本朝廷迁都平城京，以规划道路和宫城组织新的政治中心。贵族、官员、寺院与工匠在都城汇集，律令制度和佛教赞助塑造了城市生活。来自中国和朝鲜半岛的知识与技术经过本地吸收和改造，推动文字、建筑、艺术与行政实践的发展。
summary.en: In 710, the Japanese court moved to Heijō-kyō, establishing a planned political centre with streets and palace precincts. Aristocrats, officials, temples and craftspeople gathered there, while the ritsuryō system and Buddhist patronage shaped urban life. Knowledge and techniques from China and the Korean peninsula were adapted locally, contributing to developments in writing, architecture, art and administration.

significance.zh: 奈良都城集中体现了制度建设与东亚知识交流的结合。
significance.en: The Nara capital brought institutional development together with exchanges of knowledge across East Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Heijō-kyō and the Nara capital

title.zh: 阿拔斯革命

summary.zh: 750年，阿拔斯势力推翻倭马亚王朝在主要帝国地区的统治，政治重心随后转向伊拉克。新王朝依靠多地区支持者重组权力，并逐渐建立以巴格达为中心的行政与文化网络。宫廷、商人和学者的活动促进知识交流，地方势力的成长也不断改变哈里发与各地区之间的关系。
summary.en: In 750, Abbasid forces displaced Umayyad rule across the main imperial territories, and the political centre subsequently shifted toward Iraq. The new dynasty reorganised authority through supporters from several regions and developed administrative and cultural networks centred on Baghdad. Courtly, commercial and scholarly activity encouraged exchange, while growing regional powers continually altered relations with the caliphs.

significance.zh: 推动伊斯兰政治与文化重心向伊拉克转移。
significance.en: Shifted an important centre of Islamic political and cultural activity toward Iraq.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Abbasid Revolution

title.zh: 八世纪巴格达的天文翻译与观测
title.en: Astronomical translation and observation in eighth-century Baghdad

summary.zh: 八世纪中叶起，阿拔斯宫廷与学者把印度、波斯和希腊的天文与数学著作译成阿拉伯文，并在巴格达组织观测与编制历表。印度天文著作的传入带来正弦计算与历法方法，学者在此基础上发展出新的计算与记录传统。这些成果后来经伊比利亚和西西里传入欧洲，成为中世纪共享的天文学知识。
summary.en: From the mid-eighth century, Abbasid patrons and scholars translated Indian, Persian and Greek astronomical and mathematical works into Arabic and organised observations and tables in Baghdad. Indian astronomy brought sine computation and calendrical methods, on which scholars built new computational and observational traditions. This knowledge later reached Europe through Iberia and Sicily.

significance.zh: 巴格达的翻译与观测工作把不同文明的天文传统汇入同一套知识体系。
significance.en: Translation and observation in Baghdad merged astronomical traditions from several civilisations into one body of knowledge.

sources.title: UNESCO Silk Roads Programme — Evolution of Astronomy along the Silk Roads

editorialNotes.zh: 具体翻译者、著作与年代在研究中仍有争论，本条只用世纪尺度表述，不指定某一次翻译的年份。
editorialNotes.en: Translators, works and dates remain debated, so the entry uses century-scale phrasing rather than assigning a year to a single translation.

title.zh: 安史之乱

summary.zh: 755年，安禄山起兵反唐，战事随后扩展到北方与中原多个地区，长安和洛阳先后遭受冲击。持续战争造成死亡、迁徙和生产破坏，唐廷依靠地方军镇及外部援助恢复局势。平乱后地方军事力量增强，中央财政和治理方式发生变化，成为唐代政治发展的重要转折。
summary.en: In 755, An Lushan rebelled against the Tang, and warfare spread across northern and central China, reaching both Chang’an and Luoyang. Death, migration and disrupted production accompanied prolonged fighting. The court relied on regional military authorities and outside assistance to recover, leaving stronger provincial forces and altered fiscal and administrative arrangements that marked a major turn in Tang politics.

significance.zh: 加深地方军事力量，改变了唐代中央与地方的关系。
significance.en: Strengthened regional military power and changed relations between the Tang centre and its provinces.

sources.title: www.iranicaonline.org — The An Lushan Rebellion

editorialNotes.zh: 户籍数字在战乱中大幅下降，但登记崩溃与人口迁移使这些差额无法直接换算为死亡人数。
editorialNotes.en: Registered household figures fell sharply, but administrative breakdown and migration prevent these differences from being treated as direct mortality counts.

title.zh: 巴格达建城

summary.zh: 762年，阿拔斯哈里发曼苏尔在底格里斯河畔营建巴格达，作为新的帝国首都。城市的位置便于联系两河流域与远距离商路，宫廷、官署、市场和工匠逐渐汇集。此后数代赞助者与学者推动翻译、医学和数学等知识活动，使巴格达成为中世纪欧亚世界的重要政治与文化中心。
summary.en: In 762, the Abbasid caliph al-Mansur founded Baghdad beside the Tigris as a new imperial capital. Its location connected Mesopotamian resources with long-distance routes, drawing together the court, government offices, markets and craftspeople. Subsequent patrons and scholars supported translation, medicine, mathematics and other learning, making Baghdad a major political and cultural centre of medieval Eurasia.

significance.zh: 让帝国行政、商业网络与跨语言学术交流汇集于一城。
significance.en: Brought imperial administration, commercial networks and multilingual scholarship together in one city.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of Baghdad

title.zh: 婆罗浮屠的建造

summary.zh: 八至九世纪，爪哇中部建成婆罗浮屠，以层层台基、浮雕回廊和佛塔组织佛教礼仪空间。参礼者沿建筑行进，在图像叙事与空间次序中理解修行观念。工程汇集了石工、雕塑和宗教知识，也体现当地王权赞助与跨海佛教联系在爪哇社会中的结合。
summary.en: In the eighth and ninth centuries, builders in central Java created Borobudur with terraces, sculpted galleries and stupas arranged as a Buddhist ceremonial landscape. Movement through the monument connected narrative imagery with ideas of spiritual practice. The project brought together stoneworking, sculpture and religious knowledge, reflecting local royal patronage and Java’s connections with a wider maritime Buddhist world.

significance.zh: 体现爪哇社会对佛教建筑、艺术与礼仪空间的独特创造。
significance.en: Expresses Java’s distinctive development of Buddhist architecture, art and ceremonial space.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of Borobudur

editorialNotes.zh: 约780—850年为建造时期的常用圆整范围，具体阶段与赞助者的归属存在讨论。
editorialNotes.en: Approximately 780–850 is a rounded construction range; the dating of individual phases and their patrons remains debated.

title.zh: 林迪斯法恩袭击与维京时代
title.en: The Lindisfarne raid and the Viking Age

summary.zh: 793年，来自斯堪的纳维亚的袭击者劫掠英格兰东北海岸的林迪斯法恩修道院，事件在基督教文献中留下强烈震动。随后数代人中，北海与大西洋地区出现更多袭击、贸易、迁徙和定居活动。航海技术与区域竞争共同扩展了这些联系，使维京时代成为北欧社会转变的重要时期。
summary.en: In 793, Scandinavian raiders attacked the monastery of Lindisfarne on England’s northeastern coast, leaving a powerful impression in Christian written accounts. Subsequent generations saw further raiding alongside trade, migration and settlement around the North Sea and Atlantic. Maritime capabilities and regional competition expanded these connections, making the Viking Age a period of major transformation for northern European societies.

significance.zh: 成为北欧海上活动扩展及欧洲社会变化的著名早期记录。
significance.en: Became a prominent early record of expanding Scandinavian maritime activity and European social change.

sources.title: www.english-heritage.org.uk — The Lindisfarne raid and the Viking Age

editorialNotes.zh: 793年是传统上常用的维京时代开端之一，更早的跨海接触和袭击也有证据。
editorialNotes.en: 793 is one conventional starting point for the Viking Age; evidence also exists for earlier maritime contact and raiding.

title.zh: 平安京的营建与都市格局
title.en: Foundation and urban layout of Heian-kyō

summary.zh: 794年，日本朝廷把都城迁到山城国盆地中的平安京。都城参照大陆都城制度规划，以南北中轴大道和棋盘式街区组织宫城、官署与市集。盆地西部的低湿地与东侧河流影响街区扩展方向，贵族宅邸、寺院与市场逐渐成形，为延续千年的京都城市生活奠定格局。
summary.en: In 794 the Japanese court moved the capital to Heian-kyō, laid out in the Yamashiro basin on a grid of streets around a north–south axis, following continental models of capital planning. Wetlands to the west and rivers to the east shaped the direction of growth, while aristocratic residences, temples and markets gradually took shape around the planned core.

significance.zh: 平安京的规划奠定了京都长期作为政治与文化中心的空间基础。
significance.en: The planning of Heian-kyō gave Kyoto its long-lasting spatial framework as a political and cultural centre.

sources.title: Agency for Cultural Affairs, Japan — Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto: Identification, History

editorialNotes.zh: 794年为迁都之年；都城的实际范围与人口在此后数十年逐步扩展，不能把规划图等同于同期建成区。
editorialNotes.en: 794 is the year of the move; the built-up area and population expanded over subsequent decades, so the planned grid is not equated with the contemporary built city.

title.zh: 查理曼加冕

summary.zh: 800年，教皇在罗马为查理曼加冕，赋予法兰克统治者西方皇帝称号。仪式将军事扩张形成的王国、基督教权威与罗马帝国记忆联系起来，也影响了与拜占庭的关系。加洛林宫廷同时支持教育和文本整理，使政治整合与宗教、文化建设相互推动。
summary.en: In 800, the pope crowned Charlemagne in Rome, giving the Frankish ruler the title of emperor in the West. The ceremony joined a kingdom built through conquest with Christian authority and memories of the Roman Empire, while affecting relations with Byzantium. Carolingian support for education and the organisation of texts linked political consolidation with religious and cultural activity.

significance.zh: 重塑西欧皇权与教会关系，并强化帝国传统的影响。
significance.en: Reshaped relations between western European rulership and the church and renewed the influence of imperial traditions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Charlemagne’s imperial coronation

title.zh: 凯鲁万的学术与宗教中心兴盛
title.en: Kairouan flourishes as a religious centre

summary.zh: 九世纪，凯鲁万在阿格拉布王朝治下成为马格里布的重要宗教与城市中心。大清真寺的营建与修缮、街区和其他礼拜建筑的发展，体现了统治者及城市社会对宗教生活的支持。它的柱廊和建筑布局对区域清真寺产生影响，学术与信仰活动也使这座内陆城市保持广泛联系。
summary.en: In the ninth century, Kairouan flourished under the Aghlabids as an important religious and urban centre in the Maghreb. Construction and renewal of the Great Mosque, neighbourhoods and other places of worship reflected both political patronage and urban religious life. Its architecture influenced mosques across the region, while learning and devotion sustained the inland city's wider connections.

significance.zh: 凯鲁万成为北非伊斯兰建筑与宗教文化的重要传播中心。
significance.en: Kairouan became an influential centre of Islamic architecture and religious culture in North Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：凯鲁万

title.zh: 加纳帝国与跨撒哈拉贸易

summary.zh: 中世纪早期的加纳帝国位于西非萨赫勒地带，依靠对商贸和资源流通的组织积累权力。黄金、盐及其他货物沿跨撒哈拉和地区路线交换，商人与统治者在城市中心相互联系。伊斯兰商贸文化与既有社会传统并存，使这一地区成为非洲内陆与北非交往的重要枢纽。
summary.en: The early medieval Ghana Empire developed in the West African Sahel, drawing power from the organisation of commerce and resource flows. Gold, salt and other goods circulated along trans-Saharan and regional routes, linking merchants with rulers in urban centres. Islamic commercial culture coexisted with established social traditions, making the region an important connection between inland Africa and the north.

significance.zh: 推动了萨赫勒国家形成和跨撒哈拉贸易的发展。
significance.en: Supported state formation in the Sahel and the development of trans-Saharan trade.

sources.title: www.loc.gov — Ghana and trans-Saharan trade

editorialNotes.zh: 本条800—1100年选取重要发展阶段；早期王国的年代、都城遗址识别及衰落过程仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 800–1100 selects an important development phase; early chronology, identification of capital sites and the processes of decline remain debated.

title.zh: 埃尔塔欣城市与球戏文化兴盛
title.en: El Tajin and its ballgame culture flourish

summary.zh: 九至十二世纪，墨西哥湾沿岸的埃尔塔欣成为重要城市。建筑师利用地势划分不同城区，营建布满壁龛、浮雕和壁画的公共建筑。大量球场表明球戏在社会与仪式生活中的突出地位，雕刻场景则保存了宗教、权力和日常活动的信息，使这里成为理解古典期之后区域文化的重要窗口。
summary.en: Between the ninth and twelfth centuries, El Tajin became an important city near Mexico's Gulf coast. Builders used changes in elevation to organize urban areas and created public monuments decorated with niches, reliefs and murals. Numerous ball courts indicate the prominence of the ballgame in ceremonial life, while carved scenes preserve evidence of religion, authority and everyday activity.

significance.zh: 埃尔塔欣保存了中美洲球戏、城市空间和视觉叙事之间的联系。
significance.en: El Tajin preserves the relationship between the Mesoamerican ballgame, urban space and visual storytelling.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：埃尔塔欣古城

editorialNotes.zh: 居民族属及城市衰落过程仍有讨论；本条不采用遗产页面把1200年后变迁直接归于阿兹特克统治的简化说法。
editorialNotes.en: The inhabitants' identities and the city's decline remain debated; the heritage page's simplified link between events after 1200 and Aztec rule is not adopted.

title.zh: 巴厘岛苏巴克灌溉制度发展
title.en: Development of Bali's subak irrigation system

summary.zh: 自九世纪起，巴厘岛农民逐渐发展以水庙为纽带的苏巴克灌溉体系。农户通过合作组织分配水源、安排稻作，并共同维护沟渠和堰坝。农业生产、宗教仪式与社区协商在这一制度中结合，使梯田景观得以长期维持，也形成了协调有限土地与水资源的地方实践。
summary.en: From the ninth century, Balinese farmers developed subak irrigation associations linked through water temples. Communities cooperated in allocating water, organizing rice cultivation and maintaining canals and weirs. Agricultural work, religious observance and collective decision-making became intertwined. This system sustained terraced landscapes and provided local institutions for coordinating land and water resources across connected farming communities.

significance.zh: 苏巴克体现了农业技术与社区协作共同管理资源的长期经验。
significance.en: Subak demonstrates the long-term integration of agricultural technology and cooperative resource management.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：巴厘省文化景观

editorialNotes.zh: 800—1500年选取苏巴克的早期与中世纪发展阶段；该制度此后持续演变并沿用至今。
editorialNotes.en: The range selects early and medieval development; subak continued to evolve and remains in use today.

title.zh: 吴哥政治中心的兴起
title.en: Rise of the Angkor political centre

summary.zh: 九世纪起，柬埔寨内陆的王权逐渐形成以吴哥地区为中心的政治网络。统治者通过祭祀、寺庙赞助和土地组织加强权威，水利设施与稻作农业支撑人口和城市发展。此后不断修建的都城和宗教建筑，将地方资源、王室竞争与跨地区文化联系凝聚成宏大的历史景观。
summary.en: From the ninth century, royal authority in inland Cambodia developed political networks centred on the Angkor region. Ritual, temple patronage and the organisation of land strengthened rulers, while waterworks and rice agriculture supported population and urban growth. Successive capitals and religious monuments brought local resources, dynastic competition and wider cultural connections into a monumental historical landscape.

significance.zh: 开启吴哥地区长期的城市、水利与王权建设。
significance.en: Opened a long period of urban, hydraulic and royal development in the Angkor region.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rise of the Angkor political centre

editorialNotes.zh: 802年的建国叙述主要来自较晚铭文；其仪式性质与实际政治整合过程仍有学术讨论。
editorialNotes.en: The foundation narrative associated with 802 relies mainly on later inscriptions; the ceremony’s meaning and the process of political integration remain debated.

title.zh: 花剌子密的代数学

summary.zh: 九世纪初，花剌子密在巴格达写作代数学著作，以系统方法处理方程，并将计算用于继承、交易和测量等问题。书中的解释与几何论证把实用需求和抽象推理联系起来。作品经后来的阿拉伯语学者与拉丁语翻译者传播，成为不同知识传统之间持续讨论和发展的基础。
summary.en: In the early ninth century, al-Khwarizmi wrote an algebraic treatise in Baghdad that systematically treated equations and applied calculation to inheritance, commerce and measurement. Explanations and geometric arguments linked practical needs with abstract reasoning. Later Arabic scholarship and Latin translation carried the work across intellectual traditions, where its methods continued to be discussed and developed.

significance.zh: 推动代数形成可教学、可传播的系统知识。
significance.en: Helped develop algebra into a systematic body of knowledge that could be taught and transmitted.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Al-Khwarizmi

editorialNotes.zh: 约820年是著作年代的估计值；书写与传播过程延续多年。
editorialNotes.en: About 820 is an estimated date for the work; composition and transmission extended over time.

title.zh: 萨迈拉：阿拔斯王朝的新都

summary.zh: 836年，阿拔斯哈里发穆塔西姆把宫廷与军队迁往底格里斯河畔的萨迈拉，以安置突厥军人并避开巴格达的紧张局势。新城沿河延伸数十公里，包含宫殿、军营、清真寺与赛马场，螺旋宣礼塔成为标志。892年宫廷返回巴格达后，萨迈拉逐渐失去政治功能，城市遗迹仍保存了当时的空间组织。
summary.en: In 836 the Abbasid caliph al-Mu'tasim moved his court and army to Samarra on the Tigris, accommodating Turkish troops and distancing himself from tensions in Baghdad. The new city stretched for tens of kilometres along the river, with palaces, barracks, mosques and a racecourse, its spiral minaret a landmark. After the court returned to Baghdad in 892, Samarra lost its political role.

significance.zh: 萨迈拉展示了阿拔斯帝国如何用新建都城安置军队与宫廷。
significance.en: Samarra shows how the Abbasid empire used a newly built capital to house its army and court.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Abbasid Period (750–1258)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Samarra Archaeological City

editorialNotes.zh: 836—892为宫廷驻萨迈拉的时期，城市在此后仍有居民，不能把宫廷迁出视为城市废弃。
editorialNotes.en: 836–892 is the period of the court's residence; the city remained inhabited afterwards, so the court's departure is not treated as abandonment.

title.zh: 普兰巴南寺群营建
title.en: Construction of the Prambanan temple compounds

summary.zh: 九至十世纪，爪哇中部的王室与工匠营建了普兰巴南一带的宏伟寺群。高耸的印度教主殿供奉湿婆、毗湿奴和梵天，石刻浮雕展开《罗摩衍那》等叙事。附近的佛教寺院共同构成宗教景观，显示不同传统在爪哇社会中的共存，也体现了石作技术和大型工程组织的成熟。
summary.en: In the ninth and tenth centuries, patrons and artisans in central Java built monumental temple compounds around Prambanan. Tall Hindu shrines honoured Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma, while carved reliefs presented narratives including the Ramayana. Nearby Buddhist complexes formed part of the same broader religious landscape. Their construction demonstrates both religious diversity and sophisticated stoneworking and engineering organization.

significance.zh: 爪哇工匠把跨区域宗教题材发展成具有鲜明地方特色的建筑与叙事艺术。
significance.en: Javanese artisans developed distinctive architecture and narrative sculpture from widely shared religious traditions.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：普兰巴南寺庙群

editorialNotes.zh: 遗产介绍对不同建筑分别使用八、九、十世纪的断代；本条选取主要印度教寺群的九至十世纪营建阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The heritage account dates different buildings to the eighth, ninth and tenth centuries; this entry focuses on the principal Hindu complex in the ninth and tenth centuries.

title.zh: 查科大型建筑与道路网络形成
title.en: Chaco's great houses and road network develop

summary.zh: 九世纪中叶至十三世纪初，查科地区的普韦布洛先民建起多层石砌大屋、仪式空间与连接聚落的道路。建筑中的储藏区和大型基瓦，显示经济组织与宗教集会的重要作用。分布广泛的聚落共同构成区域网络，在干旱环境中协调人力、资源和交往，十一世纪前后尤为兴盛。
summary.en: From the mid-ninth to early thirteenth centuries, Ancestral Pueblo communities in the Chaco region built multistorey great houses, ceremonial spaces and roads linking settlements. Storage areas and large kivas indicate the importance of economic coordination and religious gatherings. Dispersed communities formed a regional network that organized labour, resources and exchange in an arid environment, flourishing especially around the eleventh century.

significance.zh: 查科说明北美内陆社会能够通过道路与公共建筑维持广泛联系。
significance.en: Chaco demonstrates the extensive connections sustained by roads and communal buildings in interior North America.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：查科文化

title.zh: 有纪年的《金刚经》印本

summary.zh: 868年印制的《金刚经》卷子将经文、图像和刊印题记结合，后来在敦煌藏经洞中保存下来。施主资助与宗教传播需求支持了雕版印刷的发展，使相同文本可以较大量地复制和流通。这一实物让早期印刷的技术、审美与信仰实践获得直接联系，也展示敦煌收藏所保留的广阔文化网络。
summary.en: The Diamond Sutra scroll printed in 868 combines scripture, illustration and a dated colophon and was later preserved in Dunhuang’s Library Cave. Donor patronage and the wish to circulate religious texts supported woodblock printing, enabling repeated reproduction. The surviving object directly connects early printing techniques, visual design and devotional practice within the wider cultural networks preserved by Dunhuang’s collections.

significance.zh: 提供了有明确纪年的早期印刷与宗教传播实物。
significance.en: Provides a securely dated object linking early printing with religious transmission.

sources.title: British Library / International Dunhuang Programme — The Diamond Sutra

editorialNotes.zh: 敦煌是卷子的保存与发现地点，实际刻印地点尚不确定。
editorialNotes.en: Dunhuang is the place of preservation and discovery; the original printing location is uncertain.

title.zh: 拉古纳铜板铭文记录债务豁免
title.en: The Laguna Copperplate records a debt release

summary.zh: 一份纪年为公元900年的铜板文书，记录了南瓦兰家族获得债务豁免的事项。铭文以卡维文字书写，主要使用古马来语，并包含梵语词汇及地方人名、官衔和地名。它让今天的读者得以看到菲律宾群岛早期的法律与债务关系，也呈现了当地社会与东南亚文字文化的联系。
summary.en: A copperplate document dated to 900 records a release from debt involving Namwaran's family. Written in Kawi script, its language is principally Old Malay, with Sanskrit vocabulary and local names, offices and place names. The document offers an unusually direct view of early legal and debt relations in the Philippine archipelago and its connections with Southeast Asian written culture.

significance.zh: 这是菲律宾现存最早具有明确纪年的文献之一，为早期社会史提供了文字证据。
significance.en: It is among the Philippines' earliest surviving calendar-dated documents and provides written evidence of early social relations.

sources.title: 菲律宾新闻署：拉古纳铜板纪念标志与纪年
Wikipedia百科：Laguna Copperplate Inscription

editorialNotes.zh: 部分地名及非马来语词汇的识别存在不同解释。官方新闻中把900年称作九世纪是世纪换算错误，本条采用明确的公元900年。
editorialNotes.en: Some place names and non-Malay terms have competing interpretations. The official news report incorrectly calls 900 the ninth century; this entry uses the explicit year 900.

title.zh: 后古典期玛雅城邦与抄本传统
title.en: Postclassic Maya polities and the codex tradition

summary.zh: 古典期结束后的数百年间，尤卡坦与高地地区的玛雅政治体重新组合，奇琴伊察、玛雅潘等中心先后兴起。各城邦通过联盟、战争与贸易往来，沿海盐场与内陆市场连接起来。以树皮纸抄本和彩绘陶器为载体的历法与创世叙事继续流传，十六世纪的焚毁与散佚之后仅存少量抄本。
summary.en: In the centuries after the Classic period, Maya polities in Yucatán and the highlands regrouped, with centres such as Chichen Itza and Mayapan rising in turn. Alliances, warfare and trade linked coastal salt works with inland markets. Calendrical and creation narratives continued to circulate in bark-paper codices and on painted ceramics; only a few codices survived the sixteenth century.

significance.zh: 后古典期玛雅表明古典期之后仍有持续的政治重组与文化创造。
significance.en: The Postclassic Maya show continued political reorganisation and cultural production after the Classic period.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Creation Narratives on Ancient Maya Codex-Style Ceramics (Metropolitan Museum Journal 51)

editorialNotes.zh: 900—1500为概括时段，各中心的兴起与衰落在年代上并不一致；抄本证据主要来自陶器图像与少量残本。
editorialNotes.en: The 900–1500 range is a general period; centres rose and declined at different times, and codex evidence comes mainly from ceramic imagery and a few surviving manuscripts.

title.zh: 契丹建立辽朝政权
title.en: Formation of the Khitan Liao state

summary.zh: 916年，耶律阿保机建立契丹皇帝制度，将草原军事力量与对农业地区的统治结合起来。辽政权在不同人口和地区之间采用多样的管理方式，并通过战争、外交与贸易参与东亚政治。佛教建筑、文字和工艺的发展也体现契丹社会在游牧传统与城市文化之间的创造性变化。
summary.en: In 916, Yelü Abaoji established Khitan imperial rule, combining steppe military power with government over agricultural regions. The Liao used varied administrative arrangements for different populations and participated in East Asian politics through warfare, diplomacy and trade. Buddhist architecture, writing and crafts also reveal creative changes linking Khitan pastoral traditions with urban cultural life.

significance.zh: 扩大了对东亚历史中草原国家与多元治理方式的认识。
significance.en: Broadens understanding of steppe states and varied forms of government in East Asian history.

sources.title: www.tnm.jp — Formation of the Khitan Liao state

editorialNotes.zh: 辽的起始年有907年与916年等划法，本条保留阿保机称帝的916年。
editorialNotes.en: The beginning of Liao is variously dated to 907 or 916; this entry retains Abaoji’s assumption of the imperial title in 916.

title.zh: 宋朝建立

summary.zh: 960年，赵匡胤建立宋朝，随后通过战争与政治整合扩大统治。朝廷强化文官制度和中央行政，城市、市场及文化消费持续发展，士人教育与考试逐渐影响政治生活。宋与辽、西夏及后来的金保持战争、谈判和贸易关系，形成经济活跃而政治竞争持续的东亚格局。
summary.en: In 960, Zhao Kuangyin founded the Song dynasty, which subsequently expanded through warfare and political consolidation. Civil administration strengthened, cities and markets grew, and scholarly education and examinations became increasingly important in political life. Relations with Liao, Western Xia and later Jin combined conflict, negotiation and commerce within an economically active and politically competitive East Asia.

significance.zh: 推动了文官政治、城市经济和知识文化的发展。
significance.en: Encouraged the development of civil government, urban economies and scholarly culture.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Song dynasty

title.zh: 泉州：宋元时期的海洋贸易枢纽
title.en: Quanzhou: a maritime trading hub of the Song and Yuan

summary.zh: 十至十四世纪，泉州凭借港湾、桥梁与腹地手工业成为印度洋与西太平洋贸易网络的重要节点。陶瓷、丝绸与香料在此转运，来自阿拉伯、波斯与东南亚的商人聚居城南，清真寺、佛寺与天后宫并存。元末战乱与港口条件变化之后，泉州的国际贸易地位逐渐让位于其他口岸。
summary.en: Between the tenth and fourteenth centuries Quanzhou became a major node in Indian Ocean and West Pacific trade, handling ceramics, silk and aromatics through its harbour, bridges and hinterland workshops. Arab, Persian and Southeast Asian merchants settled in the southern quarters, where mosques, Buddhist temples and the Tianhou shrine stood together. War and changing harbour conditions later reduced its international role.

significance.zh: 泉州展示了宋元中国与印度洋世界之间的商品、人群与信仰交流。
significance.en: Quanzhou shows the exchange of goods, people and beliefs between Song–Yuan China and the Indian Ocean world.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China

editorialNotes.zh: 十至十四世纪为遗产条目概括的繁荣期，不等于城市全部存续时间；刺桐等外来名称只用于相应时段。
editorialNotes.en: The tenth-to-fourteenth-century range is the prosperity period recorded by the listing, not the city's whole lifespan; foreign names such as Zayton apply only to those centuries.

title.zh: 朱罗王朝与南亚海洋联系
title.en: Chola power and South Asian maritime connections

summary.zh: 十至十一世纪，朱罗王朝在南印度扩大权力，修筑宏大寺庙，并通过陆上和海上行动参与地区竞争。寺院、商人组织和港口将农业腹地与印度洋贸易联系起来，工艺和宗教文化也随人群流动传播。王室赞助与商业网络共同塑造了泰米尔地区及其海外联系的繁荣。
summary.en: In the tenth and eleventh centuries, Chola rulers expanded their power in southern India, built major temples and participated in regional competition through land and sea campaigns. Temples, merchant organisations and ports connected agricultural hinterlands with Indian Ocean commerce. Craft traditions and religious practices travelled with people, while royal patronage and commercial networks supported the Tamil region’s wider connections.

significance.zh: 强化了南印度的寺庙文化和印度洋商贸联系。
significance.en: Strengthened southern Indian temple culture and commercial connections across the Indian Ocean.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chola power and South Asian maritime connections

editorialNotes.zh: 985—1025年选取王朝扩张的重要阶段；海上远征与各港口实际控制关系需要分别理解。
editorialNotes.en: 985–1025 selects a major expansion phase; maritime campaigns and the actual control of particular ports require separate assessment.

title.zh: 弗拉基米尔与罗斯的基督教化
title.en: Volodymyr and the Christianisation of Rus

summary.zh: 十世纪末，弗拉基米尔接受基督教，并推动基辅罗斯的王权与拜占庭基督教世界建立更紧密关系。教会组织、礼仪文本和艺术传统随之传播，书写与教育也获得新的支持。改宗从宫廷和城市逐渐影响各地社会，在长期融合中形成罗斯地区的宗教与文化传统。
summary.en: In the late tenth century, Vladimir adopted Christianity and strengthened ties between the rulers of Kyivan Rus and the Byzantine Christian world. Ecclesiastical organisation, liturgical texts and artistic traditions spread, giving new support to writing and education. Conversion gradually reached beyond court and city communities, forming regional religious and cultural traditions through a prolonged process of interaction.

significance.zh: 加强罗斯与拜占庭的联系，推动宗教制度和文字文化发展。
significance.en: Strengthened Rus–Byzantine connections and encouraged religious institutions and written culture.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Volodymyr and the Christianisation of Rus

editorialNotes.zh: 988年为传统纪年；统治者受洗的细节和各地区基督教化的速度仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 988 is the traditional date; details of the ruler’s baptism and the pace of regional Christianisation remain debated.

title.zh: 波利尼西亚航海者定居夏威夷

summary.zh: 大约十一至十二世纪，波利尼西亚航海者借助双体独木舟和对星辰、海流及鸟类的观察，到达夏威夷群岛并建立社区。他们携带作物、家畜与生产知识，在新环境中经营农业和渔业。跨海往来与地方适应共同奠定了夏威夷社会的基础，也体现出太平洋航海传统积累的经验。
summary.en: Around the eleventh and twelfth centuries, Polynesian voyagers reached Hawaii and established communities using double-hulled canoes and close observation of stars, currents and birds. They brought crops, animals and practical knowledge, developing farming and fishing in new environments. Ocean connections and local adaptation laid foundations for Hawaiian society and demonstrate the accumulated expertise of Pacific navigation.

significance.zh: 夏威夷的定居是波利尼西亚远洋航海与生态适应的重要篇章。
significance.en: The settlement of Hawaii is a major episode in Polynesian voyaging and environmental adaptation.

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：Early Hawaiians

editorialNotes.zh: 1000—1200年采用国家公园管理局的概括时段。初次定居年代和航海者的直接出发地仍随样本、方法及研究而变化。
editorialNotes.en: The 1000–1200 range follows the National Park Service summary. Initial settlement dates and immediate origins vary with evidence and analytical methods.

title.zh: 瓦普寺与湄公河文化景观发展
title.en: Vat Phou and the Mekong cultural landscape

summary.zh: 十一至十二世纪，今老挝南部的瓦普寺一带形成山体、圣泉、寺院与湄公河相互联系的宗教景观。道路和水利设施把祭祀空间与城镇连接起来，建筑布局以自然地形表达印度教宇宙观。这里与吴哥世界保持联系，也延续了湄公河中游更早的城市和信仰传统。
summary.en: In the eleventh and twelfth centuries, the area around Vat Phou in southern Laos developed a sacred landscape connecting mountain, spring, temple and Mekong River. Roads and waterworks linked ceremonial places with settlements, while the architectural layout expressed Hindu cosmology through natural features. Connections with the Angkorian world developed alongside older urban and religious traditions of the Mekong region.

significance.zh: 瓦普寺显示了宗教观念、自然环境与基础设施之间的紧密联系。
significance.en: Vat Phou demonstrates the close relationship between sacred ideas, natural terrain and infrastructure.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：瓦普寺及占巴塞文化景观

title.zh: 中世纪开罗城市文化发展

summary.zh: 十一至十四世纪，开罗不断扩展为伊斯兰世界的重要大都市。统治者与城市居民兴建清真寺、宗教学校、浴室和供水设施，商业与居住街区在这些公共空间周围发展。不同王朝的建筑层层叠加，尤其在十四世纪形成繁盛的城市景观，反映了权力、信仰与日常生活的相互塑造。
summary.en: Between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries, Cairo expanded into a major metropolis of the Islamic world. Rulers and residents supported mosques, madrasas, baths and water facilities, with commercial and residential quarters developing around shared spaces. Successive dynasties added new layers to the city, whose fourteenth-century flourishing reveals the interaction of political power, religious patronage and everyday urban life.

significance.zh: 开罗的公共建筑和街区记录了中世纪大城市的社会组织。
significance.en: Cairo's public institutions and neighbourhoods reveal the organization of a major medieval urban society.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：开罗历史城区

title.zh: 伊费陶塑艺术兴盛

summary.zh: 十一至十四世纪，今尼日利亚的伊费工匠创作了风格多样的陶塑，题材包括人物、动物与神圣形象。细致的面部刻画与高度概括的造型并存，既有佩冠者，也有社会中其他人物的形象。出土地点分布在宫廷附近和更广的城镇空间，显示这些作品参与了多样的宗教与社会生活。
summary.en: From the eleventh through fourteenth centuries, artisans at Ife in present-day Nigeria produced diverse terracotta figures and vessels. Naturalistic faces appeared alongside more abstract forms, with subjects ranging from crowned figures to animals and other members of society. Finds near the palace and across the settlement suggest that these works participated in varied religious and social practices.

significance.zh: 伊费陶塑展现了西非城市社会丰富的艺术创造与人物表现传统。
significance.en: Ife terracottas reveal the artistic diversity and sophisticated representation of people in a West African urban society.

sources.title: 大都会艺术博物馆：Ife Terracottas (1000–1400 A.D.)

editorialNotes.zh: 不少作品出自二次使用的祭祀环境，原始用途及具体人物身份尚难确定。
editorialNotes.en: Many works were found in reused ritual contexts, leaving their original functions and specific identities uncertain.

title.zh: 帕劳洛克群岛石筑村落发展
title.en: Stone-built villages develop in Palau's Rock Islands

summary.zh: 第二个千年初期以后，帕劳洛克群岛的一些岛屿出现长期居住的石筑村落。居民修筑房屋台基、梯地与防御墙，依靠海洋资源维持社区生活。贝冢、墓葬和岩画记录了人与潟湖环境的紧密关系，这些聚落也通过口述传统与后来迁往帕劳较大岛屿的后裔保持联系。
summary.en: After the beginning of the second millennium, some of Palau's Rock Islands supported permanent stone-built villages. Residents constructed house platforms, terraces and defensive walls while drawing heavily on marine resources. Middens, burials and rock art document close relationships with the lagoon environment. Oral traditions connect these settlements with descendants who later moved to Palau's larger islands.

significance.zh: 这些村落记录了太平洋小岛社群对有限陆地与丰富海洋资源的长期适应。
significance.en: These villages document the long-term adaptation of small Pacific communities to limited land and rich marine resources.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：洛克群岛南部潟湖

editorialNotes.zh: 范围选取石筑村落早期发展阶段；部分村落持续有人居住至十七、十八世纪。
editorialNotes.en: The range selects early stone-village development; some settlements remained occupied into the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

title.zh: 伊本·海赛姆的光学研究

summary.zh: 伊本·海赛姆在十一世纪初系统研究视觉、光的传播与反射，把几何分析、观察和实验性检验结合起来。他讨论光线进入眼睛所产生的视觉，并分析感知与物理过程的关系。其光学著作在阿拉伯语学术圈持续流传，后来经拉丁语翻译影响欧洲的视觉理论与自然研究。
summary.en: In the early eleventh century, Ibn al-Haytham systematically studied vision, the propagation of light and reflection through geometry, observation and experimental investigation. He explained sight through light entering the eye and examined connections between perception and physical processes. His optical writings circulated in Arabic scholarship and later Latin translations, influencing European theories of vision and the study of nature.

significance.zh: 为光学研究提供了结合数学、观察与检验的系统方法。
significance.en: Provided optics with a systematic approach combining mathematics, observation and investigation.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Al-Haytham

editorialNotes.zh: 约1020年是其主要光学著述活动的时间锚点，著作各部分的确切完成年不详。
editorialNotes.en: About 1020 is a chronological anchor for his principal optical work; the exact completion dates of individual parts are uncertain.

title.zh: 北欧人在纽芬兰的活动证据
title.en: Evidence of Norse activity in Newfoundland

summary.zh: 纽芬兰兰塞奥兹牧草地的木材研究发现，北欧人在1021年已经于当地活动。遗址中的建筑与工艺遗存记录了来自北大西洋航海网络的短期驻留，连接格陵兰与北美海岸。这些证据展示了跨洋航行的范围，也为研究北欧人与既有北美原住民世界的相遇提供了具体年代。
summary.en: Analysis of wood from L’Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland shows that Norse people were active there in 1021. Buildings and craft remains document a short-lived presence connected with North Atlantic voyages linking Greenland to the North American coast. The evidence establishes a precise date within this contact history and demonstrates the reach of Norse maritime networks.

significance.zh: 为欧洲人与北美接触史提供了可精确到年的考古证据。
significance.en: Provides archaeological evidence dated to a specific year within the history of European contact with North America.

sources.title: Nature — Evidence for European presence in the Americas in AD 1021

editorialNotes.zh: 1021年是木材加工所证实的活动年份，遗址最初建立时间和全部使用时段仍需其他证据确定。
editorialNotes.en: 1021 is the year established for the wood-working activity; the initial establishment and full period of occupation require other evidence.

title.zh: 宋代交子与纸币制度

summary.zh: 十一世纪初，四川商贸中的交子逐渐由私人信用凭证转向官府管理的纸币制度，1023年成为常用的制度化节点。纸券便于携带和结算，适应活跃市场对支付工具的需求。发行、兑换和信用管理也给政府带来新的责任，使货币形式与国家财政之间的联系更加紧密。
summary.en: In early eleventh-century Sichuan, jiaozi evolved from private credit instruments into government-administered paper money, with 1023 commonly marking institutionalisation. Paper notes made transport and settlement easier within an active commercial economy. Issuance, redemption and the maintenance of trust created new responsibilities for government, tightening connections between monetary practice, commerce and public finance.

significance.zh: 开拓了由国家管理纸币发行与信用的货币实践。
significance.en: Advanced the practice of government-managed paper-money issuance and monetary trust.

sources.title: Wikipedia（百科参考） — Song jiaozi and paper currency

editorialNotes.zh: 私人交子及其他纸质信用工具早已出现，1023年对应官府制度建设的常用纪年。
editorialNotes.en: Private jiaozi and other paper credit instruments appeared earlier; 1023 is a conventional date for government institutional development.

title.zh: 伊本·西那编成《医典》
title.en: Ibn Sina compiles the Canon of Medicine

summary.zh: 十一世纪初，伊本·西那将医学理论、药物知识和治疗经验组织成五卷本《医典》。全书依次讨论一般原理、单味药、身体各部疾病、全身性疾病与复方药剂，为读者提供便于查阅和教学的体系。它后来被译成拉丁文，并在伊斯兰世界与欧洲的医学教育中长期流传。
summary.en: In the early eleventh century, Ibn Sina organized medical theory, drugs and therapeutic knowledge into the five books of the Canon of Medicine. General principles, simple medicines, local diseases, systemic illnesses and compound remedies formed a structured reference for study. Later translated into Latin, the work circulated widely and became influential in medical education in both Islamic and European societies.

significance.zh: 《医典》推动了医学知识的系统整理及跨语言传播。
significance.en: The Canon advanced the systematic organization and transmission of medical knowledge across languages.

sources.title: 牛津大学博德利图书馆：《医典》
美国国立医学图书馆：《医典》手稿目录

editorialNotes.zh: 约1025年为常用成书年代；全书形成于作者辗转活动期间，并非一次完成于已知确切地址。
editorialNotes.en: Around 1025 is a conventional completion date; the work developed during the author's travels, and a single precise writing location is not established.

title.zh: 毕升的活字印刷

summary.zh: 十一世纪，毕升制作可以重复排列的泥活字，将单个字形与整版印刷过程分离。沈括的记述保留了字模制作、排版和印刷操作，使这一技术得以进入后世知识记录。活字与雕版在不同场合各有用途，持续的材料和工艺改进逐渐拓展了文字复制的选择。
summary.en: In the eleventh century, Bi Sheng made reusable ceramic characters that could be arranged for printing, separating individual signs from a permanently carved block. Shen Kuo’s account preserved details of type preparation, composition and printing. Movable type and woodblock methods served different needs, while continuing changes in materials and technique widened the available ways of reproducing written texts.

significance.zh: 为印刷提供了可重复组合字形的技术路径。
significance.en: Introduced a method of printing based on repeatedly recombining individual characters.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Bi Sheng’s movable type

editorialNotes.zh: 技术见于沈括对庆历年间活动的记述，约1040年为圆整锚点；毕升活动地点的确切定位仍有限。
editorialNotes.en: The technique is described by Shen Kuo for activity in the Qingli era; about 1040 is a rounded anchor, and the precise location of Bi Sheng’s work remains uncertain.

title.zh: 蒲甘佛教建筑大规模发展

summary.zh: 十一至十三世纪，蒲甘王国的统治者和各类施主在伊洛瓦底江畔兴建大量寺院、佛塔和礼拜建筑。佛教布施与积累功德的观念推动了持续的营建，壁画、铭文和塑像则传播信仰与故事。依托农业和河流交通的城市，把政治权力、工匠劳动和日常宗教活动紧密联系起来。
summary.en: Between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries, Bagan's rulers and other donors commissioned numerous temples, stupas and monasteries along the Ayeyarwady. Buddhist giving and merit-making sustained successive construction projects, while murals, inscriptions and sculpture communicated teachings and stories. Supported by agriculture and river transport, the city brought political authority, skilled labour and everyday religious practice into a monumental landscape.

significance.zh: 蒲甘的建筑群揭示了宗教捐献如何持续塑造城市与社会。
significance.en: Bagan shows how religious patronage could shape urban space and social organization over generations.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：蒲甘
盖蒂保护研究所：蒲甘保护项目

title.zh: 卡霍基亚的城市扩张

summary.zh: 十一至十二世纪，密西西比河流域的卡霍基亚迅速扩展，形成大型土丘、广场和密集居住区。农业供给、远距离交换和公共仪式支持人口汇集，巨大的工程需要组织众多劳动力。城市及其周边聚落构成重要区域中心，留下了北美原住民城市社会和政治生活的丰富证据。
summary.en: In the eleventh and twelfth centuries, Cahokia expanded rapidly in the Mississippi valley, forming monumental earthen mounds, plazas and dense residential areas. Farming, long-distance exchange and public ceremonies supported population concentration, while major construction required coordinated labour. The city and surrounding settlements became an important regional centre and preserve substantial evidence of Indigenous North American urban and political life.

significance.zh: 展现欧洲殖民以前北美城市化与公共工程的规模。
significance.en: Demonstrates the scale of North American urbanisation and public works before European colonisation.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban expansion at Cahokia

editorialNotes.zh: 1050—1150年选取快速扩张期；人口规模、政治结构及后来人口减少的原因仍在研究中。
editorialNotes.en: 1050–1150 selects the period of rapid expansion; population size, political organisation and the causes of later decline remain under investigation.

title.zh: 东西方教会分裂的重要节点
title.en: A major stage in the East–West church schism

summary.zh: 1054年，罗马教皇使节与君士坦丁堡宗主教之间的冲突以相互谴责和绝罚告终，成为东西方教会关系中的著名事件。争论涉及礼仪、教义和管辖权，也与语言及帝国政治有关。此后关系经历多次变化，分歧在更长时期内逐渐固定，形成东正教与天主教长期分立的格局。
summary.en: In 1054, conflict between papal legates and the patriarch of Constantinople culminated in condemnations and excommunications, becoming a prominent episode in relations between the eastern and western churches. Disputes concerned ritual, doctrine and jurisdiction as well as language and imperial politics. Relations continued to change afterward, with divisions gradually hardening into the enduring separation of Orthodox and Catholic traditions.

significance.zh: 成为理解教会权威、文化差异与长期分裂过程的重要节点。
significance.en: Provides an important episode for understanding church authority, cultural differences and long-term religious division.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — A major stage in the East–West church schism

editorialNotes.zh: 教会分裂持续多个世纪，1054年的事件在后世获得了特别突出的象征地位。
editorialNotes.en: The division unfolded over several centuries; the events of 1054 acquired particular symbolic prominence in later historical memory.

title.zh: 诺曼征服英格兰

summary.zh: 1066年，诺曼底公爵威廉渡海入侵英格兰，在黑斯廷斯击败哈罗德后加冕为王。征服随后通过军事行动、土地重新分配和城堡建设逐步巩固，改变了统治精英与教会组织。诺曼法语文化与既有英语社会长期交织，王权、土地关系和语言历史都受到深远影响。
summary.en: In 1066, Duke William of Normandy invaded England, defeated Harold at Hastings and was crowned king. Military campaigns, redistribution of land and castle building subsequently consolidated the conquest, changing the ruling elite and ecclesiastical organisation. Norman French culture interacted with established English society over generations, leaving lasting effects on kingship, landholding and language.

significance.zh: 深刻改变了英格兰的统治阶层、土地制度与文化联系。
significance.en: Profoundly changed England’s ruling elite, landholding and cultural connections.

sources.title: www.english-heritage.org.uk — The Norman Conquest of England

title.zh: 穆拉比特王朝建立马拉喀什

summary.zh: 十一世纪七十年代初，穆拉比特王朝在阿特拉斯山北侧建立马拉喀什，作为新的权力中心。它联系撒哈拉以南交通、山地通道与北非城市，逐渐形成宫廷、市场和宗教建筑集中的都城。后来的王朝继续扩建城墙、清真寺和园林，使马拉喀什长期影响北非及安达卢西亚的政治文化。
summary.en: In the early 1070s, the Almoravids established Marrakesh north of the Atlas Mountains as a new centre of power. Connections with Saharan routes, mountain passages and North African towns supported the growth of its court, markets and religious buildings. Successive dynasties expanded its walls, mosques and gardens, maintaining the city's influence in North African and Andalusian political and cultural life.

significance.zh: 马拉喀什把内陆交通网络与北非王朝政治紧密连接起来。
significance.en: Marrakesh connected inland transport networks with the political life of North African dynasties.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：马拉喀什老城

title.zh: 苏颂记录水运天文钟的设计
title.en: Su Song documents his astronomical clock

summary.zh: 1092年前后，苏颂在《新仪象法要》中记录了水运仪象台的设计。装置利用流水驱动机械系统，并通过链传动等部件带动天文仪器和报时机构，将时间显示与天体运行演示结合起来。图文说明保存了复杂机械的构造知识，也呈现了宋代天文观测、历法需求与工程实践之间的联系。
summary.en: Around 1092, Su Song documented the design of his astronomical clock in a technical treatise. Water drove a mechanical system whose transmission mechanisms moved astronomical instruments and time indicators, linking timekeeping with representations of celestial motion.
