Illustrated explanations preserved detailed engineering knowledge and reveal the connections between astronomical observation, calendrical needs and mechanical experimentation in Song China.

significance.zh: 这部著作保存了把水力、机械传动与天文仪器结合的工程方案。
significance.en: The treatise preserves an engineering design combining water power, mechanical transmission and astronomical instruments.

sources.title: 哥伦比亚大学Asia for Educators：宋代技术实验

editorialNotes.zh: 1092年对应所引资料中的著作纪年；仪象台的设计、试制与完工涉及不同年份。
editorialNotes.en: 1092 refers to the treatise date in the cited source; design, prototypes and completion of the clock involved different years.

title.zh: 第一次十字军东征

summary.zh: 第一次十字军东征在教皇号召后汇集西欧武装力量，参与者经拜占庭地区向东地中海进军。沿途战争与迫害造成严重损失，1099年耶路撒冷陷落后发生屠杀，征服者建立新的政权。宗教动员、地方政治与物资供给相互作用，重塑了地中海各社群之间的冲突和交往。
summary.en: The First Crusade gathered armed groups from western Europe after the papal appeal, sending them through Byzantine lands toward the eastern Mediterranean. Warfare and persecution caused severe losses, and the capture of Jerusalem in 1099 was followed by massacre and the establishment of new states. Religious mobilisation, regional politics and provisioning together reshaped conflict and contact among Mediterranean communities.

significance.zh: 使宗教动员与领土征服更深地介入地中海政治。
significance.en: Brought religious mobilisation and territorial conquest more deeply into Mediterranean politics.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The First Crusade

title.zh: 大津巴布韦的城市与国家
title.en: The city and state of Great Zimbabwe

summary.zh: 十一至十五世纪，大津巴布韦在非洲南部高地发展为重要政治与贸易中心。当地工匠以石块筑起宏大围墙和建筑群，农业、畜牧与黄金交换支撑权力和城市生活。通过通往印度洋港口的联系，内陆社群获得来自远方的物品，也将本地资源和文化带入更广阔的经济网络。
summary.en: Between the eleventh and fifteenth centuries, Great Zimbabwe developed into a major political and trading centre in southern Africa’s highlands. Local builders created monumental stone enclosures, supported by farming, livestock and gold exchange. Connections with Indian Ocean ports brought distant goods inland and linked local resources and cultural life to wider commercial networks.

significance.zh: 显示非洲南部本土国家建设与跨洋贸易联系的成就。
significance.en: Demonstrates southern African achievements in state building and connections with overseas trade.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The city and state of Great Zimbabwe

title.zh: 吴哥窟建造

summary.zh: 十二世纪上半叶，苏利耶跋摩二世赞助修建吴哥窟，将王权、毗湿奴信仰和精密建筑规划结合起来。回廊浮雕叙述史诗、仪式和宫廷场景，护城河与层叠空间共同营造宗教宇宙的秩序感。后来佛教信仰逐渐进入这一建筑群，使寺庙在政治变迁中持续成为礼拜与文化记忆的场所。
summary.en: In the first half of the twelfth century, Suryavarman II sponsored Angkor Wat, joining royal authority, devotion to Vishnu and precise architectural planning. Gallery reliefs portray epic, ceremonial and courtly scenes, while moats and layered spaces evoke a sacred cosmic order. Buddhist worship later developed within the complex, sustaining its religious importance through political change.

significance.zh: 体现吴哥王权与宗教艺术的结合，以及遗址长期的信仰延续。
significance.en: Expresses the union of Angkorian kingship and religious art and the site’s enduring spiritual life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of Angkor Wat

editorialNotes.zh: 1113—1150年采用主要赞助者统治时期的约略范围，具体建筑工程的起止未必与之完全一致。
editorialNotes.en: 1113–1150 approximately follows the main patron’s reign; the precise beginning and completion of construction need not match it exactly.

title.zh: 萨拉丁与开罗城堡

summary.zh: 1176年，阿尤布王朝的萨拉丁下令在穆卡塔姆山修建开罗城堡，以取代易受攻击的旧城防。城堡扼守城市东侧高地，兼具军事指挥、行政与居住功能，此后长期是埃及统治者的权力中心。城堡的修建改变了开罗的城市重心，也留下跨越多个王朝的建筑层。
summary.en: In 1176 Saladin of the Ayyubid dynasty ordered a citadel on the Muqattam ridge to replace Cairo's exposed older defences. Commanding high ground east of the city, it combined military, administrative and residential functions and remained a centre of power for later rulers, shifting the city's centre of gravity and accumulating buildings from several dynasties.

significance.zh: 开罗城堡说明军事防御如何重塑中世纪都城的空间与权力结构。
significance.en: The Cairo Citadel shows how military defence reshaped the space and power structure of a medieval capital.

sources.title: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities — Cairo Citadel

editorialNotes.zh: 1176年为下令修建之年，工程在此后延续；本条不把城堡某一期的形制套用于全部历史。
editorialNotes.en: 1176 is the year the order was given; construction continued afterwards, and no single building phase is extended across the site's whole history.

title.zh: 阇耶跋摩七世与圣剑寺

summary.zh: 十二世纪末，吴哥国王阇耶跋摩七世在战胜占婆之后大规模营建寺院与公共设施。1191年铭文记载的圣剑寺奉献给国王之父，寺院兼具佛教与印度教崇拜、医疗和行政功能，并与周围村落及水利系统相连。这些营建把王权、宗教功德与地方社会更紧密地结合起来。
summary.en: In the late twelfth century the Angkorian king Jayavarman VII, after campaigns against Champa, undertook large-scale temple and public building. Preah Khan, recorded in a 1191 inscription, was dedicated to his father and combined Buddhist and Hindu worship with medical and administrative functions, linked to surrounding villages and waterworks.

significance.zh: 圣剑寺显示吴哥王权如何通过寺院网络组织宗教与社会服务。
significance.en: Preah Khan shows how Angkorian power organised religious and social services through temple networks.

sources.title: APSARA National Authority — Preah Khan: Great Architecture and a Symbol of Victory

editorialNotes.zh: 1191年为铭文所记寺院建设年，营建活动延续到十三世纪初；碑铭所述功能不等同于日常运作的全部细节。
editorialNotes.en: 1191 is the foundation year recorded in the inscription and building continued into the early thirteenth century; epigraphic functions are not the whole of daily practice.

title.zh: 拉利贝拉岩凿教堂

summary.zh: 中世纪埃塞俄比亚的拉利贝拉形成了一组从岩体中开凿的教堂，建筑、通道和礼仪空间相互联系。工匠通过向下切凿和精细雕刻创造内部空间，使坚实岩石成为持续使用的宗教建筑。王室赞助、朝圣和地方信仰共同维持其重要地位，教堂至今延续着活跃的宗教传统。
summary.en: At medieval Lalibela in Ethiopia, builders carved a connected group of churches, passages and ritual spaces from living rock. Cutting downward and shaping the interiors transformed solid stone into religious architecture. Royal patronage, pilgrimage and local devotion sustained the site’s importance, and the churches remain centres of an active religious tradition.

significance.zh: 展现埃塞俄比亚岩凿工程、建筑艺术与宗教生活的延续。
significance.en: Demonstrates Ethiopian rock-cut engineering, architectural art and continuing religious life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela

editorialNotes.zh: 约1200年为传统上与拉利贝拉王联系的阶段，各教堂的具体建造顺序和年代仍有研究。
editorialNotes.en: About 1200 marks the phase traditionally associated with King Lalibela; the sequence and dates of individual churches remain under study.

title.zh: 马林王朝时期非斯繁荣

summary.zh: 十三至十四世纪，非斯在马林王朝时期迎来重要的城市发展。宗教学校、旅商客栈、住宅、清真寺和喷泉构成密集的街区，把学习、手工业与商业活动组织在一起。作为摩洛哥的政治和文化中心，非斯吸引了学者、商人与工匠，也保存并发展了北非城市的建筑和生活传统。
summary.en: During the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, Fez experienced major development under the Marinids. Madrasas, merchants' lodgings, houses, mosques and fountains formed dense neighbourhoods connecting learning, craft production and commerce. As an important Moroccan political and cultural centre, the city brought together scholars, traders and artisans while sustaining distinctive North African architectural and urban traditions.

significance.zh: 非斯展示了中世纪北非城市中教育、贸易与日常生活的紧密结合。
significance.en: Fez illustrates the close relationship between education, trade and everyday life in medieval North African cities.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：非斯老城

title.zh: 基尔瓦的印度洋贸易繁荣

summary.zh: 十三至十四世纪，基尔瓦依托东非海岸与内陆的联系，成为印度洋贸易的重要港口。黄金、象牙和其他货物与来自阿拉伯、南亚及更远地区的商品在此交换，商业财富支持清真寺、宫殿和珊瑚石建筑。斯瓦希里社会在本地语言、非洲传统与伊斯兰文化的交汇中形成鲜明的城市生活。
summary.en: In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, Kilwa became a major Indian Ocean port through connections with the East African coast and interior. Gold, ivory and other goods were exchanged for products from Arabia, South Asia and farther afield. Commercial wealth supported mosques, palaces and coral-stone architecture within a Swahili urban society joining African traditions with Islamic cultural connections.

significance.zh: 展现东非城市在印度洋贸易中的主动参与和文化创造。
significance.en: Shows East African cities’ active participation and cultural creativity within Indian Ocean commerce.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kilwa’s Indian Ocean trading prosperity

title.zh: 库斯科王国的早期扩张
title.en: The early expansion of the kingdom of Cusco

summary.zh: 约十三世纪初，印加人以库斯科谷地为中心形成小型王国，通过联姻、战争与水利建设逐步控制周边谷地。1438年前后，帕查库特克在位期间击败强敌并重组国家机构，此后扩张速度明显加快。库斯科的城市规划、道路与祭祀体系在这一过程中逐步成形，成为帝国权力的中心。
summary.en: From about the early thirteenth century the Inka formed a small kingdom centred on the Cusco valley, gradually controlling neighbouring valleys through marriage, warfare and waterworks. Around 1438, during the reign of Pachacuti, a major victory and institutional reorganisation preceded much faster expansion. Cusco's planning, roads and ceremonial system took shape as the centre of imperial power.

significance.zh: 库斯科王国阶段解释了印加帝国扩张的制度与空间起点。
significance.en: The Cusco kingdom phase explains the institutional and spatial starting point of Inka imperial expansion.

sources.title: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian — Inka: Creation Stories

editorialNotes.zh: 约1200—1438为早期王国阶段；具体年代依赖口述传统与后世编年，学界存在分歧。
editorialNotes.en: The c. 1200–1438 range covers the early kingdom; exact dates rest on oral tradition and later chronicles and remain debated.

title.zh: 南马都尔的人工岛与仪式中心
title.en: Artificial islets and ceremonial power at Nan Madol

summary.zh: 南马都尔在波纳佩岛近海建造人工岛、运河和巨石围墙，形成邵德雷尔王朝的仪式与政治中心。玄武岩柱和珊瑚材料的运输需要复杂的劳动组织，建筑空间体现统治者、祭司与社群之间的关系。围绕遗址的地方传统与考古发现共同保存了密克罗尼西亚社会独特的历史。
summary.en: Nan Madol’s artificial islets, channels and massive stone walls off Pohnpei formed a ceremonial and political centre of the Saudeleur dynasty. Transporting basalt columns and coral materials required substantial coordination, while its spaces expressed relationships among rulers, ritual specialists and communities. Archaeological remains and local traditions together preserve a distinctive history of Micronesian society.

significance.zh: 保存了密克罗尼西亚复杂政治组织与海岸工程的突出证据。
significance.en: Preserves outstanding evidence of complex political organisation and coastal engineering in Micronesia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Artificial islets and ceremonial power at Nan Madol

editorialNotes.zh: 1200—1500年选取主要建造繁荣期，部分遗迹及王朝活动的年代范围更广。
editorialNotes.en: 1200–1500 selects a principal construction and flourishing phase; some remains and dynastic activities extend beyond this interval.

title.zh: 拉帕努伊的摩艾与仪式景观
title.en: Moai and ceremonial landscapes on Rapa Nui

summary.zh: 拉帕努伊居民以火山岩雕刻摩艾石像，并在岛上修筑祭台和其他仪式设施。石像与祖先、地位和群体关系相连，建造和搬运过程汇集技术知识与集体劳动。居民同时调整农业和土地利用以适应岛屿环境，使宏大雕塑与日常生产共同构成持续变化的文化景观。
summary.en: Rapa Nui communities carved moai from volcanic stone and built ceremonial platforms and other structures across the island. The statues expressed connections with ancestors, status and social groups, while carving and transport combined technical knowledge with collective labour. People also adapted farming and land use to island conditions, producing a changing cultural landscape of monumental art and everyday subsistence.

significance.zh: 展现波利尼西亚社会的雕塑传统、工程知识与环境适应。
significance.en: Demonstrates Polynesian sculptural traditions, engineering knowledge and environmental adaptation.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Moai and ceremonial landscapes on Rapa Nui

editorialNotes.zh: 早期定居、石像建造分期及人口环境变化仍有讨论；本条只选取1200—1500年的文化发展阶段。
editorialNotes.en: Early settlement, phases of statue construction and population–environment changes remain debated; this entry selects the cultural development phase from 1200 to 1500.

title.zh: 斐波那契写成《计算之书》

summary.zh: 1202年，曾在北非学习并游历地中海的比萨学者斐波那契写成《计算之书》。他用印度—阿拉伯数字和十进位记数法讲解运算，把所学方法应用于货币、度量与商业问题。作品通过手抄和后来的教学传统传播，帮助欧洲计算者掌握更灵活的算术与代数技巧。
summary.en: In 1202, Fibonacci of Pisa wrote Liber abaci after studying in North Africa and travelling around the Mediterranean. He explained calculation with Hindu-Arabic numerals and decimal place value, applying methods to money, measures and commercial problems. Manuscript circulation and later teaching traditions helped European practitioners develop more flexible arithmetic and algebraic techniques.

significance.zh: 《计算之书》记录了南亚、伊斯兰世界与欧洲之间数学知识的传播。
significance.en: Liber abaci records mathematical transmission connecting South Asia, the Islamic world and Europe.

sources.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学MacTutor数学史：Fibonacci

title.zh: 第四次十字军与拉丁帝国
title.en: The Fourth Crusade and the Latin Empire

summary.zh: 1204年，第四次十字军攻陷君士坦丁堡，城中遭到大规模劫掠，拉丁帝国在拜占庭领土上建立。流亡政权在尼西亚、伊庇鲁斯与特拉比松延续拜占庭统治；1261年尼西亚军队收复君士坦丁堡，米海尔八世恢复帝国。这次分裂削弱了拜占庭的财政与军事能力，也改变了东地中海的政治与教会关系。
summary.en: In 1204 the Fourth Crusade captured Constantinople, which was extensively sacked, and a Latin empire was established on Byzantine territory. Exiles maintained Byzantine rule at Nicaea, Epirus and Trebizond; in 1261 Nicaean forces retook Constantinople and Michael VIII restored the empire. The rupture weakened Byzantine finances and military capacity and reshaped eastern Mediterranean politics.

significance.zh: 1204年的分裂改变了拜占庭国家与东地中海秩序。
significance.en: The rupture of 1204 transformed the Byzantine state and the eastern Mediterranean order.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Byzantium (ca. 330–1453)

editorialNotes.zh: 1204—1261为拉丁帝国时期；1261年复国后的疆域与制度已与1204年以前不同。
editorialNotes.en: 1204–1261 is the Latin Empire period; after 1261 the restored empire's territory and institutions differed from those before 1204.

title.zh: 德里苏丹国建立

summary.zh: 1206年，古特卜丁·艾伯克在古尔王朝扩张的基础上建立以德里为中心的统治，开启德里苏丹国时代。此后不同王朝围绕军队、财政和地方关系经营权力，城市吸引学者、商人和工匠。波斯语行政文化与南亚社会长期互动，形成新的建筑、文学和政治传统。
summary.en: In 1206, Qutb al-Din Aibak established rule centred on Delhi after the Ghurid expansion, beginning the era of the Delhi Sultanate. Successive dynasties managed armies, finance and regional relationships while the city attracted scholars, merchants and craftspeople. Persian-language administrative culture interacted with South Asian societies, contributing to new architectural, literary and political traditions.

significance.zh: 为南亚政治制度与跨区域文化交流开启重要阶段。
significance.en: Opened an important phase in South Asian political institutions and cross-regional cultural exchange.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of the Delhi Sultanate

title.zh: 成吉思汗与蒙古帝国形成
title.en: Chinggis Khan and the formation of the Mongol Empire

summary.zh: 1206年，铁木真在整合蒙古草原势力后获得成吉思汗称号，建立更有组织的军事与政治联盟。军队编制、忠诚关系和资源分配强化了统治能力，随后的征服将欧亚许多地区卷入新的帝国网络。战争带来巨大破坏，也改变了道路、外交和人群流动的条件。
summary.en: In 1206, Temüjin received the title Chinggis Khan after consolidating power across the Mongolian steppe. Military organisation, relationships of allegiance and resource distribution strengthened the new political union. Subsequent conquests brought many Eurasian regions into imperial networks, causing immense destruction while also changing the conditions of travel, diplomacy and the movement of people.

significance.zh: 奠定蒙古帝国形成与后来欧亚格局重组的基础。
significance.en: Laid foundations for the Mongol Empire and the subsequent reorganisation of Eurasian connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Chinggis Khan and the formation of the Mongol Empire

title.zh: 《大宪章》的颁布

summary.zh: 1215年，英格兰国王约翰在与贵族的冲突中接受《大宪章》，对王权行使、封建义务和司法程序作出承诺。协议很快陷入战争，但后来的重新颁布使部分原则得以延续。围绕法律约束权力的解释在后世不断扩展，使一份中世纪政治妥协获得持久的制度象征意义。
summary.en: In 1215, King John accepted Magna Carta during conflict with English barons, making commitments about royal power, feudal obligations and judicial procedure. The settlement quickly broke down into warfare, but later reissues preserved parts of it. Subsequent interpretations broadened its association with legal restraints on authority, giving a medieval political compromise an enduring institutional significance.

significance.zh: 成为后世讨论依法限制统治权力的重要历史文本。
significance.en: Became an important historical text in later debates about placing rulers under law.

sources.title: www.nationalarchives.gov.uk — Issuing of Magna Carta

editorialNotes.zh: 1215年的条款主要处于封建政治语境，其后来的普遍权利解释经历了长期变化。
editorialNotes.en: The original provisions belonged largely to a feudal political setting; later interpretations of universal rights developed over a long period.

title.zh: 马蓬古布韦的王权与贸易

summary.zh: 十三世纪，马蓬古布韦在林波波河与沙希河附近发展为区域王国的中心。山顶王室空间与周围聚落反映社会等级，农业、畜牧和黄金交换支撑统治者的权力。玻璃珠和其他外来物品显示它通过沿海网络参与印度洋贸易，连接非洲南部内陆与更广阔世界。
summary.en: In the thirteenth century, Mapungubwe became the centre of a regional kingdom near the Limpopo and Shashe rivers. Royal spaces on the hill and surrounding settlements reveal social hierarchy, supported by farming, livestock and gold exchange. Glass beads and other imported objects show participation in Indian Ocean trade through coastal networks linking southern Africa’s interior to wider commercial worlds.

significance.zh: 揭示非洲南部早期王权、社会分层与远距离交换的联系。
significance.en: Reveals connections among early southern African kingship, social hierarchy and long-distance exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kingship and trade at Mapungubwe

title.zh: 马里帝国的兴起

summary.zh: 十三世纪，松迪亚塔及其支持者在西非曼丁地区建立并扩展马里帝国。农业腹地、黄金贸易和跨撒哈拉商路为统治提供资源，王室与地方社群通过多种关系维系联系。口述传统、阿拉伯文献和考古发现共同记录其历史，使马里成为理解西非国家形成和区域交流的重要案例。
summary.en: In the thirteenth century, Sunjata and his supporters established and expanded the Mali Empire in the Mande region of West Africa. Agricultural hinterlands, gold exchange and trans-Saharan routes supplied resources, while varied relationships linked rulers and local communities. Oral traditions, Arabic accounts and archaeology together preserve its history and illuminate West African state formation and regional exchange.

significance.zh: 推动了西非大范围政治整合与商贸文化联系。
significance.en: Advanced large-scale political integration and commercial and cultural connections in West Africa.

sources.title: discovery.ucl.ac.uk — Rise of the Mali Empire

editorialNotes.zh: 1235年是传统叙述中常用的节点；早期事件年表与首都所在地仍存在重要不确定性。
editorialNotes.en: 1235 is a conventional date in historical traditions; the early chronology and locations of capitals remain substantially uncertain.

title.zh: 波利尼西亚人定居新西兰
title.en: Polynesian settlement of Aotearoa New Zealand

summary.zh: 十三世纪，来自东波利尼西亚的航海者抵达新西兰，建立聚落并逐渐形成毛利社会。新环境中的季节、动植物和海岸资源促使居民调整生产与生活方式，航海知识、亲族关系和口述传统继续联系不同社群。此后的定居扩展和文化创造，构成奥特亚罗瓦历史的重要基础。
summary.en: In the thirteenth century, voyagers from eastern Polynesia reached New Zealand, established settlements and gradually developed Māori society. Local seasons, plants, animals and coastal resources encouraged changes in subsistence and daily life. Maritime knowledge, kinship and oral traditions connected communities as settlement and cultural innovation laid important foundations for the history of Aotearoa.

significance.zh: 开启毛利社会在奥特亚罗瓦的发展与环境适应历史。
significance.en: Begins the history of Māori social development and environmental adaptation in Aotearoa.

sources.title: Te Ara — Encyclopedia of New Zealand（专业百科） — Polynesian settlement of Aotearoa New Zealand

editorialNotes.zh: 考古与年代研究通常将主要定居置于1250—1300年前后，具体航次和各地聚落建立时间有所差异。
editorialNotes.en: Archaeological and chronological research commonly places major settlement around 1250–1300; individual voyages and local settlement dates differ.

title.zh: 素可泰城市与艺术传统兴盛
title.en: Urban and artistic development at Sukhothai

summary.zh: 十三至十四世纪，素可泰及相关城镇成为泰人政治与文化的重要中心。统治者、僧侣和工匠兴建寺院、佛塔与供水设施，在吸收高棉、孟人和其他地区传统的同时，形成具有自身特点的佛像和建筑样式。城市网络把农业基础、佛教活动与王室赞助连接起来，影响了后来的泰国文化。
summary.en: In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, Sukhothai and related towns became important centres of Thai political and cultural life. Rulers, monks and artisans built monasteries, stupas and water infrastructure, developing distinctive sculpture and architecture from Khmer, Mon and other regional traditions. The urban network linked agricultural resources, Buddhist practice and royal patronage, leaving a lasting influence on later Thai culture.

significance.zh: 素可泰风格展示了东南亚区域交流中地方文化传统的形成。
significance.en: Sukhothai illustrates how a distinctive cultural tradition emerged through regional exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：素可泰历史城镇及相关历史城镇

title.zh: 拉帕哈成为汤加政治与礼仪中心
title.en: Lapaha becomes a Tongan political and ceremonial centre

summary.zh: 十三世纪前后，汤加的权力中心转向汤加塔布岛的拉帕哈。统治者在适宜独木舟停泊的潟湖边营建居所和石筑王陵，高台与巨大石板展示了首领的政治与精神地位。道路、码头及聚居空间把礼仪中心与海上交通连接起来，王陵和相关传统也在后世继续维系社会记忆。
summary.en: Around the thirteenth century, Tongan chiefly power shifted toward Lapaha on Tongatapu. Residences and monumental stone-lined tombs developed beside a lagoon suited to canoe anchorage, expressing chiefs' political and spiritual standing. Roads, landing places and settlement areas linked the ceremonial centre with maritime connections. The tombs and associated practices continued to sustain social memory in later generations.

significance.zh: 拉帕哈展现了太平洋海上交通、首领政治与大型石作工程的结合。
significance.en: Lapaha connects Pacific maritime mobility, chiefly authority and monumental stone construction.

sources.title: 汤加提交UNESCO预备名单：汤加王国古都

editorialNotes.zh: 本条聚焦十三至十五世纪的早期发展。迁都纪年结合了口述谱系与考古研究，部分王陵的早期断代仍需更多样本。
editorialNotes.en: This entry focuses on thirteenth- to fifteenth-century development. Relocation dates combine oral genealogies with archaeology, and early tomb dating requires further samples.

title.zh: 马穆鲁克时期开罗的城市扩张

summary.zh: 1250年至1517年，马穆鲁克苏丹统治埃及与叙利亚，开罗进入持续扩张期。新的街区、供水设施、清真寺、经学院与商队驿站相继修建，宗教与慈善捐赠把教育、商业和城市服务联系起来。开罗连接地中海、红海与撒哈拉商路，成为当时规模最大的伊斯兰城市之一。
summary.en: Between 1250 and 1517 the Mamluk sultans ruled Egypt and Syria, and Cairo expanded continuously. New quarters, water installations, mosques, colleges and caravanserais were built, while charitable endowments linked education, commerce and urban services. Connected to Mediterranean, Red Sea and Saharan routes, Cairo became one of the largest Islamic cities of its time.

significance.zh: 马穆鲁克开罗体现了宗教捐赠制度与城市经济的结合。
significance.en: Mamluk Cairo embodies the link between charitable endowment institutions and the urban economy.

sources.title: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities — Historical Cairo

editorialNotes.zh: 1250—1517为马穆鲁克统治期；城市扩张在此前已经展开，并在奥斯曼时期继续。
editorialNotes.en: 1250–1517 is the Mamluk period; the city had already expanded earlier and continued to do so under Ottoman rule.

title.zh: 蒙古军攻陷巴格达

summary.zh: 1258年，旭烈兀率领的蒙古军队攻陷巴格达，阿拔斯哈里发在当地的统治随之终结。围城、杀戮和破坏对居民及城市设施造成严重损失，地区政治随后被纳入伊儿汗国的发展。城市在战争之后继续经历恢复和变化，知识与文化活动也在不同地点和赞助网络中延续。
summary.en: In 1258, Mongol forces led by Hülegü captured Baghdad and ended Abbasid caliphal rule in the city. Siege, killing and destruction caused severe losses to residents and infrastructure, while regional politics were drawn into the emerging Ilkhanate. Baghdad later underwent recovery and change, and intellectual and cultural activity continued through different places and networks of patronage.

significance.zh: 重塑伊拉克政治秩序，并留下战争破坏与城市恢复的历史。
significance.en: Reshaped Iraq’s political order and left a history of wartime destruction followed by urban recovery.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Mongol sack of Baghdad

editorialNotes.zh: 中世纪记载的死亡人数差异极大，缺乏可支持精确总数的可靠统计。
editorialNotes.en: Medieval accounts give widely varying death tolls, and reliable statistics for a precise total are lacking.

title.zh: 忽必烈建立元朝国号
title.en: Kublai adopts the Yuan dynastic name

summary.zh: 1271年，忽必烈采用“大元”国号，以大都为重要政治中心经营统治。元朝逐渐整合蒙古军事传统与中国行政制度，并在1279年灭南宋后控制更广阔地区。帝国范围内的人群流动、宗教赞助和跨区域贸易十分活跃，不同群体的身份差异与政治待遇也深刻影响社会生活。
summary.en: In 1271, Kublai adopted the dynastic name Great Yuan and developed rule from the major political centre of Dadu. Yuan government combined Mongol military traditions with Chinese administrative practices, extending its authority after the defeat of Southern Song in 1279. Mobility, religious patronage and interregional commerce flourished alongside important differences in status and political treatment among social groups.

significance.zh: 将中国地区更深地纳入蒙古时代的欧亚交流网络。
significance.en: Drew regions of China more deeply into the Eurasian networks of the Mongol era.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Kublai adopts the Yuan dynastic name

title.zh: 吴哥核心区的十四世纪转型
title.en: Fourteenth-century transformation of Angkor's urban core

summary.zh: 十四世纪，吴哥都城核心区的土地利用强度逐步下降，护城河与沟渠出现淤积和浮生植被，居民向其他区域分散。传统叙述把1431年的军事失败视为城市突然废弃，但沉积与遥感研究表明转变持续数十年，与气候波动、水利失效和政治重心转移交织。吴哥的寺院与部分聚落仍在继续使用。
summary.en: During the fourteenth century land use in Angkor's administrative and economic core declined gradually; moats and channels silted up and floating vegetation spread as settlement dispersed. The military defeat of 1431 has often been read as sudden abandonment, but sedimentary and remote-sensing research indicates a longer transformation linked to climate, failing water management and shifting political centres.

significance.zh: 吴哥的转型说明城市衰落往往是长期过程，而不是单一战役的结果。
significance.en: Angkor's transformation shows that urban decline is often a long process rather than the result of one battle.

sources.title: University of Sydney — New research casts doubt on cause of Angkor's collapse

editorialNotes.zh: 1431年仍是重要的政治事件年份，但研究不支持“全城骤然废弃”的表述；本条也不把转型归因于单一原因。
editorialNotes.en: 1431 remains a significant political date, but the evidence does not support sudden abandonment of the whole city; no single cause is asserted.

title.zh: 意大利城市中的人文主义与艺术转变
title.en: Humanism and artistic change in Italian cities

summary.zh: 十四至十五世纪，意大利城市的商贸财富、宫廷与教会赞助，为艺术家和学者提供新的活动空间。古典文本的整理、对人体与自然的观察、透视和表现技法的探索相互促进。人文主义和艺术创造在不同城市间传播，也与宗教生活及社会地位紧密相连，逐渐改变了欧洲知识与视觉文化。
summary.en: In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, commercial wealth and courtly and ecclesiastical patronage supported artists and scholars in Italian cities. The study of classical texts interacted with observation of the body and nature and with new visual techniques. Humanism and artistic innovation spread among cities, remaining closely connected with religion and social status while gradually changing European intellectual and visual culture.

significance.zh: 推动古典学术、艺术实践与城市文化产生新的结合。
significance.en: Created new connections among classical learning, artistic practice and urban culture.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Humanism and artistic change in Italian cities

title.zh: 满者伯夷都城特罗武兰发展
title.en: Development of Majapahit's capital at Trowulan

summary.zh: 十四至十五世纪，爪哇东部的特罗武兰发展为满者伯夷的重要都城。宫廷、寺庙、作坊和市场通过道路及水道联系，水库与灌溉设施支持密集聚居。遗址出土的陶器、金属加工用具和外来商品，连同宫廷文学，呈现了一个依靠农业、手工业与跨海交往繁荣的城市社会。
summary.en: In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, Trowulan developed as a major capital of Majapahit in eastern Java. Roads and waterways connected courtly buildings, temples, workshops and markets, while reservoirs and irrigation supported dense settlement. Ceramics, metalworking equipment and imported goods, read alongside court literature, reveal an urban society sustained by agriculture, skilled production and connections across the seas.

significance.zh: 特罗武兰把爪哇内陆农业经济与海上交流网络连接起来。
significance.en: Trowulan linked Java's agricultural hinterland with networks of production and maritime exchange.

sources.title: 印度尼西亚提交UNESCO预备名单：特罗武兰
World Monuments Fund：Trowulan

editorialNotes.zh: 1300—1500年概括城市主要活动阶段。宫廷文学与考古遗存的对应关系，以及完整城市范围，仍有研究空间。
editorialNotes.en: The 1300–1500 range summarizes major urban activity; the relationship between court descriptions, archaeological remains and the full city extent remains under study.

title.zh: 恐鸟消失与新西兰生态转变
title.en: Moa disappear as New Zealand's ecology changes

summary.zh: 毛利先民定居新西兰后，恐鸟成为重要的食物与原料来源，骨骼可制成鱼钩和饰物，羽毛与皮也得到利用。密集捕猎与栖息地改变使这些大型不会飞的鸟类迅速减少，随后从考古记录中消失。物种消失既改变了岛屿生态，也促使人们调整获取食物与利用环境的方式。
summary.en: After the ancestors of Maori settled New Zealand, moa provided food and materials for hooks, ornaments and clothing. Intensive hunting and changes to habitats rapidly reduced these large flightless birds, which subsequently disappeared from the archaeological record. Their loss changed island ecosystems and formed part of a wider transformation in how communities obtained food and used their environments.

significance.zh: 恐鸟的消失揭示了人类定居、资源利用与岛屿生态变化的相互影响。
significance.en: Moa extinction reveals the interaction of settlement, resource use and ecological change on islands.

sources.title: 新西兰Te Ara专业百科：Moa

editorialNotes.zh: 1300—1550年为涵盖捕猎和最晚考古记录的宽时段；具体灭绝时间因地区、物种及定年方法而有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 1300–1550 is a broad range covering exploitation and the latest archaeological record; exact extinction timing varies by region, species and dating method.

title.zh: 曼萨·穆萨朝觐

summary.zh: 1324至1325年前后，马里统治者曼萨·穆萨率庞大随行队伍前往麦加朝觐，并途经开罗。旅程中的外交往来与黄金支出引起外界关注，扩大了马里在地中海和伊斯兰世界的声誉。返回后持续的宗教与建筑赞助，进一步联系王权、商业财富和西非的学术生活。
summary.en: Around 1324–1325, Mali’s ruler Mansa Musa travelled to Mecca on pilgrimage with a large entourage, passing through Cairo. Diplomatic encounters and substantial spending of gold attracted attention and increased Mali’s visibility in the Mediterranean and Islamic worlds. Continuing religious and architectural patronage linked royal authority and commercial wealth with West African scholarly life.

significance.zh: 使西非王国的财富和文化联系进入更广泛的国际记录。
significance.en: Brought West African wealth and cultural connections into a wider international record.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Mansa Musa’s pilgrimage

editorialNotes.zh: 随行人数、黄金数量及物价影响的记载各异，无法据此可靠计算现代意义上的个人财富排名。
editorialNotes.en: Accounts vary over entourage size, gold quantities and price effects; they cannot securely establish a personal wealth ranking in modern financial terms.

title.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰的建立传统

summary.zh: 墨西加人在特斯科科湖的岛屿上建立特诺奇蒂特兰，逐步修筑堤道、运河、寺庙和居住区。城市利用湖泊环境发展交通、农业和市场，并在后来的军事联盟与贡赋体系中扩大权力。密集的城市生活和宏大礼仪建筑，使其成为欧洲人抵达前中美洲最重要的政治中心之一。
summary.en: The Mexica established Tenochtitlan on islands in Lake Texcoco, gradually building causeways, canals, temples and residential areas. The city used its lake environment for transport, agriculture and markets, later expanding its power through military alliances and tribute. Dense urban life and major ceremonial buildings made it one of Mesoamerica’s most important political centres before European arrival.

significance.zh: 展现墨西哥盆地湖泊城市的发展与墨西加权力的增长。
significance.en: Shows the development of lake-based urbanism and the growth of Mexica power in the Basin of Mexico.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The foundation tradition of Tenochtitlan

editorialNotes.zh: 1325年为常见建立传统的纪年，早期聚落与王朝叙事之间仍有考古和历史问题。
editorialNotes.en: 1325 is the date in a widely used foundation tradition; relations between early settlement and dynastic narratives remain subjects of archaeological and historical research.

title.zh: 维查耶纳伽尔与亨比都城
title.en: Vijayanagara and the capital at Hampi

summary.zh: 十四世纪中叶，维查耶纳伽尔王国以通加巴德拉河畔的亨比为中心统治南印度。都城依托花岗岩丘陵、河流与灌溉系统扩展，寺庙、集市与王室建筑组成密集的城市景观，并与波斯、葡萄牙及东南亚商人保持贸易联系。1565年塔利科塔战役后都城被攻陷并遭劫掠，城市迅速衰败。
summary.en: From the mid-fourteenth century the Vijayanagara kingdom ruled much of South India from Hampi beside the Tungabhadra river. The capital expanded around granite hills, water systems and irrigated land, its temples, bazaars and royal quarters forming a dense urban landscape linked to Persian, Portuguese and Southeast Asian trade. After the battle of Talikota in 1565 the city was sacked and rapidly declined.

significance.zh: 亨比显示了南印度帝国都城如何以宗教与商业空间组织权力。
significance.en: Hampi shows how a South Indian imperial capital organised power through religious and commercial space.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Hampi

editorialNotes.zh: 1336年为传统建国年；1565年为都城被攻陷之年，王国的地方势力此后仍延续一段时间。
editorialNotes.en: 1336 is the traditional foundation year; 1565 is the year the capital fell, after which regional powers of the kingdom persisted for a time.

title.zh: 黑死病的跨区域大流行

summary.zh: 十四世纪中叶，鼠疫沿欧亚交通和贸易网络扩散，严重冲击欧洲、西亚及北非多地。大规模死亡扰动家庭、生产、城市治理和宗教生活，劳动力与土地关系随之改变。不同地区的恢复和社会后果各有差异，考古、文献与古代DNA研究正在不断丰富对这场大流行的认识。
summary.en: In the mid-fourteenth century, plague spread through Eurasian travel and trading networks, severely affecting many parts of Europe, western Asia and North Africa. Mass mortality disrupted households, production, government and religious life, with consequences for labour and landholding. Regional experiences differed, and archaeology, written sources and ancient DNA continue to refine understanding of the pandemic.

significance.zh: 深刻改变人口结构、劳动关系与跨区域疾病传播史。
significance.en: Profoundly affected population structures, labour relations and the history of disease transmission across regions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Black Death pandemic

editorialNotes.zh: 不同地区的死亡比例与疫情年代差异较大，全球总死亡数及传播细节仍存在不确定性。
editorialNotes.en: Mortality rates and outbreak timing varied substantially by region; global totals and details of transmission remain uncertain.

title.zh: 阿瑜陀耶建都

summary.zh: 1350年，阿瑜陀耶在昭披耶河流域建立为王都。三条河流环绕的城址有利于防御，也便于内陆农业区与海上航线交换货物。城市逐渐形成道路、运河和蓄排水设施相连的格局，王宫、寺院与居民区围绕水道展开，后来成长为东南亚重要的政治与商业中心。
summary.en: In 1350, Ayutthaya was founded as a royal capital in the Chao Phraya basin. Its setting among three rivers offered defensive advantages and connected inland agricultural districts with maritime routes. Roads, canals and water infrastructure gradually organized a city of palaces, temples and residential quarters. Ayutthaya subsequently developed into a major political and commercial centre in Southeast Asia.

significance.zh: 河流交通与城市水利为阿瑜陀耶后来的区域地位奠定了基础。
significance.en: River connections and urban water management supported Ayutthaya's subsequent regional importance.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：阿瑜陀耶古城

title.zh: 明朝建立

summary.zh: 1368年，朱元璋在南京建立明朝，随后攻取大都，结束元朝在中国大部分地区的统治。新政权恢复农业与税收，重组官僚、军事和地方管理，并以强有力的皇权约束功臣与官员。后续社会发展延续了区域贸易和文化创造，也不断面对财政、边疆及统治秩序的挑战。
summary.en: In 1368, Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming dynasty in Nanjing, and his forces subsequently captured Dadu, ending Yuan rule across much of China. The new government restored agriculture and revenue collection and reorganised civil, military and local administration under strong imperial authority. Regional trade and cultural production continued to develop amid enduring fiscal, frontier and political challenges.

significance.zh: 开启了中国政治重建及此后长期的明代社会发展。
significance.en: Began political reconstruction and the long development of Ming society in China.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Ming dynasty

title.zh: 帖木儿定都撒马尔罕与工匠迁移
title.en: Timur's capital at Samarkand and the movement of craftsmen

summary.zh: 1370年，帖木儿定都撒马尔罕，以此为基地向波斯、中亚与西亚扩张。都城营建集合了从各地征调或迁移来的工匠，蓝色琉璃砖、穹顶与经学院形成此后中亚建筑的基本语汇。撒马尔罕同时是商路枢纽，来自中国、印度、波斯与草原的货物和人群在此交汇，宫廷也扶植波斯书法与细密画。
summary.en: In 1370 Timur made Samarkand his capital and expanded from there into Persia, Central Asia and West Asia. Building projects gathered craftsmen transferred or recruited from conquered regions, and glazed tilework, domes and colleges shaped a lasting Central Asian architectural vocabulary. As a caravan hub the city brought together goods and people from China, India, Persia and the steppe.

significance.zh: 帖木儿的撒马尔罕把军事征服、工匠迁移与跨区域贸易结合为一体。
significance.en: Timur's Samarkand combined military conquest, the movement of craftsmen and transregional trade.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Timurid Period (ca. 1370–1507)

editorialNotes.zh: 1370年为定都之年；主要建筑的营建延续到十五世纪，不能把这一时期全部归入帖木儿在位年代。
editorialNotes.en: 1370 is the year the capital was established; major building continued into the fifteenth century and is not all assigned to Timur's reign.

title.zh: 刚果王国与姆班扎刚果
title.en: The Kongo kingdom and Mbanza Kongo

summary.zh: 十四世纪前后，刚果王国在非洲中西部逐渐形成，以姆班扎刚果为重要政治中心。统治者通过地方关系、资源征集和区域贸易扩大影响，城市汇集王室、贵族及宗教活动。王国在欧洲海上来访以前已经建立自身的社会与政治网络，后来又在新的跨大西洋联系中持续调整。
summary.en: Around the fourteenth century, the Kingdom of Kongo took shape in west-central Africa, with Mbanza Kongo as an important political centre. Rulers expanded influence through regional relationships, resource collection and trade, while the city brought together royal, aristocratic and religious activity. These established social and political networks later adapted to new Atlantic connections following European maritime arrivals.

significance.zh: 凸显中非本土国家形成及其参与后来全球联系的历史基础。
significance.en: Highlights indigenous state formation in central Africa and its foundations for later global connections.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The Kongo kingdom and Mbanza Kongo

editorialNotes.zh: 约1390年是宽泛时间锚点，王国形成过程及早期统治者的具体年代主要依赖后期传统重建。
editorialNotes.en: About 1390 is a broad chronological anchor; the formation of the kingdom and dates of early rulers are largely reconstructed from later traditions.

title.zh: 马六甲港口国家的兴起
title.en: Rise of the port polity of Melaka

summary.zh: 十五世纪初，马六甲在海峡要道兴起，利用港口位置吸引南海与印度洋之间的商船。统治者通过外交、法律安排和商业服务协调不同来源的商人，伊斯兰信仰也随贸易与政治联系扩大影响。多语言、多社群的港口生活使马六甲成为东南亚重要的商业与文化中心。
summary.en: In the early fifteenth century, Malacca rose at a strategic position on the straits, attracting ships moving between the South China Sea and the Indian Ocean. Rulers used diplomacy, legal arrangements and commercial services to accommodate merchants of varied origins, while Islamic connections expanded. Multilingual and diverse port communities made Malacca a major Southeast Asian commercial and cultural centre.

significance.zh: 强化海峡贸易与东南亚多元港口社会的发展。
significance.en: Strengthened trade through the straits and the development of diverse Southeast Asian port society.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rise of the port polity of Melaka

editorialNotes.zh: 约1400年为城市兴起的常用约数，建城者及早期王统的不同叙述存在差异。
editorialNotes.en: About 1400 is a conventional approximation for the port’s rise; accounts differ concerning its founder and early royal succession.

title.zh: 奇穆首都昌昌繁荣
title.en: Chan Chan flourishes as the Chimu capital

summary.zh: 十五世纪，奇穆王国首都昌昌以庞大的土筑宫殿群和严格组织的城区著称。高墙围合居所、仓储、祭祀空间与水池，城外灌溉系统支持农业，城内工匠从事纺织、木作和金属加工。王国随后被印加征服，而留下的城市布局仍清楚显示了统治、生产与水资源管理的关系。
summary.en: In the fifteenth century, the Chimu capital Chan Chan was distinguished by extensive earthen compounds and a carefully ordered urban plan. Enclosures contained residences, storage, ceremonial spaces and reservoirs; irrigation sustained agriculture while workshops produced textiles, woodwork and metal objects. The kingdom later fell to the Incas, but the city preserves the relationship between government, production and water management.

significance.zh: 昌昌展示了安第斯沿海城市在干旱环境下组织生产与权力的方式。
significance.en: Chan Chan shows how an Andean coastal city organized production and authority in an arid environment.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：昌昌考古区

editorialNotes.zh: 1400—1500年概括十五世纪的鼎盛与政权转变，未把印加征服定为该时段末年。
editorialNotes.en: The range summarizes fifteenth-century flourishing and political transition; it does not date the Inca conquest to 1500.

title.zh: 廷巴克图学术网络兴盛

summary.zh: 十五世纪，廷巴克图的清真寺、经学校和学者网络逐渐形成西非重要的知识中心。桑科雷、津加雷贝尔和西迪叶海亚等宗教建筑与城市生活相联系，教学与伊斯兰文化传播吸引更广区域的人群。沙漠边缘的城市由此兼具宗教、教育和交流功能，并在随后一个世纪继续繁荣。
summary.en: In the fifteenth century, Timbuktu's mosques, Quranic schools and scholarly networks developed into a major West African centre of learning. Institutions associated with Sankore, Djingareyber and Sidi Yahia connected teaching and religious practice with urban life. The city at the edge of the Sahara drew people into wider networks of knowledge and exchange, continuing to flourish in the following century.

significance.zh: 廷巴克图说明撒哈拉以南非洲拥有活跃而持久的书面学术传统。
significance.en: Timbuktu demonstrates the enduring importance of written scholarship and intellectual exchange in sub-Saharan Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：廷巴克图

title.zh: 郑和船队的远航

summary.zh: 1405至1433年，郑和等人率明朝船队多次远航，联系东南亚、南亚、阿拉伯半岛和东非港口。使团进行外交、礼物交换与贸易，也在部分地区使用武力。庞大的航行依靠既有港口网络和多种航海知识，使明朝宫廷与印度洋沿岸社会之间建立了更密切的联系。
summary.en: Between 1405 and 1433, fleets led by Zheng He and others connected the Ming court with ports in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Arabia and eastern Africa. Their missions combined diplomacy, gift exchange and trade with episodes of military intervention. Large-scale voyages drew on established ports and varied maritime knowledge, strengthening connections between the court and Indian Ocean societies.

significance.zh: 展示国家赞助远航与印度洋既有网络相互作用的规模。
significance.en: Demonstrates the scale of interaction between state-sponsored voyages and established Indian Ocean networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Voyages of Zheng He’s fleets

title.zh: 阿兹特克三邦同盟的形成
title.en: Formation of the Aztec Triple Alliance

summary.zh: 1428年，特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科与特拉科潘的统治者联合击败阿斯卡波察尔科的霸权，组成通常称为阿兹特克的三邦同盟。同盟通过贡赋、军事扩张与联姻控制墨西哥谷地及周边地区，贡赋清单记录布匹、粮食、羽毛与金属制品。三邦各自保留内政，外交与战争则多共同行动。
summary.en: In 1428 the rulers of Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan combined to defeat the hegemony of Azcapotzalco, forming the alliance commonly called the Aztec empire. Through tribute, military expansion and marriage the three cities dominated the Basin of Mexico and beyond; tribute rolls record cloth, food, feathers and metalwork. Each city kept its own internal government.

significance.zh: 三邦同盟的建立是阿兹特克扩张与贡赋体系的起点。
significance.en: The Triple Alliance marks the starting point of Aztec expansion and its tribute system.

sources.title: British Museum — The Aztecs: educational resource

editorialNotes.zh: 1428年为通常采用的结盟年份；三个城市的内政保持独立，“帝国”是后世概括的说法。
editorialNotes.en: 1428 is the conventional date of the alliance; the three cities retained separate internal government, and 'empire' is a later summary term.

title.zh: 兀鲁伯天文团队编成星表
title.en: Ulugh Beg's team compiles a star catalogue

summary.zh: 1437年，撒马尔罕天文团队汇集长期观测和计算成果，编成与兀鲁伯相关的天文表。学者利用大型观测仪器研究恒星、太阳与行星运动，并改进历法和三角计算。成果来自兀鲁伯、卡西、卡迪扎德等人的合作，显示宫廷赞助如何支持持续研究，也为后来的天文学提供重要数据。
summary.en: In 1437, Samarkand's astronomical team brought sustained observation and calculation together in the tables associated with Ulugh Beg. Scholars used large instruments to study stars, the Sun and planets, while refining calendrical and trigonometric work. Contributions by Ulugh Beg, al-Kashi, Qadi Zada and their colleagues show how court patronage supported collective research and produced data influential in later astronomy.

significance.zh: 撒马尔罕的成果体现了前望远镜时代精密观测与团队研究的水平。
significance.en: Samarkand's work demonstrates sophisticated observation and collaborative research before telescopes.

sources.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学MacTutor数学史：Ulugh Beg

title.zh: 印加帝国的扩张

summary.zh: 十五世纪，帕查库蒂时期的印加从库斯科向外扩张，通过征服、联盟、道路与劳动征发组织广阔地区。仓储和交通设施连接不同生态区，地方社群被纳入新的资源与行政安排。帝国建设带来基础设施和交换，也伴随强制迁移与反抗，使安第斯政治生活发生深刻变化。
summary.en: In the fifteenth century, the Inca expanded from Cusco under Pachacuti through conquest, alliances, roads and organised labour obligations. Storage and transport connected different ecological zones, bringing local communities into new administrative and resource arrangements. Imperial construction created infrastructure and exchange while also producing forced relocation and resistance, profoundly changing political life across the Andes.

significance.zh: 建立了安第斯地区大范围的交通、资源和行政联系。
significance.en: Established extensive connections for transport, resources and administration across the Andes.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Expansion of the Inca Empire

editorialNotes.zh: 1438—1471年采用帕查库蒂统治的传统年表，主要依赖后期记载，精确年份仍有争议。
editorialNotes.en: 1438–1471 follows the traditional chronology of Pachacuti’s reign, based largely on later accounts; precise dates remain disputed.

title.zh: 埃乌阿雷时期的贝宁王国

summary.zh: 十五世纪中叶，奥巴埃乌阿雷加强贝宁王国的王权，推动首都和宫廷秩序的发展。王室礼仪与工匠组织相互联系，象牙、金属和其他材料被用于表现祖先、权威与历史记忆。地方生产及贸易网络为政治中心提供资源，形成后来贝宁艺术与制度传统的重要基础。
summary.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Oba Ewuare strengthened kingship in Benin and developed the capital and courtly order. Royal ritual and organised craft production were closely connected, with ivory, metal and other materials expressing ancestry, authority and historical memory. Local production and trading networks supplied the political centre and helped establish foundations for later Benin artistic and institutional traditions.

significance.zh: 强化了贝宁王权与专业工艺相互支撑的传统。
significance.en: Strengthened traditions linking Benin kingship with specialised artistic production.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Benin under Oba Ewuare

editorialNotes.zh: 1440—1473年为埃乌阿雷在位的传统年表，具体改革细节部分依赖后世口述与王室记忆。
editorialNotes.en: 1440–1473 is the traditional chronology of Ewuare’s reign; details of reforms partly depend on later oral accounts and royal memory.

title.zh: 谷登堡与欧洲活字印刷

summary.zh: 十五世纪中叶，谷登堡及其合作者在美因茨结合金属活字、油墨和印压技术，形成可以持续生产书籍的工艺体系。《圣经》的印制展现了排版与制作能力，随后印刷作坊在欧洲城市传播。书籍复制速度和规模的变化，逐渐重塑知识交流、教育、商业与宗教传播。
summary.en: In mid-fifteenth-century Mainz, Gutenberg and his collaborators combined metal type, suitable ink and press technology into a system for producing books. The printing of the Bible demonstrated its typographic and manufacturing capabilities, and workshops subsequently spread through European cities. Changes in the scale and speed of reproduction gradually reshaped education, commerce, religious communication and the exchange of knowledge.

significance.zh: 推动欧洲书籍生产和知识传播方式发生长期变化。
significance.en: Drove long-term changes in European book production and the transmission of knowledge.

sources.title: www.gutenberg.de — Gutenberg and European movable-type printing

editorialNotes.zh: 东亚已有更早的雕版和活字印刷传统；本条关注谷登堡在欧洲形成的具体技术组合与生产体系。
editorialNotes.en: East Asia had earlier woodblock and movable-type traditions; this entry concerns Gutenberg’s specific combination of techniques and production system in Europe.

title.zh: 卡米成为托尔瓦王朝中心
title.en: Khami becomes a centre of the Torwa dynasty

summary.zh: 十五世纪中叶以后，卡米在大津巴布韦衰落后的区域重组中兴起，成为托尔瓦王朝的重要中心。工匠以干砌石墙支撑高台，用人字形和棋盘状纹样装饰墙面，统治者居所与居民区呈现出社会层次。来自远方的器物说明，这一内陆城市仍参与了跨区域的贸易联系。
summary.en: After the mid-fifteenth century, Khami emerged during the regional reorganization following Great Zimbabwe's decline and became a centre of the Torwa dynasty. Builders used decorated dry-stone retaining walls to support raised platforms, with chiefly residences and surrounding settlement expressing social distinctions. Imported objects demonstrate that this inland urban centre remained connected with long-distance trading networks.

significance.zh: 卡米延续并发展了津巴布韦地区的石城建筑和政治组织传统。
significance.en: Khami continued and transformed regional traditions of stone architecture and political organization.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：卡米遗址国家纪念地

title.zh: 奥斯曼军攻取君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 1453年，穆罕默德二世率奥斯曼军队攻取君士坦丁堡，结束拜占庭帝国在这座城市的统治。围城与陷落造成杀戮、俘虏和人口流离，随后统治者推动迁入、修建与行政调整。城市成为奥斯曼帝国的重要中心，东地中海的军事、政治和商业关系由此重新组织。
summary.en: In 1453, Mehmed II’s Ottoman forces captured Constantinople, ending Byzantine imperial rule in the city. Siege and conquest brought killing, captivity and displacement, followed by immigration, rebuilding and administrative change. The city became a major Ottoman imperial centre, and military, political and commercial relationships across the eastern Mediterranean were reorganised around the new order.

significance.zh: 重塑东地中海权力格局，并开启城市的奥斯曼帝国时期。
significance.en: Reshaped eastern Mediterranean power and began the city’s Ottoman imperial era.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Ottoman conquest of Constantinople

title.zh: 哥伦布航行抵达加勒比

summary.zh: 1492年，哥伦布船队横渡大西洋，抵达已有原住民社会生活的加勒比岛屿。此后日益持续的跨洋联系改变了欧洲、美洲和非洲之间的交流，作物、人口与知识随之流动。殖民征服、奴役和疾病传播也给当地社群带来灾难性冲击，使这一航行成为影响极不均衡的全球历史转折。
summary.en: In 1492, Columbus’s fleet crossed the Atlantic and reached Caribbean islands inhabited by Indigenous societies. Increasingly sustained transatlantic connections subsequently moved crops, people and knowledge among the Americas, Europe and Africa. Colonial conquest, enslavement and disease inflicted devastating losses on local communities, making the voyage a global turning point with profoundly unequal consequences.

significance.zh: 开启持续跨大西洋联系，并推动了破坏深重的殖民扩张。
significance.en: Opened sustained transatlantic connections and helped initiate deeply destructive colonial expansion.

sources.title: Library of Congress — 1492: An Ongoing Voyage

editorialNotes.zh: 最初登陆岛屿的确切识别仍有争论。
editorialNotes.en: The precise identification of the first landing island remains debated.

title.zh: 格拉纳达陷落与宗教政策转向
title.en: Fall of Granada and changing religious policy

summary.zh: 1492年，格拉纳达纳斯里王朝向卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡君主投降，伊比利亚最后一个穆斯林王国结束。同年，犹太人被要求改宗或离境，穆斯林社群后来也面临越来越强的宗教压力。王权扩展与宗教政策转向共同改变了地方生活，造成迁徙、财产损失和新的离散社群。
summary.en: In 1492, Granada’s Nasrid rulers surrendered to the monarchs of Castile and Aragon, ending the peninsula’s last Muslim kingdom. Jews were ordered to convert or leave that same year, and Muslim communities later faced increasing religious pressure. Expanding royal authority and changing religious policies transformed local life, bringing migration, losses of property and new diasporic communities.

significance.zh: 标志伊比利亚政治与宗教秩序的重大转折。
significance.en: Marked a major turning point in Iberian political and religious order.

sources.title: www.alhambra-patronato.es — Fall of Granada and changing religious policy
Center for Online Judaic Studies — Edict of the Expulsion of the Jews from Spain, 1492 (primary text translation)

title.zh: 《托尔德西里亚斯条约》

summary.zh: 1494年，卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙签订《托尔德西里亚斯条约》，以大西洋上的经线协调各自的海外扩张主张。两国试图通过外交减少竞争，并为后续远航和殖民提供依据。被划入主张范围的原住民社会没有参与谈判，其既有政治秩序与欧洲王室提出的权利之间，日后产生了长期冲突。
summary.en: In 1494, Castile and Portugal signed the Treaty of Tordesillas, using an Atlantic meridian to coordinate overseas claims. Diplomacy sought to reduce rivalry and provide a framework for later voyages and colonisation. Indigenous societies within the claimed regions had no part in the negotiations, and conflicts between their established political orders and European royal claims continued for centuries.

significance.zh: 为欧洲殖民竞争建立外交框架，也凸显其与当地社会的冲突。
significance.en: Created a diplomatic framework for European colonial competition and exposed its conflict with local societies.

sources.title: www.unesco.org — The Treaty of Tordesillas

title.zh: 阿斯基亚陵营建
title.en: Construction of the Tomb of Askia

summary.zh: 十五世纪末，桑海统治者阿斯基亚·穆罕默德在加奥营建大型土筑陵墓建筑群。高耸的塔体、礼拜空间与集会场所把政治权威和伊斯兰信仰结合起来，其土木工艺适应了萨赫勒环境。建筑见证了桑海在黄金与盐贸易网络中的地位，也成为当地持续使用的宗教和公共空间。
summary.en: In the late fifteenth century, the Songhai ruler Askia Muhammad commissioned a monumental earthen complex at Gao. Its tall central structure, prayer areas and assembly space brought political authority and Islamic worship together through construction suited to the Sahelian environment. The monument reflects Songhai's place in gold and salt trading networks and continued to function as a religious and communal site.

significance.zh: 该建筑将桑海国家权力、萨赫勒土筑技术与跨撒哈拉贸易联系起来。
significance.en: The monument connects Songhai authority, Sahelian earthen architecture and trans-Saharan exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：阿斯基亚陵

editorialNotes.zh: 1495年采用UNESCO遗产条目的纪年；本条不沿用该页面对朝觐先后关系的简化叙述。
editorialNotes.en: The date 1495 follows the UNESCO entry; its simplified account of the sequence involving Askia's pilgrimage is not adopted.

title.zh: 达·伽马抵达卡利卡特

summary.zh: 1498年，达·伽马船队绕过非洲抵达卡利卡特，建立葡萄牙往返欧洲与印度洋的海路联系。航行借助区域航海知识，进入由南亚、阿拉伯和非洲商人长期经营的繁荣贸易世界。后续葡萄牙活动将商业与武力结合，逐渐改变部分港口和航线上的权力关系。
summary.en: In 1498, Vasco da Gama’s fleet reached Calicut after rounding Africa, establishing a Portuguese sea connection between Europe and the Indian Ocean. The voyage drew on regional maritime knowledge and entered a flourishing commercial world long sustained by South Asian, Arabian and African merchants. Later Portuguese activity combined commerce with force, gradually changing power at some ports and along particular routes.

significance.zh: 使葡萄牙海上力量更直接地介入印度洋商业网络。
significance.en: Enabled Portuguese maritime power to intervene more directly in Indian Ocean commercial networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut

title.zh: 卡布拉尔船队抵达巴西

summary.zh: 卡布拉尔率葡萄牙船队前往印度途中抵达今巴西海岸，并以王室名义提出领土主张。船员与当地原住民的接触，把这片大陆纳入葡萄牙跨洋活动的视野。此后几十年，沿岸贸易逐渐转向殖民定居与甘蔗种植，原住民社会也经历土地侵占、疾病传播和强迫劳动带来的剧变。
summary.en: Pedro Álvares Cabral reached the coast of present-day Brazil while leading a Portuguese expedition toward India. Encounters with Indigenous communities brought the region into Portugal's expanding oceanic networks. Over subsequent decades, coastal commerce developed into settlement and sugar cultivation, while land seizure, epidemic disease and forced labour transformed the societies already living there.

significance.zh: 这次抵达成为葡萄牙美洲殖民扩张和大西洋经济形成的重要节点。
significance.en: The landing became a turning point in Portuguese colonization and the formation of an Atlantic economy.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Cabral reaches Brazil

title.zh: 十六世纪奥斯曼宫廷与帝国文化
title.en: The sixteenth-century Ottoman court and imperial culture

summary.zh: 十六世纪，奥斯曼帝国以伊斯坦布尔为中心整合巴尔干、安纳托利亚、阿拉伯地区与北非。宫廷工坊为苏丹和高级官员制作瓷器、织物、地毯、金属器与细密画，把帖木儿、波斯与地中海传统熔合为可辨识的宫廷风格。行会与市场供应城市日常所需，帝国的视觉语言也随行政与贸易网络传播到各行省。
summary.en: In the sixteenth century the Ottoman empire, centred on Istanbul, governed the Balkans, Anatolia, the Arab lands and North Africa. Court workshops produced ceramics, textiles, carpets, metalwork and miniature painting for the sultan and officials, fusing Timurid, Persian and Mediterranean traditions into a recognisable court style. Guilds and markets supplied daily urban needs.

significance.zh: 奥斯曼宫廷艺术体现了帝国行政、贸易与多元传统的结合。
significance.en: Ottoman court art embodies the combination of imperial administration, trade and diverse traditions.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Ottomans before 1600

editorialNotes.zh: 来源关注1600年以前的宫廷艺术，本条不据此描述帝国全部制度，也不把宫廷风格等同于各行省的日常器物。
editorialNotes.en: The source concerns court art before 1600; this entry does not describe the empire's whole institutional order or equate court style with provincial everyday objects.

title.zh: 十六至十七世纪明代瓷器与全球贸易
title.en: Ming porcelain and global trade in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries

summary.zh: 十六世纪起，景德镇等窑场烧造的青花瓷沿多条海路进入东南亚、西亚、东非与欧洲市场。白银流入与海外需求推动窑场扩大生产，商人与船主把瓷器、丝和香料编入跨洋贸易网络，欧洲与西亚的订制纹样也反馈到中国窑场。明代后期的战乱与海禁变化使部分航线中断，瓷器已成为早期全球贸易的标志商品。
summary.en: From the sixteenth century, blue-and-white porcelain from Jingdezhen and other kilns reached Southeast Asian, West Asian, East African and European markets by several sea routes. Inflowing silver and overseas demand encouraged larger production, while merchants wove porcelain, silk and spices into transoceanic networks. Foreign orders and motifs also reached Chinese kilns.

significance.zh: 瓷器贸易说明明代中国经济已深度参与早期全球商品流动。
significance.en: The porcelain trade shows how deeply the Ming economy was involved in early global commodity flows.

sources.title: Smithsonian Libraries — Ming: porcelain for a globalised trade

editorialNotes.zh: 条目以十六至十七世纪为范围，不把某一年的贸易量当作全程水平；景德镇为代表性产地而非唯一窑口。
editorialNotes.en: The range covers the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries; no single year's volume stands for the whole period, and Jingdezhen is a representative rather than the only production centre.

title.zh: 萨法维丝织与宫廷赞助
title.en: Safavid silk textiles and court patronage

summary.zh: 萨法维王朝时期，宫廷工坊与城市作坊生产大量丝织品，用于赏赐、外交与出口。伊斯法罕等地的织工以金线、银线和复杂花纹制作袍服与壁毯，丝绸贸易为王朝提供重要收入，并连接欧洲、奥斯曼与印度市场。十八世纪初的政治动荡与贸易路线变化使生产规模下降。
summary.en: Under the Safavid dynasty, court and urban workshops produced large quantities of silk textiles for gifts, diplomacy and export. Weavers in Isfahan and other cities used gold and silver thread and complex patterns for robes and hangings, and the silk trade provided major revenue while linking European, Ottoman and Indian markets. Political upheaval later reduced output.

significance.zh: 丝织业把萨法维宫廷的消费、外交与跨区域市场连接在一起。
significance.en: Silk production linked Safavid court consumption and diplomacy with transregional markets.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Persian Silks (exhibition)
Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 1500—1722为王朝概括范围，丝织生产的盛期与地区分布并不均衡，本条不作产量估计。
editorialNotes.en: 1500–1722 is the dynasty's overall range; silk production peaked unevenly across regions, and no output figures are given.

title.zh: 萨法维王朝建立

summary.zh: 伊斯玛仪一世在大不里士称沙阿，建立萨法维王朝，并将十二伊玛目派什叶派确立为国家宗教。王朝随后整合伊朗高原的领地，通过宫廷、军队和宗教机构巩固权力。长期的宗教转变改变了地方社会，也使伊朗同奥斯曼帝国和中亚乌兹别克政权的竞争获得鲜明的教派色彩。
summary.en: Ismail I proclaimed himself shah at Tabriz, founded the Safavid dynasty and made Twelver Shiism the state religion. The dynasty expanded across the Iranian plateau and consolidated power through its court, army and religious institutions. A prolonged, often coercive religious transformation reshaped local society and gave Iran's rivalry with Ottoman and Uzbek neighbours a strong sectarian dimension.

significance.zh: 萨法维统治为近世伊朗的政治整合与宗教认同留下深远遗产。
significance.en: Safavid rule left a lasting legacy of political integration and religious identity in Iran.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

title.zh: 莫桑比克岛成为葡萄牙印度洋据点
title.en: Mozambique Island becomes a Portuguese oceanic base

summary.zh: 葡萄牙在莫桑比克岛建立据点，把原有的斯瓦希里海岸贸易节点纳入通往印度的海上网络。岛上的港口、仓储、要塞和行政机构逐渐发展，非洲、阿拉伯、印度与欧洲的商人、技术和文化在此交汇。港口繁荣同殖民控制、奴隶贸易和军事竞争交织，深刻改变了东非沿海的经济与城市空间。
summary.en: Portugal established a base on Mozambique Island, incorporating an existing Swahili coastal trading centre into its route to India. Ports, warehouses, fortifications and administration developed amid exchanges among African, Arab, Indian and European communities. Commercial activity was intertwined with colonial control, slave trading and military competition, reshaping the economy and urban landscape of coastal East Africa.

significance.zh: 莫桑比克岛展示了东非港口如何连接并参与近世印度洋的跨区域变迁。
significance.en: The island shows how East African ports connected with and shaped early modern Indian Ocean networks.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Island of Mozambique

title.zh: 马六甲陷落与葡萄牙海上据点
title.en: The fall of Melaka and the Portuguese maritime base

summary.zh: 1511年，葡萄牙舰队攻占马六甲，控制了这个连接印度洋与南海的港口国家。此前马六甲依靠季风航线、税收与多语商人群体成为区域贸易中心；陷落后葡萄牙修筑要塞并试图维持香料与航运垄断，但亚齐、柔佛等政权的竞争使贸易分流。东南亚港口格局由此进入欧洲势力与本地政权并存的新阶段。
summary.en: In 1511 a Portuguese fleet captured Melaka, taking over the port polity that linked the Indian Ocean with the South China Sea. The city had prospered on monsoon shipping, tolls and a multilingual merchant community. Portugal built a fortress and sought to control spices and shipping, but competition from Aceh, Johor and others diverted trade.

significance.zh: 马六甲的陷落改变了东南亚海上势力的分布与贸易路线。
significance.en: The fall of Melaka changed the distribution of maritime power and trade routes in Southeast Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca

editorialNotes.zh: 1511年为攻占之年；葡萄牙对香料与航线的实际控制始终有限，不能表述为垄断整个海域。
editorialNotes.en: 1511 is the year of the conquest; Portuguese control of spices and routes was always partial and is not described as a monopoly of the sea.

title.zh: 路德与宗教改革的开端

summary.zh: 马丁·路德围绕赎罪券提出论题，质疑教会实践与救赎观念之间的关系。争论经印刷品和讲道迅速传播，逐渐扩大为对教皇权威、圣经解释和教会制度的挑战。诸侯、城市和普通信徒各有诉求，改革由此形成多个教派，并与欧洲国家建设、教育改革和社会冲突交织。
summary.en: Martin Luther's arguments against indulgences challenged the relationship between church practice and salvation. Pamphlets and preaching spread the controversy, broadening it into disputes over papal authority, biblical interpretation and church institutions. Princes, towns and believers pursued different aims, producing several Protestant traditions and connecting religious change with education, state formation and social conflict.

significance.zh: 宗教改革打破了西欧拉丁基督教世界原有的教会统一。
significance.en: The Reformation fractured the institutional unity of Latin Christianity in western Europe.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Luther and the Protestant Reformation
Deutschlandmuseum — Martin Luther’s 95 theses

editorialNotes.zh: 路德在1517年提出并传播《九十五条论纲》有文献依据；是否于10月31日将论纲钉在维滕贝格教堂门上，仍有史学争论。
editorialNotes.en: Luther’s circulation of the Ninety-five Theses in 1517 is documented; whether he nailed them to the church door at Wittenberg on 31 October remains debated.

title.zh: 麦哲伦—埃尔卡诺环球航行

summary.zh: 西班牙资助的船队在麦哲伦率领下出航，穿过南美洲南端海峡，随后横渡太平洋。麦哲伦在菲律宾的冲突中身亡，埃尔卡诺继续率维多利亚号经印度洋和非洲南端返回西班牙。幸存者完成首次环球航行，航程中的饥饿、暴力和高死亡率也显露出早期远洋扩张的代价。
summary.en: A Spanish-funded fleet under Ferdinand Magellan crossed the strait at South America's southern tip and sailed across the Pacific. After Magellan died in a conflict in the Philippines, Juan Sebastián Elcano brought the Victoria home through the Indian Ocean and around southern Africa. Survivors completed the first circumnavigation after enduring hunger, violence and devastating losses.

significance.zh: 环球航行把原本分离的海洋航路连接起来，拓展了全球地理认识。
significance.en: Circumnavigation linked separate ocean routes and expanded practical knowledge of the globe.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation

title.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰陷落

summary.zh: 科尔特斯率领的西班牙军队与特拉斯卡拉等原住民盟军围攻特诺奇蒂特兰。地方政治矛盾为联军提供兵力与补给，天花、饥饿和持续战斗则削弱了墨西加首都的抵抗。城市陷落后，征服者在废墟上重建殖民中心，新西班牙的统治机构逐步形成，各地原住民仍持续抵抗与协商。
summary.en: Spanish troops led by Hernán Cortés and Indigenous allies, including Tlaxcalans, besieged Tenochtitlan. Regional rivalries supplied the coalition with soldiers and provisions, while smallpox, hunger and combat weakened the Mexica capital. After its fall, colonizers rebuilt an administrative centre on its ruins, and New Spain developed through further conquest, resistance and negotiation.

significance.zh: 墨西加帝国中心的覆灭重组了中部美洲的权力与社会秩序。
significance.en: The destruction of the Mexica imperial centre reorganized power and society in central Mesoamerica.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Fall of Tenochtitlan

title.zh: 巴布尔建立莫卧儿统治

summary.zh: 巴布尔在第一次帕尼帕特战役中击败德里苏丹易卜拉欣·洛迪，随后取得德里与阿格拉。火器运用、战场部署和地方联盟帮助他建立莫卧儿统治的基础。新王朝经历早期战争与短暂中断后，在阿克巴等后继者统治下扩大疆域，发展出影响南亚甚深的财政、行政和宫廷文化。
summary.en: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at the First Battle of Panipat and captured Delhi and Agra. Firearms, battlefield organization and regional alliances helped establish the foundations of Mughal rule. After early wars and an interruption of dynastic power, successors such as Akbar expanded the empire and developed influential systems of taxation, administration and court culture.

significance.zh: 莫卧儿王朝逐渐成为南亚政治整合、商业与艺术发展的重要力量。
significance.en: The Mughal dynasty became a major force in South Asian political integration, commerce and the arts.

sources.title: Panipat District Government — First Battle of Panipat, 1526

title.zh: 卡哈马卡事件与印加征服
title.en: Cajamarca and the conquest of the Incas

summary.zh: 皮萨罗率领的西班牙人利用会面机会，在卡哈马卡俘获印加统治者阿塔瓦尔帕。此前的内战和疫病已削弱帝国，地方势力之间的竞争又帮助入侵者扩大控制。阿塔瓦尔帕后来被处死，西班牙殖民政权逐渐接管安第斯地区，而印加残余政权与原住民抵抗仍延续多年。
summary.en: Francisco Pizarro's forces seized the Inca ruler Atahualpa during a meeting at Cajamarca. Civil war and epidemic disease had weakened the empire, and rivalries among local groups helped the invaders extend control. Atahualpa was later executed, while Spanish colonial administration spread through the Andes amid continuing Inca and Indigenous resistance.

significance.zh: 统治者被俘使印加政治体系陷入危机，加速了安第斯殖民秩序的形成。
significance.en: The ruler's capture destabilized Inca government and accelerated the formation of colonial rule in the Andes.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Cajamarca and the conquest of the Incas

title.zh: 哥白尼发表日心体系

summary.zh: 哥白尼的《天体运行论》在其去世之年出版，将太阳置于行星体系的中心，并把地球的自转和公转纳入数学解释。书中仍沿用圆周运动等传统假设，却重新安排了天体之间的关系。这个模型为后来的观测、计算与争论提供起点，开普勒和伽利略等人进一步改造了人们理解天空的方式。
summary.en: Copernicus's On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres appeared in the year of his death. It placed the Sun at the centre of the planetary system and incorporated Earth's rotation and orbital motion into a mathematical account. Although it retained traditional circular motions, the model reorganized astronomy and opened questions later pursued by Kepler, Galileo and others.

significance.zh: 日心体系开启了近代天文学重新解释地球位置与天体运动的进程。
significance.en: Heliocentrism opened a sustained rethinking of Earth's position and the motions of celestial bodies.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Copernicus publishes the heliocentric model

title.zh: 波托西银矿开发
title.en: Development of the Potosí silver mines

summary.zh: 西班牙殖民者开始开发波托西的富银矿山，矿业城市迅速成长为安第斯经济中心。开采、冶炼和运输依靠原住民劳动力，殖民时期的强制轮役制度带来沉重负担。白银通过欧洲和太平洋航路流入全球市场，连接美洲矿区、亚洲商品需求与欧洲帝国财政，也留下污染与社会创伤。
summary.en: Spanish colonizers began exploiting the rich silver deposits at Potosí, which grew into a major Andean mining city. Indigenous labour sustained extraction, refining and transport, while colonial forced-service arrangements imposed severe burdens. Silver circulated through European and Pacific routes, linking American mines with Asian markets and imperial finance, alongside lasting environmental damage and social suffering.

significance.zh: 波托西白银成为近世全球贸易的重要媒介，其生产建立在严酷的劳动体系之上。
significance.en: Potosí silver became a major medium of global exchange through a harsh colonial labour system.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — City of Potosí

title.zh: 特伦托大公会议

summary.zh: 天主教会在特伦托召开大公会议，分阶段回应宗教改革造成的教义与制度危机。会议重申圣事、传统和教会权威，规范神职人员教育与纪律，并推动建立修院。其决议通过主教、修会、传教和艺术逐步落实，塑造了此后数百年的天主教生活，也加深了欧洲各教派之间的界线。
summary.en: The Catholic Church convened the Council of Trent in successive sessions to address doctrinal and institutional challenges raised by the Reformation. It reaffirmed sacraments, tradition and ecclesiastical authority while reforming clerical education and discipline. Bishops, religious orders, missions and the arts carried its decisions into practice, shaping Catholic life and sharpening confessional divisions.

significance.zh: 会议为天主教内部改革及其全球传播确立了持久的制度框架。
significance.en: The council established an enduring framework for Catholic reform and worldwide expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Council of Trent

title.zh: 阿克巴时期的帝国整合与宫廷文化
title.en: Imperial consolidation and court culture under Akbar

summary.zh: 1556年阿克巴继位后，莫卧儿帝国通过军事征服、联姻与行政改革把北印度和德干部分地区纳入统治。皇帝在法泰赫普尔西克里与拉合尔等地的宫廷中集合波斯、印度与中亚的工匠、画家和学者，推行翻译与宗教辩论。这种整合扩大了帝国的税基，也留下了多语言、多宗教的宫廷文化。
summary.en: After Akbar acceded in 1556, the Mughal empire incorporated much of northern India and parts of the Deccan through conquest, marriage alliances and administrative reform. At courts in Fatehpur Sikri and Lahore he gathered Persian, Indian and Central Asian craftsmen, painters and scholars, encouraging translation and religious debate. This widened the revenue base and produced a multilingual court culture.

significance.zh: 阿克巴时期奠定了莫卧儿帝国行政与文化整合的基本模式。
significance.en: Akbar's reign established the basic pattern of Mughal administrative and cultural consolidation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Mughals before 1600

editorialNotes.zh: 1556—1605为阿克巴在位期；艺术史来源侧重宫廷赞助与绘画，不能覆盖帝国全部税制与地方行政。
editorialNotes.en: 1556–1605 is Akbar's reign; the art-historical source emphasises court patronage and painting and does not cover the whole revenue or local administration.

title.zh: 胡马雍陵与莫卧儿纪念建筑
title.en: Humayun's Tomb and Mughal commemorative architecture

summary.zh: 十六世纪六十年代，莫卧儿宫廷在德里为皇帝胡马雍营建陵墓，约1570年完成。陵园采用四分花园、水渠与居中穹顶的布局，由波斯与印度工匠共同建造，成为此后莫卧儿陵墓建筑的重要参照，也影响了泰姬陵一类纪念性建筑的空间组织。陵园在后世经历修缮与再利用。
summary.en: In the 1560s the Mughal court built a tomb for the emperor Humayun in Delhi, completed around 1570. Its charbagh garden, water channels and central dome were made by Persian and Indian craftsmen and became an important reference for later Mughal tombs, shaping the spatial organisation of monuments such as the Taj Mahal.

significance.zh: 胡马雍陵把波斯园林传统转化为莫卧儿纪念建筑的基本范式。
significance.en: Humayun's Tomb turned Persian garden traditions into a basic model for Mughal commemorative architecture.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Humayun's Tomb, Delhi

editorialNotes.zh: 来源以1560年代与约1570年概括建造与完成时间，本条沿用该概括，不指定动工的具体日期。
editorialNotes.en: The source summarises construction in the 1560s and completion around 1570; this entry follows that summary without assigning a precise start date.

title.zh: 马尼拉大帆船贸易

summary.zh: 西班牙航海者找到从菲律宾横渡太平洋返回美洲的可行航路，随后发展出连接马尼拉与阿卡普尔科的大帆船贸易。中国丝绸、瓷器等亚洲商品与美洲白银在这一网络中交换，商人、船员和移民也跨海流动。马尼拉逐渐成为亚洲区域贸易与西班牙殖民世界相交的港口。
summary.en: Spanish navigators established a practicable Pacific return route from the Philippines to the Americas, enabling the Manila–Acapulco galleon trade. Asian goods, including Chinese silk and porcelain, were exchanged for American silver, while merchants, sailors and migrants crossed the ocean. Manila became a meeting point between Asian commercial networks and the Spanish colonial world.

significance.zh: 太平洋贸易把亚洲生产、美洲白银与欧洲殖民网络更紧密地联系起来。
significance.en: Pacific commerce connected Asian production, American silver and European colonial networks more closely.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Manila galleon trade

title.zh: 摩洛哥入侵与桑海帝国衰落

summary.zh: 摩洛哥军队跨越撒哈拉沙漠，在通迪比击败桑海军队，随后进入尼日尔河沿岸的重要城市。远征依赖火器和精锐兵力，却难以在遥远的苏丹地区维持稳定控制。桑海中央权力瓦解后，地方政权重新组合，跨撒哈拉贸易、城市学术生活和区域政治关系都受到战争与长期动荡的冲击。
summary.en: A Moroccan army crossed the Sahara and defeated Songhai forces at Tondibi before occupying important Niger River towns. Firearms and experienced troops helped the expedition, but sustained control across such distances proved difficult. Songhai's central authority fragmented, local powers reorganized, and warfare disrupted trans-Saharan commerce, urban scholarship and regional political relationships.

significance.zh: 桑海的衰落改变了西非萨赫勒地区长期形成的政治与贸易格局。
significance.en: Songhai's decline transformed established political and commercial relationships across the western Sahel.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Moroccan invasion and Songhai’s decline

title.zh: 马尼拉刊印《基督教教义》
title.en: Doctrina Christiana is printed in Manila

summary.zh: 马尼拉刊印西班牙文与他加禄文《基督教教义》，以木版印刷传播宗教知识。他加禄语同时使用拉丁字母和本地文字，保留早期语言与书写传统的珍贵记录。书籍把传教、翻译和印刷技术结合起来，也反映殖民社会中本地读者、亚洲工艺和欧洲宗教机构之间的文化接触。
summary.en: A Spanish and Tagalog Doctrina Christiana was printed from woodblocks in Manila. Tagalog appeared in both Roman letters and a local script, preserving valuable evidence of early language and writing. The book joined missionary teaching, translation and printing and reflected cultural encounters among local readers, Asian technologies and European religious institutions.

significance.zh: 早期印本为研究菲律宾语言、文字与殖民时期知识传播留下重要实物。
significance.en: The early printed book preserves important evidence of Philippine writing and colonial knowledge transmission.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Doctrina Christiana, 1593

title.zh: 阿巴斯一世与伊斯法罕

summary.zh: 十六世纪九十年代，萨法维沙阿阿巴斯一世把都城从加兹温迁到伊斯法罕，围绕皇家广场营建清真寺、巴扎、宫殿与桥梁，并把新城区设为瓦克夫地产以支持宗教与公共设施。迁都使政治中心远离奥斯曼前线，同时加强了与印度洋和欧洲贸易的联系。伊斯法罕由此成为十七世纪西亚最大的城市之一。
summary.en: In the 1590s Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital from Qazvin to Isfahan, laying out mosques, bazaars, palaces and bridges around a royal square and endowing the new centre as waqf property. The move placed the court farther from the Ottoman frontier and strengthened links with Indian Ocean and European trade. Isfahan became one of the largest cities of seventeenth-century West Asia.

significance.zh: 伊斯法罕的营建把萨法维的政治、宗教与商业权力集中于新的都城。
significance.en: The building of Isfahan concentrated Safavid political, religious and commercial power in a new capital.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 迁都时间来源记为十六世纪九十年代；本条不把某一年的工程视为城市全部建成，也不采用缺乏依据的人口数字。
editorialNotes.en: The source places the transfer in the 1590s; no single year's works are treated as completion of the city, and no unsupported population figures are used.

title.zh: 英国东印度公司获特许状
title.en: Charter of the English East India Company

summary.zh: 伊丽莎白一世向英国东印度公司颁发特许状，授权其经营与亚洲的贸易。公司起初通过商站、航运和同当地统治者谈判参与印度洋商业，后来逐渐拥有军队与征税权。商业组织、国家支持和武装扩张相互结合，使公司在十八世纪由贸易参与者转变为南亚重要的领土统治者。
summary.en: Elizabeth I granted a charter to the English East India Company for Asian trade. The company initially entered Indian Ocean commerce through trading posts, shipping and agreements with local rulers. State support and armed expansion later accompanied its commercial activities, and during the eighteenth century it acquired armies, revenue powers and extensive territorial authority in South Asia.

significance.zh: 特许公司成为欧洲商业资本与海外政治扩张结合的重要制度。
significance.en: The chartered company became a powerful institution linking European commerce with overseas political expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Charter of the English East India Company

title.zh: 曼加斯与罗伊·马塔的酋长权威
title.en: Mangaas and the chiefly authority of Roi Mata

summary.zh: 十七世纪初，瓦努阿图中部岛屿的酋长罗伊·马塔以曼加斯一带的居所与仪式空间行使权威。当地社会依靠芋田、渔猎与交换维持生计，酋长通过分配资源、主持仪式和联姻维系跨岛关系。罗伊·马塔死后被葬于勒勒帕岛，其头衔与传说延续至今，成为当地社会记忆的一部分。
summary.en: In the early seventeenth century the chief Roi Mata exercised authority from residences and ceremonial places around Mangaas in central Vanuatu. Communities lived from taro gardens, fishing and exchange, while the chief sustained inter-island relations through the distribution of resources, ritual and marriage. After his death he was buried on Lelepa, and his title and stories remain part of local memory.

significance.zh: 罗伊·马塔遗址记录了太平洋岛屿酋长制度与口述传统的结合。
significance.en: The Roi Mata sites record the combination of Pacific chiefly institutions and oral tradition.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chief Roi Mata's Domain

editorialNotes.zh: 坐标为遗产地整体代表点，不是单独居所址；年代为十七世纪初，来源明确否定十六世纪的说法。
editorialNotes.en: The coordinate is the representative point of the whole property, not the individual residence; the date is the early seventeenth century, and the source explicitly rules out the sixteenth.

title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿传统与十八世纪学术活动
title.en: Timbuktu's manuscript tradition and eighteenth-century scholarship

summary.zh: 十七至十八世纪，廷巴克图的家族图书馆持续抄写与收藏手稿，内容涵盖天文学、法律、算术、医学与商业契约。商队贸易带来的收入支持学者教学与书籍流通，部分天文和法律抄本明确记为十八世纪抄写。这些手稿说明撒哈拉以南非洲存在延续数百年的书写与学术传统。
summary.en: In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries family libraries in Timbuktu continued to copy and collect manuscripts on astronomy, law, arithmetic, medicine and commercial agreements. Income from caravan trade supported teaching and the circulation of books; some astronomical and legal copies are explicitly dated to the eighteenth century.

significance.zh: 廷巴克图手稿表明西非城市拥有延续数百年的书写与学术网络。
significance.en: Timbuktu's manuscripts show that West African cities sustained centuries-long written scholarly networks.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Ancient Manuscripts from the Desert Libraries of Timbuktu
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Timbuktu

editorialNotes.zh: 1733年抄本只是展品中的例证，不代表全部藏书的年代；家族图书馆的收藏史并不连续完整。
editorialNotes.en: The 1733 copy is one exhibited example, not the date of every manuscript, and the history of family libraries is not continuous or complete.

title.zh: 荷兰东印度公司成立
title.en: Foundation of the Dutch East India Company

summary.zh: 荷兰多个亚洲贸易公司合并为东印度公司，获得贸易垄断及缔约、筑堡和作战等权力。公司利用长期资本和跨洋组织网络扩大经营，在香料、纺织品和其他商品贸易中建立重要地位。商业活动与强制垄断、殖民战争和地方联盟相互结合，深刻影响东南亚及印度洋的经济政治关系。
summary.en: Several Dutch Asian trading ventures merged into the VOC, receiving monopoly privileges and powers to make treaties, build forts and wage war. Long-term capital and overseas organization supported its trade in spices, textiles and other goods. Commerce, coercive monopoly, colonial warfare and local alliances together transformed relationships across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean.

significance.zh: 东印度公司把股份资本、贸易网络与国家授权的武力结合成跨洋制度。
significance.en: The VOC combined joint-stock capital and commercial networks with state-authorized coercive power.

sources.title: Nationaal Archief — VOC, 1602–1800

title.zh: 德川幕府建立

summary.zh: 德川家康在关原战役后的权力重组中获任征夷大将军，以江户为中心建立幕府。德川家族与各藩大名构成等级化的统治体系，后续制度强化了对武士、城市与乡村的管理。持续的国内和平促进人口、农业、市场和出版文化发展，也形成了幕府晚期改革与危机的社会背景。
summary.en: After consolidating power following Sekigahara, Tokugawa Ieyasu became shogun and established his government at Edo. The Tokugawa house and regional lords formed a hierarchical political order, strengthened by later regulations over warriors, towns and villages. Prolonged domestic peace encouraged agriculture, markets and print culture, creating the social conditions of the later shogunate's reforms and crises.

significance.zh: 江户幕府开启了两个多世纪的政治稳定与社会经济转型。
significance.en: The Edo shogunate began more than two centuries of political stability and socioeconomic transformation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Establishment of the Tokugawa shogunate

title.zh: 二条城与幕府在京都的权威
title.en: Nijō Castle and shogunal authority in Kyoto

summary.zh: 1603年，德川家康在京都营建二条城，并在此向朝廷与诸侯显示将军权威。此后二百余年，幕府通过驻京机构、城郭与仪式参与京都的政治生活，二条城既是将军的居所，也是幕府与宫廷交涉的场所。1867年，德川庆喜在此表明奉还大政的意向，幕府统治随之结束。
summary.en: In 1603 Tokugawa Ieyasu built Nijō Castle in Kyoto, using it to display shogunal authority before the court and lords. For more than two centuries the shogunate took part in the capital's political life through residences, fortifications and ceremony. In 1867 the castle hosted the declaration of intent to return governing power to the emperor, ending shogunal rule.

significance.zh: 二条城把幕府权力与京都宫廷的长期共存凝固在建筑与仪式之中。
significance.en: Nijō Castle materialises the long coexistence of shogunal power and the Kyoto court in architecture and ceremony.

sources.title: City of Kyoto / Nijō-jo Castle — Chronology

editorialNotes.zh: 1603年为现二之丸区域完成之年；1867年为表明奉还大政意向之年，政权移交在此后数月完成。
editorialNotes.en: 1603 is the completion year of the present Ninomaru area; 1867 is the year the intent to return power was declared, with the transfer completed in the following months.

title.zh: 伽利略的望远镜观测

summary.zh: 伽利略改进望远镜并将其用于天文观察，发现月球表面起伏、木星卫星等现象，随后发表《星际信使》。这些观测削弱了天体完美无瑕和一切绕地球运行的传统观念。仪器制造、公开出版与争论共同改变了科学证据的传播方式，日心学说也由此获得新的观测支持。
summary.en: Galileo improved the telescope and turned it toward the sky, observing the Moon's uneven surface and satellites around Jupiter before publishing Sidereus Nuncius. These findings challenged ideas of perfect heavens and universal Earth-centred motion. Instrument making, publication and controversy changed how evidence circulated, while new observations strengthened arguments for heliocentric astronomy.

significance.zh: 望远镜使可重复的仪器观测成为近代天文学的重要证据来源。
significance.en: The telescope made repeatable instrumental observation a central source of evidence in modern astronomy.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Galileo’s telescopic observations

title.zh: 三十年战争

summary.zh: 波希米亚的政治与宗教冲突引发战争，神圣罗马帝国诸邦和多个欧洲强国相继卷入。天主教与新教的对立同王朝利益交织，军队征粮、疾病和人口流离使中欧社会遭受严重破坏。战争经过多次联盟重组，最终由威斯特伐利亚和约结束主要战事，并重新安排帝国内部权利与欧洲力量关系。
summary.en: Political and religious conflict in Bohemia expanded into war involving imperial territories and major European powers. Confessional divisions intersected with dynastic ambitions, while military requisitioning, disease and displacement devastated central European communities. Changing alliances prolonged the conflict until the Peace of Westphalia ended its principal hostilities and revised imperial rights and European power relationships.

significance.zh: 战争显示教派冲突与国家竞争的交织，并推动新的欧洲外交安排。
significance.en: The war intertwined confessional conflict with state rivalry and prompted new diplomatic arrangements in Europe.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Thirty Years’ War

title.zh: 贡德尔成为埃塞俄比亚固定都城
title.en: Gondar becomes an Ethiopian royal capital

summary.zh: 法西利德皇帝在贡德尔建立固定都城，改变埃塞俄比亚王廷长期迁移营地的惯例。皇宫、教堂、修道院和行政建筑在此陆续兴建，形成法西尔盖比建筑群。当地工艺与外来建筑影响相互结合，绘画、音乐和文学随宫廷及宗教活动发展，使贡德尔成为十七、十八世纪的重要政治与文化中心。
summary.en: Emperor Fasilides established a permanent capital at Gondar after a long tradition of mobile royal camps. Palaces, churches, monasteries and administrative buildings formed the Fasil Ghebbi complex. Local craftsmanship interacted with external architectural influences, while painting, music and literature flourished around court and religious life, making Gondar a major seventeenth- and eighteenth-century cultural centre.

significance.zh: 固定都城推动了埃塞俄比亚宫廷文化、建筑与国家行政的集中发展。
significance.en: A permanent capital concentrated Ethiopian court culture, architecture and government.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar Region

title.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德与红堡营建
title.en: The building of Shahjahanabad and the Red Fort

summary.zh: 1639年，莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗在德里旧城以北营建新的都城沙贾汗纳巴德，宫殿城堡红堡于1648年前后完成。红堡沿雅穆纳河西岸展开，亭阁、水渠与花园结合波斯、帖木儿和印度建筑传统；宫堡与清真寺、集市共同构成帝国都城。此后德里多次经历政权更替，红堡始终是权力象征。
summary.en: In 1639 the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan began a new capital, Shahjahanabad, north of earlier Delhi, and the palace-fortress known as the Red Fort was completed around 1648. Set beside the Yamuna, its pavilions, water channels and gardens combined Persian, Timurid and Indian traditions, while mosques and bazaars formed the imperial city around it.

significance.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德集中体现了莫卧儿都城规划与建筑综合能力。
significance.en: Shahjahanabad concentrates Mughal achievement in capital planning and architectural synthesis.

sources.title: Ministry of Culture, Government of India / Press Information Bureau — Red Fort, Delhi: Backgrounder
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Red Fort Complex

editorialNotes.zh: 1639—1648为红堡建造期；此后红堡经过改建并长期作为军事设施使用。
editorialNotes.en: 1639–1648 is the Red Fort's construction period; it was later altered and long used as a military installation.

title.zh: 清军入关并定都北京
