summary.zh: 李自成军进入北京后，明朝中央政权崩溃；清军随即通过山海关，并在击败大顺军后占领北京。顺治帝迁都北京，清朝开始以新的政治中心统治中国。此后仍经历对南明、地方抵抗与其他势力的长期战争，军事征服、制度继承和满汉精英合作共同塑造了清代国家。
summary.en: After Li Zicheng's forces entered Beijing and the Ming central government collapsed, Qing troops passed through Shanhai Pass and defeated the Shun army. The Shunzhi emperor made Beijing his capital. Subsequent campaigns against Southern Ming regimes and other opponents extended Qing control, combining conquest, inherited institutions and cooperation among Manchu and Han elites.

significance.zh: 清朝取得北京是明清鼎革的关键节点，并开启新的帝国整合过程。
significance.en: The Qing capture of Beijing marked a decisive stage in dynastic transition and imperial consolidation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Qing occupation of Beijing

title.zh: 威斯特伐利亚和约

summary.zh: 经过长期谈判，明斯特与奥斯纳布吕克签订的一系列和约结束了三十年战争的主要冲突。和约调整神圣罗马帝国诸邦的权利与宗教安排，承认荷兰和瑞士的独立地位，并重新分配部分领土。参与谈判的多国使节也展示了持续外交协商在处理复杂国际争端中的作用。
summary.en: Treaties negotiated at Münster and Osnabrück ended the principal conflicts of the Thirty Years' War. They revised the rights and religious arrangements of imperial territories, recognized Dutch and Swiss independence, and redistributed some lands. Multilateral negotiations also demonstrated the role of sustained diplomacy in settling disputes involving overlapping political and confessional interests.

significance.zh: 和约重整了中欧政治秩序，并成为欧洲外交史的重要参照。
significance.en: The settlements reorganized central European politics and became an important reference point in diplomatic history.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Peace of Westphalia

title.zh: 清代宫廷绘画与帝国文化整合
title.en: Qing court painting and imperial cultural consolidation

summary.zh: 十七世纪后期至十八世纪，清廷通过画院、南巡与宫廷收藏组织绘画创作，皇帝、满洲贵族、汉族文人与欧洲传教士画家共同参与。宫廷绘画既记录典礼、战功与巡幸，也吸收文人山水和西洋透视技法，成为多民族帝国展示秩序与自我叙述的工具。这些作品同时也限定了后人观看清帝国的视角。
summary.en: From the late seventeenth to the eighteenth century the Qing court organised painting through the academy, imperial tours and collections, bringing together the emperor, Manchu nobles, Han literati and European missionary artists. Court pictures recorded ceremonies, campaigns and journeys while combining literati landscape with Western perspective, serving as instruments of imperial self-presentation.

significance.zh: 宫廷绘画显示清代如何用图像整合多民族帝国的政治秩序。
significance.en: Court painting shows how the Qing used images to integrate the political order of a multi-ethnic empire.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Qing Dynasty (1644–1911): Painting

editorialNotes.zh: 1662—1795覆盖康熙后期至乾隆末年的主要赞助期；绘画赞助集中于宫廷与精英，不能代表清代全部视觉文化。
editorialNotes.en: 1662–1795 covers the main patronage period from the later Kangxi to the end of Qianlong; patronage centred on court and elite circles and does not represent all Qing visual culture.

title.zh: 牛顿发表《自然哲学的数学原理》

summary.zh: 牛顿出版《自然哲学的数学原理》，以运动定律和万有引力说明地面物体与天体的运动。他把数学推导、天文观测和实验问题联系起来，解释行星轨道、潮汐等现象。著作经后续研究者阐释与扩展，形成可供计算和预测的力学体系，深刻影响物理学、工程与启蒙时期的自然观。
summary.en: Newton's Principia used laws of motion and universal gravitation to explain terrestrial and celestial movement within one mathematical framework. It connected mathematical reasoning with observations and physical problems, including planetary orbits and tides. Later researchers clarified and extended its methods, creating a predictive mechanics that deeply influenced physics, engineering and Enlightenment views of nature.

significance.zh: 统一的数学力学使自然现象能够得到系统解释与定量预测。
significance.en: A unified mathematical mechanics enabled systematic explanations and quantitative predictions of natural phenomena.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Newton, Principia, 1687

title.zh: 英国光荣革命与权利法案
title.en: Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

summary.zh: 威廉率军进入英格兰，詹姆斯二世出逃，议会随后拥立威廉与玛丽为共同君主。次年的《权利法案》限制王权，并确认议会在征税、立法和军队事务中的重要地位。政权转换在不列颠及爱尔兰产生不同后果，宗教归属和继承权仍引发战争，而议会制度则获得更稳定的政治基础。
summary.en: William's intervention in England led to James II's flight and Parliament's offer of the crown to William and Mary. The following year's Bill of Rights limited royal powers and strengthened Parliament's position in taxation, legislation and military affairs. The transition had different consequences across Britain and Ireland, where religious and succession conflicts continued.

significance.zh: 君主与议会的关系发生持久调整，为英国宪政发展奠定关键基础。
significance.en: The settlement durably altered relations between monarchy and Parliament and advanced British constitutional development.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

title.zh: 锡克教卡尔萨共同体形成

summary.zh: 古鲁戈宾德·辛格在阿南德普尔建立卡尔萨共同体，以入教仪式、共同纪律和外在标志加强锡克教徒的集体认同。信仰实践同维护群体尊严与自我防卫结合，挑战既有等级观念。卡尔萨此后经历与邻近政权的冲突，并在旁遮普的宗教生活、军事组织和政治形成中发挥深远作用。
summary.en: Guru Gobind Singh established the Khalsa at Anandpur, strengthening Sikh collective identity through initiation, shared discipline and visible symbols. Religious commitment combined with communal dignity and self-defence and challenged inherited hierarchies. The Khalsa later confronted neighbouring powers and deeply influenced religious life, military organization and political formation in Punjab.

significance.zh: 卡尔萨为锡克教共同体提供了持久的组织、伦理与身份基础。
significance.en: The Khalsa provided an enduring organizational, ethical and identity framework for Sikh communities.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Quoit (Chakra), Sikh tradition

title.zh: 阿散蒂国家的兴起

summary.zh: 十八世纪初，奥塞·图图领导的阿散蒂势力把多个阿坎政治共同体联合起来，并从库马西向外扩展。黄金贸易、军事组织与共同仪式支持王权，宫廷吸收不同地区的传统，发展出织物、金饰和权杖等鲜明艺术。阿散蒂逐渐成为西非内陆的重要强国，在区域贸易和外交中发挥持续影响。
summary.en: Around the beginning of the eighteenth century, Osei Tutu's Asante polity united several Akan communities and expanded from Kumasi. Gold commerce, military organization and shared ritual supported royal authority. The court adopted traditions from across its territories and developed distinctive textiles, goldwork and regalia, becoming an influential centre of West African politics and culture.

significance.zh: 阿散蒂的兴起说明非洲国家建设、商业网络与艺术创造之间的密切联系。
significance.en: Asante's rise illustrates the close relationship among African state-building, commerce and artistic production.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Art of the Asante Kingdom

editorialNotes.zh: 约1700年用于标示阿散蒂在十七世纪末至十八世纪初的政治整合，国家形成经历了持续的联盟与战争过程。
editorialNotes.en: Around 1700 marks Asante’s political consolidation across the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, through a continuing process of alliance and warfare.

title.zh: 法国《百科全书》出版

summary.zh: 狄德罗、达朗贝尔及众多作者开始出版法国《百科全书》，系统汇集科学、技艺、哲学和日常生产知识。文章与图版既介绍学术成果，也赋予工匠经验更高地位。出版过程遭遇审查与禁令，编者仍持续推进工程，使知识分类、理性批判和公共讨论成为启蒙运动的重要实践。
summary.en: Diderot, d'Alembert and numerous contributors began publishing the Encyclopédie, collecting knowledge of science, crafts, philosophy and production. Its essays and illustrations presented scholarship alongside artisans' expertise. Despite censorship and prohibitions, the editors continued the enterprise, turning the organization of knowledge, rational criticism and public discussion into central practices of the Enlightenment.

significance.zh: 《百科全书》扩大了知识的社会传播，并促进对传统权威的公开讨论。
significance.en: The Encyclopédie broadened the circulation of knowledge and public debate about inherited authority.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of the Encyclopédie

title.zh: 七年战争

summary.zh: 欧洲列强围绕领土、殖民地和商业利益展开战争，战事延伸到北美、加勒比海、南亚及海上航路。英国与法国的殖民竞争和普鲁士同欧洲邻国的冲突相互连接，地方盟友也深刻影响战局。战后英国海外地位增强，各国战争债务和殖民治理压力则为随后数十年的改革与革命积累矛盾。
summary.en: European powers fought over territory, colonies and commercial interests in conflicts reaching North America, the Caribbean, South Asia and maritime routes. Anglo-French colonial rivalry intersected with Prussia's struggles against European neighbours, while local allies shaped campaigns. Britain emerged stronger overseas, but wartime debts and colonial tensions created pressures that fed subsequent reforms and revolutions.

significance.zh: 多洲战场之间的联系显示帝国竞争已经形成紧密的全球体系。
significance.en: The connected campaigns revealed how imperial competition had become a global system.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Seven Years’ War

title.zh: 普拉西战役

summary.zh: 英国东印度公司军队在普拉西击败孟加拉纳瓦布西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉。米尔·贾法尔等人的背离及公司参与的政治交易，对结果具有决定性影响。胜利使公司能够干预孟加拉统治，并获得重要财政资源；此后进一步战争和征税权扩张，把贸易公司推向领土统治者的位置。
summary.en: East India Company forces defeated Bengal's nawab, Siraj al-Dawlah, at Plassey. Defections and political agreements involving Mir Jafar were decisive to the result. Victory enabled the company to influence Bengal's government and obtain substantial resources; subsequent wars and revenue rights transformed its position from commercial actor toward territorial ruler.

significance.zh: 普拉西成为东印度公司建立南亚殖民权力的重要转折点。
significance.en: Plassey marked a major turn in the company's construction of colonial power in South Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Battle of Plassey

title.zh: 英国工业革命

summary.zh: 十八世纪后期，英国纺织生产、煤炭开采、蒸汽动力和机械制造相互促进，工厂逐渐扩大规模。生产集中改变了劳动节奏和城乡人口分布，也依赖贸易网络、资本积累与资源供应。工业化带来产量增长和新技术，同时伴随危险劳动、贫困与污染，后来扩展到欧洲其他地区和世界各地。
summary.en: From the later eighteenth century, British textiles, coal mining, steam power and machine making reinforced one another as factories expanded. Concentrated production changed working rhythms and settlement patterns, drawing on trade, capital and resources. Industrialization increased output and technical capacity while generating dangerous labour conditions, poverty and pollution, before spreading to other regions.

significance.zh: 机器生产和化石能源逐渐改变了全球经济增长与人类环境的关系。
significance.en: Mechanized production and fossil energy transformed economic growth and humanity's relationship with the environment.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Industrial Revolution in Britain

editorialNotes.zh: 1760—1840年是叙述英国早期工业化时常用的分期。不同产业和地区的转变速度各异，工业化也在此后继续扩展。
editorialNotes.en: 1760–1840 is a conventional period for Britain’s early industrialization. Industries and regions changed at different speeds, and industrialization continued afterward.

title.zh: 库克考察澳大利亚东海岸

summary.zh: 库克率奋进号沿澳大利亚东海岸航行，绘制海图并采集自然标本，随后为英国提出领土主张。航行属于更广泛的太平洋科学考察与帝国竞争，也涉及与原住民的接触和冲突。形成的海图和报告为后来的英国殖民计划提供知识基础，沿岸原住民的土地与生活此后受到深刻影响。
summary.en: James Cook sailed along Australia's eastern coast in the Endeavour, mapping shores and collecting specimens before claiming territory for Britain. The voyage combined Pacific scientific investigation with imperial competition and encounters with Indigenous communities. Its charts and reports informed later British colonization, which profoundly affected Indigenous lands and ways of life.

significance.zh: 考察把科学知识、航海能力与英国在太平洋的殖民扩张联系起来。
significance.en: The voyage linked scientific knowledge and navigation with British colonial expansion in the Pacific.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Cook claims Australia

title.zh: 美国独立宣言

summary.zh: 北美十三个殖民地的代表通过《独立宣言》，宣布脱离英国，并以自然权利和人民同意论证新政治秩序。声明出现在已经展开的独立战争之中，军事胜利与国际援助随后巩固了独立。宣言的平等语言广泛流传，也被后来的废奴、妇女权利和民权运动用于挑战现实中的排斥。
summary.en: Representatives of thirteen British colonies adopted the Declaration of Independence, invoking natural rights and government by consent. Issued during an ongoing war, the declaration was followed by military struggle and international assistance that secured independence. Its language of equality circulated widely and later supplied arguments for abolition, women's rights and civil-rights movements.

significance.zh: 宣言将独立诉求与普遍权利语言结合，成为现代政治思想的重要文本。
significance.en: The declaration connected independence with universal rights and became a major text of modern political thought.

sources.title: US National Archives — Declaration of Independence

title.zh: 第一舰队抵达悉尼湾
title.en: First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

summary.zh: 第一舰队把囚犯、军人和其他殖民者运往澳大利亚，在悉尼湾建立英国定居点。新南威尔士殖民地逐渐发展出强制劳动、土地占有和对外补给体系。殖民定居与疾病传播压迫当地原住民社会，并引发长期的抵抗与边疆冲突，澳大利亚的近代国家形成由此进入新的阶段。
summary.en: The First Fleet brought convicts, soldiers and other settlers to Australia and established a British settlement at Sydney Cove. New South Wales developed around coerced labour, land appropriation and overseas supplies. Settlement and introduced diseases placed Indigenous communities under severe pressure, producing resistance and prolonged frontier conflict as colonial Australia took shape.

significance.zh: 悉尼殖民地成为英国在澳大利亚扩张的起点，也开启持续的土地与权利冲突。
significance.en: Sydney became a base for British expansion and enduring conflicts over Indigenous land and rights.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — The First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

title.zh: 法国大革命

summary.zh: 财政危机促使法国召开三级会议，代表权争议很快扩大为对旧制度的挑战。攻占巴士底狱、废除封建特权和《人权与公民权宣言》相继出现，革命随后经历共和国、恐怖统治和战争。国家主权、法律平等与公民身份成为政治争论中心，社会动员也改变了欧洲及大西洋世界。
summary.en: France's fiscal crisis brought the Estates-General together, and disputes over representation became a challenge to the old regime. The fall of the Bastille, abolition of feudal privileges and Declaration of the Rights of Man were followed by republican government, the Terror and war. Sovereignty, legal equality and citizenship became central questions across the Atlantic world.

significance.zh: 法国大革命重塑了现代公民政治，也展示了革命动员的复杂后果。
significance.en: The French Revolution reshaped modern citizenship and demonstrated the far-reaching consequences of revolutionary mobilization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French Revolution

title.zh: 海地革命

summary.zh: 圣多明各被奴役者发动起义，争取自由的斗争与法国革命、殖民战争及种族等级冲突交织。杜桑·卢维杜尔等领导人建立新的政治力量，后来德萨林领导的军队击败法军。海地于一八〇四年宣布独立，结束当地奴隶制和法国殖民统治，却面临国际孤立及沉重的经济压力。
summary.en: Enslaved people in Saint-Domingue launched an uprising that intersected with the French Revolution, colonial warfare and racial hierarchies. Leaders including Toussaint Louverture built new political forces, and armies under Dessalines eventually defeated the French. Haiti declared independence in 1804, ending slavery and French rule while confronting international isolation and severe economic pressures.

significance.zh: 海地革命证明被奴役者能够推翻殖民奴隶制度，并震动整个大西洋世界。
significance.en: Haiti's revolution overturned a colonial slave system and reverberated across the Atlantic world.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Haitian Revolution

title.zh: 黑人移民在弗里敦建立新社区
title.en: Black settlers establish a community at Freetown

summary.zh: 一千余名来自新斯科舍的黑人移民抵达塞拉利昂，参与建立弗里敦。他们中许多人曾在北美争取自由，却在战后生活中遭遇歧视与土地承诺落空。移民带来宗教、语言和自治期待，与当地社会及后来获释者共同塑造新的社区，弗里敦由此成为黑人大西洋迁徙史的重要节点。
summary.en: More than a thousand Black settlers from Nova Scotia arrived in Sierra Leone and helped establish Freetown. Many had sought freedom in North America but encountered discrimination and unfulfilled land promises. Their religious practices, language and aspirations for self-government interacted with local societies and later freed arrivals, making the city a major centre of Black Atlantic migration.

significance.zh: 弗里敦的形成连接了奴隶制、解放诉求和跨大西洋黑人社会的历史。
significance.en: Freetown's formation connected slavery, emancipation and the history of Black Atlantic communities.

sources.title: Government of Nova Scotia — African Heritage Month Narratives: Week Three

title.zh: 詹纳开展牛痘接种实验

summary.zh: 爱德华·詹纳依据挤奶工感染牛痘后较少患天花的观察，开展牛痘接种实验，并在之后发表研究结果。接种方法经医师、国家机构与地方网络逐渐传播，降低了天花带来的威胁。早期实践的风险、材料质量与公众信任也持续推动接种技术和公共卫生制度的改进。
summary.en: Edward Jenner tested cowpox inoculation after observing that dairy workers who contracted cowpox appeared protected against smallpox. Publication helped the practice spread through physicians, state institutions and local networks. Vaccination reduced smallpox's threat, while questions about safety, the quality of vaccine material and public trust shaped improvements in technique and public-health organization.

significance.zh: 牛痘接种为预防性免疫和后来全球消灭天花奠定了实践基础。
significance.en: Cowpox vaccination provided a practical foundation for preventive immunization and the later eradication of smallpox.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Smallpox

title.zh: 阮朝以顺化为统一越南的都城
title.en: Huế becomes the capital of Nguyễn Vietnam

summary.zh: 阮福映结束长期战争后建立阮朝，以嘉隆为年号，并将顺化确立为统一越南的首都。皇城、陵寝、庙宇和行政设施沿香江及周边地区发展，空间布局体现王权、礼制与自然景观的结合。宫廷音乐、文学和工艺在这里汇集，使顺化持续承担越南的政治、宗教与文化中心功能。
summary.en: After prolonged warfare, Nguyễn Ánh founded the Nguyễn dynasty as Gia Long and established Huế as the capital of unified Vietnam. Citadels, tombs, temples and administrative buildings developed around the Perfume River, connecting royal authority, ritual and landscape. Court music, literature and crafts flourished as Huế became a political, religious and cultural centre.

significance.zh: 顺化的建设把国家统一与阮朝宫廷文化凝聚为持久的城市遗产。
significance.en: Huế embodied political unification and Nguyễn court culture in an enduring urban heritage.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Complex of Huế Monuments

title.zh: 《拿破仑法典》颁布

summary.zh: 法国颁布《民法典》，把革命后形成的财产权、法律平等和世俗民事秩序编入较统一的法律体系。法典简化了旧制度下复杂的地方规则，并通过法国扩张与后来的法律改革影响多国。它同时强化了家庭中的男性权威，妇女在婚姻、财产和法律行为方面受到明显限制。
summary.en: France's Civil Code consolidated property rights, legal equality and secular civil institutions into a more uniform framework. It simplified the fragmented rules inherited from the old regime and influenced other countries through French expansion and later legal reforms. Within the family, however, it reinforced male authority and restricted women's marital, property and legal autonomy.

significance.zh: 成文法典传播了革命的部分法律成果，同时延续了深刻的性别等级。
significance.en: Codification spread important revolutionary legal principles while preserving pronounced gender hierarchies.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Promulgation of the Napoleonic Code

title.zh: 索科托哈里发国的形成

summary.zh: 奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥倡导宗教改革，批评豪萨统治者的税收与治理，并领导追随者投入战争。运动汇集宗教学者、牧民和其他不满群体，在一系列战役后重组多个豪萨国家。新政权通过地方埃米尔、伊斯兰法和学术网络治理广大地区，成为十九世纪西非内陆重要的宗教政治力量。
summary.en: Usman dan Fodio criticized the taxation and government of Hausa rulers and led a movement for Islamic reform into war. Scholars, pastoralists and other dissatisfied groups joined the struggle, which reorganized several Hausa states. The resulting caliphate governed through regional emirs, Islamic law and scholarly networks and became a major nineteenth-century West African power.

significance.zh: 索科托的形成把宗教改革与区域国家重组结合，对西非思想和制度留下长期影响。
significance.en: Sokoto connected religious reform with regional state formation and left an enduring institutional and intellectual legacy.

sources.title: Library of Congress Country Study — Usman dan Fodio and the Sokoto Caliphate

title.zh: 英国废除跨大西洋奴隶贸易

summary.zh: 英国议会通过法律，禁止英国臣民参与奴隶贸易。长期的废奴动员、被奴役者抵抗和政治变化共同促成决定，海军随后参与拦截运奴船。种植园中的奴隶制仍继续存在，其他国家和非法商人也维持贩运，废除贸易因而成为更长久的解放斗争与国际执法过程的一环。
summary.en: Britain's Parliament prohibited British subjects from participating in the slave trade after sustained abolitionist campaigning, resistance by enslaved people and political change. Naval interception became part of enforcement. Plantation slavery continued, alongside trafficking by other countries and illegal traders, making abolition of the trade one stage in a longer struggle over emancipation and international enforcement.

significance.zh: 禁运法改变了英国的大西洋政策，并扩大了跨国废奴运动的影响。
significance.en: The act redirected British Atlantic policy and strengthened the international abolitionist movement.

sources.title: UK Parliament — Abolition of the slave trade

title.zh: 拉丁美洲独立战争

summary.zh: 拿破仑战争削弱伊比利亚王权后，西属美洲多地建立自治机构，并逐步转向独立。玻利瓦尔、圣马丁等人的军队与各地社会力量参与长期战争，帝国原有的政治空间被重组为多个国家。独立后的宪政、土地与种族关系仍充满冲突，殖民时代的社会等级在新秩序中继续受到挑战。
summary.en: The Napoleonic disruption of Iberian monarchy encouraged autonomous governments and independence movements across Spanish America. Armies led by Bolívar, San Martín and others joined diverse local forces in prolonged wars that replaced imperial territories with new states. Independence was followed by disputes over constitutions, land and racial hierarchies inherited from colonial society.

significance.zh: 拉丁美洲独立重绘了美洲政治地图，并开启长期的共和国建设。
significance.en: Latin American independence redrew the continent's political map and began prolonged processes of republican state-building.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Spanish American independence wars

title.zh: 维也纳会议

summary.zh: 拿破仑战败前后，欧洲列强在维也纳协商战后安排，调整疆域并恢复或确认多个王朝的地位。奥地利、英国、俄国、普鲁士和法国通过谈判寻求力量平衡，以抑制新的大规模战争。会议体系为后续外交协调提供框架，同时也同自由主义、民族主义和地方政治诉求不断发生冲突。
summary.en: European powers met in Vienna around Napoleon's defeat to negotiate territorial settlements and restore or confirm dynastic rule. Austria, Britain, Russia, Prussia and France sought a balance of power that could prevent renewed continental war. The resulting framework supported diplomatic consultation while repeatedly conflicting with liberal, nationalist and local political aspirations.

significance.zh: 维也纳安排塑造了十九世纪欧洲外交与反革命政治的基本格局。
significance.en: The Vienna settlement shaped nineteenth-century European diplomacy and conservative political order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Congress of Vienna

title.zh: 坦博拉火山大喷发

summary.zh: 印度尼西亚松巴哇岛的坦博拉火山猛烈喷发，火山灰和碎屑摧毁周边聚落，造成大规模伤亡与流离。进入高层大气的物质影响全球气候，次年部分地区出现异常寒冷和收成失败。灾害通过粮食价格、饥荒与迁徙产生跨洲影响，显示偏远地区的地质活动也能改变全球社会生活。
summary.en: Tambora's eruption on Sumbawa devastated nearby settlements with ash and volcanic debris, causing extensive deaths and displacement. Material injected into the upper atmosphere affected global climate, contributing to unusual cold and crop failures in several regions the following year. Food shortages, rising prices and migration transmitted the disaster's consequences across continents.

significance.zh: 坦博拉把局部火山灾害与全球气候、农业和社会危机联系在一起。
significance.en: Tambora connected a volcanic catastrophe with global climatic, agricultural and social disruption.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Eruption of Mount Tambora

title.zh: 莱武卡与十九世纪太平洋港镇
title.en: Levuka and the nineteenth-century Pacific port town

summary.zh: 十九世纪二十年代起，斐济的莱武卡因海滩交易、椰油和贸易船而发展成港镇。欧洲商人、传教士与斐济社群在此交汇，木构商铺、仓库、教堂与行政建筑沿滨海形成低层街区。1874年斐济成为英国殖民地后，莱武卡一度作为首府；1882年首府迁往苏瓦，港镇的发展随之放缓。
summary.en: From the 1820s Levuka grew into a port town in Fiji through beachcomber trade, coconut oil and shipping. European traders, missionaries and Fijian communities met there, and low-rise wooden shops, warehouses, churches and administrative buildings lined the shore. After Fiji became a British colony in 1874 Levuka briefly served as capital; the capital moved to Suva in 1882 and growth slowed.

significance.zh: 莱武卡展示了太平洋岛屿港镇在殖民接触时期的空间与社会形态。
significance.en: Levuka shows the spatial and social form of a Pacific island port town during colonial contact.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Levuka Historical Port Town

editorialNotes.zh: 1820年代为港镇发展阶段起点，不能据此推断当地村落形成于此时；1874与1882年的政治变化分别表述。
editorialNotes.en: The 1820s mark the beginning of the port-town phase and do not imply that local villages began then; the political changes of 1874 and 1882 are kept separate.

title.zh: 福拉湾学院创办

summary.zh: 教会传教会在弗里敦创办福拉湾学院，最初主要培养教师与传教人员。学校随着课程与学位制度的发展，吸引西非不同地区的学生，并于十九世纪后期同英国杜伦大学建立联系。毕业生进入教育、宗教和公共生活，使学院成为区域知识传播和专业人才培养的重要机构。
summary.en: The Church Missionary Society founded Fourah Bay College in Freetown to train teachers and missionaries. Expanding curricula and later university affiliation attracted students from different parts of West Africa. Graduates entered education, religious institutions and public life, helping the college become a significant regional centre for learning and professional training.

significance.zh: 学院推动了近代西非高等教育网络的发展，并扩大非洲知识分子的交流空间。
significance.en: The college helped develop modern West African higher education and networks of African intellectual exchange.

sources.title: University of Sierra Leone — Fourah Bay College
University of Sierra Leone — Fourah Bay College history

title.zh: 孟加拉禁止寡妇殉葬

summary.zh: 东印度公司治下的孟加拉颁布法令，禁止寡妇在丈夫火葬时殉葬，并将协助或参与实施者纳入刑事惩处。拉姆·莫汉·罗伊等印度改革者长期反对这一习俗，宗教解释、妇女处境与殖民干预在争论中交织。法令推动法律与社会改革，也使国家权力介入宗教惯例的问题更加突出。
summary.en: Bengal's colonial government prohibited sati, the burning of widows on their husbands' funeral pyres, and made participation punishable. Indian reformers including Ram Mohan Roy had campaigned against the practice. Debates intertwined religious interpretation, women's circumstances and colonial intervention, making the regulation a significant episode in legal and social reform.

significance.zh: 禁令成为南亚妇女处境、社会改革与宗教权威讨论的重要节点。
significance.en: The prohibition became an important point in South Asian debates over women, reform and religious authority.

sources.title: Fordham University Internet History Sourcebook — Bentinck on the suppression of sati, 1829
East India Company — Bengal Sati Regulation, 4 December 1829 (transcription at India of the Past)

title.zh: 法国入侵阿尔及利亚

summary.zh: 法国军队在阿尔及尔附近登陆并夺取城市，开启对阿尔及利亚的长期征服。阿卜杜·卡迪尔等领导的抵抗迫使法军持续作战，战争伴随土地没收、强制迁移与平民苦难。殖民者定居和行政制度随后扩大，改变了土地关系与社会结构，也积累了二十世纪民族解放运动面对的矛盾。
summary.en: French forces landed near Algiers and captured the city, beginning a prolonged conquest of Algeria. Resistance led by Abd al-Qadir and others was met with sustained warfare, land confiscation and forced displacement. Settler colonization and administrative expansion transformed landholding and society, establishing conditions that later shaped the national liberation struggle.

significance.zh: 入侵开启了法国在北非最持久、冲突最深的殖民统治之一。
significance.en: The invasion began one of France's most enduring and deeply contested colonial regimes.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French invasion of Algeria

title.zh: 英国殖民地废奴法
title.en: Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

summary.zh: 英国议会通过《废除奴隶制法》，为帝国多数殖民地的法律废奴建立依据，主要条款于次年实施。许多获释者仍被迫进入所谓学徒制度，种植园的劳动关系继续引发抗争。殖民地奴隶主获得巨额国家补偿，而被奴役者争取土地、工资和真正自由的斗争则延续下去。
summary.en: Britain's Slavery Abolition Act established emancipation in most British colonies, with its main provisions taking effect the following year. Many formerly enslaved people were compelled into apprenticeship arrangements, and plantation labour remained contested. Slaveholders received substantial government compensation, while freed communities continued struggles over land, wages and the practical meaning of freedom.

significance.zh: 法律废奴改变了殖民社会的劳动制度，并开启新的自由与平等斗争。
significance.en: Legal emancipation transformed colonial labour systems and opened further struggles over freedom and equality.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

title.zh: 毛里求斯契约劳工移民制度扩展

summary.zh: 英国废奴后，在毛里求斯推动以契约劳工维持种植园生产，印度移民开始大规模跨海进入糖业劳动体系。招募、运输与多年合同把家庭生计同殖民市场联系起来，劳工经常面对严厉纪律和有限选择。此后制度扩散至其他殖民地，迁徙人口也逐渐改变毛里求斯及印度洋地区的文化与社会构成。
summary.en: After abolition, British authorities promoted indentured labour in Mauritius to sustain plantation production. Indian migrants entered sugar work through recruitment, overseas transport and multi-year contracts, often under strict discipline and constrained choices. The system spread to other colonies, while migrant families reshaped the social and cultural composition of Mauritius and the wider Indian Ocean.

significance.zh: 契约移民把后奴隶制劳动体系与全球人口流动连接起来，形成新的跨国侨民社会。
significance.en: Indenture linked post-emancipation labour systems with global migration and new diasporic communities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Aapravasi Ghat

editorialNotes.zh: 1834年标示毛里求斯契约劳工移民试验的开端；今天列入世界遗产的阿普拉瓦西·加特移民站主体建于1849年。
editorialNotes.en: 1834 marks the beginning of the Mauritian indentured-migration experiment; the Aapravasi Ghat immigration depot now on the World Heritage List was built in 1849.

title.zh: 第一次鸦片战争

summary.zh: 清政府查禁鸦片贸易后，英国以武力干预，战争在中国沿海与长江下游展开。清军在海军技术、组织和后勤方面处于不利地位，最终签订《南京条约》。香港割让、赔款和通商口岸开放改变了中外关系，条约体系随后继续扩大，清朝也逐渐面对改革外交与军事制度的压力。
summary.en: Britain intervened militarily after Qing efforts to suppress the opium trade, fighting along China's coast and lower Yangtze. Qing forces faced disadvantages in naval technology, organization and logistics. The Treaty of Nanjing ceded Hong Kong, imposed an indemnity and opened treaty ports, initiating a widening treaty system and pressure for institutional reform.

significance.zh: 战争使清朝进入不平等条约体系，并深刻改变中国与海外势力的关系。
significance.en: The war drew Qing China into an unequal treaty system and transformed its foreign relations.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — First Opium War

title.zh: 《怀唐伊条约》签署
title.en: Signing of the Treaty of Waitangi

summary.zh: 英国代表与毛利首领开始签署《怀唐伊条约》，随后签名活动在新西兰多地继续。毛利文和英文文本对统治权、主权与酋长权威的表述存在重要差异，影响了双方的理解。殖民扩张、土地交易和战争不断加深争议，条约后来又成为毛利权利主张、历史申诉与国家关系的重要基础。
summary.en: British representatives and Māori chiefs began signing the Treaty of Waitangi, with signatures subsequently collected around New Zealand. Differences between Māori and English texts concerning governance, sovereignty and chiefly authority shaped divergent understandings. Colonization, land transactions and warfare intensified disputes, while the treaty later became central to Māori rights claims and historical settlements.

significance.zh: 条约及其不同文本持续影响新西兰国家权力与毛利权利的讨论。
significance.en: The treaty and its differing texts remain central to debates over state authority and Māori rights.

sources.title: NZHistory — Treaty of Waitangi

title.zh: 一八四八年欧洲革命

summary.zh: 经济困难、粮食危机和政治排斥推动欧洲多地爆发革命，巴黎、维也纳、柏林及意大利地区相继出现动员。参与者要求宪法、代议制度、民族统一或社会改革，工人与中产阶层之间也存在分歧。多数革命政府最终被压制，但农奴义务、政治组织与民族国家议题已经发生持久变化。
summary.en: Economic hardship, food crises and political exclusion helped provoke revolutions across Europe, including Paris, Vienna, Berlin and Italian territories. Participants demanded constitutions, representation, national unification or social reform, while workers and middle-class reformers often disagreed. Most revolutionary governments were defeated, but changes to rural obligations and political mobilization endured.

significance.zh: 革命虽多遭挫败，却扩大了公民政治与民族运动的社会基础。
significance.en: Despite defeat, the revolutions widened the social foundations of civic politics and national movements.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — European revolutions of 1848

title.zh: 太平天国运动

summary.zh: 洪秀全领导的太平天国运动在华南兴起，逐渐占领长江流域大片地区，并以南京为天京。其宗教思想、土地主张和政治组织挑战清朝统治，战争又引发地方军事力量的扩张。清军与地方武装经过长期围剿攻陷天京，冲突、饥荒和疫病造成巨大人口损失，帝国权力结构也随之改变。
summary.en: Hong Xiuquan's Taiping movement arose in southern China, occupied extensive Yangtze territories and made Nanjing its capital. Its religious teachings, land proposals and political organization challenged Qing rule, while war strengthened regional military forces. Qing and local armies eventually captured the capital after a conflict whose fighting, famine and disease caused immense human losses.

significance.zh: 太平天国战争重创清代社会，并推动军事与地方权力结构的变化。
significance.en: The Taiping war devastated Qing society and altered the balance of military and regional power.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Taiping Rebellion

title.zh: 克里米亚战争

summary.zh: 俄国与奥斯曼帝国的争端升级为战争，英国、法国和撒丁王国随后站到奥斯曼一方。克里米亚半岛的围城与战斗造成严重损失，疾病和供应问题进一步暴露军队管理缺陷。新闻报道、摄影和护理改革让战争进入新的公共视野，战后俄国也加紧反思军事、交通与社会制度。
summary.en: Conflict between Russia and the Ottoman Empire drew in Britain, France and Sardinia on the Ottoman side. Fighting and siege warfare in Crimea caused heavy losses, compounded by disease and poor supply. Reporting, photography and nursing reform brought the war into public view, while Russia's defeat increased pressure for military, transport and social reform.

significance.zh: 战争动摇了欧洲旧有均势，并促进现代战争报道与军队医疗改革。
significance.en: The conflict unsettled Europe's balance of power and advanced war reporting and military medical reform.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Crimean War

title.zh: 加尔各答大学成立
title.en: Foundation of the University of Calcutta

summary.zh: 加尔各答大学依据殖民政府推动的高等教育计划成立，初期以伦敦大学为制度参照，组织考试、学位和附属学院体系。新的教育网络培养法律、行政、科学与文学人才，也为印度知识分子交流提供平台。随着学科与研究扩展，大学逐渐参与社会改革、科学创造和民族政治的公共讨论。
summary.en: The University of Calcutta was established under a colonial higher-education programme, initially following the University of London's examining and affiliation model. Its network trained professionals in administration, law, science and literature and created spaces for Indian intellectual exchange. Expanding disciplines and research later connected the university with social reform, scientific work and national politics.

significance.zh: 大学推动了南亚现代高等教育制度与跨学科知识网络的发展。
significance.en: The university helped develop modern South Asian higher education and interdisciplinary intellectual networks.

sources.title: University of Calcutta — Foundation of the University

title.zh: 印度起义与公司统治终结
title.en: Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

summary.zh: 印度士兵的兵变与地方社会对东印度公司统治的不满汇合，在北印度和中印度发展为广泛起义。各地参与者追求不同目标，既包括恢复旧权利，也包括反抗侵占和社会干预。英国镇压起义后，议会取消公司的统治权，由王室直接管理印度，并重新调整军队、土邦关系和殖民政策。
summary.en: A sepoy revolt combined with broader grievances against East India Company rule to produce uprisings across northern and central India. Participants pursued diverse aims, including restoration of rights and resistance to annexation and interference. After suppression, Britain transferred authority from the company to the Crown and reorganized the army, princely relations and colonial policy.

significance.zh: 起义终结了公司的直接统治，使英国在印度的殖民制度发生转型。
significance.en: The uprising ended direct company rule and transformed Britain's colonial institutions in India.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

title.zh: 《物种起源》出版
title.en: Publication of On the Origin of Species

summary.zh: 达尔文出版《物种起源》，综合自然观察、育种研究和长期通信，以自然选择解释生物适应与物种变化。华莱士此前独立提出相近思想，两人的论文曾共同发表。著作引发广泛科学与宗教讨论，进化研究随后同遗传学、生态学和化石证据结合，持续修正并扩展对生命历史的理解。
summary.en: Darwin's On the Origin of Species synthesized observations, breeding studies and correspondence to explain adaptation and evolutionary change through natural selection. Wallace had independently reached a similar idea, and their papers had been presented jointly. The book generated wide debate, while later genetics, ecology and fossil research expanded and refined evolutionary understanding.

significance.zh: 自然选择为解释生命多样性提供了能够检验和持续发展的机制。
significance.en: Natural selection offered a testable mechanism for explaining biological diversity and change.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of On the Origin of Species

title.zh: 俄国农奴解放改革

summary.zh: 亚历山大二世颁布农奴解放改革，结束私人庄园中大量农奴对地主的人身依附。农民获得法律身份与一定土地权利，但土地分配、赎买费用和村社安排仍限制生活改善。改革推动劳动力与市场关系变化，也留下土地不足和贫困问题，成为此后俄国政治争论与农村动荡的重要背景。
summary.en: Alexander II's emancipation reform ended personal bondage for millions of serfs on private estates. Peasants acquired legal standing and certain land rights, but allotments, redemption payments and communal arrangements constrained the benefits. The reform changed labour and market relationships while leaving land shortages and poverty that continued to shape Russian politics and rural unrest.

significance.zh: 农奴解放改变了帝国的社会基础，土地问题则继续推动后续改革与革命。
significance.en: Emancipation changed the empire's social foundations, while unresolved land questions drove later reform and revolution.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Emancipation of Russian serfs

title.zh: 美国内战与奴隶制废除
title.en: American Civil War and abolition of slavery

summary.zh: 奴隶制的扩张与存续引发日益激烈的政治冲突，南方各州脱离联邦后爆发内战。联邦军最终获胜，战争中的解放政策、被奴役者自我解放和黑人参军共同推动奴隶制瓦解。第十三修正案完成法律废奴，重建时期随后围绕公民身份、投票权和种族权力展开激烈斗争。
summary.en: Conflict over slavery's expansion and survival led southern states to secede and triggered civil war. Union victory, wartime emancipation policies, enslaved people's pursuit of freedom and Black military service together dismantled slavery. The Thirteenth Amendment established legal abolition, and Reconstruction brought further struggles over citizenship, voting rights and racial power.

significance.zh: 内战维护了联邦并废除奴隶制，重新界定了美国自由与公民权的政治议程。
significance.en: The war preserved the Union, abolished slavery and recast the political struggle over freedom and citizenship.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — American Civil War and abolition of slavery

title.zh: 红十字运动与第一部日内瓦公约
title.en: Red Cross movement and the first Geneva Convention

summary.zh: 索尔费里诺战场伤员的遭遇促使亨利·杜南倡议建立救援组织，日内瓦的委员会随后推动国际合作。各国于次年通过首部《日内瓦公约》，要求照顾伤员并保护医疗人员与设施。志愿救护、统一标志和国际条约相结合，成为红十字运动与现代战争人道规则的制度起点。
summary.en: The suffering of wounded soldiers at Solferino led Henry Dunant to advocate organized relief, and a Geneva committee promoted international cooperation. The first Geneva Convention followed in 1864, requiring care for wounded soldiers and protection for medical personnel and facilities. Volunteer relief, a recognized emblem and treaty obligations established foundations for the Red Cross movement.

significance.zh: 救援组织与国际公约开始共同承担减轻战争苦难的责任。
significance.en: Organized relief and international treaty obligations became complementary means of reducing wartime suffering.

sources.title: ICRC — Founding and early years

title.zh: 明治维新

summary.zh: 反幕府力量宣布恢复天皇统治，德川政权在政治重组与戊辰战争中瓦解。新政府随后推进废藩置县、征兵、学校教育和工业建设，逐渐把藩国分立的秩序改造为中央集权国家。改革改变了武士身份、税制和日常生活，也增强日本参与国际竞争及对外扩张的能力。
summary.en: Anti-shogunal forces proclaimed the restoration of imperial rule, and Tokugawa government collapsed through political realignment and the Boshin War. The new state abolished domains, introduced conscription, expanded schooling and promoted industry. These changes centralized government, transformed samurai status and taxation, and strengthened Japan's capacity for international competition and imperial expansion.

significance.zh: 明治改革重建了日本的国家制度，并加速其工业化与社会转型。
significance.en: Meiji reforms rebuilt Japan's state institutions and accelerated industrial and social transformation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Meiji Restoration

title.zh: 苏伊士运河通航

summary.zh: 苏伊士运河正式通航，在地中海与红海之间开辟直接航道，缩短欧洲与亚洲间多条海运路线。工程依靠大规模劳动力和国际资本，其融资又与埃及债务及欧洲干预相连。运河把全球航运集中到新的战略通道，埃及由此成为商业、军事和国家主权竞争的关键地区。
summary.en: The Suez Canal opened a direct passage between the Mediterranean and Red Sea, shortening many shipping routes between Europe and Asia. Construction drew on extensive labour and international capital, while financing became entangled with Egyptian debt and European intervention. The canal concentrated commerce along a new strategic corridor contested by states and empires.

significance.zh: 新航道重组了全球海运，也显著提高了埃及的战略地位。
significance.en: The canal reorganized world shipping and greatly increased Egypt's strategic importance.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Suez Canal

title.zh: 德意志帝国成立

summary.zh: 普鲁士在同丹麦、奥地利及法国的战争和外交竞争中扩大影响，最终推动多数德意志邦国统一。威廉一世在凡尔赛被宣布为德意志皇帝，新帝国保留联邦结构，却由普鲁士掌握主导地位。统一带来庞大的国内市场与强大工业国家，也使欧洲原有的力量平衡发生深刻变化。
summary.en: Prussia expanded its influence through wars and diplomacy involving Denmark, Austria and France, bringing most German states into a new empire. Wilhelm I was proclaimed emperor at Versailles. The empire retained a federal structure under Prussian predominance, combining a large internal market with industrial power and substantially altering Europe's balance of power.

significance.zh: 德国统一使一个新的工业与军事强国成为欧洲政治中心力量。
significance.en: Unification placed a new industrial and military power at the centre of European politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Proclamation of the German Empire

title.zh: 贝尔取得电话专利并传输语音
title.en: Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

summary.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔取得电话相关专利，并实现清晰语音的电传输。围绕电信技术已有多位发明者长期实验，电话随后通过交换台、线路建设和商业运营进入日常生活。实时远距离通话改变了企业组织、城市联系与私人交流，也使通信网络的投资和控制成为新的经济问题。
summary.en: Alexander Graham Bell obtained a telephone patent and demonstrated intelligible speech transmitted electrically. Building on experiments by several inventors, telephone service spread through exchanges, line construction and commercial operation. Real-time conversation over distance changed business organization, urban connections and personal communication, while network investment and control acquired growing economic importance.

significance.zh: 电话使远距离交流从文字电报扩展到即时语音，推动现代通信网络形成。
significance.en: The telephone extended long-distance communication into live speech and helped build modern communications networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

title.zh: 柏林会议与非洲殖民瓜分
title.en: Berlin Conference and colonial partition of Africa

summary.zh: 欧洲列强等国家在柏林讨论非洲贸易与殖民规则，确立刚果盆地商业安排及沿海占领通知、有效控制等原则。非洲社会未被平等纳入谈判，既有政治与土地权利遭到忽视。会议与随后各国的军事征服相互关联，加速了非洲殖民瓜分，并留下长期影响国家关系的边界与统治结构。
summary.en: European powers and other states met in Berlin to negotiate African trade and colonial rules, including arrangements for the Congo basin and principles governing coastal occupation. African societies had no equal voice in the negotiations. The conference and subsequent military conquests accelerated colonial partition, leaving boundaries and institutions with lasting consequences.

significance.zh: 会议为殖民扩张提供列强间的协调框架，加剧了非洲主权被剥夺的过程。
significance.en: The conference coordinated imperial expansion and intensified the loss of African sovereignty.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Berlin Conference and colonial partition of Africa

title.zh: 巴西废除奴隶制

summary.zh: 巴西颁布《黄金法》，废除国内奴隶制，结束美洲最后一个大规模合法奴隶制度。长期的黑人抵抗、逃亡、废奴组织活动和政治压力共同推动这一决定。解放后的黑人群体仍面临土地、教育和就业方面的排斥，争取平等的斗争继续影响巴西共和国的社会与政治发展。
summary.en: Brazil's Golden Law abolished slavery, ending the last major legal slave system in the Americas. Black resistance, flight, abolitionist organizing and political pressure all contributed to the decision. Emancipated communities continued to face exclusion from land, education and employment, and struggles for equality remained central to the society and politics of republican Brazil.

significance.zh: 废奴结束了巴西的法律奴役制度，并开启重塑自由劳动和公民权的长期过程。
significance.en: Abolition ended legal enslavement in Brazil and began a prolonged reworking of labour and citizenship.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Abolition of slavery in Brazil

title.zh: 新西兰妇女获得议会选举权
title.en: Women gain the parliamentary vote in New Zealand

summary.zh: 新西兰在长期妇女组织动员和大规模请愿后修改选举法，成年女性获得全国议会选举投票权。凯特·谢泼德等人的组织工作把禁酒、家庭生活与政治代表权问题联系起来，毛利女性也获得投票资格。女性参选议会的权利后来才确立，妇女政治参与由此逐步扩展。
summary.en: After sustained organizing and large petitions, New Zealand amended its electoral law to give adult women the vote in parliamentary elections. Campaigners including Kate Sheppard connected temperance, family concerns and political representation, and Māori women also gained voting eligibility. Eligibility to stand for Parliament came later as women's political participation continued to expand.

significance.zh: 新西兰成为妇女全国投票权的重要先例，鼓舞了其他国家的争取选举权运动。
significance.en: New Zealand established a landmark precedent for women's national voting rights and encouraged campaigns abroad.

sources.title: NZHistory — New Zealand women and the vote

title.zh: 阿杜瓦战役

summary.zh: 孟尼利克二世动员埃塞俄比亚各地力量，在阿杜瓦击败意大利入侵军。战争与双方对《乌查利条约》的不同解释及意大利殖民扩张有关，埃塞俄比亚利用外交、军备采购和大规模集结取得胜利。战后意大利承认埃塞俄比亚独立，这一结果在非洲与黑人侨民社会产生广泛回响。
summary.en: Menelik II mobilized forces from across Ethiopia and defeated an invading Italian army at Adwa. The conflict grew from disputes over the Treaty of Wuchale and Italian colonial ambitions. Diplomacy, arms purchases and large-scale mobilization contributed to victory, after which Italy recognized Ethiopian independence and the outcome resonated across Africa and its diaspora.

significance.zh: 阿杜瓦成为非洲成功抵抗欧洲殖民征服的鲜明象征。
significance.en: Adwa became a powerful symbol of successful African resistance to European colonial conquest.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Battle of Adwa

title.zh: 天然放射性的发现

summary.zh: 贝克勒尔研究铀盐时发现一种能够穿透物质并使感光板曝光的自发辐射。居里夫妇等研究者随后扩大实验，识别新的放射性元素并发展测量方法。研究表明原子内部存在此前未知的变化过程，为核物理、放射性测年与医学应用开辟道路，也逐渐引出对辐射伤害的认识。
summary.en: Becquerel discovered that uranium salts emitted spontaneous radiation capable of penetrating materials and exposing photographic plates. The Curies and other researchers extended the investigations, identified new radioactive elements and developed measurement methods. Radioactivity revealed unexpected processes within atoms, opening paths into nuclear physics, dating techniques and medicine while also exposing radiation's hazards.

significance.zh: 放射性研究突破了原子不可分的旧观念，开启核科学的新领域。
significance.en: Radioactivity challenged older ideas about indivisible atoms and opened the field of nuclear science.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physics 1903

title.zh: 菲律宾宣布独立

summary.zh: 菲律宾革命者在卡维特省卡维特镇宣布脱离西班牙，阿奎纳多领导的政府试图把反殖民战争转化为独立国家。此前的革命动员同美西战争相交，西班牙随后向美国转让对菲律宾的主权主张。菲律宾共和国与美国之间很快爆发战争，独立诉求继续塑造此后数十年的国家与社会发展。
summary.en: Filipino revolutionaries declared independence from Spain at Kawit, while Aguinaldo's government sought to turn anticolonial struggle into sovereign statehood. The revolution intersected with the Spanish–American War, after which Spain ceded its claim to the Philippines to the United States. War with American forces followed, and independence remained a central political demand.

significance.zh: 宣言成为菲律宾民族国家的重要象征，并揭示殖民帝国更替中的独立困境。
significance.en: The declaration became a national symbol and exposed the challenges of independence amid changing colonial powers.

sources.title: US Census Bureau — Philippines Independence Day (1898)

title.zh: 澳大利亚联邦成立

summary.zh: 澳大利亚六个英国殖民地在多轮会议与公民投票后联合为联邦，宪法开始生效。新制度在联邦政府和各州之间分配权力，同时保留同英国王室的联系。关税、国防和移民政策获得全国层面的安排，而原住民排斥及种族化移民限制也被带入联邦初期的国家建设。
summary.en: Six British colonies united as the Commonwealth of Australia after conventions and referendums. A new constitution divided powers between federal and state governments while retaining ties to the British Crown. Customs, defence and immigration acquired national institutions, but Indigenous exclusion and racial immigration restrictions also became part of the early federation's political order.

significance.zh: 联邦建立了现代澳大利亚的国家框架，并留下持续发展的权利与自治议题。
significance.en: Federation established modern Australia's national framework and enduring debates over rights and self-government.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Federation

title.zh: 爱因斯坦的奇迹年论文

summary.zh: 爱因斯坦在同一年发表多篇论文，讨论光量子、布朗运动、狭义相对论以及质量与能量的关系。他从看似不同的问题出发，重新考察光、物质、时间和测量之间的联系。这些成果随后经过实验检验与理论发展，成为量子物理和相对论的重要基础，改变了二十世纪的科学图景。
summary.en: Einstein published papers on light quanta, Brownian motion, special relativity and the relation between mass and energy in the same year. Starting from different physical problems, he reconsidered connections among light, matter, time and measurement. Subsequent experiments and theoretical developments made these works foundational to quantum physics and relativity.

significance.zh: 这些论文为微观世界与时空观念带来突破，推动现代物理学形成。
significance.en: The papers transformed ideas about matter and spacetime and helped establish modern physics.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Albert Einstein, biographical

title.zh: 墨西哥革命

summary.zh: 反对迪亚斯长期统治的起义发展为墨西哥革命，农民、工人、地方武装和政治精英提出不同改革目标。萨帕塔等力量要求土地归还，宪政派则重建国家权力。一九一七年宪法纳入土地、劳动和国家资源权利，长期战争之后，新政治秩序在社会改革与集权之间逐渐形成。
summary.en: Revolt against Porfirio Díaz's long rule developed into the Mexican Revolution, bringing together peasants, workers, regional armies and political elites with competing aims. Zapatistas demanded land restitution, while constitutionalists rebuilt state power. The 1917 constitution addressed land, labour and national resources, and a new order emerged from years of warfare and social reform.

significance.zh: 革命把土地与劳动权利写入国家建设议程，重塑了现代墨西哥。
significance.en: The revolution placed land and labour rights at the centre of modern Mexican state-building.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Mexican Revolution

title.zh: 辛亥革命与清朝终结
title.en: Xinhai Revolution and the end of Qing rule

summary.zh: 武昌起义后，多省宣布脱离清朝，革命派与地方实力者推动共和政体的建立。中华民国临时政府随后成立，清帝于次年退位，延续两千多年的皇帝制度告终。政权转移也伴随妥协和权力竞争，共和宪政、国家统一与社会改革成为此后中国政治持续面对的核心问题。
summary.en: The Wuchang uprising prompted provinces to break with Qing rule, while revolutionaries and regional leaders promoted a republic. A provisional republican government formed, and the emperor abdicated the following year. Compromise and power struggles shaped the transition, leaving constitutional government, national unity and social reform at the centre of China's political agenda.

significance.zh: 辛亥革命结束帝制，使共和国家成为中国政治实践的新方向。
significance.en: The revolution ended imperial monarchy and established republican statehood as a new political direction in China.

sources.title: 故宫博物院 — 辛亥革命 / Palace Museum — Xinhai Revolution

title.zh: 泰戈尔获得诺贝尔文学奖
title.en: Tagore receives the Nobel Prize in Literature

summary.zh: 泰戈尔凭借诗歌及其英文译写获得诺贝尔文学奖，使孟加拉文学在国际读者中受到广泛关注。他的创作涉及诗、小说、戏剧和音乐，并同教育实验、社会批评及跨文化交往相联系。获奖后的国际传播既扩大印度文学的可见度，也使翻译如何塑造不同文化的理解成为值得讨论的问题。
summary.en: Tagore received the Nobel Prize in Literature as his poetry and English renderings attracted international readers. His work spanned poems, fiction, drama and music and connected with educational experimentation, social criticism and cross-cultural exchange. Recognition broadened the visibility of Bengali and Indian literature and highlighted translation's role in shaping understanding between cultures.

significance.zh: 泰戈尔的国际传播扩大了南亚文学参与世界文化对话的空间。
significance.en: Tagore's international reception widened the place of South Asian literature in global cultural exchange.

sources.title: NobelPrize.org — Tagore and his India, by Amartya Sen

title.zh: 巴拿马运河通航

summary.zh: 巴拿马运河通航，以船闸系统连接大西洋与太平洋，缩短美洲两侧及全球多条海运路线。工程在法国早期失败后由美国完成，涉及疾病防治、巨额投资和来自多地的劳工。美国对运河区的控制使航运基础设施与国家主权紧密相连，后来成为巴拿马外交和社会动员的焦点。
summary.en: The Panama Canal opened, linking the Atlantic and Pacific through a lock system and shortening major shipping routes. The United States completed the project after an earlier French failure, drawing on disease control, extensive capital and international labour. American control of the Canal Zone made the waterway a central issue in Panamanian sovereignty and diplomacy.

significance.zh: 运河重组了全球航运，也把巴拿马置于长期的主权与战略竞争之中。
significance.en: The canal reorganized shipping and placed Panama at the centre of enduring sovereignty and strategic disputes.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Panama Canal

title.zh: 第一次世界大战

summary.zh: 萨拉热窝刺杀事件引发外交危机，欧洲联盟体系与军事动员使危机升级为大规模战争。战事波及殖民地和海洋，工业化武器、堑壕作战与全面动员造成巨大伤亡。战争结束时，多个帝国崩溃，新国家和革命政权出现；和平安排与未解决的民族问题继续影响此后的国际秩序。
summary.en: The Sarajevo assassination triggered a diplomatic crisis that escalated through alliances and military mobilization. War spread across colonies and oceans, while industrial weapons, trench warfare and mass mobilization produced immense losses. Several empires collapsed, new states and revolutionary governments emerged, and unresolved national questions complicated the peace settlements that followed.

significance.zh: 第一次世界大战摧毁旧帝国秩序，并为二十世纪的革命与国际冲突奠定背景。
significance.en: The war destroyed imperial orders and shaped the setting for twentieth-century revolutions and international conflicts.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — First World War

title.zh: 俄国二月与十月革命

summary.zh: 战争、粮食短缺与政治失信促使俄国二月革命推翻沙皇，临时政府与苏维埃并存的局面随之出现。持续战争和土地问题削弱临时政府，布尔什维克在十月革命中夺取中央权力。随后展开的内战与制度重建，最终形成新的社会主义国家，也使革命思想成为全球政治竞争的重要力量。
summary.en: War, food shortages and collapsing political authority brought down the tsar in the February Revolution. The provisional government shared power uneasily with soviets, while continued war and land disputes weakened its position. Bolshevik seizure of power in October led to civil war and the construction of a socialist state with worldwide ideological influence.

significance.zh: 俄国革命把社会主义革命转化为国家制度，并改变全球政治对立的结构。
significance.en: The revolutions turned socialist revolution into a state system and reshaped global political conflict.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Russian revolutions of 1917

title.zh: 一九一八年流感大流行

summary.zh: 一种甲型流感病毒在第一次世界大战末期迅速传播，军队调动、人口密集与跨洋交通加快了感染。疫情分多轮席卷世界，造成极其严重的死亡和社会停摆，青壮年群体也受到突出影响。各地采取隔离、限制集会和公共卫生宣传等措施，这场灾难深刻暴露了战争时期医疗与信息体系的脆弱。
summary.en: An influenza A virus spread rapidly near the end of the First World War, aided by troop movements, crowded settlements and overseas transport. Successive waves caused extraordinary mortality and social disruption, including severe losses among young adults. Quarantine, gathering restrictions and health campaigns exposed the limits of wartime medical and information systems.

significance.zh: 流感大流行显示传染病能够跨越国界，并推动公共卫生经验的积累。
significance.en: The pandemic demonstrated the transnational reach of infectious disease and shaped public-health experience.

sources.title: CDC archive — 1918 Pandemic (H1N1 virus)

title.zh: 朝鲜三一运动

summary.zh: 朝鲜独立宣言公布后，学生、宗教人士和各地居民举行大规模示威，要求摆脱日本殖民统治。运动跨越城乡并遭到严厉镇压，许多参与者被捕或遇害。三一运动扩大了民族动员，推动海外独立组织的整合，也促使殖民当局调整部分统治方式，而争取独立的行动继续发展。
summary.en: After a Korean declaration of independence, students, religious figures and local residents organized mass demonstrations against Japanese colonial rule. Protests spread through towns and villages and faced severe repression. The movement broadened nationalist mobilization, encouraged coordination among overseas independence groups and prompted some changes in colonial administration while resistance continued.

significance.zh: 三一运动成为朝鲜半岛民族独立运动的重要转折与共同记忆。
significance.en: The March First Movement became a major turning point and shared memory in Korean independence struggles.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Korean March First Movement

title.zh: 五四运动

summary.zh: 巴黎和会关于山东权益的安排激起中国学生抗议，北京示威随后扩展为跨地区的罢课、罢工和抵制日货行动。反帝诉求与新文化运动中的思想讨论汇合，青年、知识分子和工商业群体进入政治公共空间。白话文、科学与民主等议题进一步传播，多种社会改革和革命思潮也获得新的支持。
summary.en: The Paris Peace Conference's treatment of Shandong provoked Chinese student protests that expanded into strikes and boycotts. Anti-imperial demands intersected with the New Culture Movement, bringing students, intellectuals and commercial groups into public politics. Vernacular writing, science and democracy gained wider discussion, while competing reformist and revolutionary ideas attracted new supporters.

significance.zh: 五四运动把文化革新与群众政治联系起来，深刻影响现代中国思想与组织形态。
significance.en: The movement linked cultural renewal with mass politics and shaped modern Chinese thought and organization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — May Fourth Movement

title.zh: 《凡尔赛条约》签署

summary.zh: 协约国与德国在凡尔赛签订和约，规定领土调整、军备限制、赔偿安排和战争责任，并将国际联盟盟约纳入条约。谈判受到安全需求、民族自决和国内政治压力的共同影响。德国社会对条约强烈不满，其他地区的自决要求也未得到一致回应，战后秩序因而留下多重争议。
summary.en: The Allies and Germany signed a treaty at Versailles establishing territorial changes, military restrictions, reparations and war-responsibility provisions, alongside the League of Nations covenant. Security concerns, national self-determination and domestic pressures shaped negotiations. German resentment and uneven treatment of self-determination elsewhere left the postwar settlement burdened with unresolved disputes.

significance.zh: 条约建立了第一次世界大战后的重要规则，也留下脆弱的安全与合法性问题。
significance.en: The treaty established major postwar rules while leaving unresolved problems of security and political legitimacy.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Treaty of Versailles

title.zh: 国际联盟成立
title.en: Establishment of the League of Nations

summary.zh: 国际联盟在第一次世界大战后的和平安排中成立，试图通过集体安全、仲裁和国际合作减少战争。联盟开展卫生、难民与社会事务工作，并处理若干争端，但美国未加入、列强利益分歧及执行能力薄弱限制了成效。面对三十年代的侵略扩张，联盟的集体安全体系逐渐失灵。
summary.en: The League of Nations emerged from the postwar settlement to promote collective security, arbitration and international cooperation. It undertook work on health, refugees and social issues and helped settle some disputes. American non-membership, conflicting great-power interests and weak enforcement limited its effectiveness, especially against the aggressive expansion of the 1930s.

significance.zh: 国联积累了多边治理经验，其成就与失败共同影响联合国的设计。
significance.en: The League's achievements and failures supplied experience that later influenced the United Nations.

sources.title: UN Geneva — League of Nations overview

title.zh: 胰岛素由实验研究走向临床治疗
title.en: Insulin moves from research to treatment

summary.zh: 多伦多研究团队在既有胰腺研究基础上推进胰岛素提取，班廷、贝斯特、麦克劳德和科利普分别参与实验、支持与提纯工作。经过改进的制剂进入临床，使严重糖尿病患者的病情显著改善。研究随后同生产和分发体系衔接，把常常致命的疾病转变为可以长期管理的状况，改变了患者与家庭生活。
summary.en: Toronto researchers developed insulin extraction from earlier pancreatic research, with Banting, Best, Macleod and Collip contributing experiments, laboratory support and purification. Improved preparations entered clinical use and dramatically benefited people with severe diabetes. Production and distribution turned a frequently fatal condition into one that could be managed over time, transforming patients' and families' lives.

significance.zh: 胰岛素治疗成为实验室发现、临床研究与药物生产结合的重大成果。
significance.en: Insulin therapy became a major achievement linking laboratory investigation, clinical research and pharmaceutical production.

sources.title: University of Toronto Libraries — Discovery and Early Development of Insulin

title.zh: 图坦卡蒙墓的现代考古发现
title.en: Modern archaeological discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb

summary.zh: 霍华德·卡特团队在帝王谷发现图坦卡蒙墓入口，随后对墓室和随葬品展开多年清理与记录。保存丰富的物品为研究古埃及王室生活、宗教和工艺提供大量材料。发现引发全球关注，也置身于埃及争取文物控制与民族自主的时代背景，使考古学、博物馆收藏和文化所有权相互交织。
summary.en: Howard Carter's team located Tutankhamun's tomb in the Valley of the Kings and began years of excavation and documentation. Its rich contents provided evidence of Egyptian royal life, religion and craftsmanship. Worldwide interest coincided with Egyptian demands for cultural authority, bringing archaeology, museum collecting and ownership of antiquities into close political relationship.

significance.zh: 墓葬发现扩展了古埃及研究，也推动了关于文化遗产归属的公共讨论。
significance.en: The discovery expanded Egyptology and sharpened public debate over the ownership of cultural heritage.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Modern archaeological discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb

title.zh: 土耳其共和国成立
title.en: Proclamation of the Republic of Turkey

summary.zh: 奥斯曼帝国战败与解体后，土耳其民族运动通过战争和外交确立新的国家地位，共和国在安卡拉成立。穆斯塔法·凯末尔领导的政府随后推进世俗化、教育、法律和文字改革，重塑国家与社会关系。新的共和国制度同战争造成的人口迁移和帝国遗产一道，塑造了现代土耳其。
summary.en: After Ottoman defeat and disintegration, the Turkish nationalist movement secured a new state through war and diplomacy and proclaimed a republic at Ankara. Mustafa Kemal's government pursued secularization and reforms in education, law and writing. Republican institutions, wartime population displacement and the Ottoman inheritance together shaped modern Turkey.

significance.zh: 共和国的建立结束奥斯曼王朝政治，并开启广泛的国家与社会改革。
significance.en: The republic ended Ottoman dynastic politics and launched extensive state and social reforms.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Proclamation of the Republic of Turkey

title.zh: 拉曼与同事发现新的光散射现象
title.en: Raman and colleagues discover shifted light scattering

summary.zh: 拉曼与克里希南等人在加尔各答研究光通过物质后的散射，发现部分散射光的频率发生变化。这种现象揭示光与分子能量交换的机制，为识别物质结构提供新方法。随后发展的拉曼光谱广泛应用于物理、化学和材料研究，成果也展示了殖民时期印度本土研究机构的科学创造力。
summary.en: Raman, Krishnan and colleagues in Calcutta observed that a small fraction of scattered light changed frequency after passing through matter. The effect revealed energy exchange between light and molecules and provided a new way to investigate structure. Raman spectroscopy subsequently developed across physics, chemistry and materials research, demonstrating the achievements of India's scientific institutions.

significance.zh: 拉曼效应为物质分析提供重要工具，并成为印度现代科学史的关键成果。
significance.en: The Raman effect became a powerful analytical tool and a landmark of modern Indian science.

sources.title: NobelPrize.org — C. V. Raman Nobel Lecture

title.zh: 青霉素的发现与临床发展
title.en: Discovery and clinical development of penicillin

summary.zh: 弗莱明观察到青霉菌抑制细菌生长，发现青霉素的抗菌作用。十余年后，弗洛里、钱恩等团队推进提纯和临床研究，战时国际合作又解决大规模生产问题。药物由实验室现象转为广泛使用的治疗手段，显著改善细菌感染的治疗，并推动抗生素研发和制药工业发展。
summary.en: Fleming observed that a mould inhibited bacterial growth and identified penicillin's antibacterial action. More than a decade later, teams including Florey and Chain advanced purification and clinical research, while wartime cooperation enabled mass production. A laboratory observation became a widely used treatment, transforming the management of bacterial infections and stimulating antibiotic research.

significance.zh: 青霉素的临床推广开启抗生素时代，改变了现代医疗的能力与组织。
significance.en: Penicillin's clinical adoption opened the antibiotic era and transformed the capabilities of modern medicine.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physiology or Medicine 1945

title.zh: 世界经济大萧条

summary.zh: 美国金融市场崩溃与银行危机加深经济衰退，信用收缩、贸易下降和政策失误使危机扩展到世界。工厂停产、农业价格下跌和失业冲击家庭生活，各国尝试公共工程、福利、货币和贸易政策回应。危机改变了国家与市场的关系，也加剧社会不安，为多种政治动员提供土壤。
summary.en: Financial collapse and banking crises in the United States intensified an economic downturn that spread through credit contraction, falling trade and policy failures. Factory closures, agricultural price declines and unemployment devastated households. Governments experimented with public works, welfare and monetary policies, changing state–market relations while social insecurity strengthened competing political movements.

significance.zh: 大萧条动摇自由放任政策，并促使各国重新考虑经济干预与社会保障。
significance.en: The Depression challenged laissez-faire policies and expanded debate over economic intervention and social protection.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Great Depression

title.zh: 印度食盐进军

summary.zh: 甘地带领追随者从萨巴尔马蒂前往丹迪海岸，以制盐行动挑战英国殖民政府的食盐垄断。容易理解的日常生活议题激发广泛参与，运动随后发展为全国性的公民不服从。镇压与逮捕扩大国际关注，印度民族运动也借此把非暴力抵抗、群众组织与争取自治的政治目标联系起来。
summary.en: Gandhi led followers from Sabarmati to Dandi, where making salt challenged the British colonial salt monopoly. An issue rooted in everyday life attracted broad participation and developed into nationwide civil disobedience. Arrests and repression drew international attention, linking nonviolent resistance and mass organization to the Indian movement for self-government.

significance.zh: 食盐进军把日常经济负担转化为群众能够参与的反殖民政治行动。
significance.en: The Salt March turned an everyday economic burden into a widely accessible form of anticolonial action.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Salt March

title.zh: 日本占领中国东北

summary.zh: 日本关东军以九一八事变为借口展开军事行动，迅速扩大对中国东北的占领，并于次年扶植伪满洲国。侵略改变了东北的政治、经济和社会结构，殖民工业开发与强制控制并行。中国各类抗日抵抗持续发展，国际联盟的调查与谴责则暴露了集体安全机制制止侵略的能力不足。
summary.en: Japan's Kwantung Army used the Mukden Incident as a pretext to occupy northeastern China and establish Manchukuo the following year. Colonial industrial development accompanied coercive political and social control. Chinese resistance continued, while League of Nations investigation and condemnation exposed the weakness of collective security in restraining aggression.

significance.zh: 东北被占领成为日本扩大侵华战争与国际秩序危机的重要开端。
significance.en: The occupation marked a major stage in Japanese aggression against China and the crisis of international order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Japanese occupation of Manchuria

title.zh: 暹罗转向君主立宪

summary.zh: 由军人和文职人员组成的人民党在曼谷采取行动，迫使暹罗王室接受君主立宪。临时宪法和议会随后建立，国家权力的合法性开始以人民与成文制度重新表述。转型内部包含不同政治愿景，军方、王室与文官精英之间的竞争持续发展，成为现代泰国政治的重要历史背景。
summary.en: A coalition of military officers and civilians known as the People's Party forced Siam's monarchy to accept constitutional government. A temporary constitution and assembly followed, recasting political legitimacy around the people and written institutions. Competing visions persisted among military, royal and civilian elites, shaping the subsequent development of Thai politics.

significance.zh: 一九三二年的转型结束绝对君主制，并开启泰国持续的宪政与权力分配争论。
significance.en: The transition ended absolute monarchy and opened Thailand's continuing constitutional and power-sharing debates.

sources.title: Parliament of Thailand — History of the National Assembly

title.zh: 纳粹在德国建立独裁统治
title.en: Establishment of Nazi dictatorship in Germany

summary.zh: 希特勒被任命为德国总理后，纳粹利用紧急法令、政治暴力和《授权法》摧毁议会民主。反对党、工会和公民自由遭到压制，种族主义被纳入国家制度，犹太人等群体受到日益严厉的迫害。独裁巩固与重新武装相互推进，最终通向侵略战争和由国家组织的种族灭绝。
summary.en: After Hitler became chancellor, the Nazis used emergency decrees, political violence and the Enabling Act to dismantle parliamentary democracy. Opposition parties, unions and civil liberties were suppressed, while racial ideology became state policy and persecution intensified. Dictatorial consolidation and rearmament developed together, leading toward aggressive war and state-organized genocide.

significance.zh: 纳粹掌权展示了民主制度被迅速摧毁的过程，并为战争与大屠杀铺平道路。
significance.en: Nazi consolidation destroyed democratic institutions and prepared the machinery of war and genocide.

sources.title: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — Nazi rise to power

title.zh: 中国全面抗日战争爆发

summary.zh: 卢沟桥冲突后，日本侵华战争全面扩大，中国进入长期全面抗战。南京、上海、武汉等地相继遭受战争打击，政府、工业和人口向内地迁移。国民党、共产党及各地社会力量以不同方式参与抵抗，中国战场后来与太平洋战争相连，平民承受占领、屠杀、轰炸、饥荒和流离之苦。
summary.en: After fighting at the Marco Polo Bridge, Japan expanded its invasion and China entered full-scale resistance. Warfare devastated major cities and drove governments, industries and civilians inland. Nationalist, Communist and local forces resisted in different ways, while the Chinese theatre later merged with the Pacific War and civilians endured occupation, massacres, bombing, famine and displacement.

significance.zh: 中国抗战成为第二次世界大战亚洲战场的核心，并深刻重塑中国社会与国家。
significance.en: China's resistance became central to the Asian theatre of the Second World War and transformed Chinese society.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Outbreak of full-scale Sino-Japanese War

title.zh: 第二次世界大战

summary.zh: 德国入侵波兰使欧洲战争全面爆发，战事随后同亚洲既有冲突汇合，扩展为全球战争。轴心国侵略、纳粹大屠杀、大规模轰炸和占领暴力造成空前苦难。盟国最终获胜，欧洲殖民强国衰弱，美苏地位上升，联合国建立，战后重建、去殖民化与冷战开始塑造新的世界秩序。
summary.en: Germany's invasion of Poland opened full-scale war in Europe, which later converged with existing Asian conflicts. Axis aggression, the Holocaust, mass bombing and occupation violence caused unprecedented suffering. Allied victory weakened European colonial powers, elevated the United States and Soviet Union, and brought reconstruction, decolonization, the United Nations and Cold War rivalry.

significance.zh: 第二次世界大战重组全球权力，并留下人权、战争责任与国际安全的持久议题。
significance.en: The war reordered global power and left enduring questions of human rights, responsibility and international security.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Second World War

title.zh: 广岛与长崎原子弹轰炸
title.en: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

summary.zh: 美国在广岛和长崎投下原子弹，爆炸、热辐射与后续辐射伤害造成大量平民死亡，幸存者长期承受健康与社会影响。轰炸发生在太平洋战争最后阶段，同苏联对日参战等事态一起构成日本投降的背景。核武器的毁灭能力随后成为冷战威慑、裁军运动与国际安全讨论的中心。
summary.en: The United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, causing mass civilian deaths through blast, heat and radiation and leaving survivors with lasting consequences. The attacks occurred in the final stage of the Pacific War alongside Soviet entry against Japan. Nuclear destruction subsequently became central to deterrence, disarmament and international security.

significance.zh: 原子弹轰炸开启核武器时代，使战争的毁灭规模与人道后果发生质变。
significance.en: The bombings opened the nuclear-weapons era and transformed the scale and humanitarian consequences of warfare.

sources.title: United Nations — History of nuclear testing and the beginning of the nuclear era

title.zh: 奥斯维辛集中营解放

summary.zh: 苏联军队进入奥斯维辛集中营及灭绝营体系，发现被遗留的囚犯与纳粹罪行证据。此前纳粹已强迫大量囚犯撤离，死亡行军造成进一步伤亡。营地见证了对犹太人的系统性灭绝，以及对罗姆人、波兰人和其他群体的迫害；幸存者证言与保存遗址后来成为大屠杀研究和纪念的核心。
summary.en: Soviet forces reached Auschwitz and found prisoners left behind alongside evidence of Nazi crimes. Earlier forced evacuations had sent many prisoners on deadly marches. The camp complex witnessed the systematic murder of Jews and persecution of Roma, Poles and others; survivor testimony and the preserved site became central to Holocaust research and remembrance.

significance.zh: 解放使部分幸存者获得救援，也让纳粹灭绝体系的证据逐步呈现于世。
significance.en: Liberation rescued surviving prisoners and exposed evidence of the Nazi system of extermination.

sources.title: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — Auschwitz

title.zh: 联合国成立

summary.zh: 各国代表在旧金山制定并签署《联合国宪章》，联合国于同年正式成立。新组织吸取国联经验，建立大会、安全理事会及其他机构，承担维护和平、促进合作与发展等职责。常任理事国否决权体现大国妥协，组织运作也始终受到成员国利益、资源和国际政治环境的影响。
summary.en: Delegates drafted and signed the United Nations Charter in San Francisco, and the organization formally came into existence later that year. Drawing on League experience, it created the General Assembly, Security Council and other institutions for peace, cooperation and development. The permanent-member veto embodied great-power compromise, while operations depended on members and international politics.

significance.zh: 联合国为战后多边外交、国际规范与全球合作建立了持续运作的框架。
significance.en: The United Nations created an enduring framework for multilateral diplomacy, international norms and global cooperation.

sources.title: United Nations — History of the UN

title.zh: 印度尼西亚宣布独立并争取主权
title.en: Indonesian independence and struggle for sovereignty

summary.zh: 日本投降后，苏加诺与哈达宣布印度尼西亚独立，新的共和国开始组织政府与抵抗力量。荷兰试图恢复殖民统治，战争与多轮谈判随之展开，国际压力逐渐增加。一九四九年的主权移交确认新的国家安排，革命和外交共同奠定印度尼西亚国家建设的基础，也留下领土与权力整合问题。
summary.en: After Japan's surrender, Sukarno and Hatta proclaimed Indonesian independence and organized republican institutions. Dutch attempts to restore colonial authority led to war, negotiations and increasing international pressure. The 1949 transfer of sovereignty established new state arrangements, while revolution and diplomacy laid foundations for nation-building and left further questions of territorial and political integration.

significance.zh: 独立革命使群岛摆脱荷兰殖民统治，并成为亚洲去殖民化的重要进程。
significance.en: The revolution ended Dutch colonial rule and became a major process in Asian decolonization.

sources.title: Nationaal Archief — Sovereignty transfer to Indonesia, 1949

title.zh: 印度独立与印巴分治

summary.zh: 英国结束对印度的殖民统治，印度与巴基斯坦独立，边界划分将旁遮普和孟加拉等地区分割。宗教社群间的暴力、大规模迁徙及行政崩溃给数百万家庭带来创伤。独立国家随后建设各自制度，而难民安置、少数群体权利与克什米尔等争端持续影响南亚社会与国家关系。
summary.en: British colonial rule ended as India and Pakistan became independent, with partition dividing Punjab, Bengal and other territories. Communal violence, mass migration and administrative breakdown traumatized millions of families. The new states built their institutions while refugee settlement, minority rights and disputes including Kashmir continued to shape South Asian societies and interstate relations.

significance.zh: 独立实现了殖民统治的终结，分治则留下持久的人口与地缘政治后果。
significance.en: Independence ended colonial rule, while partition left lasting demographic and geopolitical consequences.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian independence and Partition

title.zh: 贝尔实验室制成晶体管

summary.zh: 巴丁与布拉顿在贝尔实验室制成点接触晶体管，利用半导体实现电信号放大，肖克利随后发展结型器件。新元件逐步替代体积大、耗电高的电子管，推动设备缩小和可靠性提高。制造工艺与电路设计继续发展，晶体管成为通信、计算机和消费电子产品的基础部件，开启电子技术的新阶段。
summary.en: Bardeen and Brattain demonstrated a point-contact transistor at Bell Labs, using a semiconductor to amplify signals; Shockley subsequently developed the junction transistor. These devices gradually replaced bulky, power-hungry vacuum tubes, enabling smaller and more reliable equipment. Advances in fabrication and circuit design made transistors fundamental to communications, computers and consumer electronics.

significance.zh: 晶体管为电子设备的小型化、集成电路与现代数字计算奠定了基础。
significance.en: The transistor laid foundations for miniaturization, integrated circuits and modern digital computing.

sources.title: Computer History Museum — Inventing the Transistor

title.zh: 《世界人权宣言》通过
title.en: Adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights

summary.zh: 联合国大会在巴黎通过《世界人权宣言》，以人的尊严为基础列出公民、政治、经济、社会和文化权利。来自不同地区的起草者在战争暴行与殖民秩序仍存的背景下寻求共同原则。宣言随后影响国际条约、国家宪法和社会运动，成为人们评价国家行为与提出权利诉求的重要语言。
summary.en: The UN General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in Paris, articulating civil, political, economic, social and cultural rights grounded in human dignity. Drafters from different regions sought shared principles after wartime atrocities and amid continuing colonial rule. The declaration subsequently influenced treaties, constitutions and social movements throughout the world.

significance.zh: 宣言为跨国人权讨论提供共同参照，并推动后续法律与社会实践。
significance.en: The declaration supplied a shared reference for human-rights claims and influenced later law and activism.

sources.title: United Nations — Universal Declaration of Human Rights

title.zh: 锡兰取得独立

summary.zh: 锡兰通过宪政谈判取得独立，以英联邦自治领身份结束英国殖民统治，森纳那亚克领导新政府。国家继承议会制度，并开始自主处理经济、教育与外交事务。独立后的公民身份、语言和族群关系逐渐成为政治核心，种植园劳工与少数群体权利等议题对后来的斯里兰卡产生深远影响。
summary.en: Ceylon gained independence through constitutional negotiations as a dominion within the Commonwealth, with D. S. Senanayake leading the government. Parliamentary institutions supported new authority over economic, educational and foreign affairs. Citizenship, language and ethnic relationships became central political questions, including the rights of plantation workers and minority communities in the future Sri Lanka.

significance.zh: 独立开启锡兰自主国家建设，也使多族群社会的公民权问题成为长期政治挑战。
significance.en: Independence opened sovereign state-building and enduring questions of citizenship in a multiethnic society.

sources.title: Sri Lanka National Archives — Dominion Status

title.zh: 伊巴丹大学学院成立

summary.zh: 伊巴丹大学学院在尼日利亚成立，初期通过同伦敦大学的特别联系提供高等教育。学校开设文科、科学和医学课程，回应当地社会长期要求在非洲获得大学训练的诉求。随着独立运动和学术本土化发展，校园成为教育、文学与非洲历史研究的重要空间，并于一九六二年取得独立大学地位。
summary.en: University College Ibadan opened in Nigeria with a special relationship to the University of London. Arts, science and medical programmes answered longstanding demands for university training in Africa. As independence and intellectual localization advanced, the campus became important for education, literature and African historical research, gaining independent university status in 1962.

significance.zh: 伊巴丹扩大了尼日利亚本土高等教育能力，并为去殖民化时期的知识生产提供基地。
significance.en: Ibadan expanded Nigerian higher education and supported intellectual production during decolonization.

sources.title: University of Ibadan — History

title.zh: 以色列建国、战争与巴勒斯坦人大流离
title.en: Israel’s foundation, war and the Palestinian Nakba

summary.zh: 英国结束巴勒斯坦委任统治后，以色列宣布建国，此前的社群冲突扩大为以色列与周边阿拉伯国家的战争。大量巴勒斯坦人逃离或被驱逐，村镇生活与社会网络遭到破坏，这一灾难被称为“纳克巴”。战争确立以色列的国家地位，也留下难民、边界和巴勒斯坦国家诉求等长期未决问题。
summary.en: As Britain's Palestine mandate ended, Israel declared independence and existing communal fighting expanded into war with neighbouring Arab states. Large numbers of Palestinians fled or were expelled, with communities and social networks shattered in what Palestinians call the Nakba. The war consolidated Israeli statehood and left unresolved issues of refugees, borders and Palestinian national aspirations.

significance.zh: 同一历史转折同时包含以色列建国与巴勒斯坦社会的大规模流离。
significance.en: The same historical turning point combined Israeli statehood with mass Palestinian displacement.

sources.title: United Nations — History of the Question of Palestine

title.zh: 中华人民共和国成立
title.en: Foundation of the People’s Republic of China

summary.zh: 中国共产党在内战中取得决定性优势后，中华人民共和国在北京宣布成立，新的中央政府逐步建立全国治理体系。土地改革、经济恢复与制度重组改变了社会关系，中国的国际联系也在冷战格局中重新安排。国民党政府退往台湾，两岸此后形成分治局面，相关政治问题持续影响地区关系。
summary.en: After decisive Communist victories in the Chinese Civil War, the People's Republic of China was proclaimed in Beijing. The new government developed national institutions through land reform, economic recovery and political reorganization, while foreign relations were reshaped within the Cold War. The Nationalist government withdrew to Taiwan, establishing a continuing cross-strait division.

significance.zh: 新政权的成立重塑中国国家制度，并改变东亚与全球冷战格局。
significance.en: The new state transformed China's institutions and altered East Asian and global Cold War politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Foundation of the People’s Republic of China

title.zh: 朝鲜战争

summary.zh: 朝鲜半岛在战后分裂的基础上爆发全面战争，朝鲜军队南进后，美国主导的联合国军与中国人民志愿军相继参战。战线反复推进，大规模轰炸和地面战斗造成严重平民损失。停战协定结束主要战事，军事分界线与非军事区形成，半岛分裂和安全对立则延续至战后。
summary.en: Full-scale war broke out on the divided Korean peninsula when North Korean forces advanced south. US-led UN forces and Chinese forces subsequently intervened. Shifting fronts, bombing and ground fighting caused devastating civilian losses. An armistice ended major combat and established a demarcation line and demilitarized zone, while division and security confrontation persisted.

significance.zh: 朝鲜战争使冷战在东亚军事化，并巩固了半岛长期分裂的格局。
significance.en: The war militarized the Cold War in East Asia and entrenched Korea's division.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Korean War

title.zh: DNA双螺旋结构模型

summary.zh: 沃森与克里克提出DNA双螺旋结构模型，解释碱基配对如何为遗传信息的复制提供机制。模型建立在化学约束及富兰克林、威尔金斯等人的X射线衍射研究之上。此后实验逐步阐明复制、转录和遗传密码，分子生物学迅速发展，并改变医学、农业与生物技术的研究方向。
summary.en: Watson and Crick proposed a double-helical model of DNA that suggested how complementary bases could support replication. Chemical constraints and X-ray diffraction research by Franklin, Wilkins and others were crucial to its development. Later experiments elucidated replication, transcription and the genetic code, accelerating molecular biology and changing medicine, agriculture and biotechnology.

significance.zh: DNA结构把遗传现象与分子机制联系起来，推动生命科学进入新的研究阶段。
significance.en: DNA's structure connected inheritance with molecular mechanisms and opened a new phase of biological research.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physiology or Medicine 1962

title.zh: 阿尔及利亚独立

summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线发动反殖民战争，农村游击、城市行动和法国军事镇压使冲突不断升级。战争涉及酷刑、迁移和严重平民伤亡，也在法国国内引发政治危机。埃维昂协议与独立公民投票结束法国统治，独立国家随后面对重建、权力整合及殖民战争留下的社会创伤。
summary.en: Algeria's National Liberation Front launched an anticolonial war that expanded through rural insurgency, urban operations and French repression. Torture, displacement and civilian deaths accompanied the conflict, which also generated political crisis in France. The Évian agreements and an independence referendum ended French rule, leaving the new state to confront reconstruction and the war's legacies.

significance.zh: 阿尔及利亚独立成为非洲去殖民化的重要胜利，也深刻改变法国的政治与社会。
significance.en: Algerian independence was a major decolonization victory with profound consequences for Algeria and France.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Algerian independence

title.zh: 万隆会议

summary.zh: 来自亚洲与非洲的二十九个国家和地区代表在万隆会面，讨论殖民主义、和平共处、经济合作与种族歧视。与会者的政治制度和国际立场各不相同，却共同强调主权与平等。会议扩大了新独立国家的外交联系，为后来不结盟运动及全球南方合作提供重要经验和象征资源。
summary.en: Representatives from twenty-nine Asian and African countries met at Bandung to discuss colonialism, peaceful coexistence, economic cooperation and racial discrimination. Despite different political systems and international alignments, participants emphasized sovereignty and equality. The conference strengthened diplomatic links among newly independent states and supplied experience and symbolism for later nonalignment and South–South cooperation.

significance.zh: 万隆使亚非国家以集体姿态参与塑造战后国际议程。
significance.en: Bandung strengthened Asian and African states' collective role in shaping the postwar international agenda.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bandung Conference

title.zh: 南非《自由宪章》通过
title.en: Adoption of South Africa's Freedom Charter

summary.zh: 来自南非各地的代表在克利普敦召开人民大会，汇集群众提出的诉求并通过《自由宪章》。文件主张不分种族的政治平等、教育、劳动权利与更公平的资源分配。宪章成为反种族隔离联盟的重要共同纲领，连接基层动员与未来国家构想，后来也影响民主南非的宪法语言与公共讨论。
summary.en: Delegates gathered at the Congress of the People in Kliptown and adopted a charter based on demands collected across South Africa. It called for nonracial political equality, education, labour rights and fairer access to resources. The document became a shared platform for the anti-apartheid alliance and influenced later constitutional language and public debate.

significance.zh: 《自由宪章》把反种族隔离斗争同未来社会的权利与经济愿景联系起来。
significance.en: The charter connected resistance to apartheid with a vision of rights and social transformation.

sources.title: Nelson Mandela Foundation — Freedom Charter 60th anniversary

title.zh: 索尔克脊髓灰质炎疫苗试验结果公布
title.en: Salk polio vaccine trial results are announced

summary.zh: 大规模试验结果公布，确认索尔克研制的灭活脊髓灰质炎疫苗能够有效预防疾病。志愿者、家庭、医护人员和公共筹资共同支持研究，随后接种项目迅速扩展。疫苗改变了儿童与家庭面对瘫痪风险的处境，也推动生产质量控制和监测制度发展，成为现代公共卫生的重要实践。
summary.en: Results from a large field trial established the effectiveness of Salk's inactivated polio vaccine. Volunteers, families, health workers and public fundraising supported the research, followed by expanding vaccination programmes. The vaccine changed the threat of childhood paralysis and encouraged further development of manufacturing controls and surveillance within modern public health.

significance.zh: 有效疫苗把预防脊髓灰质炎转化为可大规模组织的公共卫生行动。
significance.en: An effective vaccine made polio prevention a practicable large-scale public-health undertaking.

sources.title: Salk Institute — About Jonas Salk

title.zh: 苏伊士运河国有化与苏伊士危机
title.en: Canal nationalization and the Suez Crisis

summary.zh: 纳赛尔宣布将苏伊士运河公司国有化，试图以运河收入支持埃及发展。英国、法国与以色列随后联合发动军事行动，但在国际反对、美国金融压力和联合国干预下撤退。埃及保住运河控制权，危机暴露传统殖民强国影响力的下降，也提高了纳赛尔和阿拉伯民族主义的地区声望。
summary.en: Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal Company to support Egyptian development. Britain, France and Israel then launched coordinated military action, but international opposition, American financial pressure and UN intervention forced withdrawal. Egypt retained control of the canal, while the crisis exposed declining European imperial power and strengthened Nasser's standing in the Arab world.

significance.zh: 苏伊士危机把经济主权、去殖民化与冷战力量关系集中展现出来。
significance.en: The crisis brought economic sovereignty, decolonization and Cold War power relationships into sharp focus.

sources.title: National Army Museum — Suez Crisis

title.zh: 加纳独立
