summary.zh: 黄金海岸在夸梅·恩克鲁玛及群众政党长期动员后，以加纳之名取得独立。选举、罢工、谈判和自治制度的发展共同构成权力移交过程。新国家把经济发展与泛非主义相联系，支持其他殖民地的解放运动，并在冷战竞争中探索自主外交及国家建设道路。
summary.en: The Gold Coast became independent as Ghana after sustained mobilization led by Kwame Nkrumah and a mass political party. Elections, strikes, negotiation and expanding self-government shaped the transfer of power. Ghana linked development with Pan-Africanism, supported liberation movements elsewhere and sought an autonomous role amid Cold War competition.

significance.zh: 加纳独立为撒哈拉以南非洲去殖民化提供了有力示范与支持中心。
significance.en: Ghana's independence supplied a powerful example and organizing centre for African decolonization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Independence of Ghana

title.zh: 斯普特尼克一号升空

summary.zh: 苏联发射斯普特尼克一号，使人造卫星首次进入地球轨道。卫星发出的无线电信号可在地面接收，展示了火箭技术跨越地表距离的能力。发射震动国际舆论，推动美苏增加航天、科学教育和研究投入，也为后来通信、气象观测和地球科学卫星的发展打开道路。
summary.en: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, placing the first artificial satellite in Earth orbit. Its radio signals could be received on the ground, demonstrating the capabilities of rocket technology. The launch intensified US–Soviet investment in spaceflight, research and science education, while opening possibilities for later communications, weather observation and Earth-science satellites.

significance.zh: 人造卫星开启了航天时代，使太空成为科研、基础设施与国家竞争的新领域。
significance.en: The satellite opened the space age and made orbit a new arena for science, infrastructure and state competition.

sources.title: NASA — Dawn of the Space Age

title.zh: 马来亚联合邦独立
title.en: Independence of the Federation of Malaya

summary.zh: 马来亚联合邦在吉隆坡宣布独立，东姑阿都拉曼出任首任总理。民族组织动员、跨社群联盟和同英国谈判共同推动权力移交，新宪法建立联邦与君主立宪制度。国家仍面对紧急状态时期的武装冲突及族群、发展议题，随后又同沙巴、砂拉越和新加坡组成更大的马来西亚联邦。
summary.en: The Federation of Malaya became independent in Kuala Lumpur with Tunku Abdul Rahman as prime minister. Nationalist organizing, a cross-community alliance and negotiations with Britain produced a federal constitutional monarchy. Armed conflict during the Emergency and communal and developmental questions continued, before Malaya joined Sabah, Sarawak and Singapore in the larger Malaysian federation.

significance.zh: 马来亚独立建立了半岛自主国家制度，并为随后马来西亚的形成奠定基础。
significance.en: Malayan independence established sovereign institutions on the peninsula and prepared the ground for Malaysia's formation.

sources.title: Parliament of Malaysia — General Information

title.zh: 阿契贝出版《瓦解》

summary.zh: 尼日利亚作家钦努阿·阿契贝出版《瓦解》，以伊博社会中的人物、制度和口述传统描写殖民进入前后的变化。小说把非洲人的经验与内部矛盾置于叙事中心，挑战欧洲文学中常见的单一非洲形象。作品经翻译和教育体系广泛传播，成为现代非洲文学及殖民历史讨论的重要文本。
summary.en: Nigerian writer Chinua Achebe published Things Fall Apart, portraying change in Igbo society through characters, institutions and oral traditions. African experience and internal tensions stood at the centre of the narrative, challenging reductive European representations. Translation and teaching carried the novel internationally, making it a major text in modern African literature and debates about colonial history.

significance.zh: 小说扩大了非洲作者讲述自身历史的世界影响，并推动现代非洲文学传播。
significance.en: The novel expanded the global reach of African historical perspectives and modern African literature.

sources.title: Oxford Academic — Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart: A Casebook

title.zh: “非洲年”与联合国非殖民化宣言
title.en: Year of Africa and the UN decolonization declaration

summary.zh: 十七个非洲国家在同一年获得独立，使殖民帝国迅速收缩。各地解放过程包括谈判、群众动员与武装斗争，国家建设条件差异显著。联合国大会同时通过给予殖民地国家和人民独立的宣言，扩大自决原则的国际地位；新国家也开始在发展、边界和冷战竞争中寻求共同立场。
summary.en: Seventeen African countries became independent in one year, dramatically reducing European colonial rule. Negotiation, mass organizing and armed struggle contributed in different settings. The UN General Assembly also adopted its declaration on independence for colonial countries and peoples, strengthening self-determination while new states confronted development challenges, inherited borders and Cold War pressures.

significance.zh: “非洲年”改变了联合国成员结构和世界政治重心，使去殖民化成为国际核心议程。
significance.en: The Year of Africa shifted UN membership and global politics, placing decolonization at the centre of international affairs.

sources.title: United Nations — Decolonization

title.zh: 绿色革命在亚洲扩展
title.en: Expansion of the Green Revolution in Asia

summary.zh: 二十世纪六十年代起，亚洲多地推广高产水稻和小麦品种，并配合灌溉、化肥、植保与农业信贷。科研机构、政府和农民共同推动增产，部分地区的粮食供给明显改善。技术投入也改变土地、劳动力和市场关系，收益分配、水资源消耗及生态影响逐渐成为农业政策的重要议题。
summary.en: From the 1960s, high-yield rice and wheat spread across parts of Asia alongside irrigation, fertilizers, crop protection and agricultural credit. Research institutions, governments and farmers contributed to substantial gains in production. These changes also altered land, labour and market relationships, bringing distributional questions, water use and environmental effects into agricultural policy debates.

significance.zh: 绿色革命提高了粮食生产能力，并重塑农业技术、国家政策与农村社会的联系。
significance.en: The Green Revolution raised food-production capacity and reshaped links among agricultural technology, government and rural society.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Expansion of the Green Revolution in Asia

title.zh: 加加林首次载人轨道飞行

summary.zh: 尤里·加加林乘东方一号进入地球轨道，完成首次载人航天飞行后返回地面。任务检验了人在发射、失重和再入过程中的基本适应能力，也集中展现苏联的火箭、控制与生命保障技术。成功飞行扩大了航天竞赛的公众影响，推动双方把更长时间飞行和月球探索纳入计划。
summary.en: Yuri Gagarin orbited Earth aboard Vostok 1 and returned safely, completing the first human spaceflight. The mission tested human survival through launch, weightlessness and return and demonstrated Soviet achievements in rocketry, control and life support. It intensified public interest in the space race and encouraged plans for longer missions and lunar exploration.

significance.zh: 人类首次进入太空，为载人航天的技术发展与国际竞争树立了里程碑。
significance.en: Human entry into space established a milestone for crewed exploration and technological competition.

sources.title: European Space Agency — 12 April 1961

title.zh: 古巴导弹危机

summary.zh: 美国发现苏联在古巴部署核导弹后实施海上封锁性质的“隔离”，美苏进入高度危险的对峙。公开威慑与秘密谈判同时进行，最终苏联撤回导弹，美国承诺不入侵古巴，并另行撤除在土耳其的导弹。危机显示误判与升级的风险，随后推动双方改善直接沟通及核风险管理。
summary.en: After discovering Soviet nuclear missiles in Cuba, the United States imposed a naval quarantine and confronted the Soviet Union. Public threats and secret negotiations produced Soviet withdrawal, an American non-invasion pledge and a separate removal of US missiles from Turkey. The crisis exposed escalation risks and encouraged improved direct communication and nuclear-risk management.

significance.zh: 古巴危机让核战争风险迫近现实，并促使超级大国发展危机管控机制。
significance.en: The crisis brought nuclear war close and encouraged superpower mechanisms for managing confrontation.

sources.title: US Office of the Historian — Cuban Missile Crisis

title.zh: 西萨摩亚独立

summary.zh: 西萨摩亚在长期毛运动和政治协商之后取得独立，结束新西兰的管理。第二次世界大战后，联合国非殖民化议程与本地自治诉求共同推动宪法和国家机构的建立。新国家把议会制度同萨摩亚社会传统相结合，成为太平洋岛国摆脱殖民统治的重要先例，也为区域合作增添新的自主声音。
summary.en: Western Samoa became independent after the Mau movement and prolonged political negotiation, ending New Zealand administration. Postwar decolonization and local demands for self-government supported constitutional development. The new state combined parliamentary institutions with Samoan traditions, establishing an important precedent for Pacific island independence and adding a sovereign voice to regional affairs.

significance.zh: 萨摩亚独立推动了太平洋去殖民化，并体现本地运动在自治进程中的力量。
significance.en: Samoan independence advanced Pacific decolonization and demonstrated the force of local movements for self-government.

sources.title: New Zealand Ministry for Culture and Heritage — Towards independence

title.zh: 第二次梵蒂冈大公会议

summary.zh: 天主教主教与其他与会者在罗马召开第二次梵蒂冈大公会议，讨论教会同现代社会的关系。会议推动礼仪更新、平信徒参与以及同其他基督教派和宗教的对话，并重新表述宗教自由等议题。各地教会随后以不同方式落实改革，围绕传统、权威和变化速度的讨论持续展开。
summary.en: The Second Vatican Council brought bishops and other participants to Rome to reconsider the Catholic Church's relationship with the modern world. It encouraged liturgical renewal, lay participation and dialogue with other Christians and religions, while addressing religious freedom. Implementation varied across local churches and generated continuing discussion about tradition, authority and reform.

significance.zh: 梵二会议重塑了现代天主教的礼仪、公共角色与跨宗教关系。
significance.en: Vatican II reshaped modern Catholic worship, public engagement and relations with other religions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Second Vatican Council

title.zh: 非洲统一组织成立
title.en: Foundation of the Organization of African Unity

summary.zh: 三十二个独立非洲国家在亚的斯亚贝巴成立非洲统一组织，寻求在去殖民化、反对种族隔离和国际外交中加强合作。成员强调主权平等与领土完整，同时面对泛非团结和国家自主之间的张力。组织支持解放运动并协调多边立场，为后来非洲联盟的制度发展积累经验。
summary.en: Thirty-two independent African states established the Organization of African Unity in Addis Ababa to cooperate on decolonization, opposition to apartheid and international affairs. Members emphasized sovereign equality and territorial integrity while negotiating tensions between Pan-African unity and national autonomy. The organization supported liberation movements and developed experience later inherited by the African Union.

significance.zh: 非统组织为独立非洲建立了持续的大陆合作平台。
significance.en: The OAU created a lasting continental platform for cooperation among independent African states.

sources.title: African Union — Overview and history

title.zh: 美国《民权法案》通过

summary.zh: 美国国会在长期民权运动和全国动员推动下通过《民权法案》，禁止公共场所、就业等领域的多种歧视，并加强联邦执行权。黑人社区组织、学生抗议、诉讼和领导人的政治协商共同促成突破。法律随后改变学校、工作与公共生活，而投票权、住房和经济不平等问题继续推动社会运动。
summary.en: Congress passed the Civil Rights Act after sustained movement organizing and national mobilization. It prohibited discrimination in public accommodations and employment and strengthened federal enforcement. Black community activism, student protests, litigation and political negotiation drove the breakthrough, while voting rights, housing and economic inequality remained central to continuing campaigns.

significance.zh: 法案为打击制度性种族歧视提供更有力的联邦法律工具。
significance.en: The act strengthened federal legal instruments against institutional racial discrimination.

sources.title: US National Archives — Civil Rights Act

title.zh: 新加坡独立

summary.zh: 新加坡结束与马来西亚的联邦关系，成为独立共和国。新政府面对市场规模有限、住房不足、就业压力和族群关系等挑战，逐步发展公共住房、工业投资、教育与港口服务。依托区域航运位置和国际贸易联系，新加坡在此后几十年形成具有重要金融和商业影响力的城市国家。
summary.en: Singapore separated from Malaysia and became an independent republic. Its government confronted a small domestic market, housing shortages, employment pressures and communal tensions, developing public housing, industry, education and port services. Regional shipping connections and international trade helped it grow over subsequent decades into an influential commercial and financial city-state.

significance.zh: 独立促使新加坡建立适应城市国家条件的经济与治理体系。
significance.en: Independence prompted Singapore to develop institutions and an economy suited to a city-state.

sources.title: National Archives of Singapore — Proclamation of Singapore, 1965

title.zh: 塞姆班电影《黑女孩》问世

summary.zh: 塞内加尔导演乌斯曼·塞姆班推出《黑女孩》，以一名赴法国工作的年轻女性为中心，描绘家庭劳动、种族歧视与殖民关系的延续。影片在达喀尔和法国空间之间展开，通过影像与内心独白呈现人物的孤立。它扩大了非洲电影的国际可见度，也展示电影作为社会批判和自主表达媒介的潜力。
summary.en: Senegalese director Ousmane Sembène's Black Girl follows a young woman working in France, examining domestic labour, racism and continuing colonial relationships. Moving between Dakar and France, images and interior narration convey her isolation. The film increased international visibility for African cinema and demonstrated its potential as a medium of social criticism and independent expression.

significance.zh: 《黑女孩》成为非洲电影史的里程碑，使后殖民经验进入全球银幕讨论。
significance.en: Black Girl became a landmark of African cinema and brought postcolonial experience into international film discussion.

sources.title: mk2 Films — Black Girl (1966)

title.zh: 达喀尔举办首届世界黑人艺术节
title.en: Dakar hosts the first World Festival of Black Arts

summary.zh: 塞内加尔在桑戈尔倡议和联合国教科文组织支持下举办世界黑人艺术节，邀请非洲及侨民世界的艺术家、作家与学者参与。音乐、舞蹈、戏剧、电影和展览共同构成文化交流空间。艺术节把新独立国家的文化建设同泛非认同相联系，也引发关于传统、现代性和黑人艺术表达的讨论。
summary.en: Senegal hosted the first World Festival of Black Arts under Senghor's initiative and UNESCO's auspices. Artists, writers and scholars from Africa and its diasporas met through music, dance, theatre, film and exhibitions. The festival linked cultural nation-building with Pan-African identity and encouraged debate about tradition, modernity and Black artistic expression.

significance.zh: 艺术节把非洲与侨民文化网络集中到新独立国家主导的国际舞台。
significance.en: The festival connected African and diasporic cultural networks on an international stage led by an independent African state.

sources.title: M HKA Museum — First World Festival of Negro Arts

title.zh: 东南亚国家联盟成立

summary.zh: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国在曼谷签署宣言，成立东南亚国家联盟。成员希望缓和地区对立，促进经济、社会与文化合作，并在冷战压力下维护自主空间。组织通过长期协商逐渐扩大成员和合作领域，成为东南亚处理区域关系及对外外交的重要平台。
summary.en: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand signed the Bangkok Declaration to establish ASEAN. Members sought to reduce regional tensions, promote economic, social and cultural cooperation and preserve autonomy during the Cold War. Through sustained consultation, the organization expanded its membership and activities and became a major platform for Southeast Asian diplomacy.

significance.zh: 东盟为东南亚建立了跨制度、持续协商的区域合作机制。
significance.en: ASEAN established a durable regional mechanism for consultation across different political systems.

sources.title: ASEAN — The founding of ASEAN

title.zh: 澳大利亚通过原住民相关修宪公投

summary.zh: 澳大利亚选民以压倒性多数支持修改宪法，取消联邦对原住民立法的排除，并废除人口统计中的排除条款。菲思·班德勒等活动者通过多年请愿和组织工作扩大支持，工会、教会及跨族群联盟共同参与。公投改变了联邦责任的制度基础，为后来的原住民政策和权利运动提供新条件。
summary.en: Australian voters overwhelmingly approved constitutional changes removing exclusions concerning federal lawmaking for Aboriginal people and constitutional population counts. Activists including Faith Bandler built support through years of petitions and organizing with unions, churches and cross-community alliances. The referendum changed the institutional basis of federal responsibility and created new conditions for Indigenous policy and rights campaigns.

significance.zh: 公投扩大了联邦政府的原住民事务责任，也展示社会运动推动宪制变化的能力。
significance.en: The vote expanded federal responsibility and demonstrated the capacity of social movements to achieve constitutional change.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Indigenous referendum

editorialNotes.zh: 公投涉及联邦立法权限与宪法中的人口统计条款。澳大利亚原住民的联邦投票权已在1962年扩展，1967年公投没有首次授予公民身份或投票权。
editorialNotes.en: The referendum concerned Commonwealth legislative powers and a constitutional population-counting provision. Federal voting rights had been extended in 1962; the 1967 vote did not first confer citizenship or voting rights.

title.zh: 阿波罗十一号载人登月

summary.zh: 阿波罗十一号从地球出发，阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林乘登月舱降落月面，柯林斯留在月球轨道。航天员采集样本、布置实验并安全返回，任务依赖庞大的工程、计算和地面支持网络。电视传播使登月成为全球共同观看的事件，也把冷战技术竞争与人类探索的想象联系起来。
summary.en: Apollo 11 carried astronauts to the Moon, where Armstrong and Aldrin landed while Collins remained in lunar orbit. Samples, experiments and a safe return depended on extensive engineering, computing and ground-support networks. Television made the landing a shared global event that linked Cold War technological competition with wider aspirations for human exploration.

significance.zh: 首次载人登月展示复杂工程协作的能力，并开启直接研究月面的新阶段。
significance.en: The first crewed lunar landing demonstrated complex engineering coordination and enabled direct exploration of the Moon.

sources.title: NASA — Apollo 11

title.zh: 斐济取得独立

summary.zh: 斐济在伦敦宪政会议和主要政党协商后取得独立，以自治领身份结束英国殖民统治。新议会制度需要协调原住民斐济人与印度裔居民等群体的代表权，并处理土地、农业与经济发展问题。独立扩大了斐济参与地区外交和国际组织的空间，其政治安排也在后续社会变化中持续受到考验。
summary.en: Fiji became independent after constitutional talks in London and agreement between major parties. Its parliamentary system had to address representation among Indigenous Fijians, Indo-Fijians and other communities, alongside land, agriculture and development. Independence expanded regional and international participation, while the political settlement faced continuing tests as society and power relationships changed.

significance.zh: 斐济独立是太平洋国家建设的重要阶段，并把多族群代表权置于宪政核心。
significance.en: Fijian independence advanced Pacific state-building and placed multiethnic representation at the centre of constitutional politics.

sources.title: Parliament of the Republic of Fiji — Our Story

title.zh: 孟加拉国独立战争

summary.zh: 东巴基斯坦选举结果引发的权力危机升级为军队镇压与独立战争，大量平民被杀害或逃往印度。孟加拉民族主义者组织抵抗，印度随后直接参战，巴基斯坦军队于年底在达卡投降。孟加拉国独立后面临战争破坏、难民返回和国家重建，语言、政治代表权与民族身份成为其历史核心。
summary.en: A crisis over electoral power in East Pakistan escalated into military repression and a war of independence. Civilians suffered mass killing and displacement, with many fleeing to India. Bengali resistance and later Indian military intervention ended in Pakistani surrender at Dhaka, leaving independent Bangladesh to rebuild after devastation and refugee movements.

significance.zh: 孟加拉国的诞生重绘南亚政治地图，并彰显语言与政治代表权在民族动员中的力量。
significance.en: Bangladesh's emergence redrew South Asia and demonstrated the political force of language and representation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bangladesh Liberation War

title.zh: 南太平洋论坛首次召开
title.en: First meeting of the South Pacific Forum

summary.zh: 太平洋七个独立或自治国家的领导人在惠灵顿首次举行南太平洋论坛，讨论贸易、航运、电信和外交合作。会议为新兴岛国提供直接交流共同利益的空间，并决定继续定期会晤。论坛后来扩大成员及议题范围，使海洋资源、安全和气候问题能够以区域共同立场进入国际谈判。
summary.en: Leaders from seven independent or self-governing Pacific countries met in Wellington to discuss trade, shipping, telecommunications and diplomacy. The first South Pacific Forum gave emerging island states a direct setting for common interests and led to regular meetings. Its later expansion supported regional positions on marine resources, security and climate in international negotiations.

significance.zh: 论坛使太平洋岛国以更集中的区域声音参与国际事务。
significance.en: The forum strengthened the collective regional voice of Pacific island states in international affairs.

sources.title: Pacific Islands Forum — Wellington communiqué, 5–7 August 1971

title.zh: 《世界遗产公约》通过
title.en: Adoption of the World Heritage Convention

summary.zh: 联合国教科文组织通过《保护世界文化和自然遗产公约》，把文化遗产与自然环境纳入共同的国际保护框架。缔约国承担识别和保护责任，并可通过名录、基金与国际援助开展合作。公约逐渐改变遗产管理、旅游和公众认知，也使保护要求与社区生活、发展需求之间的协调更加突出。
summary.en: UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention, bringing cultural heritage and natural environments into a shared international protection framework. States assumed identification and conservation responsibilities, supported by a list, fund and cooperation mechanisms. The convention influenced heritage management, tourism and public awareness, while highlighting tensions among conservation, community life and development.

significance.zh: 公约使重要文化与自然遗产的保护成为各国共同参与的国际事业。
significance.en: The convention made the protection of significant cultural and natural heritage a shared international undertaking.

sources.title: UNESCO — World Heritage Convention

title.zh: 联合国人类环境会议
title.en: UN Conference on the Human Environment

summary.zh: 各国代表在斯德哥尔摩召开联合国人类环境会议，把污染、资源与人类发展问题带入全球外交议程。会议通过宣言和行动计划，推动联合国环境规划署建立。发达国家与发展中国家对责任、贫困和增长的不同关注也浮现出来，环境治理此后逐渐同发展、健康与国际公平相联系。
summary.en: The UN Conference on the Human Environment met in Stockholm, bringing pollution, resources and development into global diplomacy. Its declaration and action plan helped establish the UN Environment Programme. Different concerns about responsibility, poverty and growth emerged among countries, shaping later connections between environmental governance, development, health and international equity.

significance.zh: 斯德哥尔摩会议为现代全球环境外交提供了持续发展的制度起点。
significance.en: Stockholm provided an institutional starting point for modern global environmental diplomacy.

sources.title: United Nations — Stockholm 1972

title.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚独立

summary.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚在逐步扩大自治并制定宪法后取得独立，结束澳大利亚的行政管理。新国家将语言和地方社会极其多样的地区纳入议会制度，面临交通、教育、资源分配与区域自治等挑战。独立使太平洋去殖民化继续推进，也开启围绕土地、矿产和国家认同的长期政治协商。
summary.en: Papua New Guinea became independent after expanding self-government and adopting a constitution, ending Australian administration. The new state brought highly diverse linguistic and local communities into a parliamentary system while confronting challenges in transport, education, resources and regional autonomy. Independence advanced Pacific decolonization and opened continuing negotiations over land, minerals and national identity.

significance.zh: 独立建立了巴布亚新几内亚自主治理的国家框架，并扩大太平洋岛国的国际参与。
significance.en: Independence established sovereign institutions and widened Pacific island participation in international affairs.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Papua New Guinea

title.zh: 越南战争结束

summary.zh: 北越军队进入西贡，南越政府投降，越南战争的主要战事结束。长期战争涉及殖民遗产、民族统一、革命政治和冷战干预，造成严重伤亡与生态破坏。越南随后统一，社会重建伴随人口迁移和政治整合；战争经验也深刻影响美国外交、反战运动以及整个东南亚地区。
summary.en: North Vietnamese forces entered Saigon and South Vietnam's government surrendered, ending the war's principal fighting. Colonial legacies, national unification, revolutionary politics and Cold War intervention had combined in a devastating conflict. Vietnam subsequently reunified amid reconstruction, migration and political consolidation, while the war reshaped American foreign policy and Southeast Asian politics.

significance.zh: 战争结束推动越南统一，并成为二十世纪反殖民战争与冷战干预的重要转折。
significance.en: The war's end enabled Vietnamese reunification and marked a major turning point in Cold War intervention.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — End of the Vietnam War

title.zh: 红色高棉统治与大规模暴行
title.en: Khmer Rouge rule and mass atrocities

summary.zh: 红色高棉夺取金边后强迫城市居民迁往农村，实行严酷的集体劳动与社会控制。政治清洗、处决、饥饿、疾病和强迫劳动造成大量死亡，族群与宗教群体也遭到系统性迫害。越南军队进入金边后该政权垮台，幸存者此后长期面对创伤、重建与追责，相关审判逐步记录暴行事实。
summary.en: After capturing Phnom Penh, the Khmer Rouge forcibly moved city residents into rural areas and imposed harsh collective labour and social control. Purges, executions, hunger, disease and forced work caused mass death, alongside systematic persecution of ethnic and religious groups. The regime's fall was followed by difficult reconstruction, survivor testimony and eventual criminal proceedings.

significance.zh: 红色高棉时期成为研究国家暴力、种族灭绝与转型正义的重要历史案例。
significance.en: The period became a major case in the study of state violence, genocide and transitional justice.

sources.title: Extraordinary Chambers in the Courts of Cambodia — Historical Context

title.zh: 澳大利亚北领地原住民土地权立法
title.en: Aboriginal land-rights legislation for the Northern Territory

summary.zh: 澳大利亚通过《原住民土地权利法》，为北领地传统土地所有者提出和获得土地权利提供法律机制。立法承接尤尔卡拉请愿、古林吉罢工等多年行动，把社区同土地的传统联系纳入正式程序。土地委员会和权利申请改变了国家、开发企业与原住民社区之间的协商关系，资源与文化保护议题进一步受到关注。
summary.en: Australia enacted the Aboriginal Land Rights Act for the Northern Territory, creating mechanisms to recognize traditional ownership and pursue land claims. It followed campaigns including the Yirrkala petitions and Gurindji strike. Land councils and claim procedures changed negotiations among governments, developers and Indigenous communities, bringing resource decisions and cultural protection into closer relation.

significance.zh: 法律承认传统土地联系，为原住民争取土地控制与文化延续提供制度工具。
significance.en: The law recognized traditional relationships to land and supplied institutional tools for ownership and cultural continuity.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Aboriginal Land Rights Act

title.zh: 索韦托学生起义

summary.zh: 索韦托学生走上街头，抗议种族隔离教育及强制使用南非荷兰语授课的政策。警方开枪造成学生死亡，抗议迅速扩展，并在南非多地引发持续抵抗。学生组织、黑人意识运动和社区参与共同加强反种族隔离动员，遇害者影像传播到世界各地，使政权的暴力受到更广泛谴责。
summary.en: Students in Soweto protested apartheid education and compulsory Afrikaans instruction. Police opened fire, killing demonstrators and provoking wider resistance across South Africa. Student organizations, Black Consciousness activism and community participation strengthened the anti-apartheid struggle, while images of the victims circulated internationally and intensified condemnation of state violence.

significance.zh: 学生抗议使新一代青年成为反种族隔离斗争的重要力量。
significance.en: The uprising established a new generation of young people as a major force against apartheid.

sources.title: South African History Online — 16 June 1976: Soweto Uprising

title.zh: 肯尼亚绿带运动成立
title.en: Foundation of Kenya's Green Belt Movement

summary.zh: 旺加里·马塔伊在肯尼亚妇女组织支持下发起绿带运动，回应农村妇女面对的燃料、饮水和土地退化问题。社区通过育苗与植树改善环境，并把生态工作同生计、组织能力和妇女参与联系起来。运动随后扩展到公共土地保护和民主权利倡议，使环保成为基层社会行动的重要形式。
summary.en: Wangari Maathai founded the Green Belt Movement with support from Kenya's women's organizations, responding to rural concerns about fuel, water and degraded land. Community nurseries and tree planting linked environmental restoration with livelihoods, organization and women's participation. The movement later expanded into defence of public land and democratic rights, making conservation a form of grassroots civic action.

significance.zh: 绿带运动把环境保护、妇女生计和公民参与整合为持续的社区实践。
significance.en: The movement joined environmental protection, women's livelihoods and civic participation in sustained community action.

sources.title: Green Belt Movement — Who We Are

title.zh: 中国改革开放启动
title.en: Beginning of China’s reform and opening

summary.zh: 中共十一届三中全会后，中国把经济建设置于更突出位置，农村改革、对外开放和企业制度调整陆续展开。家庭联产承包、经济特区、贸易与投资联系改变生产和就业结构。改革在不同阶段推进，带来快速增长、城市化和生活水平改善，也产生地区差异、环境压力与新的社会问题。
summary.en: After the Third Plenum of the Eleventh Central Committee, China gave greater priority to economic development and expanded rural reform, opening and enterprise change. Household farming arrangements, special economic zones, trade and investment transformed production and employment. Successive reforms generated rapid growth, urbanization and improved living standards alongside regional disparities and environmental pressures.

significance.zh: 改革开放把中国更深地纳入世界经济，并引发广泛的社会与空间转型。
significance.en: Reform and opening integrated China more deeply into the world economy and transformed society and settlement patterns.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Beginning of China’s reform and opening

title.zh: 伊朗革命

summary.zh: 伊朗反对巴列维王朝的抗议由宗教、自由派、左翼和其他力量共同推动，并在大规模示威与罢工中扩大。沙阿离境后，霍梅尼返回伊朗，君主制瓦解，伊斯兰共和国随后建立。革命联盟内部的竞争逐渐改变权力分配，新的宗教政治制度也重组了伊朗社会与对外关系。
summary.en: Opposition to the Pahlavi monarchy brought together religious, liberal, leftist and other groups through mass demonstrations and strikes. After the shah departed and Khomeini returned, the monarchy collapsed and an Islamic republic was established. Competition within the revolutionary coalition reshaped power, while new religious-political institutions transformed society and foreign relations.

significance.zh: 伊朗革命重塑国家与宗教的关系，并改变中东地区的战略格局。
significance.en: The revolution reconfigured state–religion relations and altered the Middle East's strategic landscape.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Iranian Revolution

title.zh: 世界宣布消灭天花

summary.zh: 世界卫生大会确认全球天花已经消灭，结束了这种疾病长期造成的死亡与社会创伤。成果来自国际合作、大规模接种、病例监测和发现疫情后围绕接触者开展的针对性行动。各国医务人员与地方社区的参与使传播链最终中断，也为后续疾病控制提供组织经验和公共卫生目标。
summary.en: The World Health Assembly certified the global eradication of smallpox after centuries of devastating disease. International cooperation combined vaccination, surveillance and targeted action around detected cases and contacts. Health workers and local communities helped interrupt transmission, creating a landmark example of coordinated public health and an influential model for subsequent disease-control efforts.

significance.zh: 天花成为首个经全球公共卫生行动消灭的人类传染病。
significance.en: Smallpox became the first human infectious disease eradicated through a global public-health campaign.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Smallpox

title.zh: 瓦努阿图独立

summary.zh: 新赫布里底群岛结束英法共同管理，以瓦努阿图共和国之名取得独立。殖民时期并行的行政和教育体系、土地争议及本地政治运动共同塑造了转型。沃尔特·利尼领导的新政府推动国家机构整合，并在太平洋地区倡导去殖民化与自主外交，群岛多样的语言和社区传统成为国家建设的重要基础。
summary.en: The New Hebrides ended Anglo-French condominium rule and became the Republic of Vanuatu. Parallel colonial systems, land disputes and local political movements shaped the transition. Walter Lini's government worked to integrate institutions and supported decolonization and independent diplomacy in the Pacific, while the archipelago's linguistic and community diversity remained central to nation-building.

significance.zh: 瓦努阿图独立结束了特殊的双重殖民管理，并增强太平洋地区的自主外交力量。
significance.en: Independence ended an unusual dual colonial administration and strengthened autonomous Pacific diplomacy.

sources.title: United Nations — List of former Trust and Non-Self-Governing Territories

title.zh: 格莱珉银行正式成立

summary.zh: 穆罕默德·尤努斯在孟加拉国开展的乡村信贷试验转变为格莱珉银行，为难以取得传统银行贷款的贫困居民提供小额信贷。服务逐渐以农村妇女为主要借款群体，把金融活动带入村庄与家庭生产。模式在国际上广泛传播，也促使研究者持续评估贷款条件、债务风险和减贫效果。
summary.en: Muhammad Yunus's rural credit experiment in Bangladesh became Grameen Bank, offering small loans to people excluded from conventional banking. Rural women became the principal borrowers as financial services reached village and household production. The model spread internationally and stimulated continuing investigation of lending conditions, debt risk and effects on poverty.

significance.zh: 格莱珉推动普惠金融成为国际发展议题，并带来对微型信贷效果的持续研究。
significance.en: Grameen made financial inclusion a major development issue and stimulated research into microcredit's effects.

sources.title: Grameen Bank — Introduction

title.zh: 《拉罗汤加条约》开放签署
title.en: Treaty of Rarotonga opens for signature

summary.zh: 太平洋国家在拉罗汤加缔结南太平洋无核区条约，把长期反核试验和环境保护诉求转化为区域规则。条约限制核爆炸装置及相关活动，并安排保障和履约机制。区域合作连接岛国对海洋、健康与主权的关切，随后生效的制度成为全球无核区网络的重要组成部分。
summary.en: Pacific states concluded the South Pacific Nuclear Free Zone Treaty at Rarotonga, translating opposition to nuclear testing and environmental concerns into regional rules. Restrictions on nuclear explosive devices and related activities were supported by safeguards and compliance arrangements. The agreement connected ocean protection, health and sovereignty and became part of the global network of nuclear-weapon-free zones.

significance.zh: 条约使太平洋地区以共同法律安排回应核试验与核武器风险。
significance.en: The treaty provided a shared legal response to nuclear testing and weapons risks in the Pacific.

sources.title: United Nations Treaty Collection — South Pacific Nuclear Free Zone Treaty

editorialNotes.zh: 条约于1985年8月6日开放签署，于1986年12月11日生效；此条目记录开放签署这一节点。
editorialNotes.en: The treaty opened for signature on 6 August 1985 and entered into force on 11 December 1986; this entry records its opening for signature.

title.zh: 切尔诺贝利核事故

summary.zh: 切尔诺贝利核电站四号反应堆在一次测试中发生爆炸与火灾，大量放射性物质释放到环境。人员疏散、污染清理和医疗应对持续多年，周边居民经历长期迁移与生活中断。事故暴露反应堆设计、操作和信息通报的问题，推动核安全合作，也影响苏联社会对政府透明度的讨论。
summary.en: An explosion and fire during a test at Chernobyl's reactor four released large amounts of radioactive material. Evacuation, decontamination and health responses continued for years, while residents faced prolonged displacement. The disaster exposed failures in reactor design, operations and information sharing, encouraging international nuclear-safety cooperation and debate about Soviet government transparency.

significance.zh: 事故使跨境核风险成为全球公共议题，并推动安全规范与信息合作。
significance.en: The disaster made transboundary nuclear risks a global public issue and strengthened safety cooperation.

sources.title: International Atomic Energy Agency — Chornobyl

title.zh: 越南启动革新政策

summary.zh: 越南在经济停滞、短缺与高通胀压力下启动“革新”，逐步调整中央计划和生产组织。随后农业经营、价格管制、私人经济以及外贸投资政策发生变化，家庭生产和市场交换得到更大空间。改革同教育、基础设施和国际联系的发展结合，推动经济增长与减贫，也带来新的区域与社会差异。
summary.en: Vietnam launched Đổi Mới amid stagnation, shortages and high inflation. Changes to agriculture, price controls, private activity, trade and investment gradually expanded household production and market exchange within continuing state direction. Combined with education, infrastructure and international integration, reforms supported growth and poverty reduction while generating new regional and social disparities.

significance.zh: 革新政策改变越南的经济组织方式，并推动其重新融入区域与全球市场。
significance.en: Đổi Mới transformed Vietnam's economic organization and reintegration into regional and global markets.

sources.title: World Bank — Trade reform in Vietnam: opportunities with emerging challenges

title.zh: 《蒙特利尔议定书》通过

summary.zh: 各国通过《蒙特利尔议定书》，逐步限制消耗臭氧层的化学物质。科学观测、产业替代技术与国际谈判共同推动协议形成，后续修订加强了淘汰要求，并为发展中国家提供支持。国家履约与技术转型逐渐降低相关物质排放，使保护臭氧层成为国际环境合作中的重要经验。
summary.en: Countries adopted the Montreal Protocol to phase out ozone-depleting substances. Scientific observation, alternative technologies and negotiation helped create the agreement, while later amendments strengthened controls and support for developing countries. Implementation and industrial change reduced emissions, making ozone protection an important example of sustained international environmental cooperation.

significance.zh: 议定书展示了科学证据、资金支持与可执行规则结合的环境治理成效。
significance.en: The protocol demonstrated the value of linking scientific evidence, financial support and enforceable environmental rules.

sources.title: UNEP Ozone Secretariat — Montreal Protocol

title.zh: 毛利语获得新西兰官方语言地位
title.en: Māori gains official-language status in New Zealand

summary.zh: 《毛利语言法》生效，使毛利语成为新西兰官方语言，并设立推广其使用的专门机构。法律承接社群长期行动和怀唐伊法庭对语言保护的建议，回应母语使用者减少的危机。语言地位、教育和媒体逐渐形成相互支持的复兴网络，文化传承也更明确地进入国家责任与公共生活。
summary.en: The Māori Language Act made te reo Māori an official language and established a commission to promote its use. Community campaigning and Waitangi Tribunal recommendations had responded to declining transmission. Recognition supported a wider revival through education and media, bringing language continuity more clearly into public life and the responsibilities of the state.

significance.zh: 语言立法把原住民文化复兴同公共制度和国家责任联系起来。
significance.en: Language recognition linked Indigenous cultural revival with public institutions and state responsibility.

sources.title: New Zealand Ministry for Culture and Heritage — Te reo Māori recognised as official language

title.zh: 柏林墙开放

summary.zh: 东德长期积累的经济与政治不满在大规模示威和人口外流中集中爆发。政府关于旅行规定的混乱发布促使民众聚集边境，检查站随后开放，柏林居民开始自由穿越隔离墙。开放成为东欧剧变的鲜明象征，并推动德国统一谈判，欧洲战后形成的分裂秩序迅速改变。
summary.en: Mass demonstrations and emigration intensified East Germany's political crisis. Confused announcements about travel rules brought crowds to border crossings, which guards then opened, allowing Berliners to cross the wall freely. The opening became a defining image of eastern Europe's transformations and accelerated negotiations toward German reunification and a changed European order.

significance.zh: 柏林墙开放使冷战分裂的象征失去作用，并加速德国与欧洲秩序重组。
significance.en: The opening dismantled a central symbol of Cold War division and accelerated Europe's political reorganization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Berlin Wall

title.zh: 万维网的提出与开放
title.en: Invention and open release of the World Wide Web

summary.zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在欧洲核子研究中心提出万维网方案，以超文本连接分散的信息。浏览器、服务器及统一地址和传输规则逐渐形成，研究机构随后开放相关软件供广泛使用。万维网借助既有互联网基础设施扩展，降低了发布与访问资料的门槛，并改变科研、商业、媒体与日常交流。
summary.en: Tim Berners-Lee proposed a hypertext system at CERN to connect distributed information. Browsers, servers, addressing and transfer conventions followed, and CERN made the software openly available. Built on existing internet infrastructure, the Web lowered barriers to publishing and retrieving information and transformed research, commerce, media and everyday communication.

significance.zh: 万维网使互联网更易被普通用户使用，推动全球信息传播的快速扩展。
significance.en: The Web made the internet more accessible and enabled rapid expansion of global information sharing.

sources.title: CERN — The birth of the Web

title.zh: 纳米比亚独立

summary.zh: 纳米比亚在长期解放斗争和国际外交后取得独立，结束南非统治。联合国过渡时期援助团监督选举与转型，新宪法和民选机构随后建立。独立进程涉及地区战争、冷战关系和难民返回，新的国家则面对殖民时代遗留的土地、收入与公共服务差异，开始推进自主治理与社会重建。
summary.en: Namibia became independent after a long liberation struggle and international diplomacy, ending South African rule. UNTAG supervised elections and transition as a new constitution and elected institutions emerged. Regional warfare, Cold War relationships and refugee return shaped the process, while the new state confronted inherited inequalities in land, income and public services.

significance.zh: 纳米比亚独立完成了南部非洲去殖民化的重要阶段，并成为联合国转型行动的关键案例。
significance.en: Namibian independence marked a major stage in southern African decolonization and UN-supported political transition.

sources.title: United Nations in Namibia — The UN's role in Namibian independence

title.zh: 人类基因组计划

summary.zh: 国际科研团队启动人类基因组计划，组织大规模测序、定位和数据共享，并逐步完成参考序列。自动化仪器、计算方法和跨国协作使研究能力迅速提高，项目也设立对伦理、法律和社会问题的研究。获得的资源推动疾病研究与生物技术发展，并使遗传信息的使用和保护成为公共议题。
summary.en: International teams launched the Human Genome Project to coordinate sequencing, mapping and data sharing toward a reference genome. Automation, computation and collaboration expanded research capacity, alongside study of ethical, legal and social implications. The resulting resources advanced disease research and biotechnology and intensified debate about the use and protection of genetic information.

significance.zh: 基因组计划把生命科学推进到大规模共享数据与系统研究的新阶段。
significance.en: The project moved biology toward large-scale shared data and systematic genomic research.

sources.title: National Human Genome Research Institute — Human Genome Project

title.zh: 苏联解体

summary.zh: 苏联在经济困境、制度改革和各共和国民族动员中陷入持续危机，八月政变失败进一步削弱中央权力。多个共和国宣布独立，领导人随后商定新的国家间安排，戈尔巴乔夫辞职，苏联于年底终结。解体重绘欧亚政治地图，核武器、经济联系和社会保障的重组成为继承国家面临的重大任务。
summary.en: Economic difficulties, institutional reform and republican national movements deepened the Soviet crisis, while the failed August coup further weakened central authority. Republics declared independence, leaders negotiated new interstate arrangements and Gorbachev resigned. Dissolution redrew Eurasia's political map and left successor states to reorganize nuclear responsibilities, economic ties and social protection.

significance.zh: 苏联解体结束了冷战的一极，并开启欧亚地区复杂的国家与社会转型。
significance.en: Soviet dissolution ended one pole of the Cold War and initiated complex transitions across Eurasia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Dissolution of the Soviet Union

title.zh: 吴哥国际保护合作机制建立

summary.zh: 柬埔寨结束长期战争后，国际社会建立吴哥保护与发展协调机制，由柬埔寨、联合国教科文组织及各国团队共同推进工作。考古、建筑修复、环境管理和人员培训逐渐衔接，古迹保护也需要兼顾周边居民生计与旅游发展。吴哥由此成为跨国文化遗产合作和战后能力重建的重要场所。
summary.en: After Cambodia's prolonged conflicts, an international coordination mechanism brought together Cambodian authorities, UNESCO and partner teams for Angkor's protection and development. Archaeology, structural conservation, environmental management and training were linked with questions of local livelihoods and tourism. The site became a major setting for heritage cooperation and the rebuilding of Cambodian professional capacity.

significance.zh: 吴哥保护展示了文化遗产修复如何参与战后重建与国际合作。
significance.en: Angkor's conservation demonstrated how cultural heritage could contribute to post-conflict reconstruction and international cooperation.

sources.title: UNESCO — International Coordinating Committee for Angkor

title.zh: 卢旺达反图西族种族灭绝
title.en: Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda

summary.zh: 卢旺达极端主义当局与民兵组织针对图西族展开种族灭绝，同时杀害反对暴力的胡图族及其他人。国家机构、宣传和地方网络被用于动员屠杀，国际社会未能及时阻止。卢旺达爱国阵线取得军事胜利后，难民危机、司法追责和社会重建持续展开，影响也波及邻近地区。
summary.en: Extremist authorities and militias carried out genocide against Rwanda's Tutsi population, also murdering Hutu opponents and others. State institutions, propaganda and local networks enabled organized killing, while international action failed to stop it promptly. The Rwandan Patriotic Front's victory was followed by refugee crises, accountability efforts and difficult reconstruction across the region.

significance.zh: 种族灭绝成为国际保护平民与追究大规模暴行责任的深刻警示。
significance.en: The genocide became a profound warning about civilian protection and accountability for mass atrocities.

sources.title: United Nations — Rwanda historical background

title.zh: 南非首次普遍选举与种族隔离终结
title.en: South Africa’s first universal national election

summary.zh: 长期反种族隔离斗争、国内动员和国际压力推动南非进入谈判转型。首次面向所有种族成年公民的全国选举后，曼德拉出任总统，新的宪政建设开始推进。政治权利实现重大扩展，社会同时面对土地、财富、教育与居住格局中遗留的不平等，转型正义和公共政策成为重建工作的核心。
summary.en: Long resistance, domestic mobilization and international pressure helped bring South Africa into a negotiated transition. Its first national election open to adults of all racial groups brought Mandela to the presidency and advanced a new constitutional order. Expanded political rights were accompanied by difficult work on inherited inequalities and transitional justice.

significance.zh: 普遍选举终结了种族隔离国家的政治基础，并开启民主社会重建。
significance.en: Universal elections ended apartheid's political foundations and opened democratic reconstruction.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — South Africa’s first universal national election

title.zh: 世界贸易组织成立
title.en: Establishment of the World Trade Organization

summary.zh: 世界贸易组织在乌拉圭回合谈判成果基础上成立，继承并扩展关税与贸易总协定的制度。新框架涵盖货物、服务和知识产权，并建立更系统的争端处理程序。成员国在降低贸易壁垒的同时，对农业、发展空间和规则公平持续存在分歧，全球化的利益分配因而成为重要公共讨论。
summary.en: The World Trade Organization emerged from the Uruguay Round, extending the institutional framework of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade. It covered goods, services and intellectual property and established a more structured dispute process. Members pursued trade liberalization while contesting agriculture, development policy and the distribution of globalization's benefits.

significance.zh: 世贸组织扩大了全球贸易规则的范围，并强化贸易与国内政策的联系。
significance.en: The WTO broadened global trade rules and strengthened their connection to domestic policy.

sources.title: World Trade Organization — What is the WTO?

title.zh: 香港主权移交
title.en: Transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong

summary.zh: 依据《中英联合声明》及《香港基本法》的安排，英国结束对香港的管治，中国恢复对香港行使主权，香港特别行政区成立。“一国两制”规定原有经济制度和生活方式延续，并建立新的宪制关系。主权移交连接殖民历史与新的治理阶段，也使自治、法律和身份议题持续受到关注。
summary.en: Under arrangements in the Sino-British Joint Declaration and Hong Kong's Basic Law, British administration ended, China resumed the exercise of sovereignty and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region was established. One country, two systems provided for continuity in economic and social arrangements within a new constitutional relationship, shaping continuing debates about law, autonomy and identity.

significance.zh: 主权移交结束香港的英国殖民管治，并确立特别行政区的宪制框架。
significance.en: The handover ended British colonial administration and established the constitutional framework of the special administrative region.

sources.title: Hong Kong Basic Law — Official text

title.zh: 北爱尔兰《贝尔法斯特协议》

summary.zh: 英国、爱尔兰及北爱尔兰主要政治力量达成《贝尔法斯特协议》，为长期冲突后的权力分享与合作建立制度。协议涉及民意同意原则、跨境机构、权利保障和解除武装等问题，并获得公民投票支持。执行过程反复受到政治分歧影响，谈判形成的框架仍为和平与争端处理提供基础。
summary.en: Britain, Ireland and major Northern Irish political parties reached the Belfast Agreement, establishing institutions for power sharing and cooperation after prolonged conflict. Consent, cross-border bodies, rights and disarmament formed central provisions, supported by referendums. Implementation faced repeated political difficulties, but the negotiated framework continued to support peace and dispute resolution.

significance.zh: 协议把敌对政治力量纳入共同制度，成为以谈判缓解长期冲突的重要案例。
significance.en: The agreement brought opposing political forces into shared institutions and became a major example of negotiated conflict resolution.

sources.title: UK Government — The Belfast Agreement

title.zh: 九一一恐怖袭击

summary.zh: 基地组织成员劫持民航客机，袭击纽约世界贸易中心和华盛顿附近的五角大楼，另一架飞机在乘客反抗后坠毁。袭击造成大量平民死亡，并改变美国及多国的安全政策。阿富汗战争、反恐合作、监控扩张和旅行安检随后发展，也引发关于战争权力、公民自由与国际责任的长期争论。
summary.en: Al-Qaeda hijackers attacked the World Trade Center and Pentagon with passenger aircraft; another plane crashed after passengers resisted. The attacks killed thousands and transformed security policy in the United States and elsewhere. War in Afghanistan, counterterrorism cooperation, expanded surveillance and travel screening followed, alongside disputes over civil liberties and international responsibility.

significance.zh: 九一一袭击深刻改变二十一世纪初的战争、安全政策与公共生活。
significance.en: The attacks transformed warfare, security policy and public life in the early twenty-first century.

sources.title: National September 11 Memorial & Museum — 9/11 primer

title.zh: 非洲联盟正式成立

summary.zh: 非洲国家领导人在德班正式启动非洲联盟，接续非洲统一组织的大陆合作工作。新组织在去殖民化经验基础上，更强调经济一体化、发展与和平安全，并逐步建立相关决策和执行机构。成员仍需协调主权、共同责任与资源限制，非盟由此成为非洲处理地区危机和全球议题的重要平台。
summary.en: African leaders launched the African Union in Durban as a successor to the Organization of African Unity. Building on decolonization-era cooperation, the new body placed greater emphasis on integration, development, peace and security and developed related institutions. Members continued to negotiate sovereignty, shared responsibilities and resource constraints while expanding continental coordination.

significance.zh: 非盟把泛非合作推进到更广泛的经济、发展和安全议程。
significance.en: The African Union broadened Pan-African cooperation across economic, developmental and security agendas.

sources.title: African Union — About the African Union

title.zh: 东帝汶恢复独立

summary.zh: 东帝汶在长期抵抗、联合国主持的全民投票与过渡行政之后恢复独立。此前投票后的暴力造成严重破坏与流离，国际维和和本地政治组织共同参与安全与制度重建。新政府接管国家机构，开始处理贫困、基础设施、司法和发展问题，独立进程也成为国际支持自决与国家建设的重要经验。
summary.en: Timor-Leste restored independence after prolonged resistance, a UN-organized referendum and transitional administration. Violence following the referendum had caused severe destruction and displacement, and peacekeeping and local political institutions supported reconstruction. The new government assumed authority while confronting poverty, infrastructure and justice challenges, making the transition an important case of internationally supported self-determination.

significance.zh: 独立结束长期外国统治与过渡管理，使东帝汶人民取得自主国家机构。
significance.en: Independence ended foreign rule and transitional administration and established Timorese sovereign institutions.

sources.title: United Nations — Timor-Leste independence celebrations, 20 May 2002

title.zh: 印度洋地震海啸

summary.zh: 苏门答腊外海发生巨大海底地震，引发海啸，摧毁印度洋多国沿岸社区。印尼、斯里兰卡、印度和泰国等地遭受严重伤亡，渔业、住房、交通与旅游设施大面积受损。国际救援和地方互助支持灾后重建，灾难也推动印度洋预警体系、风险教育和沿海防灾能力的建设。
summary.en: A massive undersea earthquake off Sumatra generated a tsunami that devastated coastal communities around the Indian Ocean. Indonesia, Sri Lanka, India and Thailand suffered especially severe losses to lives, homes and livelihoods. International assistance and local action supported recovery, while the disaster accelerated regional warning systems, risk education and coastal preparedness.

significance.zh: 海啸促使各国加强跨境灾害预警，并重视沿海社区的长期韧性。
significance.en: The tsunami strengthened cross-border warning cooperation and attention to long-term coastal resilience.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami

title.zh: 《联合国土著人民权利宣言》通过
title.en: UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples

summary.zh: 联合国大会在多年土著代表参与和谈判后通过《土著人民权利宣言》。文件涉及自决、土地、文化、语言和参与决策等权利，为各地社群提出主张提供共同参照。宣言的实施取决于国家法律、政策和社会行动，其原则逐渐进入遗产、资源开发、教育与土地争议的讨论。
summary.en: After years of negotiations involving Indigenous representatives, the UN General Assembly adopted the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples. It addressed self-determination, land, culture, language and participation in decisions. Its principles supplied a shared reference for community claims and increasingly informed debates over resource development, education, heritage and land disputes.

significance.zh: 宣言提高了土著权利在国际规范中的地位，并扩大土著社群的政治表达空间。
significance.en: The declaration strengthened Indigenous rights in international norms and expanded the visibility of Indigenous political claims.

sources.title: United Nations — Declaration on Indigenous Peoples’ Rights

title.zh: 肯尼亚推出M-PESA移动支付

summary.zh: 萨法利通信在肯尼亚推出M-PESA，让用户通过手机账户转账，并在代理网点存取现金。系统回应城市劳动者向家乡汇款的实际需求，以已有移动网络和社区商业网点扩大金融服务。此后支付、储蓄与其他业务逐渐接入，移动货币改变家庭、小商户和服务机构处理日常交易的方式。
summary.en: Safaricom launched M-PESA in Kenya, enabling transfers through mobile accounts and cash deposits or withdrawals at agents. The service addressed practical needs such as sending money from cities to rural families, using existing mobile networks and local shops. Payments and further financial services later expanded, changing everyday transactions for households, small businesses and institutions.

significance.zh: M-PESA成为移动通信扩大金融服务覆盖的有影响力案例。
significance.en: M-PESA became an influential example of mobile communications extending access to financial services.

sources.title: Safaricom — M-PESA: 17 years of transforming lives

title.zh: 全球金融危机

summary.zh: 美国住房信贷风险在证券化和金融机构之间传播，流动性紧张与银行损失逐渐升级为全球危机。雷曼兄弟倒闭后，市场恐慌冲击信贷、贸易和就业，各国采取救助、货币宽松与财政措施。危机暴露金融监管和风险定价的缺陷，复苏中的债务、分配与紧缩问题又带来长期政治影响。
summary.en: Risks in US housing finance spread through securitization and interconnected institutions, escalating into a global crisis. After Lehman Brothers failed, panic disrupted credit, trade and employment, prompting rescues, monetary easing and fiscal responses. Regulatory failures and mispriced risks drew scrutiny, while debt, distribution and austerity shaped the uneven recovery and its political consequences.

significance.zh: 金融危机显示跨国金融联系的脆弱性，并推动监管、宏观政策与公平议题的重新讨论。
significance.en: The crisis exposed interconnected financial vulnerabilities and reopened debates over regulation, macroeconomic policy and fairness.

sources.title: Federal Reserve History — Great Recession

title.zh: 尼泊尔建立联邦民主共和国
title.en: Nepal becomes a federal democratic republic

summary.zh: 尼泊尔民选制宪会议举行首次会议，决定废除君主制，建立联邦民主共和国。决定承接人民运动、内战结束后的和平协议和选举进程，使毛派力量及其他政党进入新的制度协商。此后制宪、军队整合、地方代表权与社会包容仍需长期谈判，共和转型由此展开新的国家重建阶段。
summary.en: Nepal's elected Constituent Assembly abolished the monarchy and declared a federal democratic republic at its first meeting. The decision followed popular mobilization, a peace agreement ending civil war and elections that brought Maoists and other parties into institutional negotiation. Constitution-making, military integration, representation and inclusion remained central to the subsequent transition.

significance.zh: 共和国的建立结束王朝统治，并把和平建设同联邦制和社会包容议题联系起来。
significance.en: The republic ended dynastic rule and connected peace-building with federalism and social inclusion.

sources.title: United Nations — Report of the Secretary-General on Nepal, S/2008/454
Office of the President of Nepal — History and Background

title.zh: 阿拉伯世界抗议浪潮

summary.zh: 突尼斯的抗议在长期失业、腐败与政治压制的背景下爆发，并通过新闻和社会网络影响多个阿拉伯国家。示威者要求尊严、工作与政治参与，各地政府和社会力量采取不同回应。部分政权被推翻，另一些地区走向镇压、改革或内战，区域秩序由此进入持续重组的阶段。
summary.en: Protests in Tunisia grew amid unemployment, corruption and political repression and inspired mobilization across several Arab countries. Demonstrators demanded dignity, work and political participation, while governments and social forces responded differently. Some regimes fell; other settings saw repression, reform or civil war, producing prolonged changes in regional politics and society.

significance.zh: 抗议浪潮打破既有政治稳定的表象，并凸显各国社会结构与国家回应的差异。
significance.en: The uprisings exposed deep political grievances and the importance of differing social structures and state responses.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Arab uprisings

title.zh: CRISPR-Cas9成为可编程基因编辑工具
title.en: CRISPR-Cas9 becomes a programmable editing tool

summary.zh: 研究者将细菌免疫系统中的CRISPR-Cas9机制转化为可按RNA序列定向切割DNA的工具。夏彭蒂耶、杜德娜及合作者的实验显示，改变向导序列即可重新指定切割目标。后续团队将方法扩展到细胞基因组，显著降低基因编辑门槛，并推动基础生物学、农业和医学研究及相关伦理讨论。
summary.en: Researchers adapted the bacterial CRISPR-Cas9 immune mechanism into a tool that could cut DNA at locations specified by RNA. Charpentier, Doudna and collaborators demonstrated programmable targeting by changing the guide sequence. Later teams extended the approach to cellular genomes, lowering barriers to gene editing and expanding biological, agricultural and medical research and ethical debate.

significance.zh: 可编程基因编辑加快了研究者检验基因功能和探索生物技术应用的进程。
significance.en: Programmable editing accelerated investigation of gene function and potential biotechnology applications.

sources.title: NobelPrize.org — Chemistry Prize 2020 scientific background

title.zh: 西非埃博拉疫情与跨国应对
title.en: West African Ebola epidemic and international response

summary.zh: 埃博拉疫情在几内亚被确认后，迅速影响利比里亚和塞拉利昂等地，医疗系统、家庭照护和日常经济受到严重冲击。医护人员、社区组织及国际机构通过隔离治疗、接触者追踪与安全安葬逐步阻断传播。危机暴露基层卫生资源不足和应急协调缺陷，也推动疫苗研究与卫生体系恢复。
summary.en: After Ebola was identified in Guinea, the epidemic spread widely through Liberia and Sierra Leone, disrupting health services, caregiving and economic life. Health workers, communities and international organizations used treatment, contact tracing and safer burials to interrupt transmission. The crisis exposed weaknesses in health infrastructure and coordination and accelerated vaccine research and system recovery.

significance.zh: 疫情强调可信社区合作与持续卫生投入在跨境传染病应对中的作用。
significance.en: The epidemic highlighted the importance of trusted community cooperation and sustained health-system investment.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Ebola outbreak 2014–2016, West Africa
World Health Organization — Origins of the 2014 Ebola epidemic

editorialNotes.zh: 事件名称与区间沿用世界卫生组织的“2014—2016年西非疫情”分期；回溯调查将最早传播链追至2013年12月的几内亚病例。
editorialNotes.en: The title and range follow WHO’s 2014–2016 West African epidemic designation; retrospective investigation traced the earliest transmission chain to a case in Guinea in December 2013.

title.zh: 《巴黎协定》通过

summary.zh: 各国在巴黎通过新的全球气候协定，将限制升温、加强适应和支持低排放发展纳入共同框架。协定通过各国自主贡献、透明度和定期盘点推动行动，同时强调资金与能力建设。此后实施围绕减排力度、化石能源、发展需求和责任分配不断展开，气候治理更深地进入经济与社会政策。
summary.en: Countries adopted the Paris Agreement to limit warming, strengthen adaptation and support low-emission development. Nationally determined contributions, transparency and periodic stocktakes formed its operating framework, alongside finance and capacity-building. Implementation brought continuing disputes over ambition, fossil fuels, development needs and responsibility, embedding climate governance more deeply in economic and social policy.

significance.zh: 《巴黎协定》确立了广泛参与、逐步提高行动力度的全球气候合作框架。
significance.en: The agreement established a broadly participatory framework for progressively strengthening global climate action.

sources.title: UNFCCC — The Paris Agreement

title.zh: 联合国可持续发展目标

summary.zh: 联合国会员国通过《二〇三〇年可持续发展议程》，以十七项目标统筹减贫、健康、教育、平等与生态保护。议程把发展任务扩展到所有国家，并强调不同目标之间的联系。政府、国际组织和社会团体随后以指标和规划推动落实，资金、数据能力及政策取舍成为实现目标的关键条件。
summary.en: UN member states adopted the 2030 Agenda with seventeen Sustainable Development Goals linking poverty, health, education, equality and environmental protection. The agenda applied to all countries and emphasized connections among goals. Governments and other actors developed plans and indicators, while finance, statistical capacity and policy trade-offs became central to implementation.

significance.zh: 可持续发展目标为多领域政策协调提供共同语言与可追踪的国际议程。
significance.en: The goals provided a shared language and measurable international agenda for coordinating development policy.

sources.title: United Nations — Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda

title.zh: 非洲大陆自由贸易区协定生效
title.en: African Continental Free Trade Area agreement enters into force

summary.zh: 非洲大陆自由贸易区协定在达到批准门槛后生效，随后在尼亚美启动运行阶段。成员通过关税减让、原产地规则和减少非关税壁垒，寻求扩大非洲内部贸易与区域价值链。制度建设还涉及服务、投资、基础设施及海关能力，实际贸易安排逐步落实，反映非洲经济一体化的长期努力。
summary.en: The AfCFTA agreement entered into force after reaching its ratification threshold, followed by an operational launch in Niamey. Tariff concessions, rules of origin and efforts against non-tariff barriers aimed to expand intra-African trade and regional value chains. Implementation required further work on services, investment, infrastructure and customs capacity within a long-term integration project.

significance.zh: 协定为非洲内部市场整合和跨境生产合作建立了大陆层面的制度基础。
significance.en: The agreement created a continental institutional basis for market integration and cross-border production.

sources.title: African Union — The African Continental Free Trade Area

title.zh: 新冠疫情被评估为全球大流行

summary.zh: 世界卫生组织于三月将新冠肺炎疫情评估为全球大流行，呼吁各国加强应对。病毒传播给医疗系统、学校、工作与国际交通造成广泛冲击，检测、公共卫生措施、疫苗研发和治疗研究迅速展开。疫情也暴露医疗资源与生活条件的不平等，并改变人们对全球卫生合作和社会保障的讨论。
summary.en: In March, WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic and urged stronger responses. Transmission disrupted health systems, schools, workplaces and international travel, while testing, public-health measures, vaccines and treatment research expanded rapidly. The pandemic exposed inequalities in resources and living conditions and reshaped debate about global health cooperation and social protection.

significance.zh: 这一宣布标志全球卫生应对进入新阶段，疫情的影响远及经济、教育与社会生活。
significance.en: The announcement marked a new phase of global response to a crisis affecting health, economies, education and society.

sources.title: World Health Organization — 11 March 2020 briefing

title.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰

summary.zh: 俄罗斯于二月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，把此前已经存在的冲突扩大为大规模战争。城市遭到攻击，大量平民伤亡与流离，能源、粮食和交通网络受到冲击。乌克兰组织抵抗，国际社会围绕援助、制裁和外交展开行动，联合国大会通过决议谴责侵略，欧洲安全秩序受到深刻挑战。
summary.en: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February, greatly expanding an existing conflict. Attacks on cities caused civilian deaths and displacement and disrupted energy, food and transport networks. Ukraine resisted, other states mobilized assistance and sanctions, and the UN General Assembly condemned the aggression, confronting Europe with a major security crisis.

significance.zh: 全面入侵改变了欧洲安全环境，并通过粮食、能源和外交联系产生全球影响。
significance.en: The invasion transformed European security and produced global consequences through food, energy and diplomatic networks.

sources.title: United Nations — General Assembly demands an end to the invasion and withdrawal

title.zh: 印度月船三号成功软着陆
title.en: Chandrayaan-3 successfully lands on the Moon

summary.zh: 印度空间研究组织的月船三号在月球南部高纬地区成功软着陆，维克拉姆着陆器随后释放智慧号月球车。任务开展地表温度、等离子体环境和元素等观测，验证着陆、导航与巡视技术。成功建立在前期月球任务和长期工程投入之上，使印度成为实现月面软着陆的少数国家之一。
summary.en: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 landed successfully at a high southern lunar latitude, and the Vikram lander released the Pragyan rover. Instruments investigated temperature, plasma and surface composition while demonstrating landing, navigation and mobility technologies. Built on earlier lunar missions and sustained engineering work, the achievement placed India among the few countries to accomplish a soft lunar landing.

significance.zh: 月船三号扩大了月球探索的参与者，也积累了后续深空任务所需技术。
significance.en: Chandrayaan-3 broadened participation in lunar exploration and developed capabilities for future deep-space missions.

sources.title: European Space Agency — Chandrayaan-3 landing

title.zh: 喀麦隆启动常规疟疾疫苗接种

summary.zh: 喀麦隆把RTS,S疟疾疫苗纳入常规儿童免疫服务，将此前在部分非洲国家试点的技术推向更广泛应用。卫生人员需要完成多剂接种、供应管理与社区沟通，并把疫苗同蚊帐、诊断和治疗结合。长期研发由此进入公共卫生服务的新阶段，为降低儿童患病和死亡负担增加了工具。
summary.en: Cameroon introduced the RTS,S malaria vaccine into routine childhood immunization, extending a technology previously piloted in several African countries. Delivery required multiple doses, supply management and community engagement alongside bed nets, diagnosis and treatment. Long-term research thus entered a wider stage of public-health implementation, adding a tool to reduce childhood illness and death.

significance.zh: 常规接种把疟疾疫苗研发转化为面向儿童的持续公共卫生服务。
significance.en: Routine delivery turned malaria-vaccine research into a continuing public-health service for children.

sources.title: WHO Regional Office for Africa — Cameroon malaria vaccine rollout
